article.articleHeadline: Đà Nẵng chủ động xử lý môi trường khi dịch sốt xuất huyết tăng cao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Da Nang Proactively Addresses Environmental Measures as Dengue Fever Outbreak Rises
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever is rising in Da Nang, Vietnam. As of 16 October 2026, the city reports nearly 4,400 dengue cases this year, up about 2.3-fold from the same period in 2025, and more than 300 outbreaks, up roughly 3.5-fold. The Khai Tay 2 hamlet, Ngũ Hành Sơn Ward, is among affected areas, prompting intensified vector control. Local health stations, ward authorities, and the city’s disease control center are conducting larviciding, spraying insecticides, and eliminating mosquito breeding sites at households to curb Aedes populations. Ongoing case surveillance and outbreak response are maintained, with community participation emphasized to remove larval habitats. Officials highlight a two-tier local government approach to assess risk, control mosquitoes, and sustain public awareness, especially amid irregular rain and sun patterns that favor mosquito development and dengue transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ダナンでデング熱流行増加に伴い環境対策を積極的に実施
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ダナン市でデング熱症例が前年比2.3倍に増加しているが、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生危機の明確な証拠はなく、地域的な季節性流行として当局が対応中である。
triage.notes: デング熱は毎年季節的に発生する疾患であり、症例数増加は報告されているが重症度や死亡者数についての情報はない。地元当局が主体的に対応しており、現時点で国際的な懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện ca bệnh sốt rét ngọai lai ở Quảng Trị: Điều trị kéo dài không khỏi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Imported malaria case detected in Quảng Trị: prolonged treatment fails to cure.
article.articleSummary: Imported malaria case detected in Quảng Trị, Vietnam: A female patient born in 1989 from Dân Hóa commune, Quảng Trị, who previously worked in Taiwan, presented with malaria after returning from Taiwan. She had malaria in March 2025 treated in Taiwan. On September 1, 2026 she developed fever with chills and sweats and was treated in Taiwan but not cured. Returning home on September 25, she sought private care without improvement. On October 7, 2026 she was admitted to Minh Hóa District Hospital, Quảng Trị for fever of unknown origin, then transferred to Hue Central Hospital that evening. Hue CDC conducted epidemiological tracing, rapid malaria testing, and blood smear microscopy, revealing Plasmodium falciparum trophozoites with parasitemia density ++. The Hue CDC classified this as an imported malaria case from Taiwan. Antimalarial therapy was initiated per Ministry of Health guidelines, with continued monitoring; no other household members reported malaria.

triage.headline_ja: クアンチ省で輸入マラリア症例を発見:長期治療でも治癒せず
triage.triage_reason: 単一の輸入症例であり、台湾からの帰国者における既知の個別事例。地域的拡大や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。
triage.notes: 本症例は台湾で感染し、ベトナム帰国後に発症した輸入症例として地元CDCにより適切に分類・管理されている。家族内二次感染報告もなく、地域内伝播のリスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreads to Kenya for the first time
article.articleSummary: Ebola spreads to Kenya for the first time. A second linked case has been reported in Kenya, a week after the country recorded its first death from the virus. Both cases trace to the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, which has caused more than 4,000 deaths—the largest Ebola outbreak in the DRC’s history. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccines or treatments, with mortality around 50 percent. Kenya’s linked cases illustrate cross-border transmission from the DRC outbreak, underscoring the outbreak’s severity and the lack of targeted countermeasures.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、初めてケニアに拡大
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模（死者4000人超）のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが発生しており、国境を越えてケニアへの感染拡大（死亡例含む2例）が確認された。ワクチン・治療薬が未承認のブンディブギョ株で致死率約50%と深刻。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし、DRCで発生したアウトブレイクの国境を越えた拡大事例として重要性が高い。ワクチン・治療薬未承認、致死率約50%という点から国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威として引き続き監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 新增1宗猴痘輸入個案　36歲患者潛伏期內曾在外地有高風險性接觸
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One new imported monkeypox case; a 36-year-old patient had high-risk exposure elsewhere during the incubation period.
article.articleSummary: One newly imported monkeypox case reported in Hong Kong on 16 October 2026: a 36-year-old man developed fever and sore throat on 10 October, with a widespread rash affecting the genital area, trunk, hands and feet. Deterioration prompted isolation at Queen Mary Hospital on 13 October; laboratory confirmation by the Public Health Laboratory Service. He had high‑risk exposure abroad during the incubation period. Epidemiological investigation continues, with reporting to the World Health Organization. Since August, Hong Kong’s monkeypox activity has risen; however, the first 15 days of October show a >60% drop in confirmed cases compared with September, while vaccine doses in early October rose >60% year on year. Since 2022, Hong Kong has 116 cases (91 local, 25 imported), all male. Of 23 cases since August, all reported high‑risk sex during incubation (with strangers or multiple partners, unprotected). Genomic analysis reveals identical sequences in some cases, suggesting multiple transmission chains among men who have sex with men.

triage.headline_ja: 新たに輸入エムポックス1例　36歳患者は潜伏期間中に海外でハイリスク接触
triage.triage_reason: 香港における輸入例の追加報告であり、既知のアウトブレイク（2022年以降116例）の一環。直近では症例数が減少傾向にあり、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、継続的な性的接触による感染拡大の可能性があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: WHOへの報告は通常のサーベイランス報告であり、IHR緊急性基準には該当しない。香港はMSM間での複数伝播チェーンが継続しているが、ワクチン接種増加・症例減少など管理体制は機能している。

article.articleHeadline: Hantavirus, tuberculosis o mpox, las diez infecciones que pueden cambiar el mundo en una década: "Van a venir con más rapidez"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hantavirus, tuberculosis or mpox, the ten infections that could change the world in a decade: "They will come more quickly"
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has caused 8,728 cases and 4,205 deaths over about five months, with a 48% fatality rate; diagnoses were delayed by a new Bundibugyo variant not detected by initial tests, hindering containment. Crimean-Congo hemorrhagic fever (CCHF) is emerging in Spain, transmitted by the Hyalomma tick; the country’s first human autochthonous case was in 2016 (Madrid, from a tick bite in Ávila), and since then 23 cases and 7 deaths have been recorded. The vector is widespread, raising concerns of endemic spread in Spain at levels seen in Turkey, where thousands of cases occur yearly. Seimc spokesperson Cisneros lists ten infections with major global risk—also including hantavirus, tuberculosis, mpox, dengue and avian influenza—and warns that outbreaks will continue and accelerate amid climate and policy shifts.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルス、結核、mpox──10年で世界を変えうる10の感染症「より速いスピードでやってくる」
triage.triage_reason: 記事中でコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが症例8,728件・死亡4,205件（致死率48%）、新規Bundibugyo変異株による診断遅延という重大かつ異常な内容が具体的に報告されており、確認のためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は複数感染症を扱う総説的な科学記事だが、DRCのエボラ出血熱に関する具体的かつ重大な数値（症例8,728、死亡4,205、致死率48%）が含まれており、既存の公式発表との整合性確認が必要。CCHFはスペインで発生しているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: 猴痘｜防護中心：確診數字降60% 防控策略初步有成效 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox | Centre for Health Protection: Confirmed cases down 60%; initial effectiveness of prevention and control strategies | am730
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox in Hong Kong: One imported case confirmed in a 36-year-old man with recent high-risk exposure abroad. Fever and sore throat began on 10 October, followed by a widespread red rash on the genitals, trunk, hands and feet; lab testing at Queen Mary Hospital was positive. The patient remains stable in isolation as epidemiological investigations proceed, with WHO notified. Since August, mpox activity rose sharply, but initial prevention measures show early gains: confirmed cases in the first 15 days of October fell by over 60% from the same period last month, while vaccine doses rose over 60% month-on-month. About 650 high-risk individuals have been vaccinated in the past month. The Yau Ma Tei Integrated Treatment Centre will add a vaccination slot next Saturday (24 October) from 10:00 to 13:00; high-risk individuals may call 8:30–17:00, Monday–Friday, to book.

triage.headline_ja: サル痘｜衛生防護センター：確診数が60%減少、防疫対策に初期的効果
triage.triage_reason: 香港における既知のmpoxアウトブレイクの継続報告であり、感染者数は前月比60%減少し、ワクチン接種も進展するなど対策が奏功している。新規性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められず、ルーチンのサーベイランス更新情報と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は香港における輸入症例1例の報告と、8月以降のmpox流行が制御策により改善傾向にあることを示す定期的な公衆衛生報告であり、新たな懸念シグナルとは言えない。

article.articleHeadline: 手足口病活躍程度上升　葉柏強：相信開學後衛生措施不足所致 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hand, foot and mouth disease activity is on the rise; Yip Pak-keung believes it is due to insufficient hygiene measures after schools reopen.
article.articleSummary: HFMD activity in Hong Kong is rising, with the Health Department noting significant upticks; in the first three days of this week, 9 outbreaks involving 24 people have been recorded. Professor Ye Boqiang, a pediatrician at HKU's Faculty of Medicine, says outbreaks have become more evident this month, especially in nurseries, kindergartens, and primary schools. He cites school reopening and insufficient hygiene measures, plus possible sleep deprivation or uneven nutrition, as factors lowering immunity and fueling school-based transmission. HFMD is usually caused by enteroviruses and is common in children, with peak seasons May–July and October–December. Incubation is about 3–7 days; early symptoms include fever, sore throat, and mouth ulcers. Some viruses, like Enterovirus 71, are not effectively killed by alcohol; handwashing with soap and water is recommended. Schools and care facilities should implement daily monitoring and routine sanitation, including thorough disinfection with properly diluted household bleach.

triage.headline_ja: 手足口病の流行が増加傾向、葉柏強氏は開学後の衛生対策不足が原因と指摘
triage.triage_reason: 香港での手足口病（EV71含む）の季節的な流行拡大であり、学校での通常対応レベルの事例。重症例や死亡の報告はなく、IHR基準・社会的関心ともに高くない。
triage.notes: 香港は中国(1814991)に含めて集計。季節性のHFMD流行で、重症化や死亡等の報告はなし。学校での通常の感染対策強化を呼びかける内容。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Cúm A/H1N1 diễn biến phức tạp ở TP.HCM
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A/H1N1 influenza situation is complex in Ho Chi Minh City.
article.articleSummary: Week 40 in Ho Chi Minh City (TP.HCM) saw a surge of acute respiratory infections, with influenza A/H1N1 (2009) predominating. Among 151 positive flu samples that week, 116 were A/H1N1pdm09, about 77% of positives, raising the year-to-date influenza tally to 397 cases. Overall respiratory cases reached 34,664 in week 40, up 64% from the four-week average, as seasonal change and school resumption are linked to transmission. The City’s Center for Disease Control (HCDC) has intensified surveillance, expanding sampling to 29 facilities and monitoring community clusters to identify trends and interventions. Preventive measures are urged: regular handwashing, covering coughs/sneezes, wearing masks when symptomatic, and seeking prompt medical care. Annual influenza vaccination is emphasized, especially for the elderly and those with underlying conditions.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市でA/H1N1インフルエンザの流行が複雑化
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザ（H1N1pdm09）の増加であり、既知の病原体で国際的拡大の兆候は乏しいが、症例数急増と当局の監視強化があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA/H1N1pdm09の流行で、既知の病原体株。HCDCが監視を強化しているが重症度や死亡者数の情報は記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Organização Mundial da Saúde pede vigilância após Quênia confirmar segundo caso de Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Health Organization urges surveillance after Kenya confirms a second case of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second Ebola case, a 39-year-old man infected with Bundibugyo ebolavirus, linked to the Congo outbreak. The first Kenyan patient, who had lived in the DRC, died in hospital on 5 October after arriving in Nairobi from Uganda on 3 October. The second case developed symptoms on 13 October among contacts in quarantine. The World Health Organization urged intensified surveillance but does not recommend travel restrictions at this time. More than 40 contacts—passengers and crew, airport staff, baggage handlers, immigration personnel, health workers, and family—are being tracked; most are in quarantine, with some under home monitoring. Six passengers remain unlocated due to foreign phone numbers. Since May, preparedness including port-of-entry screening has been reinforced; WHO donated about $70,000 in supplies and trained over 4,000 health workers. Priority is locating the final six passengers and monitoring contacts through the incubation period. Ebola transmission occurs via bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）、ケニアでのエボラ出血熱第2例確認を受け警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境し、二次感染例が確認されたため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの二次感染だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRCでの進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクを verified_locations として記載。ウガンダも経由地として言及されるが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Епидемијата на ебола во Конго е втората најголема во историјата: илјадници се мртви
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in Congo is the second largest in history: thousands have died.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bu dibugyo strain, is the second-largest in history with over 9,000 confirmed cases and more than 4,000 deaths. The epicenter remains Ituri, but transmission has expanded to North Kivu, South Kivu, Chopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, and now North Ubangi—the eighth province affected. In North Ubangi, two cases have been confirmed, though not yet officially announced; authorities report numerous suspected deaths in the Vipinda health zone near the Bas-Uele border, with samples sent to provincial labs and Kinshasa for analysis. Cross-border spread includes Uganda, which was declared Ebola-free in August, and Kenya, where a first case was reported earlier this month and a second case linked to the first has been documented.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行は史上2番目の規模：数千人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9000例超・死者4000人超の大規模エボラ流行が拡大を続け、ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境伝播も確認されておりIHR基準を複数満たすため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの拡大が記載されているが両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。北ウバンギでの2症例は未公式発表との記載あり、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : plus de 9 000 cas et 4 410 décès, un deuxième cas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: more than 9,000 cases and 4,410 deaths, a second case.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo strain) remains active five months after its declaration. As of 15 October 2026, the WHO reports 9,144 confirmed cases and 4,410 deaths across seven eastern provinces and 65 health zones, with Ituri Province accounting for more than 70% of cases. Transmission persists in Nord-Kivu and Haut-Uele, while areas see uneven progression—decreases in some zones are followed by rebounds elsewhere, hindering countrywide interruption of transmission. Ongoing challenges include delays in case detection, difficulties in tracing contacts, and limited access to care. Population mobility, insecurity, and insufficient ambulance transport further impede interventions, keeping healthcare capacity strained in North Kivu. The region faces cross-border risk after Kenya confirmed a second Ebola case on 14 October, a 39-year-old man related to the first patient, underscoring the need for strengthened surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 コンゴ民主共和国：症例9,000例超、死者4,410人、第2例確認
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱が大規模流行（症例9,144・死者4,410）を継続中で、ケニアへの越境感染も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニアでの症例確認は越境拡大の懸念を示すが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。5ヶ月にわたり流行が継続し、地域によって増減を繰り返し封じ込めが困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: 增一宗外地傳入猴痘個案　中心稱本月首15天個案大幅下跌六成
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One more imported monkeypox case; the Centre says the first 15 days of this month saw a 60% drop in cases.
article.articleSummary: One more imported monkeypox case in Hong Kong. The Centre for Health Protection confirms a 36-year-old male in stable condition. He developed fever, sore throat and widespread rash on Oct 10; after calling the hotline on Oct 13 he was hospitalized at Queen Mary Hospital and confirmed positive for monkeypox by laboratory testing. Exposure occurred through high-risk contact overseas during the incubation period. Epidemiological investigation continues, with reporting to the World Health Organization. Since August, local mpox cases have risen, prompting multi-pronged measures: detailed epidemiology, enhanced vaccination, and NGO partnerships to reach high-risk individuals and boost uptake. Early indicators show the first 15 days of October saw mpox diagnoses fall by more than 60% compared with September, while vaccine doses in the same period rose by over 60% month-on-month. The Centre will maintain targeted controls to protect public health.

triage.headline_ja: 輸入性サル痘症例が1件増加　衛生当局は今月前半15日間の症例数が前月比6割減と発表
triage.triage_reason: 香港での輸入例1件の追加報告だが、同時に症例数は前月比6割減と改善傾向が示されており、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や拡大リスクは低い。継続的なサーベイランス対象として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区はChina(1814991)に含めて集計。記事は症例数減少を報告しており、むしろ対策の効果を示す内容。WHOへの報告は継続中だが新たな公衆衛生緊急性は認められない。

article.articleHeadline: 台南增1例境外移入登革熱 誘卵桶捕獲逾76萬粒斑蚊卵
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tainan reports one new imported dengue fever case; ovitraps capture over 760,000 Aedes eggs.
article.articleSummary: Taiwan’s Tainan City reports one new imported dengue case in Yongkang District’s Xiqiao Li, a Vietnamese woman in her 40s who first entered Taiwan to work on 6 October and developed rash, headache, and muscle pain by 13 October; PCR confirmed dengue infection, the city’s 14th imported case. Authorities activated preventive measures including indoor/outdoor fogging, environmental cleanup, and vector-density surveys around the residence. Ovitraps captured over 760,000 Aedes mosquito eggs, with 1,785 neighborhoods meeting intervention criteria; 97,292 households were surveyed, uncovering 11,985 standing-water containers of which 222 were positive, and health education reached 53,076 residents. Nationally, Taiwan had 201 dengue cases by 15 October (14 local, 187 imported), with Vietnam the leading source, followed by Indonesia and the Philippines. Mayor Huang Weizhe urged healthcare providers and the public to enhance medical testing, rapid screening, and TOCC-based reporting to mitigate transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 台南で境外移入デング熱症例1件を追加確認、誘蚊卵器で76万個超のヒトスジシマカ卵を捕獲
triage.triage_reason: 台湾における境外移入デング熱の日常的なサーベイランス報告であり、対象国での発生事例ではなく、国際的拡大や異常性も認められない。
triage.notes: 本事例は台湾（対象国リスト外）における境外移入デング熱症例の定期報告。感染者はベトナム国籍だが、感染自体がベトナムで発生したことを示す記述はなく、台湾国内の媒介蚊対策活動が主題。ベトナム・インドネシア・フィリピンは台湾への輸入症例の由来国として言及されているのみで、当該国での発生拡大を示すものではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Jangan Diabaikan, Suara Serak dan Batuk Berkepanjangan Bisa Jadi Gejala Infeksi TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Don't Ignore It: Hoarseness and Prolonged Cough Could Be Symptoms of Tuberculosis Infection.
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) can involve the larynx and vocal cords, causing hoarseness that may accompany a persistent cough. Mycobacterium tuberculosis isn’t limited to the lungs; laryngeal TB can trigger voice changes, odynophagia, weight loss, reduced appetite, and night sweats. The main symptom is a cough lasting more than two weeks, with airborne transmission via droplets: a single cough may emit about 3,000 droplets containing up to 3,500 bacteria, and a sneeze can release 4,500–1,000,000 bacteria. Global data from WHO indicate TB sickens about 10 million people annually and causes about 1.5 million deaths. In Indonesia, the Ministry of Health (Kemenkes RI) mandates official diagnostics: Molecular Rapid Test (TCM), sputum smear (BTA), chest X-ray, and tuberculin skin test. Treatment spans six months with four antibiotics (e.g., rifampicin and isoniazid), provided free by the government; adherence is essential to prevent drug resistance. Seek evaluation for persistent hoarseness with cough.

triage.headline_ja: 無視してはいけない、嗄声と長引く咳は結核感染の症状かもしれない
triage.triage_reason: 結核に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、特定のアウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核の症状・診断・治療に関する一般的な啓発情報であり、特定の発生事例や異常な増加を報じるものではない。

article.articleHeadline: An Giang ghi nhận hơn 7.000 ca mắc sốt xuất huyết, 1 trường hợp tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: An Giang records more than 7,000 dengue cases, one death.
article.articleSummary: An Giang, Vietnam reports dengue fever exceeding 7,000 cases in 2026 to date, a 1.9-fold rise from 2025. Of these, 6,757 are mild with warning signs and 309 are severe; one death occurred in Mỹ Hòa Hưng. Children predominate: 3,619 of the mild cases are 15 years or younger (54%), and 229 of the severe cases (74%) are children. Clusters include Phú Quốc (1,032), Tịnh Biên (891), Chợ Mới (848), An Phú (769), Châu Phú (661), and Long Xuyên (594); several districts show declines. Officials warn the 2026 outbreak may persist from 2025, with transmission remaining high across numerous localities. Response emphasizes larval source reduction, proactive insecticide spraying, enhanced case and vector surveillance, virus typing, and stronger coordination with education. Separately, Da Nang reports 4,251 dengue cases, up 2.4x vs 2025, under close monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: アンザン省でデング熱患者7,000人超を記録、死亡1例
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで季節性デング熱が前年比1.9倍に増加し重症例・死亡例も報告されているが、風土病であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視する段階と判断。
triage.notes: デング熱はベトナムで毎年流行する風土病であり、今回の増加も季節的傾向の一環とみられる。重症例・死亡例があるため経過観察が必要。ダナンでも患者数増加が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Bệnh giao mùa gia tăng, nhiều trẻ em ở Huế nhập viện
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seasonal illnesses on the rise, many children in Hue admitted to hospital.
article.articleSummary: Seasonal illnesses are rising among children in Hue, Vietnam, with increasing hospital admissions. At Hue Central Hospital's Pediatric Center, respiratory and infectious diseases surged from early September 2026: 195 admissions in the first week of September and over 600 in the second week of October; outpatient visits rose from about 850 to more than 2,560. Common conditions include seasonal influenza, respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) infections, bronchiolitis, pneumonia, hand-foot-mouth disease, dengue fever, and gastroenteritis. Several children present with persistent high fever and fever-associated seizures requiring admission. Dr. Tran Thi Hanh Chan notes the rise through October and that younger children or those with underlying illnesses are most at risk. Hue’s Center for Disease Control has stepped up surveillance, coordinating with education authorities and healthcare facilities to detect suspected cases early and limit spread. Parents should monitor health, maintain hygiene, vaccinate fully, and seek care for prolonged fever, seizures, or breathing difficulties.

triage.headline_ja: 季節性疾患が増加、フエの多くの子どもたちが入院
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の呼吸器・感染症（インフルエンザ、RSV、手足口病、デング熱等）の増加による入院者数増加が報告されているが、特定の新興病原体や異常な拡大パターンは確認されず、現地当局による通常のサーベイランス強化対応の範囲内と見られる。
triage.notes: 複数の疾患（季節性インフルエンザ、RSV、手足口病、デング熱など）が混在しており、単一の明確な新興感染症シグナルとは言えない。フエ市当局が既にサーベイランス強化と教育機関との連携を実施しており、季節的な医療需要増加として管理されている模様。続報があれば経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo spreads to new province bordering CAR
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak has reached North Ubangi province, on the border with the Central African Republic, marking the eighth Congolese province affected. Officials told Reuters that two cases were recorded in North Ubangi, with suspect deaths in the Wapinda health area near Bas-Uele prompting testing. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or treatment; a first clinical vaccine trial is expected to begin in the DRC by the end of October, per the World Health Organization. The outbreak was declared on May 15 and, as of Oct 14, 2026, has reported over 9,000 cases and 4,441 deaths. Cases have also appeared in Uganda (Uganda declared Ebola-free in August) and Kenya (second case announced on Oct 5, a relative of the first patient who died Oct 5).

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ出血熱流行、中央アフリカ共和国と国境を接する新たな州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ(ブンディブギョ株)がDRC内で第8州に拡大し、累計9,000例超・死亡4,441人、ワクチン・治療法なし、ウガンダ・ケニアにも波及しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす重大な公衆衛生事例。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国、ウガンダ、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRC国内での地理的拡大が主題。

article.articleHeadline: Les pays de la Cemac harmonisent une série de protocoles dans la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The CEMAC countries harmonize a series of protocols in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Six member states of the Central African Economic and Monetary Community (CEMAC) have harmonized eight Ebola prevention protocols, adopted at a Brazzaville meeting to counter an Ebola threat linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak that has persisted since May last year. The protocols cover epidemiological surveillance, contact tracing and monitoring, border entry controls, and risk communication, with the aim of preventing, early detection, and rapid response at the community level. Ludovic Fiomona, regional coordinator of the Central Africa Health Security Programme, praised the preparedness progress, noting a shift from panic to confidence. Dr Carole Bohimbo of Africa CDC emphasized coordinated regional action to enhance effectiveness. The Brazzaville gathering, supported by the World Bank and other partners, drew about a hundred health actors from the sub-region, and the countries pledged immediate implementation.

triage.headline_ja: CEMAC諸国、エボラ対策で一連のプロトコルを統一
triage.triage_reason: DRCで継続中のエボラ流行への地域対応協力に関する会議報告であり、新規感染拡大や新事例の報告ではないため、フルRRAの緊急性は低いが継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCで継続中のエボラ流行に対するCEMAC加盟国（コンゴ共和国、ガボン、カメルーン、中央アフリカ共和国、赤道ギニア、チャドなど）の地域的予防プロトコル調整会議についての報告であり、これら周辺国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。新規感染拡大の報告はなく、既存流行への行政対応に関するニュース。

article.articleHeadline: ACP : " Ebola : retrait de la riposte de 72 bénéficiaires de 700
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ACP: "Ebola: withdrawal of the response for 72 of the 700 beneficiaries."
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the Ebola response for the 17th outbreak faces transparency scrutiny as donor disbursements reach about $962 million, yet only roughly $200 million is documented on the ground, leaving more than $700 million with unclear traceability. Health Minister Roger Kamba announced on Oct 15 that of 97 implementing structures, 25 are accredited to operate on the ground; unaccredited entities are barred. Treasury has not received funds, and accreditation requires rigorous accounting and traceability of donor resources under government oversight. Separately, the political landscape is rocked by the Front for the Refoundation of the Nation (FRN) led by former president Joseph Kabila, with alleged Kagame influence and links to the AFC/M23, prompting security analyses and domestic backlash. Kinshasa’s government has also ordered the immediate ban of 13 political parties, including PPRD and LGD, amid suspicions of FRN ties.

triage.headline_ja: ACP：「エボラ出血熱：700人の受益者のうち72人が対応から撤退」
triage.triage_reason: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国における第17次エボラ対応の資金透明性・認定機関問題を扱っており、新たな症例数や死亡者数などの疫学的更新情報は含まれていないため、継続的な監視対象とする。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の第17次エボラ流行に関する資金管理・認定団体の問題と政治的動向（カビラ派政党禁止等）が中心で、疫学的な新規情報（症例数・死亡者数・拡大状況）は含まれていない。続報での疫学データ確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Trẻ mắc cúm gia tăng, bác sĩ cảnh báo những dấu hiệu bệnh chuyển nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rise in flu cases among children; doctors warn of signs that the illness is worsening.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam's National Pediatric Hospital reports a surge in influenza among children, with nearly 70 cases per week over the past two weeks, predominantly under 5 years old and many with pneumonia or bronchiolitis, and some with fever-related seizures. Experts warn that children with preexisting respiratory or cardiovascular conditions, those on immunosuppressants, or undergoing cancer treatment are at higher risk of severe disease. Influenza typically presents with high fever and upper respiratory symptoms (sneezing, runny nose, cough); fever can be prominent and last about three days, with most children recovering in roughly a week with appropriate care. Parents should monitor for persistent fever unresponsive to antipyretics, fatigue, poor appetite, or reduced activity, and seek medical evaluation promptly. Laboratory testing requires trained personnel to ensure safe sample collection and accurate diagnosis. Early recognition is key to preventing complications.

triage.headline_ja: 小児のインフルエンザ患者が増加、医師が重症化の兆候に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる小児患者の増加であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、重症例（肺炎・熱性痙攣）の報告があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザの通常範囲内の流行と考えられるが、小児の重症例報告が続く場合は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Les pays de la Cemac harmonisent une série de protocoles dans la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The CEMAC countries harmonize a series of protocols in the Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: Eight harmonized protocols in the Central African Economic and Monetary Community (CEMAC) strengthen Ebola response across member states, targeting epidemiological surveillance, contact tracing, border controls, and risk communication to prevent, detect early, and respond effectively to any community emergence of Ebola virus disease. Ludovic Fiomona, regional coordinator of the Health Security Programme in Central Africa, praised the readiness achieved, noting that months ago there was panic but now a shared mindset to face future outbreaks. Dr. Carole Bohimbo of Africa CDC’s Emergency Preparedness and Response unit said the coordinated regional effort will boost effectiveness and that preparation reduces impact, especially when done together. The Brazzaville meeting in Republic of Congo gathered about one hundred health actors with support from partners including the World Bank.

triage.headline_ja: CEMAC諸国、エボラ対応における一連のプロトコルを標準化
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は中部アフリカ経済通貨共同体（CEMAC）加盟国によるエボラ対応プロトコルの標準化・準備態勢強化に関する会議報告であり、実際のエボラ発生事例の報告ではない。対象国における実発生情報もない。
triage.notes: 会議開催地はコンゴ共和国（Republic of Congo）のブラザビルであり、対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは地域文脈として言及されているが実際の発生国ではないため除外。実際のエボラ症例発生に関する情報は記事中に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: ข่าวสาร : ผลงานวิจัยจากคณะสัตวแพทยศาสตร์ มหาวิทยาลัยเชียงใหม่ เรื่อง Quantifying ASF Outbreak Dynamics in the Philippines (2019-2023) Using Joinpoint Regression and the Estimated Dissemination Ratio ได้ตีพิมพ์ในวารสารวิชาการนานาชาติ Animals (Published: 7 September 2026) - มหาวิทยาลัยเชียงใหม่
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News: Research by the Faculty of Veterinary Medicine, Chiang Mai University, titled "Quantifying ASF Outbreak Dynamics in the Philippines (2019–2023) Using Joinpoint Regression and the Estimated Dissemination Ratio," published in the international scholarly journal Animals (Published: 7 September 2026) - Chiang Mai University.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreaks in the Philippines (2019–2023) are quantified in a Chiang Mai University veterinary study using joinpoint regression and the estimated dissemination ratio, published in Animals (Sept 7, 2026). Analyzing August 2019–December 2023 surveillance data, the outbreak peaked in September 2020, with the infection detection rate reaching 20.6% in 2020 and decreasing to 3.9% by 2023. The epidemic pattern shifted from a nationwide simultaneous surge in 2020 to localized, smaller, asynchronous regional transmission through 2023. The model identifies key change points in June, September, and December 2020, and August 2022, with notable late-year activity (September–November). Findings underscore the need for continuous surveillance, timely outbreak investigations, and adaptive, flexible control policies that respond to evolving epidemiology and dissemination dynamics.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース：チェンマイ大学獣医学部の研究「Joinpoint回帰と推定伝播率を用いたフィリピンにおけるASFアウトブレイク動態の定量化（2019-2023年）」が国際学術誌Animalsに掲載（2026年9月7日発行）
triage.triage_reason: 2019-2023年の過去データに基づく学術研究の発表であり、新規発生や現在進行中のアウトブレイクを報告するものではないため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去（2019-2023年）のASF発生動態を分析した学術論文の紹介記事であり、現在進行形の感染症イベントではない。発生地域にタイ（チェンマイ）とフィリピンが含まれるが、これは研究実施機関の所在地と研究対象地域であり、現時点での新規アウトブレイク発生国ではないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 俄羅斯就莫斯科州懷疑出現猴痘疫情展開流行病學調查
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia launches an epidemiological investigation into a suspected monkeypox outbreak in Moscow Oblast.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox outbreak investigation in Moscow Oblast, Russia. Health authorities confirm a suspected monkeypox case and have launched an epidemiological investigation with comprehensive prevention measures. Five contacts have been admitted for medical observation and remain asymptomatic. Moscow Oblast uses an in-house advanced testing system capable of rapid monkeypox detection, with laboratory confirmation being pursued. Past cases include a confirmed monkeypox case in February in Domodedovo, and two travelers returning from Thailand to Saint Petersburg diagnosed with monkeypox. The situation indicates potential local transmission with imported exposure; no deaths reported at this time. Authorities emphasize rapid detection, contact tracing, and isolation as key containment steps, and ongoing surveillance and diagnostics are in place.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、モスクワ州での猴痘(サル痘)疑い症例を受け疫学調査を展開
triage.triage_reason: ロシアでのMpox疑い例に関する報道であり、対象国リストに含まれる国での発生は確認されないため、フルRRAへの移行基準は満たさないが、流行拡大や越境リスクの観点から続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（モスクワ州、サンクトペテルブルク、ドモジェドヴォ）であり、タイは輸入症例の渡航歴として言及されているのみでタイ国内での発生ではない。対象国リストに該当する国での発生は確認されないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: La Banque mondiale débloque 93 millions de dollars pour lutter contre Ebola en Afrique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The World Bank Unlocks $93 Million to Fight Ebola in Africa.
article.articleSummary: World Bank commits 93 million USD to fight Ebola in Africa, with 80 million allocated to the Democratic Republic of Congo to modernize laboratories, intensify virus screening, and strengthen patient care, infection prevention, and community engagement. Since May, Congo has recorded 9,066 Ebola cases and 4,381 deaths across seven provinces: Ubangi-Sud, Tshopo, Bas-Uele, Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. In Ituri the funds will preserve maternal and neonatal health services to prevent increases in neonatal and maternal mortality and help keep schools safe. An additional 13 million USD will bolster regional preparedness and resilience in 11 other vulnerable countries. The effort follows a May alert from the Africa CDC; Uganda has eliminated Ebola, while Kenya recently reported its first imported case from Congo. Total World Bank Group funding for Ebola reaches 426.6 million USD.

triage.headline_ja: 世界銀行、アフリカのエボラ対策に9300万ドルを拠出
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で9,066症例・4,381死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が継続しており、ケニアへの越境感染例も発生しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダは終息宣言済み、ケニアで輸入症例1例を確認したが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。主要な流行地はコンゴ民主共和国の7州。

article.articleHeadline: Sốt cao kéo dài, tổn thương đa cơ quan sau khi bị mò đốt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prolonged high fever and multi-organ damage after being stung by mò.
article.articleSummary: 3-year-old boy in Phú Thọ province, Vietnam, diagnosed with scrub typhus (Orientia tsutsugamushi) after three days of persistent fever up to 40°C, paroxysmal cough, and nasal discharge. A small skin lesion on the left lower chest suggested a chigger mite bite (eschar). Laboratory testing confirmed scrub typhus, with multi‑organ involvement. After appropriate treatment, fever resolved by day 3 and the patient improved; the mite bite crusted without pus. Scrub typhus is transmitted by larvae of infected mites and can cause high fever, headache, myalgia, rash, and necrotic bite marks. Without timely management, it may progress to liver, lung, cardiovascular, nervous system, and renal damage. Bites are often tiny and hidden in areas such as armpits, groin, abdomen, or folds, making diagnosis challenging. Seek medical care for prolonged fever or rash after outdoor exposure and inspect all skin areas to aid diagnosis and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: 高熱が長引き、ツツガムシに刺された後に多臓器障害が発生
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムの一地域における単一の小児症例報告であり、地域的拡大や公衆衛生上の重大な影響を示す情報がなく、社会的関心の高まりも確認できない。
triage.notes: ツツガムシ病はベクター媒介性で人-人感染はなく、単発の小児症例報告のため流行拡大の懸念は低い。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Washington appelle à la retenue, au respect des engagements de paix et à la protection du personnel médical face à Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Washington calls for restraint, respect for peace commitments, and protection of medical personnel in the face of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: On Oct 13, 2026, during a UN Security Council session, U.S. Ambassador Jeffrey Bartos urged the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Rwanda to fully and promptly honor the Washington Agreements for Peace and Prosperity, seeking a ceasefire, end to drone strikes, and avoidance of incendiary rhetoric in the East of DRC and the Great Lakes region. He called for continued pressure on parties to implement commitments. He expressed deep concern about the ongoing Ebola outbreak in the DRC and emphasized safe, unimpeded access for health responders and protection of healthcare personnel and facilities. He praised humanitarian, security, and peacekeeping personnel operating under difficult conditions. The note comes amid continued fighting despite the Washington accords and Doha process addressing the Kinshasa–AFC/M23 conflict, with parties urged to implement provisions.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：ワシントンはエボラ対応をめぐり自制と和平合意の履行、医療従事者の保護を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 国連安保理の場で米国がDRCにおける進行中のエボラ流行への深刻な懸念を表明し、医療従事者の安全なアクセス確保を求めており、紛争下での対応の困難さから国際的関心と支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は外交的声明が中心で、具体的な感染者数・死亡数・発生地域などの疫学情報は含まれていない。DRCでのエボラ流行が継続中であることが確認されており、紛争地域での医療アクセスが課題となっている。続報でエボラの感染規模・拡大状況を確認する必要あり。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah Virus Vaccines Advance From Lab Platforms to Early Clinical Testing
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus (NiV), a highly lethal zoonotic Henipavirus causing outbreaks in South and Southeast Asia, most burdened by Bangladesh and India, features case fatality estimates of about 40–75% and documented person-to-person transmission. No licensed vaccine exists. A Frontiers in Drug Discovery review maps Nipah vaccine development across platforms—recombinant soluble G subunit vaccines, viral vectors, mRNA and DNA constructs, virus-like particles, and nanoparticles—with immunoinformatic multi-epitope designs and rapid manufacturing aligned to outbreak preparedness like CEPI’s 100 Days Mission. NiV uses G and F envelope glycoproteins for cell entry; these antigens are the main targets. Preclinical data in hamsters, ferrets, and African green monkeys show protection and robust antibody responses; single-dose protection has been reported for some viral-vectored candidates; mRNA/DNA platforms show strong immunogenicity. Phase 1 trials now assess safety and immunogenicity, though lack of validated correlates of protection and geographical antigenic variation remain key challenges.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルスワクチン、研究室プラットフォームから初期臨床試験へ前進
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はニパウイルスワクチン開発の学術レビューであり、現在進行中の発生・流行を報じるものではないため、シグナルとしての緊急性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発の進捗に関する研究レビューであり、具体的な現在進行中のアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。バングラデシュ・インドは過去の疾病負担の文脈で言及されているのみで、現時点での発生事例ではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Atwine Urges Border Leaders to Strengthen Ebola Preparedness
article.articleSummary: Uganda's Health Ministry Permanent Secretary Dr Diana Atwine urged district leaders along the Uganda-DRC border to strengthen surveillance and cross-border coordination against Ebola threats amid an outbreak in the DRC caused by Bundibugyo virus. Atwine presided over a high-level meeting with MPs and border districts to bolster preparedness and emergency response. The DRC outbreak has 9,212 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,441 deaths as of October 15, according to the CDC, and is the second-largest on record, with conflict, weak health infrastructure, and population movement hindering containment. Kenya has 2 confirmed cases and 1 death; Uganda reports no active cases. CDC warns frequent cross-border travel risks further spread. Uganda’s border communities rely on trade, travel, and family visits; thus coordination among health teams, local leaders, and security personnel is essential. Atwine urged vigilance and collective action to protect communities.

triage.headline_ja: アトワイン氏、国境地域の指導者にエボラ対策強化を要請
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去2番目の規模となるエボラ流行（9,212症例、4,441死亡）が継続中で、既にケニアへの越境伝播も確認されており、IHR基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ケニア（2症例、1死亡）およびウガンダ（症例なし、国境警戒強化中）は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRCの流行は紛争・脆弱な医療インフラ・人口移動により封じ込めが困難な状況が続いている。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue-Carrying Mosquitoes Signal High Yellow Fever Risk in Northern Ghana
article.articleSummary: During the 2021 yellow fever outbreak in Ghana’s Savannah Region, 202 suspected cases were reported, with 70 laboratory-confirmed and 35 deaths (case fatality 17% among suspected, 50% among confirmed). An entomological study found dense Aedes aegypti populations, dominated by the sylvatic formosus, in container-breeding settings that exceeded WHO outbreak thresholds. Mosquitoes collected during the response tested negative for yellow fever virus, highlighting transmission risk despite the absence of detected virus in vectors. The larval survey examined 12,264 containers, yielding 3,885 larvae and 1,186 pupae across 173 positive containers (container positivity 1.26%; house positivity 12.99% across 1,001 houses). WHO indices (House, Container, Breteau, Pupal Demographic) surpassed epidemic-risk levels. Breeding sites were mainly plastic (46.95%) and metallic containers (43.32%), with clay jars (5.42%), discarded tires (4.06%), and open wells (0.24%). Implications: high vector density raises transmission potential and calls for intensified surveillance in West Africa.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱媒介蚊が北部ガーナの黄熱病流行地域で高リスクを示唆
triage.triage_reason: 2021年の過去の黄熱病流行データに基づく昆虫学的調査の報告であり、現在進行中の新規アウトブレイクではないが、媒介蚊密度が高くWHO基準を超えているため今後の流行可能性として注視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は2021年のガーナ・サバンナ地域における黄熱病流行の事後的な昆虫学的調査報告であり、現時点での新規症例発生を示すものではない。ただし媒介蚊密度がWHO基準を超えており、西アフリカでの監視強化が必要と結論づけられている。米国ジョージア州は研究機関・出版元の所在地であり発生地域ではない。アンゴラはサマリー中に言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Halálos vírus dúl Európában, Szerbiába is megérkezett
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A deadly virus is ravaging Europe, and has also reached Serbia.
article.articleSummary: West Nile virus is spreading at record levels across the European Union and has reached Serbia. This year the EU reports 1,715 cases and 130 deaths, with Italy (748), Greece (445), and France (144) most affected; the Netherlands has 10 deaths and Hungary one. In Serbia, June 1–October 11 yields 59 West Nile fever cases, of which 49 are neuroinvasive. Belgrade City accounts for 23 cases; five new infections include three from the capital. The patients are 35 men and 23 women, average age 64. The virus has been detected in 12 Serbian districts: Belgrade City (23), South Bačka (9), Šumadija (7), Central Banat (6), South Banat (4), North Banat (2), Raska (2), Pomoravlje (2), West Bačka (1), Braničevski (1), Raška (1), and Kosovska Mitrovica area (1). Hungary reports exposure in Budapest, Bács-Kiskun, Csongrád-Csanád, and Pest. West Nile virus is asymptomatic in about 80% but can cause fever and severe neurological disease; mosquito-bite prevention is advised. ECDC cautions continued low-level transmission in coming weeks as summer ends.

triage.headline_ja: 致死性ウイルスが欧州で猛威、セルビアにも到達
triage.triage_reason: 欧州（セルビア、ハンガリー、イタリア等）での西ナイル熱流行に関する記事であり、対象国（ザンビア、フィリピン、タイ等）には該当しないため見送り。
triage.notes: 記事は欧州（セルビア、ハンガリー、イタリア、ギリシャ、フランス、オランダ）における西ナイル熱の流行を報じており、対象国リストに含まれる国は発生国として言及されていない（インドはBluedotの発生地域リストに含まれるが記事本文では言及なし）。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola spreads to eighth Congo province as young children face heavy toll
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola cases were confirmed in North Ubangi, the eighth province of the Democratic Republic of Congo (borders Central African Republic), though not yet officially announced by authorities. As of Oct 13, Congo reported 9,212 confirmed cases and 4,441 deaths across seven provinces, with the outbreak spreading from Bundibugyo first declared in May. MSF notes a heavy toll among children in North Kivu, where nearly a quarter of confirmed cases are under 5 and over half of those are infants; many pediatric infections may have occurred in ordinary health facilities before referral to specialized care. At MSF’s Ebola treatment centre in Butembo, 24 of 30 children admitted from June–September died, most under age 5, suggesting infection in healthcare settings due to weak infection control. The expansion to North Ubangi adds to challenges in containing the fastest-spreading Ebola epidemic in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ第8州に拡大、幼い子どもたちに深刻な被害
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が8つ目の州に拡大し、9,212症例・4,441死亡という深刻な規模であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダ・中央アフリカ共和国も含まれるが、記事はDRC国内での感染拡大（北ウバンギ州への拡大）を主題としており、これらの国での実際の症例発生は記載されていないため除外した。致死率が高く（約48%）、医療施設内感染による小児への深刻な影響が報告されている点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Vì sao tiêm vaccine ba ngày vẫn mắc tay chân miệng?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why do people still contract hand, foot, and mouth disease three days after vaccination?
article.articleSummary: HFMD was diagnosed in a 6‑month‑old in Ho Chi Minh City three days after an inactivated EV71 vaccine. HFMD incubation is typically 3–7 days, so infection likely occurred before vaccination. The vaccine uses inactivated virus and cannot replicate or cause disease, nor worsen symptoms. Fever soon after vaccination reflects immune activation; antibodies protective against HFMD begin about two weeks after vaccination and reach protective levels around four weeks once the full schedule is completed. The vaccine currently protects specifically against EV71, the main cause of severe complications and death, but HFMD can still be caused by other enteroviruses such as Coxsackie A16, A6, A10, which are usually milder. Monitor at home, maintain hydration, offer soft, cool foods, and avoid rupturing blisters; seek care for high fever, persistent irritability, vomiting, breathing difficulty, or tremors. After recovery, complete the vaccination schedule for long-term EV71 protection. Dr. Tran Huynh Tan, VNVC.

triage.headline_ja: なぜワクチン接種3日後でも手足口病に罹患するのか？
triage.triage_reason: 個別症例に関する医学的Q&A記事であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン接種後にHFMDを発症した乳児1例についての医学解説記事であり、集団発生や感染拡大の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: CHP continues to implement multipronged strategy to curb spread of Mpox
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports one imported Mpox (Monkeypox) case on Oct 16, 2026. Since August, mpox activity has risen; overall since 2022 Hong Kong has 116 cases (91 local, 25 imported), all male. The new case involves a 36-year-old man who developed fever, sore throat and a genital-to-trunk rash on Oct 10; he was isolated at Princess Margaret Hospital after CHP PHLSB confirmed Monkeypox. He reported high-risk sexual exposure outside Hong Kong during incubation. Genetic analysis indicates multiple transmission chains among MSM. CHP’s multipronged response includes expanded vaccination venues (two-dose protection reduces infection by 82%), with ~650 high-risk individuals vaccinated in the past month; new centre at CHP Building; Oct 24 session at Yau Ma Tei; NGO outreach; Mpox hotline 2125 2373 (9:00–18:00). Since Oct 1–15, cases fell >60% vs Sept; vaccination doses in first two weeks rose >60% vs Sept. Case will be reported to the WHO.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生防護中心(CHP)、サル痘(Mpox)の拡大抑制に向け多角的戦略を継続
triage.triage_reason: 香港での輸入Mpox症例は減少傾向にあり当局が既存の多角的対策（ワクチン接種拡大等）で管理できているが、MSM間での複数の伝播鎖が継続しているため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 香港特別行政区の事例はChina(1814991)に統合して計上。症例数は9月比で60%以上減少、ワクチン接種率は60%以上増加しており、当局の対応は機能している模様。WHOへの報告予定あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ново жариште на ебола во Африка: Вирусот стигна до осмата провинција во Конго | Скопско Ехо
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Ebola hotspot in Africa: The virus has reached the eighth province in Congo | Skopsko Echo
article.articleSummary: As of 16 October 2026, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) have reached North Ubangi, the eighth province affected, near the Central African Republic border. The Bundibugyo strain underpins what Reuters calls the second-largest Ebola outbreak in history, with over 9,000 confirmed cases and more than 4,000 deaths. Health authorities confirm two infection cases in North Ubangi, though an official government statement is pending. In the Wapinda health zone near the Bas-Uele border, several suspicious deaths prompted samples sent to provincial labs and Kinshasa. The epicenter remains Ituri, but cases are rising in North Kivu; infections have also been detected in South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele and South Ubangi. Cross-border spread concerns exist as Uganda previously faced spread and Kenya reports a second case in a close family member of the first patient.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカで新たなエボラ感染拠点：ウイルスがコンゴ第8の州に到達
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで9000人超の感染・4000人超の死亡を伴い8州に拡大、国境を越えてウガンダ・ケニアにも波及しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。中央アフリカ共和国との国境付近での拡大も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Trẻ mắc cúm gia tăng, bác sĩ cảnh báo những dấu hiệu bệnh chuyển nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rising influenza cases among children, doctors warn of signs that the illness is worsening.
article.articleSummary: Influenza infections are increasing among children at Hanoi's National Pediatric Hospital (Bệnh viện Nhi Trung ương) in recent weeks, according to reports published on 16 October 2026. The hospital has observed a rising trend in pediatric flu cases, with a portion of patients requiring admission for complications such as pneumonia, bronchiolitis, and febrile seizures caused by fever. Doctors warn that some cases show signs of worsening illness, underscoring the need for timely medical evaluation and close observation in young patients presenting with flu symptoms. The report highlights the ongoing influenza activity affecting children in Vietnam and the associated burden on one of the country's major pediatric care centers.

triage.headline_ja: 小児のインフルエンザ患者増加、医師が重症化の兆候に警鐘
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザによる小児患者増加と一部重症化事例が報告されているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の懸念は見られず、通常の季節性流行の範囲内と考えられる。
triage.notes: ハノイの国立小児病院における季節性インフルエンザの増加と肺炎・気管支炎・熱性けいれんなどの合併症例が報告されているが、通常の季節性流行の範囲を超える異常性や国際的な懸念材料は記事内に見られない。

article.articleHeadline: У РФ слідом за чумою -- спалах нової смертельної хвороби: під Москвою заражені люди
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Russia, in the wake of the plague — an outbreak of a new deadly disease: people infected near Moscow.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox outbreak near Moscow, Russia: as of 16 October 2026, Moscow region authorities report five people hospitalized after direct contact with an individual preliminarily diagnosed with monkeypox. All patients are under strict isolation and undergoing laboratory testing, with ongoing contact tracing and monitoring. Earlier spillovers in the area included a case at Domodedovo Hospital and a contact, and there have been cases among Russian tourists returning from Thailand diagnosed in Saint Petersburg, signaling recurring transmission. Monkeypox is a severe viral illness presenting with high fever, painful generalized rash, and lymphadenopathy, with potential fatal outcomes; transmission occurs from infected animals via bites or scratches and through close human contact. Separately, Irkutsk region reports a fatal plague case, prompting quarantines in several facilities. Officials urge reliance on information from Rospotrebnadzor.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペストに続き新たな致死性疾患の流行:モスクワ近郊で感染者発生
triage.triage_reason: モスクワ近郊のエムポックス集団発生とイルクーツクのペスト死亡例はロシア国内の事案であり対象国リストには該当しないが、タイ渡航者由来の感染例が言及されており、輸入感染の可能性として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる発生地はロシア（モスクワ近郊、サンクトペテルブルク、イルクーツク）であり対象国リストに含まれない。タイからの帰国者がサンクトペテルブルクでエムポックス陽性と診断された旨の記載があるが、タイ国内での発生を示すものではないためverified_locationsには含めない。ただしタイへの輸入感染リスクとして継続的な注視が望ましい。
