article.articleHeadline: HCM City sees hand, foot and mouth disease cases surge nearly 48%
article.articleSummary: HFMD in Ho Chi Minh City has surged 47.8% above the four‑week average, with 1,673 cases in the past week and 38,463 infections this year. Incidence exceeds 100 per 100,000 in Con Dao Special Zone and in Binh Khanh and Hiep Phuoc communes (former Nha Be district). At Children’s Hospital 1, 70 inpatients are treated for HFMD, four severe, with 100–120 daily outpatients; about 42% of cases are from Ho Chi Minh City, the rest from nearby provinces. HFMD causes red rashes and blisters on hands, feet, mouth, and buttocks/elbows, fever, feeding difficulties and drooling; some cases include mild diarrhea. Severe signs include high fever, irritability, and possible brainstem involvement with risk of respiratory failure. Adults may carry the virus (~10%) without symptoms; hygiene advised. Children’s Hospital 2 reports 40–50 daily HFMD admissions; 10–20% have respiratory symptoms; concurrent influenza suspected. City-wide ARI: 34,664 cases; 151 influenza positives, including 116 A(H1N1).

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市で手足口病の症例が約48%急増
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市で手足口病が平均より47.8%増加し重症例も報告されているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、季節的流行の範囲内とみられるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 手足口病（HFMD）の季節的増加に加え、インフルエンザA(H1N1)陽性例も報告されており、併発感染の動向を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: В РФ вслед за чумой -- вспышка новой смертельной болезни: под Москвой заражены люди
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Russia, in the wake of the plague, a new deadly disease outbreak: people infected near Moscow.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox outbreaks in the Moscow region near Moscow, Russia, have led to at least five people hospitalized after direct contact with a person preliminarily diagnosed with monkeypox. Medical authorities are isolating contacts under strict surveillance and conducting laboratory tests to confirm the diagnosis. This follows prior regional cases, including a confirmed patient in Domodedovo hospital and a contact exposure, plus tourism-linked infections in Saint Petersburg from Thailand. Monkeypox is a severe viral infection with high fever, painful body rashes, and swollen lymph nodes, and can be fatal. Transmission occurs from infected animals (bites or scratches) or through close person-to-person contact. The broader Russian epidemiological picture includes recent plague outbreaks in Irkutsk region, where a 28-year-old laboratory worker died after breaking a vial; quarantine measures were imposed in several facilities.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでペストに続き新たな致死性疾患が発生：モスクワ近郊で人への感染確認
triage.triage_reason: 発生国はロシア（モスクワ近郊・サンクトペテルブルク・イルクーツク）であり、監視対象国リストに該当しないため対象外と判断。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア国内（モスクワ州、サンクトペテルブルク、イルクーツク州）でのMpoxおよびペスト事例を報告。タイへの渡航歴が感染源として言及されているが、タイ国内での発生・流行を示す情報はなく、対象国として計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Bundibugyo Virus Disease Spreads: Why Is It Hard to Contain?
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has spread to seven provinces—Ituri, Haut-Uélé, Bas-Uélé, Tshopo, North Kivu, South Kivu, Sud-Ubangi—with 8,224 confirmed cases, 3,982 deaths, and 2,121 recoveries as of September 29, 2026. The May 15 outbreak in Ituri is described as the most severe Ebola-related outbreak in the DRC; authorities warn it is not under control. BV has no approved vaccine or specific treatment; case fatality is nearly 50%, higher than the 25–40% seen previously. Transmission occurs via contact with bodily fluids; infectious after symptom onset. Early symptoms are nonspecific (fever, headaches, abdominal and joint pain) with nausea and diarrhea as disease progresses. Protective gear limits high-risk work to about 1 hour per session; labs are limited, delaying results. Hot spots exist in Tshopo, including Kisangani clinics; fear, mistrust, and violence impede response; cross-border movement with Uganda adds transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョウイルス病の拡大:なぜ封じ込めが困難なのか
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で致死率約50%の大規模エボラ関連（ブンディブギョウ）ウイルス病流行が7州に拡大し、8000人超の症例・4000人近い死者を出しており、国際的拡大リスクと社会的関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダとの国境を越えた移動によって越境感染リスクが指摘されているが、現時点でウガンダ国内での症例発生は記載されていないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola s-a răspândit într-o nouă provincie din RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has spread to a new province in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola has spread to Nord-Ubangi, the eighth province in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) affected by the outbreak caused by the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus. The outbreak, declared in mid-May, has become the second-largest in history with more than 9,000 cases and over 4,000 deaths confirmed. Two infection cases have been confirmed in Nord-Ubangi, though not yet officially announced by Congolese authorities. Ituri remains the epicenter, with rising case numbers also detected in Nord-Kivu, and confirmed cases in Sud-Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele and Sud-Ubangi. A Nord-Ubangi health official noted recent deaths suspected in a mining region near Wapinda, near the Bas-Uele border, prompting laboratory testing in a provincial lab and Kinshasa. Beyond DRC, cases have been detected in Uganda (declared Ebola-free in August) and in Kenya, which reported its first infection in early October and a second case among a close family member on Wednesday.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がDRCの新たな州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が史上2番目の規模（9000例超、死者4000人超）に拡大し、新たな州への拡散やウガンダ・ケニアへの越境感染が確認されており、国際的拡大リスクが高いため。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし国際拡大の事実として notes に記載。ケニアで2例確認、ウガンダは8月にエボラ終息宣言済みだが越境感染リスクに留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Еболата се прошири во уште една провинција на ДР Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has spread to another province in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has spread to North Ubangi, near the Central African Republic border, with two confirmed cases in North Ubangi though government confirmation is pending. This marks the eighth DRC province affected by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak, which was first announced in mid-May and has grown into the second-largest Ebola crisis, with over 9,000 confirmed cases and more than 4,000 deaths. Ituri remains the epicenter, but cases are rising in North Kivu, and infections have also been reported in South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Lower Uele, and South Ubangi. A North Ubangi official cited recent deaths near the Lower Uele border triggering suspicion, with samples sent to a provincial lab and Kinshasa for analysis. Outside DRC, Ebola cases have been reported in Uganda (previously Ebola-free) and Kenya, where Nairobi recorded a first case earlier this month and a second case yesterday, a relative of the first.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国のさらに1州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCで8州目に拡大し、9,000例超・4,000人超の死者を出す大規模流行であり、ウガンダ・ケニアへの国際的拡大も確認されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ流行拡大が主題。ウガンダ・ケニアへの波及も言及されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemie eboly v Kongu se rozšířila do osmé provincie, obětí je přes 4300
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Congo has spread to the eighth province; death toll is over 4,300.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to its eighth province, North Ubangi, with the death toll exceeding 4,300. The epicenter remains Ituri in the northeast, but cases have risen in North Kivu and have been confirmed in South Kivu, Tshopo, Upper Uele, Lower Uele and South Ubangi. The virus has crossed into Uganda (previously Ebola-free since August) and Kenya, where two infections have been reported since early October, one fatality. Officials say the outbreak was officially declared in mid-May, though experts believe it began months earlier. It is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; there is no approved vaccine or targeted treatment. As of 2026-10-16, Congo reports at least 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths. Transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids of infected living or dead; symptoms include fever, vomiting and diarrhea, with possible internal and external bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が第8州に拡大、死者数は4,300人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行がウガンダ・ケニアへ越境拡大し死者数が4,381人に達しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大）に該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境感染が報告されているが、両国は本トリアージの対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。承認されたワクチンや標的治療法がなく、Bundibugyo ebolavirusによる流行である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ébola alastra a nova província da RDC junto à fronteira com a República Centro-Africana - O País - A verdade como notícia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak spreads to the new province of the DRC along the border with the Central African Republic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to Ubangi-Nord Province, near the border with the Central African Republic, bringing the number of affected Congolese provinces to eight. Authorities report two cases in the new province after a string of suspected deaths in the Wapinda health zone near Bas-Uele prompted testing for Ebola. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccine or treatment exists. The World Health Organization says the first vaccine clinical trial in the DRC is expected to begin by the end of October. Declared May 15, the outbreak has already caused more than 9,000 cases and 4,441 deaths. Cross-border spread has also reached Uganda, with cases reported, and Kenya confirming a second case linked to the first patient who died on October 5. The ongoing transmission raises containment and cross-border spread concerns.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク、中央アフリカ共和国との国境に近い新たな州へ拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱が複数州・複数国（ウガンダ、ケニア）に拡大しており、死者数も多く国際的拡大リスクが高いためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境拡大や中央アフリカ共和国国境付近への拡大が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。DRCのみが対象国として該当。ワクチン未承認（Bundibugyo株）、累計9,000例超・死者4,441人と規模が大きい点も特筆。

article.articleHeadline: TP.HCM họp khẩn vì 3 học sinh mắc bệnh do não mô cầu, 1 em tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City holds urgent meeting after three students contract meningococcal disease, one dies.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 16, 2026, three 12-year-old students from Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School in Hiệp Phước commune, Nhà Bè District, Ho Chi Minh City, have meningococcal disease caused by Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B; one died. On Oct 14, HCDC identified H.H.K., a seventh-grader, with meningococcal septicemia; PCR confirmed group B; he died the same day. Another student, N.A.B.M., was admitted to Hospital for Tropical Diseases with meningitis due to group B and is currently stable. On Oct 15, N.T.H.Q., a classmate, developed fever and was admitted; Oct 16 PCR confirmed group B meningococcal disease; he is stable and isolated. Health authorities ordered rapid epidemiological investigation, antibiotic prophylaxis for close contacts, and environmental cleaning; close-contact health monitoring for 10 days per MOH guidelines. Officials urge calm and warn against self-medicating antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市、髄膜炎菌感染症で生徒3人発症・1人死亡を受け緊急会議を開催
triage.triage_reason: 同一校内で髄膜炎菌感染症のクラスターが発生し死亡例も出ていること、行政が緊急対応（抗菌薬予防投与・濃厚接触者監視）を実施している点から、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当と判断した。
triage.notes: 同一中学校内で3名が血清群B型髄膜炎菌感染症と確認され、うち1名が同日死亡。保健当局は緊急疫学調査、濃厚接触者への抗菌薬予防投与、環境消毒、10日間の健康観察を実施中。現時点で国外への拡大や渡航・貿易制限の情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: 145 Warga Serpong Muntaber, Pasokan Air dari Perumahan Positif E coli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 145 Serpong Residents Suffer from Gastroenteritis; Water Supply from Housing Complex Tests Positive for E. coli
article.articleSummary: As of 16 October 2026, 145 residents of Perumahan Serpong Lagoon in Setu, Kelurahan Keranggan, South Tangerang reported gastroenteritis with vomiting and diarrhea, linked to the community water supply. Water from the housing complex’s water treatment plant (WTP) tested positive for Escherichia coli. Three samples undergoing laboratory testing showed E. coli in the reservoir (14), in a home with a filter (660), and in a home without a filter (956). The WTP water supply has been halted pending confirmation that water meets health standards; alternate clean water distribution will be provided with oversight by the Environmental Service (DLH) and Health Service (Dinkes). Investigations aim to distinguish whether contamination arises from the treatment process or distribution network, with actions including cleaning, disinfection, optimized chlorination, and pipe inspections. Administrative coordination with the operator and potential collaboration with Perumda Tirta Pakuan/PAM are ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: セルポン住民145人が下痢嘔吐症、住宅地の水道水からE.coli陽性
triage.triage_reason: 単一の住宅団地内で発生した水道水汚染による局地的な胃腸炎であり、既に地元当局（環境局・保健局）が対応・水供給停止などの措置を講じているため、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いと判断される。
triage.notes: 死亡例や重症例の報告はなく、原因究明と水道設備の消毒・修復が進行中。地域メディアの報道に留まり、国際的関心は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Deaths Hide in Unconfirmed Cases, 13-Year Philippine Surveillance
article.articleSummary: Davao City, Philippines, is the focus of a 13-year dengue surveillance analysis (2012–2024) using PIDSR data. Of 81,075 notifications, 59,021 were suspected, 20,559 probable, and 1,495 laboratory-confirmed. Most dengue deaths occurred among patients never laboratory-confirmed. Three distinct trend lines emerged: confirmed dengue incidence rose significantly over time (p=0.003), probable cases remained stable (p=0.855), and suspected cases declined (p=0.059). The increase in confirmed cases was uniform across all three congressional districts and across ages (children <15 and adults ≥15) and sexes, with hospital admission >90% across categories. Authors attribute rises to transmission dynamics, expanded diagnostic testing, and better laboratory capacity; the Department of Health formally recognized NS1 antigen positivity as laboratory confirmation in 2024, likely influencing long-term trends. Implication: reliance on lab-confirmed data shapes perceived dengue burden and mortality.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱による死亡は未確認症例に隠れている:13年間のフィリピン・サーベイランス研究が明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 過去13年間の疫学サーベイランスに関する学術研究であり、急性の公衆衛生イベントや新規アウトブレイクを示すものではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は2012〜2024年の過去データを分析した学術研究の紹介であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクを報じるものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Sprawdzili 102 miasta. Znaleźli ponad 40 tys. nieznanych wirusów
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: They checked 102 cities. They found more than 40,000 unknown viruses.
article.articleSummary: Analysis published in Nature Communications reports more than 40,000 RNA viruses circulating across 31 countries, including Brazil, the United States, Pakistan, and South Korea. Using 1,862 samples collected during the COVID-19 pandemic (March–July 2020) from metro stations, hospitals, banks, shops, soils, freshwaters, and sewage, the MetaSUB consortium applied metatranscriptomics and the geNomad tool to assemble viral sequences and infer relationships via RdRP phylogeny. The UPVAtlas RNA virus atlas emerges from this work, revealing considerable viral diversity, with many sequences divergent enough to prompt new classification. About one-third of sequences could be linked to potential hosts; over half are bacteriophages, including 166 phages that could infect four ESKAPE pathogens. Roughly 60 viruses show high potential to infect humans and 47 to infect other mammals, though this does not imply disease. Diversity was highest in sewage; lowest on streets and retail venues. City-level results should be interpreted cautiously due to sampling biases.

triage.headline_ja: 102都市を調査。4万種以上の未知のウイルスを発見
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19パンデミック期に採取された環境サンプルからの未知RNAウイルスの網羅的分類に関する科学論文の紹介であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の脅威を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はMetaSUBコンソーシアムによる環境メタトランスクリプトーム研究（Nature Communications掲載）の紹介であり、特定の国での感染症アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。ブラジル等は31カ国のサンプリング対象地域の一つとして言及されているのみで、実際の発生事例ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: 全球公衛拉警報！剛果伊波拉破4千死、歐洲西尼羅病毒創紀錄 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Global public health alert! Ebola in the Congo surpasses 4,000 deaths; West Nile virus in Europe sets a record.
article.articleSummary: As of October 16, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to North Ubangi province near the Central African Republic. Since mid-May, the outbreak has grown to more than 9,000 laboratory-confirmed cases and over 4,000 deaths; Kenya has reported a second related case. In Europe, West Nile virus infections have broken records, with 18 countries reporting cases and totals surpassing 1,855, including 141 deaths, the highest levels on record for both human and animal infections. The report highlights ongoing global public health challenges posed by epidemic and vector-borne diseases, with EFSA and ECDC monitoring developments.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的な公衆衛生警報！コンゴのエボラ出血熱が死者4,000人を超え、欧州の西ナイルウイルスが過去最多を記録
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱が9,000例・死者4,000人超に拡大し、ケニアでも関連症例が報告されるなど国際的拡大の兆候があり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価に進むべきと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は西ナイルウイルスの欧州における流行にも言及しているが、対象国リストに該当する国ではないため除外。中央アフリカ共和国・ケニアも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: TP Hồ Chí Minh: Dịch cúm A đang lan nhanh, người dân cần chủ động phòng bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City: The Influenza A outbreak is spreading rapidly; residents should take proactive measures to prevent illness.
article.articleSummary: Week 40 surveillance in Ho Chi Minh City recorded 34,664 acute respiratory infection cases, up over 64% from the prior four weeks. Lab results identified 151 samples positive for influenza, with influenza A(H1N1)pdm09 comprising about 77% of these. At Tam Anh General Hospital facilities, respiratory visits rose sharply; in Tam Anh District 8, around 6–7 of every 10 respiratory patients tested positive for influenza A. The elderly and those with underlying conditions (heart disease, hypertension, COPD, diabetes, chronic kidney or liver disease) face rapid progression to pneumonia and respiratory failure. Influenza A can trigger complications such as myocardial infarction, stroke, or encephalitis; children may exhibit fever, cough, runny nose, fatigue, sometimes vomiting. With school return in September–October, transmission is amplified. Authorities maintain active surveillance at 29 facilities with sample collection and cluster monitoring; encourage early antiviral treatment and prompt medical care for high-risk individuals.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市：A型インフルエンザの流行が急速に拡大、住民は予防対策を
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市で急性呼吸器感染症・インフルエンザA(H1N1)pdm09陽性率が急増し、重症化リスク（肺炎・心筋梗塞・脳炎等の合併症）や学校再開に伴う感染拡大が指摘されており、WPRO基準の重症度・曝露継続・流行しやすさに該当し、行政による積極的サーベイランスという社会的関心も確認できるため。
triage.notes: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)pdm09の国内流行報告であり、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限の兆候はないが、重症化リスクと学校再開に伴う感染拡大、当局の積極的サーベイランスが確認されるためPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola outbreak spreads to eighth province bordering Central African Republic
article.articleSummary: On 16 October 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola outbreak (Bundibugyo strain) extended to North Ubangi province, bordering the Central African Republic, with two cases reported. North Ubangi's two cases have not yet been announced by authorities. The Bundibugyo strain, identified mid-May, now reaches eight provinces, including Ituri (hotspot), North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele and South Ubangi. The outbreak remains the second largest on record, with more than 9,000 cases and about 4,000 deaths. Suspected deaths in Wapinda health zone mining area near Bas-Uele; samples sent to labs in North Ubangi and Kinshasa. The epidemic has crossed borders: Uganda has reported cases after declaring itself free in August; Kenya confirmed a second case in a family member of the first patient. No vaccine or standard treatment exists for Bundibugyo strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが中央アフリカ共和国と国境を接する8番目の州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが8州に拡大し、9000例超・4000人死亡、国境を越えてウガンダ・ケニアにも拡大しており、IHR4基準すべてに該当する重大シグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニア・中央アフリカ共和国への拡大が報告されているが、いずれも対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。ワクチン・標準治療法が存在しないブンディブギョ株であり、史上2番目の規模のアウトブレイクとして国際的対応が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Clostridioides difficile: o risco intestinal depois do antibiótico
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Clostridioides difficile: the risk to the gut after antibiotics
article.articleSummary: Clostridioides difficile infection after antibiotic use: US CDC surveillance estimated 453,000 infections annually with 29,000 deaths within 30 days; about 15,000 deaths attributed directly to the bacterium, and around 20% of cases relapse. In Brazil, data are limited, with hospital-based studies guiding estimates. The infection is linked to hospitals and nursing homes but also occurs in the community: one-third of US cases are community-acquired; 81,000 occurred after discharge, and 82% of community cases had seen a clinician or dentist in the three months. Deaths concentrate in those aged 65 and older (80% of fatalities; about 1 in 9 in this age group dies within 30 days). Symptoms include persistent diarrhea, abdominal pain, fever, and dehydration. Treatment uses fidaxomicin or oral vancomycin; metronidazole reserved for mild cases; fecal microbiota transplant after at least two recurrences. Emphasizes antibiotic stewardship and soap-and-water handwashing to reduce transmission, noting spores resist alcohol.

triage.headline_ja: クロストリディオイデス・ディフィシル感染症:抗生物質使用後の腸内リスク
triage.triage_reason: 抗生物質関連の既知の医療関連感染症に関する解説記事であり、米国のサーベイランスデータ紹介が主体で、ブラジルは比較対象として言及されるのみでアウトブレイクの報告ではない。新規性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は医療解説記事であり、ブラジルにおける具体的な発生事例やアウトブレイクの報告ではなくデータの限界について言及しているのみ。対象国としての該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: சென்னை: தனியார் மருத்துவமனைகளில் பணிபுரியும் மருத்துவர்களுக்கு டெங்கு காய்ச்சல் மேலாண்மை குறித்த பயிற்சி
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chennai: Training on dengue fever management for doctors working in private hospitals.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever management training for private-hospital doctors under the Greater Chennai Corporation was held on 15 October 2026 at the Amma Mahalai conference hall, Ripon Building, Chennai. The session, led by City Health Officer Dr. M. Jegathesan, was attended by Additional City Health Officers (North, Central, South), Zone Health Officers for Zones 1–15, Zonal Medical Officers, and retired professor Dr. Raghunathan of Rajiv Gandhi Government General Hospital, who delivered the instruction. The programme covered identifying dengue fever symptoms in fever patients, treatment after laboratory confirmation, and reporting of dengue cases to the GCC via IHIP and HIMS. After the training, physicians’ questions were addressed. When dengue cases are identified, GCC health officials will visit patients’ homes to explain preventive measures, reinforcing surveillance and control efforts for dengue in private facilities.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイ：民間病院勤務の医師を対象としたデング熱管理に関する研修
triage.triage_reason: 通常の行政対応としてのデング熱管理研修であり、異常な発生急増や重篤な公衆衛生上の懸念を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の発生拡大そのものではなく、チェンナイ市当局による医療従事者向けの定例的な研修・サーベイランス強化策を報じたもの。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: Aktivitas Influenza A Meningkat, Jaga Daya Tahan Tubuh dan Kebersihan Rongga Mulut
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A Activity Is Increasing, Maintain Immune System Strength and Oral Hygiene.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A activity in Indonesia rose to a moderate level in September 2026, with Influenza A (H1N1)pdm09 identified as a dominant subtype in ongoing surveillance. Illness presents with fever, cough, runny nose, sore throat, body aches, headache, and fatigue, transmitted via respiratory droplets from coughing, sneezing, or talking. Public health guidance urges vigilance without panic and reiterates preventive practices: adequate rest, hydration, nutritious meals, hand hygiene, and wearing a mask when ill. The article notes that susceptibility is not solely due to poor immunity; sleep deprivation, chronic stress, and unhealthy habits can influence health, but influenza is caused by the virus. Misconceptions such as panas dalam should not replace medical evaluation when symptoms worsen. Additionally, oral hygiene is emphasized; MINOSEP Extra mouthwash (chlorhexidine gluconate 0.2% and CPC 0.05%) can help maintain oral health, and gargling may help reduce bacteria in the throat, nasal passages, and ears, potentially supporting immune defenses.

triage.headline_ja: インフルエンザAの活動が増加、免疫力と口腔衛生の維持を
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザA(H1N1)pdm09の中等度の流行で、一般的な健康啓発記事であり、新規性や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: H1N1pdm09は既知の季節性株であり、公衆衛生当局は通常の予防啓発を行っているのみ。健康広告的内容（マウスウォッシュ製品言及）も含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Pune Dengue Cases Hit 662 In September, PMC Targets 600 Construction Sites
article.articleSummary: Dengue cases in Pune rose to 662 in September, with monthly totals rising from 103 in June, 366 in July, and 512 in August. To curb transmission, PMC intensified inspections and spraying, focusing on construction sites where stagnating water in curing slabs fosters mosquitoes. More than 600 construction sites failed to cooperate and have been handed to the building department; penalties will follow non-compliance. In September, 3,348 containers conducive to mosquito breeding were found across 226,705 residences and business properties inspected; 398,930 containers checked, and 2,412 houses with breeding conditions identified. Notices issued: 402; fines collected: Rs 1,45,500. Dhankawadi-Sahakarnagar ward had the highest impact (599 affected houses; 724 contaminated containers), with Kondhwa-Yewalewadi (417 containers) and Kothrud (395) following. Fogging covered 27,759 houses; insecticide spraying 53,212. Authorities urged residents to prevent standing water in tyres, cans, coolers, and other containers, and to ensure water does not accumulate in warehouses and pipelines.

triage.headline_ja: プネーのデング熱感染者数、9月に662人に達し、PMCが建設現場600カ所を対象に対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: インドのプネーで季節性のデング熱症例が増加しているが、地域の衛生当局が通常の媒介生物対策・取締りを実施している範囲内であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の深刻な公衆衛生上の懸念は確認されない。
triage.notes: プネー市（マハーラーシュトラ州）における季節性デング熱の増加と地方自治体（PMC）による媒介蚊対策・罰金徴収等の通常業務報告。重症度・死亡数等の詳細情報はなく、国際的懸念には至っていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-uitbraak treft kinderen onevenredig hard, maar zij blijven onderbelicht in de respons
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak disproportionately affects children, but they remain underrepresented in the response.
article.articleSummary: North Kivu, DRC faces an Ebola outbreak that disproportionately affects children. MSF/Epicentre report nearly one in four confirmed Ebola patients in North Kivu are children, with 24% under five and 13% under one year (higher than Ituri). From June to September 2026, at the AZG Ebola Treatment Center in Butembo, 24 of 30 admitted children died from Bundibugyo virus, most under five, reflecting rapid community spread and limited access to specialized care. First-line facilities often lack infection prevention, equipment, and trained staff to identify and safely treat suspected cases. AZG provides family-centered care with observatory spaces for parents and trained caregivers at Kitatumba ETC. Gaps include pediatric dosing guidelines and child-friendly formulations of experimental therapies; calls to prioritize children in research, vaccine trials, and access. Broader health impacts include disruptions to nutrition, routine vaccination, and primary care.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行は子どもに不均衡に深刻な影響を与えているが、対応の中で依然として十分に注目されていない
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州で継続中のエボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス）流行において小児の重症化・高致死率が報告され、IHR基準複数（深刻性、異常性、国際拡大リスク）およびWPRO基準の大半に該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はMSF/Epicentreの報告に基づき、北キブ州ブテンボのエボラ治療センターで2026年6月〜9月に入院した小児30人中24人が死亡したと報告。既知の継続流行だが小児への影響・医療体制の脆弱性が強調されており、フルRRAでの継続評価が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Les enfants paient un lourd tribut face à l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo-Kinshasa: Children pay a heavy toll amid the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: In North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola is taking a heavy toll on children. MSF Epicentre data at the Butembo Ebola Treatment Center show children account for about 24% of confirmed cases (June–September 2026), with a pediatric case fatality rate of 80% among 30 children treated there during this period (only 6 survived). Children are largely excluded from vaccination campaigns and experimental therapies. Pediatric care requires tailored dosing for dehydration and hypoglycemia, yet many healthcare workers lack experience with children. MSF has created spaces for parental contact through plexiglass and trains accompanying staff (13 at Kitatumba) to support young patients. MSF calls for prioritizing pediatric inclusion in research and treatments, strengthening infection prevention in non-specialized facilities to curb nosocomial transmission, and maintaining routine vaccination, nutrition, and primary care; addressing pediatric data gaps for Bundibugyo virus.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ流行で子どもたちが重い代償を払っている
triage.triage_reason: 北キブ州で継続中のエボラ流行において小児の致死率が80%と極めて高く、ワクチン・治療へのアクセス格差や院内感染リスクも指摘されており、公衆衛生上深刻な懸念がありフルリスク評価が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: 既存のエボラ流行（北キブ州、ブテンボ）に関する継続報道。小児の致死率80%、ワクチン・治療からの除外、院内感染対策の必要性についてMSFが報告・提言している。新規発生ではなく既知流行の詳細分析記事だが、深刻度と国際支援の必要性からPICKUPと判断。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo nguy hiểm sau 4 ca liên cầu lợn liên tiếp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Danger warning after four consecutive Streptococcus suis infection cases.
article.articleSummary: Four consecutive Streptococcus suis infections were culture-confirmed at Hanoi's National Institute of Infectious and Tropical Diseases Hospital in Vietnam over roughly two weeks, including a 53-year-old man from Hải Phòng who developed septic shock, multi-organ failure, and disseminated intravascular coagulation after eating tiết canh. The cluster features meningitis and septicemia presentations; patients exhibited fever, severe headache, confusion, and altered consciousness, with some experiencing prolonged headaches and possible hearing loss. Laboratory findings were striking: platelets 29 × 10^9/L, fibrinogen <0.35 g/L, and lactate 13 mmol/L, indicating severe sepsis with coagulopathy and metabolic acidosis. All cases required intensive care, airway support, antibiotics, and continuous renal replacement therapy. Public health guidance urges avoiding tiết canh and undercooked pork, enforcing protective measures for pig workers, and seeking prompt medical evaluation after exposure or symptom onset to prevent serious complications and sepsis.

triage.headline_ja: 連続する豚レンサ球菌感染症4症例後の危険警告
triage.triage_reason: WPRO基準（重症度・持続曝露）に複数該当し、公衆衛生当局が注意喚起を行うなど社会的関心も認められるためフルリスク評価への移行を検討する。
triage.notes: 豚レンサ球菌症はベトナムで生豚血（tiết canh）摂取に関連して散発的に発生する既知の人獣共通感染症であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の報告はない。今回は短期間に4例が集中し重症例（敗血症性ショック・多臓器不全）が複数あるため、継続的な動向確認が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Русия обяви "извънредно положение" в Сибир, но заради шап, още не обявява причината за смъртта на биолаборантката по чумата
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia declared a "state of emergency" in Siberia, but due to shap, it has not yet announced the cause of death of the biolab technician assigned to the plague.
article.articleSummary: State of emergency declared in Siberia over plague (Yersinia pestis) amid fears of a Black Death outbreak in Irkutsk Oblast. In Zabaykalsky Region, authorities imposed restrictions, vaccinating livestock and limiting grazing after warnings of infection from China and Mongolia. A pro-Kremlin channel claims infections have reached Russia and that authorities are concealing the situation, while officials say the measures are precautionary against a serious animal disease. In Irkutsk Oblast, anger grows over the death of 28-year-old scientist Daria Shipilova at the Irkutsk Institute of Plague Control; authorities canceled quarantine and have offered unclear explanations. Tests reportedly point to plague, but officials cite an undetermined pneumonia. Past incidents include cattle culls in Irkutsk Oblast for nodular dermatitis; earlier in Novosibirsk, up to 4,500 cattle were culled for pasteurellosis and rabies, fueling suspicion of cover-ups. Plague transmits through fleas and animals; pneumonic form spreads by droplets and can be fatal without antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアがシベリアで「非常事態」を宣言、ただし口蹄疫を理由としており、ペスト担当の生物研究者の死因はまだ公表していない
triage.triage_reason: ペスト(Yersinia pestis)関連の研究者死亡と非常事態宣言、隠蔽疑惑など異常性・重篤性が高く、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（シベリア：イルクーツク州、ノヴォシビルスク州、ザバイカル地方）であり、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空。中国・モンゴルは感染警告の発信元として言及されているのみで、実際の発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Bandarlampung sebut skrining kunci pemutus rantai penularan TBC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bandar Lampung Health Office says screening is the key to breaking the TB transmission chain
article.articleSummary: Bandar Lampung, Indonesia — The City Health Office (Dinkes) says early detection through TB screening is key to breaking transmission. The city targets screening 25,000 residents in 2026–2027 to help accelerate national TB elimination by 2030. Suspected cases will undergo diagnostic confirmation, including laboratory tests; those confirmed will receive complete treatment according to standard operating procedures. For drug-susceptible TB, therapy lasts six months. To maximize cure rates, healthcare workers at puskesmas and PJO (Penanggung Jawab Menelan Obat) will monitor treatment adherence and educate patients and families to reduce transmission among close contacts. The local government pledges reliable access to first-line medications and health facility infrastructure. In 2027, budget planning with DPRD Komisi IV focused on TB detection, stunting reduction, HIV management, infectious disease prevention, and strengthening puskesmas facilities.

triage.headline_ja: バンダルランプン保健局、結核感染連鎖を断つ鍵はスクリーニングと発言
triage.triage_reason: 既存の結核対策プログラムに関する通常の公衆衛生活動の報道であり、異常性・急性の公衆衛生リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: กรมควบคุมโรค เตือนภัยศูนย์พักพิง! ห่วงผู้ประสบภัยเสี่ยงติดเชื้อ 'ไข้หวัดใหญ่'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Disease Control warns about shelters! Concern that disaster victims are at risk of contracting influenza.
article.articleSummary: Influenza risk highlighted for disaster relief shelters in Thailand (as of 2026-10-16). Influenza is a contagious respiratory infection spread through droplets from coughing/sneezing and by touching contaminated secretions then eyes, nose, or mouth. Crowded, poorly ventilated shelters increase transmission. The Department of Disease Control urges strict protection: wear masks in shared areas, wash hands with soap and water or use alcohol gel, and avoid sharing cups, utensils, towels, or personal items. If fever, cough, or sore throat occur, wear a mask, avoid close contact, and inform shelter staff for assessment. Common symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, headache, body aches, and fatigue. High-risk groups—children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with underlying conditions—may have worse outcomes; seek prompt care for severe symptoms such as breathing difficulty. Follow the 'Close–Wash–Avoid–Stop' guidance and call 1422 for information.

triage.headline_ja: 疾病管理局が避難所に警告！被災者のインフルエンザ感染リスクを懸念
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに対する一般的な予防啓発情報であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは見られず、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内である。
triage.notes: 避難所における季節性インフルエンザ予防の注意喚起記事。特定のアウトブレイクや異常な感染拡大は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Two-Drug Strike Cripples DNA Repair in Malaria Parasite
article.articleSummary: Malaria parasite Plasmodium falciparum ( Hyderabad, India) relies on homologous recombination to repair DNA, due to apparent absence of classical NHEJ. PfBlm, the parasite’s Bloom syndrome helicase in the RecQ family, is central to this pathway and interacts with PfRad51 and PfMre11; loss of PfBlm impairs repair and alters telomere/sldr gene regulation. Researchers at University of Hyderabad show PfBlm stability and function depend on PfHsp90, a chaperone; inhibiting PfHsp90 with 17-AAG reduces PfBlm levels in parasites via proteasomal degradation, an effect rescued by MG132, with PfBLM transcripts not downregulated (transcriptional upregulation observed). Physical interaction between PfHsp90 and PfBlm is confirmed (weak in yeast two-hybrid; robust by co-immunoprecipitation). The study notes PfHsp90 inhibition also depletes PfRad51, complicating interpretation of PfBlm-specific repair effects, as the chaperone-client relationship could influence DNA repair and parasite survival under genotoxic stress.

triage.headline_ja: 2剤併用戦略がマラリア原虫のDNA修復機能を破壊
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマラリア原虫の基礎的な分子生物学研究（DNA修復機構とタンパク質相互作用）を扱う学術研究であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な感染拡大事象を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はインド・ハイデラバード大学における基礎研究（マラリア原虫の薬剤標的研究）であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生イベントを報告するものではないため、地域は発生地域として確認されない。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Australia launches dengue vaccine; two doses cost AU$300, please note vaccination guidelines.
article.articleSummary: Australia launches dengue vaccine Qdenga; two-dose course costs AU$300 (AU$150 per dose), with doses spaced three months apart. Dengue fever, transmitted by Aedes aegypti, presents with fever, headache, myalgia, nausea, and rash; there is no specific antiviral. Four serotypes exist; infection with one provides limited immunity, and secondary infection with a different serotype can be more severe. Qdenga uses a live-attenuated dengue virus to confer immunity against all four serotypes. In endemic-country studies, it reduces clinical dengue by about 80% in the first year and hospitalization by over 95%, with protection against hospitalization lasting beyond four years. Side effects are common but usually mild, mainly injection-site pain/redness, headache, fatigue, and muscle pain. It is not suitable for immunocompromised or pregnant individuals. In Australia, vaccination is recommended for travelers aged 4+ who have had dengue, and for those never infected but planning long stays or repeated trips. In 2025, Australia reported >1,900 dengue cases, mostly among returning travelers; common origins include Indonesia, Thailand, and India, including Bali. Bite prevention remains essential.

article.articleHeadline: Dengue leva criança de 5 anos à internação
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Sends 5-Year-Old to Hospital
article.articleSummary: Barretos reports dengue transmission linked to Aedes aegypti, with dengue confirmations rising from 272 to 288 between September 17 and October 15. A 5-year-old girl was hospitalized at Santa Casa de Barretos due to dengue complications; one dengue death has been recorded in 2026, in July. Through October 15, 2,411 notifications were logged: 288 positive for dengue, 2,109 negative, and 14 still under investigation or awaiting tests. In addition to dengue, Barretos recorded three chikungunya positives among 77 notifications, and six zika notifications, all negative. Public health guidance emphasizes eliminating standing water, keeping yards clean, and seeking medical care for fever, headache, or body pains to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱で5歳児が入院
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・バレトス市における季節性のデング熱流行の地方自治体統計報告であり、症例数は限定的で国際的拡大や異常性は認められない通常の地域保健報告である。
triage.notes: ブラジルのサンパウロ州バレトス市における地方レベルのデング・チクングニア・ジカの定期サーベイランス報告。デング熱は同国で毎年流行する風土病であり、死亡例も1件のみで特段の異常性や国際的懸念は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh: Phát hiện chùm ca bệnh não mô cầu, một học sinh tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City: Detection of a cluster of meningococcal disease cases; one student has died.
article.articleSummary: On 16 October 2026, Ho Chi Minh City’s Department of Health confirmed three meningococcal disease cases caused by Neisseria meningitidis group B among students at Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School in Hiệp Phước commune, with one death. The index case, H.H.K. (b. 2014), presented fulminant meningococcemia with septic shock and died; N.A.B.M. (b. 2014) was diagnosed with meningococcal meningitis, and N.T.H.Q. (b. 2014) developed fever; PCR on cerebrospinal fluid and blood confirmed group B infection. Rapid epidemiological investigation, contact tracing, environmental cleaning, and prophylactic antibiotics for close contacts are underway. Schools and facilities are coordinating with Hiệp Phước Health Station, the hospital network, and parents to monitor health and enforce hygiene. Contacts will be observed for at least 10 days per MOH guidance; authorities emphasize early medical attention for compatible symptoms. Meningococcal disease is an acute infection transmitted via respiratory routes.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市：髄膜炎菌感染症のクラスターを検出、生徒1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 学校内でのクラスター発生かつ死亡例を伴う重症髄膜炎菌感染症であり、IHR基準の深刻性・異常性の2項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 単一校内での3例クラスター（うち1名死亡）。血清群B型による劇症型髄膜炎菌血症と髄膜炎。保健当局が接触者追跡・予防投薬・環境消毒を実施中。現時点で地域外への拡大や国際的な渡航・貿易制限の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: 5 Ribu Lebih Kasus HIV Ditemukan di Sulteng, Dinkes Soroti Tantangan Penanganan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 5,000 HIV cases detected in Central Sulawesi, Health Office highlights challenges in HIV management.
article.articleSummary: Central Sulawesi's Health Office reports 5,598 cumulative HIV cases in Sulawesi Tengah as of June 2026, including deaths. In Palu, Dr. Moh. Ikbal, Acting Head of Disease Prevention and Control, notes that expanding case finding is crucial, but many diagnosed patients refuse treatment because they feel healthy. Antiretroviral therapy (ARV) can suppress HIV viral load when taken consistently, reducing sexual transmission risk, yet it is not curative and must be continued under health guidance. The department stresses ongoing education on testing, treatment initiation, and prevention to curb transmission; more detected cases enable broader outreach and earlier treatment initiation. The remarks were delivered in Palu Selatan, Palu City. The article highlights HIV management challenges and the need for sustained public awareness to improve treatment uptake.

triage.headline_ja: 中部スラウェシ州でHIV症例5,000件超を確認、保健局が対応の課題を指摘
triage.triage_reason: HIVは既知の風土病的流行であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められず、通常の疾病管理報告に留まる。
triage.notes: 累積症例数の報告であり、新規アウトブレイクや急性の公衆衛生危機を示すものではない。地域の慢性的な疾病管理課題として地元保健当局が継続的に取り組んでいる内容。

article.articleHeadline: Liên tiếp 4 người mắc liên cầu lợn do ăn tiết canh, tiếp xúc lợn bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four consecutive people contract Streptococcus suis from eating raw pig-blood pudding and exposure to diseased pigs.
article.articleSummary: Over two weeks, four consecutive Streptococcus suis infections were admitted to Hanoi’s Central Institute of Tropical Diseases Hospital, Vietnam. The most severe case involved a 53-year-old man from Haiphong who developed septic shock after eating pig blood pudding. He presented with fever, abdominal pain, diarrhea, and delirium, then rapid deterioration with hypotension, multi‑organ failure (kidney and liver injury), and disseminated intravascular coagulation (platelets 29 x10^9/L; lactate 13 mmol/L). He required intubation, mechanical ventilation, vasopressors, antibiotics, and continuous renal replacement therapy. Other patients showed meningitis symptoms (fever, severe headache, altered consciousness). Streptococcus suis, carried by pigs, transmits via contact with pig blood/secretions or through raw/undercooked pork products. Public health guidance urges avoiding raw or undercooked pork, using PPE for handlers, covering wounds, and seeking prompt medical care if symptoms after exposure appear.

triage.headline_ja: 豚の血のプディング摂取や病気の豚との接触により4人が連続してブタレンサ球菌感染症に罹患
triage.triage_reason: 重症例（敗血症性ショック、多臓器不全）を含むクラスターだが、ベトナムで豚血プディング摂取による既知の風土病であり、異常性や国際的拡大の懸念は低い。続報を注視する。
triage.notes: ブタレンサ球菌症（Streptococcus suis）はベトナムで豚血プディング（tiết canh）摂取に関連して毎年報告される既知の人獣共通感染症であり、今回も散発的クラスターとみられる。ヒト-ヒト感染のエビデンスはなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは評価されない。

article.articleHeadline: 4 người nhập viện vì liên cầu lợn, có bệnh nhân nguy kịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four people hospitalized due to Streptococcus suis infection, with a patient in critical condition.
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus suis infection cases in Vietnam prompted hospitalization of four men at the National Institute of Infectious Diseases (Bệnh viện Bệnh Nhiệt đới Trung ương) in Hanoi. Over two weeks, the Emergency Department admitted four culture-confirmed S. suis infections, all with pig or pig-product exposure. Notably, a 53-year-old man from Hai Phong developed septic shock, multi-organ failure, and disseminated intravascular coagulation after eating a raw pig blood dish (tiết canh). He arrived encephalopathic with dark purplish skin patches; labs showed marked inflammatory response, acute kidney injury, liver injury, severe metabolic acidosis with lactate 13 mmol/L, and thrombocytopenia. He required intubation, vasopressors, broad-spectrum antibiotics, and continuous renal replacement therapy. Others presented meningitis-like symptoms; with antibiotics their condition improved, though some faced lasting headaches or hearing loss. The cases underscore infection risk from pig contact and undercooked products; advise against tiết canh, cook meat thoroughly, and use PPE in pig handling.

triage.headline_ja: 豚レンサ球菌感染により4人が入院、うち1人は重篤
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで豚レンサ球菌感染（生の豚血料理摂取が原因）による重症例が確認されたが、既知の疾患で散発的な国内事例にとどまり、国際的拡大や異常性の根拠は乏しい。
triage.notes: 豚レンサ球菌症はベトナムで生の豚血料理（ティエットカイン）摂取に関連して繰り返し報告される既知の人獣共通感染症であり、ヒトーヒト感染のリスクは低い。重症例（敗血症性ショック、多臓器不全）が1例あるが、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えず、続報の有無を注視する段階と判断。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果(金)埃博拉疫情續爆發 已蔓延至第八省
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo (Kinshasa) continues to flare up, has spread to the eighth province.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is expanding to a eighth province, North Ubangi, which borders the Central African Republic. Health officials told Reuters that North Ubangi has two confirmed cases, though not officially announced. In Wapinda health zone near Bas-Uele border, several suspected infection deaths prompted samples to Kinshasa and the provincial lab for analysis. Ituri remains the outbreak’s epicenter, with rising cases in North Kivu; other provinces with confirmed infections include South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele and South Ubangi. Bundibugyo strain outbreak, declared mid-May, has spurred cross-border spread to Uganda and Kenya; Uganda had declared the outbreak ended in August, while Kenya reported its first case earlier this month and a second on Oct 14. Over 9,000 cases and 4,000 deaths, with 2,418 recoveries; WHO ranks it second only to the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak, which had over 28,000 infections and 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ(金)のエボラ疫情が続発し、すでに8番目の省に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国内で8省目に拡大し、ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境拡大も確認されており、死者数も多数（4000人超）であることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境拡大が記載されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。累計9000症例超、死者4000人超、WHOは2014-2016年西アフリカ流行に次ぐ規模と評価。

article.articleHeadline: Le monde en bref : cancer pulmonaire du pape, épidémie de rougeole aux Etats-Unis, suspicion de peste en Sibérie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World in Brief: the Pope's lung cancer, measles outbreak in the United States, suspected plague in Siberia.
article.articleSummary: HPV vaccination: WHO experts propose routine human papillomavirus vaccination from ages 4–8 to boost global coverage from 33% toward a 90% target. West Nile virus: in France, at least 5 deaths and 60 neuro-invasive cases reported, mainly among the elderly and frail, with Île-de-France affected amid warmer temperatures. Measles: New York State declares a public health emergency amid thousands of cases, marking the worst U.S. outbreak in 35 years. Plague in Siberia: a young lab technician at a plague institute dies of pneumonia on Oct 2, with a second death under investigation; WHO says the overall risk remains very low. Pope Léon XIV: 71-year-old pope underwent successful lobectomy for pulmonary adenocarcinoma (adenocarcinoma of the lung) in Rome on Oct 13, 2026; early stage and prognosis favorable, though reduced respiratory capacity anticipated. Ebola: Kenya reports its first Ebola-related death in Oct 2026, linked to a patient infected in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and transiting through Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: 世界ニュースダイジェスト：教皇の肺がん、米国での麻疹流行、シベリアでのペスト疑い
triage.triage_reason: DRCで感染した患者に関連するエボラ関連死がケニアで初めて報告され、ウガンダを経由した越境伝播が示唆されており、国際的拡大リスクと重症度の観点から懸念がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は複数トピックをまとめた世界ニュースダイジェストであり、エボラに関する記述は簡潔（ケニアでの初のエボラ関連死、感染元はDRC、ウガンダ経由）。DRC国内での発生規模や対応状況の詳細は不明なため、続報確認とフルRRAでの詳細評価が必要。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外し、感染発生国であるDRCのみを計上した。西ナイルウイルス（フランス）、麻疹（米国）、ペスト疑い（シベリア/ロシア）は対象国リスト外のため評価対象外。

article.articleHeadline: 多病疊加進入高發季 瀋陽部署秋冬季傳染病防控 - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Multiple diseases converge as the peak season arrives; Shenyang deploys autumn–winter infectious disease prevention and control - Hong Kong Commercial Daily
article.articleSummary: On 16 October 2026, Shenyang outlined autumn–winter infectious disease prevention. Cooler weather drives a high respiratory infection period Oct–Mar, with influenza, rhinovirus, and Mycoplasma pneumoniae circulating; influenza peaks December–January. SARS-CoV-2 positives are common; respiratory tests mainly detect M. pneumoniae, influenza, and coronavirus. Children in school and kindergarten are high-risk for clusters; older adults and the chronically ill have higher pneumonia risk. Enteric disease is sporadic; norovirus and rotavirus are highly transmissible, causing vomiting and diarrhea, with vomiting as the main source; alcohol disinfection is less effective in outbreaks in schools and elder care settings. Prevention focuses on vaccination, surveillance, and health education. Free influenza vaccines for 3–6-year-olds and 65+ are funded; 213 clinics offer extended hours; vaccination from 6 months onward is advised, especially for high-risk groups. Schools will enforce symptom screening and attendance tracking; vomiting/diarrhea means no work; surfaces disinfected daily with chlorine-based products; rapid reporting follows multi-case outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: 多病疊加進入高發季 瀋陽部署秋冬季傳染病防控 - 香港商報
triage.triage_reason: 季節性の呼吸器・腸管感染症に対する通常の行政的予防対策の発表であり、異常事態や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 瀋陽市における季節性感染症（インフルエンザ、マイコプラズマ肺炎、ノロウイルス等）への通常の予防体制整備に関する行政広報記事。異常な発生増加や重症化の報告はなく、既存の年次対策の一環。

article.articleHeadline: Afrique Centrale: Les pays de la Cemac harmonisent une série de protocoles dans la riposte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Africa: The CEMAC member states harmonize a series of protocols in the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: CEMAC member states harmonized eight Ebola prevention protocols in Brazzaville in response to an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo that has persisted since May 2026. The synchronized measures cover epidemiological surveillance, contact tracing and management, border entry controls, and risk communication, with immediate implementation across the six countries. The move aims to prevent, detect early, and respond effectively to community transmission. Ludovic Fiomona, regional coordinator of the Central Africa Health Security Program, praised the heightened preparedness, noting that earlier panic has given way to coordinated readiness. Africa CDC's Dr. Carole Bohimbo said the regional, joint approach will improve efficiency and reduce outbreak impact. The Brazzaville meeting gathered about a hundred health actors, with World Bank support, to consolidate regional action.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカ：CEMAC加盟国がエボラ対策の一連のプロトコルを統一
triage.triage_reason: DRCで2026年5月から継続するエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに対し、周辺6カ国が国境管理・サーベイランス等の対策を統一するなど、国際的拡大リスクと社会的関心が高いためフルRRAへ進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: 記事はブラザビル（コンゴ共和国）での地域会合を報じているが、実際のエボラ発生国はDRCであり、コンゴ共和国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Insecurity disrupts aid, Ebola response in the east
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo’s eastern Ebola outbreak continues amid escalating insecurity that disrupts aid and response efforts. National health authorities report nearly 9,100 confirmed Ebola cases and more than 4,400 deaths. In South Kivu and North Kivu, violence has displaced over 26,000 people, increasing humanitarian needs and hampering assistance delivery. In Ituri Province, insecurity endangers civilians and Ebola operations; four civilians were killed near Pimbo in Djugu Territory, triggering the suspension of National Road 27, a key humanitarian and commercial corridor, and the cancellation of a planned mission. The broader Djugu crisis has caused civilian casualties, mass displacement, and disruption of the Ebola response. The UN and partners continue to support containment efforts and urge protection of civilians and safe, rapid, and unhindered access for aid."

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：治安悪化が東部のエボラ対応支援を妨げる
triage.triage_reason: DRC東部で約9,100症例・4,400人超の死亡が報告される大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、治安悪化による対応妨害・人道危機の深刻化がIHR基準複数に該当するため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: South Kivu、North Kivu、Ituri（Djugu、Pimboを含む）は全てDRC国内の地域であり、単一国として集約。治安悪化（武力衝突、26,000人超の避難民、幹線道路封鎖）がエボラ対応・人道支援を著しく阻害している点が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: Przenoszą ją szczury i pchły. Czy dżuma jest zagrożeniem dla Wrocławia? Eksperci mówią jasno
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rats and fleas carry it. Is the plague a threat to Wrocław? Experts say it plainly.
article.articleSummary: Plague remains a risk in Wrocław, Poland, though large historic outbreaks are not current. The bacterium Yersinia pestis persists in nature, with Wrocław suffering outbreaks in 1542, 1568, 1585 and 1633 that killed about 13,000 people. Today, cases are rare and typically linked to contact with infected animals, especially rats and fleas; pneumonic plague poses the greatest danger as it spreads through respiratory droplets between close contacts. Doctors at University Clinical Hospital in Wrocław emphasize that casual contact does not automatically cause infection; timely diagnosis and laboratory confirmation are crucial, with immediate isolation upon confirmation. Antibiotics are effective if started promptly. Vaccination is advised, particularly for travelers abroad. Regarding import/export concerns, the article notes distant foci in Congo, Madagascar, and Asia, and references a recent suspected infection in an Irkutsk laboratory, prompting discussion about risk. Ongoing vigilance is advisable for Wrocław residents due to flea-rat reservoirs.

triage.headline_ja: ネズミとノミが媒介する。ペストはヴロツワフにとって脅威か？専門家は明確に答える
triage.triage_reason: ポーランド・ヴロツワフにおけるペストの歴史解説と一般的なリスク啓発記事であり、現在の実際の症例発生や流行は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はポーランド・ヴロツワフでのペストに関する一般的な啓発記事。コンゴ、マダガスカル、アジアの遠隔地の流行地や、イルクーツク(ロシア)での研究室感染疑いに言及されているが、いずれも具体的な現状発生の詳細は乏しい。対象国の中ではDRCへの言及のみ該当するが、具体的な症例情報はなく実質的な発生報告ではない。ポーランド・ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 4 ca nhiễm liên cầu lợn liên tiếp, có người nguy kịch sau khi ăn tiết canh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four consecutive cases of Streptococcus suis infection, with some in critical condition after eating raw pig-blood dish.
article.articleSummary: Four consecutive Streptococcus suis infections were admitted to the National Institute of Tropical Diseases in Hanoi over the past two weeks, all linked to pig exposure or pig products. The 53-year-old man from Hai Phong who ate a raw pig-blood dish (tiết canh) developed septic shock, acute respiratory failure, multi-organ dysfunction, and disseminated intravascular coagulation, requiring vasopressors, intubation, and continuous renal replacement therapy. Other patients presented with meningitis-like symptoms—fever and severe headache—with varying severity; antibiotics led to improvement, though some reported persistent headaches or hearing loss. A second case describes a 61-year-old man who bought and processed raw pork and bones, then developed fever and septic shock. Transmission occurs via contact with pig blood or secretions, especially through wounds or consumption of undercooked pig products. Prevention includes avoiding tiết canh, thorough cooking, protective gear for handlers, wound care, and rapid medical evaluation for fever or neurological symptoms.

triage.headline_ja: 豚の生き血料理を食べた後、連鎖球菌感染症が4例連続発生、重篤者も
triage.triage_reason: 豚レンサ球菌感染症（Streptococcus suis）の散発例であり、既知の食習慣（ティエットカイン摂取）に関連した事例。人-人感染はなく国際的拡大リスクは低いが、重症例が複数出ているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: Streptococcus suis（豚レンサ球菌症）は既知の人獣共通感染症であり、ベトナムでは豚の生き血料理（ティエットカイン）を介した散発例が継続的に報告されている。ヒト-ヒト感染は確認されておらず、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とはみなされないが、重症化例が続く場合は注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC : Ebola, " un seul plan, un seul budget, une seule coordination ", le gouvernement mise sur l'approche village
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola, "one plan, one budget, one coordination", the government bets on the village approach.
article.articleSummary: DRC authorities bolster the Ebola response with a unified strategy—'one plan, one budget, one coordination'—for the 17th Ebola outbreak. Led by Health Minister Dr Samuel Roger Kamba, the approach emphasizes strengthened coordination and enhanced community mobilization. Hussein Twaibu Rayan, adviser to the minister for Communication and Public Relations, explains that the CREC (Risk Communication and Community Engagement) pillar has been reorganized into specialized domains: community engagement, monitoring and evaluation, logistics, capacity building, and rumor control. The model aims to harmonize partner actions, clarify responsibilities, and improve funding tracking, with a consolidated view of mobilized resources rather than a single pooled fund. Coordination spans national, provincial, zonal, and community levels to tailor interventions to field realities. The village approach directly involves populations through community relays, CACs, traditional chiefs, religious leaders, youth, and women's associations, emphasizing active participation alongside prevention messages.

triage.headline_ja: DRC：エボラ出血熱、「一つの計画、一つの予算、一つの調整」、政府は村落アプローチに賭ける
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する政府主導の統一対応戦略の記事であり、エボラの重症度の高さと政府・国際的関心の高さからフルRRAでの継続監視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は新規症例や感染拡大の報告ではなく、既知の第17次エボラアウトブレイクに対する政府の統一対応戦略（一つの計画・予算・調整）および村落アプローチの発表が主題。既存アウトブレイクの継続モニタリング対象として扱うべき。

article.articleHeadline: E coli Ditemukan dalam Sampel Air yang Buat 146 Warga Serpong Lagoon Muntaber
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: E. coli Found in Water Sample That Made 146 Residents of Serpong Lagoon Suffer Gastroenteritis
article.articleSummary: As of 16 October 2026, Escherichia coli was detected in water from Serpong Lagoon, Tangerang Selatan, Indonesia, linked to a gastroenteritis outbreak affecting 146 residents. E. coli was found in three samples: reservoir water (14), water from households using filters (660), and water from households without filters (956). Units and testing methods are not fully disclosed, so direct causality remains unproven. Authorities are investigating whether contamination stems from the Serpong Lagoon Water Treatment Plant (WTP) processing or distribution pipeline leaks. The city Health Department and Keranggan Public Health Center collected samples and urged cleaning, disinfection, and higher chlorination, along with comprehensive repairs to WTP and piping networks. No definitive confirmation that water is the direct source yet.

triage.headline_ja: E.coli、セルポンラグーンの住民146人が胃腸炎を発症した水サンプルから検出
triage.triage_reason: 単一地域の水質汚染による胃腸炎集団発生で国際的拡大の可能性は低いが、原因究明中であり続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 地元の水道施設汚染が原因とみられる局地的な集団食中毒事例。重症度や入院者数など詳細情報は不明。インドネシア国内の単一地域（南タンゲラン）に限定された事案。

article.articleHeadline: Sở Y tế TPHCM thông tin vụ 3 học sinh Trường THCS Hai Bà Trưng mắc não mô cầu, một em tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City Department of Health reports three students from Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School contracted meningococcal meningitis, one student died.
article.articleSummary: Three students at Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School in Hiệp Phước Commune, Ho Chi Minh City, contracted meningococcal disease due to Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B; one student died. On Oct 14, 12-year-old K. developed fulminant meningococcemia with septic shock; lab confirmed serogroup B and K. died that day. Another student, N.A.B.M., was diagnosed with serogroup B meningitis and treated at Ho Chi Minh City Tropical Diseases Hospital; M. is stable. On Oct 15, N.T.H.Q., seated at the same desk, developed fever; PCR confirmed meningococcal meningitis serogroup B in blood and CSF; Q. remains conscious and stable in isolation. Public health actions include epidemiologic investigation, close-contact screening and chemoprophylaxis, environmental cleaning, and 10-day health monitoring per MOH guidance. No self-medication; parents urged to rely on official updates. An emergency coordination meeting occurred Oct 16 with health and education authorities.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市保健局、ハイバーチュン中学校の生徒3名が髄膜炎菌感染症に罹患、うち1名死亡と発表
triage.triage_reason: 同一学校・同一教室内で髄膜炎菌感染症（血清群B）のクラスターが発生し1名が死亡するなど重篤な転帰があり、IHR基準の深刻性・異常性の2項目に該当するため。
triage.notes: 学校内の同一教室で複数の血清群B髄膜炎菌感染症例が確認され、1名が劇症型敗血症性ショックで死亡。保健当局は濃厚接触者の予防投薬・環境消毒・10日間の健康監視を実施し、緊急調整会議も開催済み。現時点で国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないが、学校クラスターという特性上、続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue Cases Surge in Nagpur, 62 Reported in 15 Days as Mosquito Breeding Risks Rise
article.articleSummary: Nagpur reports a dengue surge as of 16 Oct 2026: 62 cases in the last 15 days; total 162 since January, with figures likely higher as private hospitals, Mayo and GMCH treat patients not captured in official tallies. The rise aligns with warmer weather and conditions conducive to Aedes breeding: cooler water in households left unchecked, water stored in containers, tanks, flowerpots, discarded tyres and stagnant water at construction sites. Aedes transmits dengue and bites mainly during the day, so precautions are needed around the clock. Public health measures urged include wearing full-sleeved clothing, using repellents, and installing window mesh screens. Dr Milind Vyavahare (GMCH) warns not all dengue patients require hospitalization, but warning signs require urgent care: severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, breathing difficulty, reduced urine, dizziness. Even after fever subsides, serious complications can occur.

triage.headline_ja: ナグプールでデング熱症例が急増、蚊の繁殖リスク上昇で15日間に62例報告
triage.triage_reason: インドの一地域（ナグプール）での季節性デング熱の増加報告であり、例年の流行パターンの範囲内とみられるが、症例数増加の推移は注視が必要。
triage.notes: デング熱はインドの季節性流行病であり、ナグプール地域での症例増加は例年見られる現象。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、蚊媒介感染症として継続的なモニタリングが望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Ba học sinh cùng trường mắc não mô cầu, một em đã tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three students from the same school contracted meningococcal meningitis; one has died.
article.articleSummary: Three 12-year-old students from Hai Bà Trưng Middle School, Hiệp Phước Commune, Ho Chi Minh City, have meningococcal meningitis group B. H.H.K. died on 14 Oct after fulminant disease with septic shock and multi-organ failure. N.A.B.M. is hospitalized at the Tropical Diseases Hospital; condition stable. N.T.H.Q., seated beside H.K., developed fever 15 Oct; PCR-confirmed meningococcal meningitis B on 16 Oct; currently alert, stable, isolated. Authorities including Ho Chi Minh City Department of Health (HCDC) and linked hospitals are conducting rapid epidemiologic investigation, contact tracing, and antibiotic prophylaxis for close contacts; schools cleaned; health monitoring for contacts for at least 10 days. Public guidance urges early medical evaluation for fever, headache, vomiting, rash; antibiotics for close contacts should follow medical guidance; no self-prescribing.

triage.headline_ja: 同じ学校の生徒3人が髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎に感染、1人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 同一校内で髄膜炎菌感染のクラスターが発生し1名死亡しているが、現時点では学校内の限定的な集団発生であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは不明なため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 同一学校で3例確認（うち1例死亡、1例確定診断、1例入院）。当局は接触者調査・予防投薬・学校消毒を実施中。ヒト-ヒト感染（濃厚接触者間）の可能性があり経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sốc nhiễm khuẩn, suy đa tạng sau bữa tiết canh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Septic shock and multi-organ failure after eating blood soup.
article.articleSummary: Four culture-confirmed Streptococcus suis infections were reported at the Central Tropical Disease Hospital over about two weeks, all linked to pig exposure or pork products. Clinical presentations ranged from meningitis to septicemia with multi-organ failure. A 53-year-old Hai Phong man who regularly ate pig blood dish (tiết canh) developed septic shock after two days of abdominal pain and diarrhea, presenting with altered consciousness, skin mottling, tachycardia, and hypotension. Labs showed acute kidney injury, liver injury, coagulopathy with thrombocytopenia, and severe metabolic acidosis (lactate 13 mmol/L). He required endotracheal intubation, mechanical ventilation, vasopressors, antibiotics, and continuous renal replacement therapy. Experts warn rapid progression in invasive S. suis infections, particularly with septicemia. Preventive guidance: avoid pig blood dishes and undercooked pork; use protective PPE for pig handlers; seek prompt medical care with exposure and symptoms such as fever or confusion.

triage.headline_ja: 豚の血液料理（ティエットカイン）摂取後の敗血症性ショックと多臓器不全
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで既知の豚レンサ球菌（S. suis）感染症の散発例（約2週間で4例）であり、豚の生血料理という特定の食習慣に起因する食品媒介感染症。ヒト-ヒト感染はなく、新興性・異常性は低い。
triage.notes: S. suis感染はベトナムで既知の風土病的疾患であり、豚の生血料理（tiết canh）摂取や豚との接触によるもの。人-人感染のメカニズムはなく、公衆衛生への啓発記事としての性格が強い。SFTSウイルスについては記事中で言及なし（タグ付けのみ）。

article.articleHeadline: Trạm tin chiều 16/10: TPHCM cảnh báo triều cường | Ghi nhận chùm ca bệnh não mô cầu ở học sinh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Afternoon News Update 16/10: Ho Chi Minh City warns of high tide | Noting a cluster of meningococcal disease cases among students.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City reports a meningococcal disease cluster caused by Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B among students: three pupils affected and one death. The fatal case, H.H.K., 12, of Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School in Hiệp Phước commune, died Oct 14 from septic shock and multi-organ failure. A second student developed fever Oct 15 and tested positive for serogroup B meningococcus; authorities are conducting epidemiological investigations, tracing contacts, environmental cleaning, and ensuring prompt treatment to curb spread. In Hanoi, four Streptococcus suis infections linked to pigs or pork products have been recorded at the National Hospital of Tropical Diseases over about two weeks; one 53-year-old man developed septic shock and multi-organ failure after eating blood pudding. Authorities warn against raw or undercooked pork and urge immediate medical care if symptoms appear after contact with pigs.

triage.headline_ja: 16日午後のニュース速報：ホーチミン市、高潮を警告｜学生の間で髄膜炎菌感染症のクラスターを確認
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市の学生間で髄膜炎菌（血清群B）クラスターが発生し死亡例も出ており、ハノイでは豚由来のレンサ球菌感染症も複数報告されているため、重症度・流行可能性の観点からフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: ホーチミン市の髄膜炎菌クラスター（学生間、1名死亡）とハノイの豚由来レンサ球菌感染症（4例、1名重症）が同一記事内で報告されているが、いずれもベトナム国内の局地的な事例であり国際的拡大の証拠はない。

article.articleHeadline: TP.HCM ghi nhận 3 học sinh mắc não mô cầu, một em tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City records three students diagnosed with meningococcal disease, one dead.
article.articleSummary: Three students from Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School in Hiệp Phước, Ho Chi Minh City, have meningococcal disease caused by Neisseria meningitidis group B. One student died and two are under treatment as of 16 October 2026. The first case, reported on 14 October, developed fulminant meningococcemia with septic shock and multi-organ failure and died the same day. A second student was admitted with meningococcal meningitis; by 16 October, PCR testing of blood and cerebrospinal fluid confirmed the third student’s group B meningococcal infection, who is currently stable and isolated. The Department of Health directed rapid epidemiological investigation, contact tracing, and prophylactic antibiotics for close contacts, with health monitoring and school-based preventive measures. Authorities caution that common respiratory symptoms do not confirm meningococcal disease. Vaccination exists for meningococcal disease, but coverage varies; vaccination and prophylaxis decisions depend on age, health status, and medical guidelines. The situation is under active monitoring with risk assessments guiding any school-operation adjustments.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市で生徒3人が髄膜炎菌感染症と診断、うち1人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 同一学校内で髄膜炎菌感染症のクラスターが発生し死亡例も出ており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 同一校内で短期間に3症例（うち死亡1例）が発生しており、濃厚接触者への予防的抗菌薬投与や疫学調査が実施されている。今後の拡大有無（他校・地域への波及）の続報確認が必要。
