article.articleHeadline: TP.HCM ghi nhận số trẻ mắc tay chân miệng tăng mạnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City records a sharp increase in the number of children infected with hand, foot, and mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City reports a sharp rise in hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) among children. In the latest week, HFMD cases reached 1,673, up 47.8% from the four‑week average; year‑to‑date total is 38,463. Incidence is highest in Con Dao Zone and in Bình Khánh and Hiệp Phước communes in the Nhà Bè area. Pediatric hospitals show a surge: Children’s Hospital 1 has 70 HFMD inpatients, 4 severe, and 100–120 daily outpatients, about 42% from HCMC. Typical symptoms include vesicles and rash on hands, feet, mouth and buttocks; some cases present subtly. Warning signs include persistent high fever, lethargy, or neurological symptoms. At Children’s Hospital 2, HFMD admissions nearly doubled to 40–50 daily, with 10–20% presenting respiratory infections. Last week saw 34,664 acute respiratory infections and 151 influenza positives, dominated by A/H1N1 2009 (116). Measures: reinforce hand hygiene, masking, reduce travel for sick children, and promote annual flu vaccination.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市、手足口病患者数が急増と報告
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ホーチミン市で手足口病症例が前週比47.8%増と急増し、重症例や神経症状の警告例も報告されており、WPRO基準の複数項目（異常性、重症度、持続的曝露、流行しやすさ）に該当し社会的関心（メディア報道・公的対応）も確認されるためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はベトナム国内の手足口病（HFMD）およびインフルエンザA/H1N1の流行状況を報告しており、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは現時点で確認されていない。地域の小児病院の負荷増加が見られるため、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue fever: why symptoms can worsen even after the fever subsides
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever, transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes, can worsen after the fever subsides. The illness, common in tropical and subtropical regions including India, typically starts 4–10 days after a bite with high fever, severe headache, retro-orbital pain, muscle/joint pain, nausea, vomiting and rash; some infections are mild or asymptomatic. Because dengue symptoms resemble other infections, medical evaluation and testing are important. The critical phase often occurs 3–7 days after symptoms begin, as fever falls, and may involve fluid leakage, severe bleeding or organ damage. Warning signs needing urgent care include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, bleeding, rapid breathing, restlessness, weakness, and pale skin. There is no antiviral cure; treatment is supportive with fluids and symptom control. Paracetamol is acceptable; avoid aspirin/ibuprofen. Prevention hinges on eliminating standing water, covering tanks, using repellents, wearing protective clothing, and installing screens or nets; daytime mosquito activity requires year-round precautions.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱：発熱が治まった後に症状が悪化することがある理由
triage.triage_reason: デング熱に関する一般的な医学解説記事であり、特定の発生状況や異常なイベントを報告するものではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の症状・治療・予防に関する一般的な健康情報記事であり、インドにおける具体的な発生報告や流行状況を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: PMC Begins Two-Month Night Survey to Detect Filariasis Among Construction Workers and Migrant Labourers
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-16, Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) launched a two-month night-time survey to detect lymphatic filariasis (elephantiasis) among construction workers and migrant labourers in Pune. Beginning at 9 pm and running to midnight, twelve teams (six from PMC, six from the state health department) will collect blood samples at construction sites and worker accommodations. The aim is early detection to curb local transmission, as many workers come from states where the disease is more common. Pune is not endemic and has seven old cases, but officials say screening remains essential to protect public health. Dr. Rajesh Dighe notes timely identification and treatment can prevent spread. Lymphatic filariasis is a parasitic disease spread by mosquitoes; infections can be asymptomatic for years and may cause limb swelling or genital complications if untreated.

triage.headline_ja: プネー市、建設労働者と移住労働者を対象にフィラリア症検出のための2か月間の夜間調査を開始
triage.triage_reason: プネーは非流行地であり既存症例も7件のみで、ルーティンのサーベイランス活動に過ぎず、国際的拡大や重大な公衆衛生上の脅威は認められない。
triage.notes: リンパ系フィラリア症はインドの一部地域で流行性だが、本記事は予防的スクリーニング活動の報道であり、新規アウトブレイクや異常事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: சாக்கடை கழிவுநீர் சாலையில் பெருக்கெடுத்து ஓட்டம்: தொற்றுநோய் பரவும் அபாயத்தால் பொதுமக்கள் அவதி
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Heavy flow of sewage wastewater on the street: risk of infectious disease spread alarms the public.
article.articleSummary: Veerarakavapuram, 13th Ward, Tiruchendur Municipality, in Tuticorin district, reports sewage water pooling on major streets after an underground sewer line ruptured, turning roads into a stagnant, foul-smelling pool. The public health risk is rising as dirty water fosters mosquito breeding, threatening dengue and malaria outbreaks. Schoolchildren, the elderly, and motorists face daily hardship. Residents say repeated complaints to the municipality have yielded no action. On Friday, 16 October 2026, they issued an emergency demand for immediate measures: seal the sewer line on an urgent basis, stop sewage effluent, and remove the stagnating water to restore safe conditions for local residents and daily commuters.

triage.headline_ja: 下水が道路に溢れ出し、感染症流行の危険性で住民が困窮
triage.triage_reason: 特定の患者発生やアウトブレイクの報告ではなく、下水漏れによる蚊媒介感染症リスクの懸念を住民が訴える地域インフラ問題の記事であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも該当性が低い。
triage.notes: 実際の患者数・感染報告はなく、下水漏れによる蚊発生で将来的なデング熱・マラリアのリスクが懸念されているローカルインフラ問題の記事。続報があれば経過観察対象となり得る。

article.articleHeadline: Analytical and clinical validation of SYBR Green- and TaqMan-based multiplex real-time PCR assays for quantitative detection of intestinal protozoa in India
article.articleSummary: India-based validation of multiplex real-time PCR assays (SYBR Green and TaqMan) for quantitative detection of Entamoeba histolytica, Giardia lamblia, and Cryptosporidium spp. in stool from 540 patients with gastrointestinal disorders. The TaqMan multiplex assay showed the highest analytical sensitivity, with a limit of detection down to 10^-8 dilution of recombinant DNA standards, R^2 ≈ 0.99, and 100% diagnostic specificity. Overall detection was 24.4% (probe-based) and 23.1% (SYBR-based), with near-perfect inter-assay concordance (κ ≈ 0.93–0.97). Probe-based assay captured low-intensity and mixed infections confirmed by Sanger sequencing. The multiplex platform enables simultaneous detection in a single reaction, reducing reagent use, hands-on time, instrument occupancy, and turnaround. Reagent costs dropped from ~₹1,800 to ₹900 per sample and total assay time from ~4.5 h to ~1.5 h, supporting routine molecular diagnosis and surveillance in high-burden settings, including immunocompromised patients.

triage.headline_ja: インドにおける腸管寄生原虫の定量検出のためのSYBR GreenおよびTaqManベースのマルチプレックスリアルタイムPCRアッセイの分析的・臨床的検証
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は診断アッセイの検証に関する研究報告であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は診断検査法の技術的検証研究であり、特定のアウトブレイクイベントを報告するものではないため、地域特定イベントとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: E coli Ditemukan di 3 Sampel Air Serpong Lagoon, Tertinggi di Rumah Tanpa Filter
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: E. coli Found in 3 Serpong Lagoon Water Samples, Highest in Households Without Water Filters.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 Oct 2026, Escherichia coli was detected in three water samples from the Serpong Lagoon housing area, Keranggan, Setu, South Tangerang (Tangsel). The highest reading was in households without water filters (956), while reservoir samples from the water treatment plant registered 14 and households with filters 660; units and testing methods were not disclosed, limiting direct comparison. The findings accompany a muntaber (vomiting and diarrhea) outbreak affecting 146 residents of Serpong Lagoon, though the results do not confirm the water as the direct source of illness. Deputy Mayor Pilar Saga Ichsan urged overhauling the Serpong Lagoon WTP, supplying alternative clean water, and suspending use until quality meets standards. Calls include disinfection, chlorination optimization, and pipeline checks, with environmental and health offices overseeing water quality and broader evaluation to pinpoint the contamination source.

triage.headline_ja: セルポンラグーンの水サンプル3件からE.coli検出、フィルターなしの家庭で最高値
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア南タンゲランの住宅地で水質汚染と嘔吐下痢症の集団発生（146名）が確認されたが、水が直接の原因かは未確定であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 地域の水道施設の汚染による集団食中毒事例で、南タンゲラン市当局が対応中。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念は低いが、原因究明と水質改善の進捗を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: La Jornada: Los casos de sarampión casi se han quintuplicado en América, alerta OPS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: La Jornada: Measles cases have nearly quintupled in the Americas, PAHO warns.
article.articleSummary: Measles in the Americas tallies 55,792 confirmed cases and 77 deaths this year, per PAHO. The risk is deemed very high due to mass religious gatherings in South America. Guatemala leads with 34,335 cases and 50 deaths; Mexico 13,595 cases and 23 deaths; the United States, Peru, and Canada complete the top five, representing 99.5% of regional cases. In Mexico, Zacatecas records 385 cases and six deaths; technical support focuses on contact tracing and accelerating MR (measles and rubella) and MMR (measles, rubella and mumps) vaccination, especially for children 1–4 years and adults 25–29. In the two weeks prior, 687 new cases were confirmed across seven countries/territories, down 35% from 2025. US 293, Guatemala 200, Peru 155, Mexico 34, Bolivia 3; Canada and Brazil 1 each. Low-level transmission could persist for more than 12 months, risking reestablishment of endemic transmission and threatening measles-free status pursued by some countries, including Mexico.

triage.headline_ja: ラ・ホルナダ：米州における麻疹症例がほぼ5倍に増加、PAHOが警告
triage.triage_reason: PAHOが米州全体で麻疹症例が前年比約5倍に急増（55,792例、77人死亡）と警告しており、複数国にまたがる地域的拡大・重症例・公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が確認されるため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はグアテマラ・メキシコ・米国・ペルー・カナダが中心（地域全体の99.5%を占める）。対象国リストの中ではブラジルのみ、直近2週間で1例の確認症例が記載されており、実発生国として含めた。他の主要発生国（グアテマラ、メキシコ、米国、ペルー、カナダ）は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: TPHCM: Phát hiện chùm ca não mô cầu, một học sinh tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City: A cluster of meningococcal meningitis cases detected; one student dies.
article.articleSummary: Three students from Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School in Hiệp Phước Commune, Ho Chi Minh City, are confirmed to have meningococcal meningitis caused by Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B, with one death. On 14 Oct, HCDC reported H.H.K. (2014) fulminant meningococcemia with septic shock and multi‑organ failure; lab confirmed serogroup B, and the patient died that day. The same day, N.A.B.M. (2014) was diagnosed with meningitis due to serogroup B and admitted to Hospital for Tropical Diseases, currently listed as stable. On 15 Oct, N.T.H.Q. (2014), a desk mate of H.K., developed fever; CSF and blood PCR confirmed meningococcal meningitis B; patient is conscious, stable, and in isolation. Authorities held an emergency meeting, ordering close-contact antibiotic prophylaxis, environmental cleaning, and intensified surveillance. Exposed individuals are monitored for at least 10 days; no additional cases among contacts identified so far. Public health guidance urges prompt medical evaluation for suspected cases and cautions against unverified information.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市：髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎のクラスターを検出、学生1人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 学校内で髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎（血清群B）のクラスターが発生し死亡例も出ており、公衆衛生上重大かつヒト-ヒト感染リスクがあるため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 疾患名に『Classical Swine Fever』が含まれているが記事内容とは無関係であり、誤タグと判断。実際の主題はヒト髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎（Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B）のクラスター発生。

article.articleHeadline: Nhiều ca sốc nhiễm khuẩn, suy đa tạng do nhiễm liên cầu lợn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many Cases of Septic Shock and Multi-Organ Failure Due to Streptococcus suis Infection.
article.articleSummary: Four culture-confirmed Streptococcus suis infections were reported at the National Hospital for Tropical Diseases in Hanoi over the past two weeks, all linked to pig exposure or consumption of pig products. Clinical presentations ranged from meningitis with fever and severe headache to septic shock with multi-organ failure. Notably, a 53-year-old man from Hai Phong developed septic shock, acute kidney injury, liver injury, coagulopathy, and required vasopressors, intubation, and continuous renal replacement therapy after eating raw pig blood pudding (tiết canh). Others had meningitis symptoms; some experienced prolonged headaches and hearing loss as potential sequelae. Clinicians warn of rapid progression in septicemia and urge avoidance of raw or undercooked pork and contact with pig blood or secretions. Preventive guidance emphasizes PPE for handlers, avoiding slaughter of sick pigs, and seeking urgent medical care if symptoms after pork exposure arise.

triage.headline_ja: 豚レンサ球菌感染による敗血症性ショックおよび多臓器不全の症例が多発
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでは豚レンサ球菌（Streptococcus suis）感染症は既知の地方病であり、今回も生豚血プディング等の摂取に関連した散発例（4例）にとどまる。重症例はあるが人-人感染のリスクは低く、国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念も現時点ではないため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: Streptococcus suis（豚レンサ球菌）はベトナムで毎年一定数報告される地方病的な人獣共通感染症。感染経路は主に生豚血製品の摂取や豚との接触によるもので、人-人感染は確認されていない。重症化（敗血症性ショック・多臓器不全）例が複数見られる点は注視が必要だが、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: 3 học sinh TP HCM mắc não mô cầu, một em tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three students in Ho Chi Minh City contracted meningococcal meningitis, one died.
article.articleSummary: Three students at Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School, Hiệp Phước, Ho Chi Minh City, contracted meningococcal meningitis caused by Neisseria meningitidis group B. The first case, born in 2014, on 14/10 developed fulminant meningitis with septic shock and multi‑organ failure and died; lab testing confirmed group B. A second student from the same school was admitted to Infectious Diseases Hospital on 14/10 with a similar diagnosis and is currently stable. On 15/10, a third classmate who sat nearby developed fever and, by 16/10, PCR in blood and CSF confirmed group B meningitis; the patient is isolated and stable. Authorities are tracing close contacts and providing antibiotic prophylaxis to high‑risk contacts; prophylaxis is not for all students. Vaccines exist for group B with varying coverage; vaccination should be tailored. Pasteur Institute Ho Chi Minh City notes group B accounts for >98% of southern cases (2014–2025).

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市の生徒3人が髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎に感染、うち1人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 同一校内で3名の髄膜炎菌感染例（うち1名死亡）が確認されており、IHR基準の深刻性・異常性に該当し、学校という閉鎖環境でのヒト-ヒト感染拡大リスクも否定できないため。
triage.notes: Classical Swine Fever（豚コレラ）は記事内容と無関係で、疾患タグの誤分類と思われる。実際の主題はヒトの髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎クラスター発生であり、ホーチミン市の単一校内での事例に限定されている。今後の接触者調査や追加症例の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Cryo-EM Reveals How FMDV O/Cathay Variants Evade Neutralizing Antibodies
article.articleSummary: Foot-and-mouth disease virus (FMDV) O/Cathay topotype circulating in East and Southeast Asia shows antigenic drift that reduces neutralization by infection- and vaccine-induced antibodies. Recent O/Cathay isolates from China exhibit markedly lower sensitivity to sera from immunized animals, signaling functional immune escape. Researchers used seven porcine-derived neutralizing monoclonal antibodies and cryo-electron microscopy to map escape determinants to two antigenic regions. The first centers on VP1 near the receptor-binding RGD motif, with substitutions at the +2 position (glutamine to histidine or arginine) that alter antibody recognition without impairing receptor engagement. The second is a VP3-centered epitope, where changes at VP3-73 (Val to Lys) and VP3-134 (Lys to Thr) disrupt antibody contacts. These residues act epistatically, jointly affecting four pnAbs (pO18-2, -18, -28, -29), suggesting single-residue analyses may underestimate antigenic distance and complicate vaccine design against O/Cathay.

triage.headline_ja: クライオEM、FMDV O/Cathay変異体がどのように中和抗体を回避するかを明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫の免疫回避メカニズムに関する科学的知見の報告。中国での循環が確認されているが、記事は主に実験室での構造解析報告であり、アウトブレイク情報ではない。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは中国における FMDV O/Cathay の免疫回避メカニズムに関する研究報告である。サマリーに「東南アジアで循環」と述べられているが、具体的なアウトブレイク統計やケース報告ではなく、主に構造生物学的な分析結果の報告。動物疾患（豚）の研究であるが、ワクチン設計の複雑化などから獣医公衆衛生面での懸念がある。情報不足のため WATCH。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: TPHCM: Dịch cúm A đang lan nhanh, người dân cần chủ động phòng bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City: Influenza A outbreak spreading rapidly; residents should take proactive measures to prevent illness.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A (H1N1) 2009 is driving an ongoing outbreak in Ho Chi Minh City, with over 34,600 acute respiratory illness cases reported in a single week. Laboratory testing shows Influenza A/A(H1N1) 2009 dominating positive samples. While initial symptoms may be mild—cough, fatigue, or fever—infection can rapidly progress to pneumonia and respiratory failure with serious complications. Authorities continue city-wide surveillance of respiratory pathogens and actively collect samples from 29 healthcare facilities, including hospitals and district centers, while closely monitoring clusters in the community to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市：インフルエンザA型の流行が急速に拡大、住民は予防対策を
triage.triage_reason: 週間で3万4600件を超える急性呼吸器疾患が報告され、H1N1(2009)型インフルエンザが急速に拡大している。重症化（肺炎・呼吸不全）の可能性があり、社会的関心・行政の監視体制強化も見られるためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: H1N1(2009)は既に季節性株として定着しているが、1週間で3万件超の症例報告は規模として大きく、クラスター監視・検体採取など当局の積極的対応が報じられている。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は記事中に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Warga Serpong Lagoon Keluhkan Biaya Mahal Air Bersih yang Justru Terkontaminasi E. Coli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Residents of Serpong Lagoon complain about the high cost of clean water that is actually contaminated with E. coli.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 October 2026, residents of Serpong Lagoon in Keranggan, Setu, Tangerang Selatan report that their water supply is contaminated with Escherichia coli (E. coli) and that monthly bills, bundled with the local environmental maintenance fee (IPL), are high. An outbreak of muntaber (vomiting and diarrhea) has affected hundreds; E. coli was confirmed in three water samples, with the highest contamination in homes without water filtration. One child required hospitalization for four days and three nights. Reported bills include about Rp 1.2 million (Rp 900k for water plus Rp 300k IPL), while other households cite Rp 700k–Rp 1 million per month, often for water-only costs of Rp 200–500k. The water supply is managed by the housing developer, who also restricts borewell drilling. Dinas Kesehatan Tangerang Selatan has advised residents to stop using WTP water for consumption.

triage.headline_ja: セルポン・ラグーン住民、E.coliに汚染された高額な水道料金に不満を訴える
triage.triage_reason: 特定地域の水道水からE.coliが検出され、数百人規模の嘔吐下痢症(muntaber)流行と小児入院例が報告されており、住民・保健当局双方の関心が高いためフルRRAでの確認が妥当。
triage.notes: 南タンゲラン(バンテン州)の特定住宅開発地区(Serpong Lagoon)における水道インフラ由来のE.coli汚染事例。地方保健局(Dinas Kesehatan Tangerang Selatan)が飲用中止を勧告済みで、国際的拡大リスクは低いが、継続的な水質汚染曝露と住民の健康被害・経済的負担への社会的関心が高いため経過を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Update on mosquito-borne diseases, dengue fever and chikungunya fever
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever (DF) in Hong Kong: 1 imported case from Oct 9–15; total 34 DF cases in 2026 (32 imported, 2 local). 2025 had 59 (all imported); 2024 had 161 (156 imported, 5 local). Globally, DF remains high: 2024 >14 million cases; 2025 >5 million cases and >4,000 deaths in >90 countries; Jan–Aug 2026 ~2.2 million cases and >1,100 deaths. Regional activity remains elevated; Bangladesh, Cambodia, Sri Lanka and Vietnam each >100,000 cases; Indonesia >80,000; Malaysia >70,000; Singapore >2,600. Guangdong Province, China has 586 DF cases in 2026 as of September (155 in September). Chikungunya fever (CF) in Hong Kong: 2 imported CF cases (males, ages 17 and 64) from Oct 9–15; both travelled to the Mainland during incubation; HK total CF in 2026 is 7 confirmed (6 imported, 1 local); one recovered, the other stable. Guangdong CF: 1,753 cases in 2026 as of September (1,014 in September). Preventive measures emphasize environmental hygiene and DEET-based repellents (up to 30% for pregnant individuals, up to 10% for children), with alternatives IR3535 and picaridin; travelers should check destinations and follow label directions.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊媒介性感染症（デング熱・チクングニア熱）に関する最新情報
triage.triage_reason: 香港衛生当局による定期的な蚊媒介感染症サーベイランス報告であり、地域全体で症例数は多いものの、季節性の既知の流行パターンの範囲内で特段の異常性・新規性は認められない。広東省・ベトナム・インドネシア等での症例数増加は継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: カンボジア・スリランカ・バングラデシュ・マレーシア・シンガポールも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。香港の記事はChina(1814991)に含めた。定期的な衛生当局の週報であり、新規アウトブレイクを示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: बारिश के बाद डेंगू का वार! एक महिला डेंगू पॉजिटिव, हेल्थ टीम अलर्ट
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Strikes After the Rain! A Woman Tests Positive for Dengue, Health Team on Alert.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever continues in Gurudaspur after the monsoon, with Shahzada Nagar and Qadri Mohalla reporting hospitalised cases. A woman in Qadri Mohalla tested dengue-positive, prompting door-to-door checks by the health department. While the index patient is confirmed dengue-positive, officials say the other fever cases in the area have not yet tested positive for dengue. Four members of the patient’s household are also experiencing fever but are not confirmed dengue cases. Health teams found about 10 live dengue larvae in the neighborhood, triggering a targeted awareness and vector-control drive. Authorities have launched intensified public education on dengue prevention and eliminating breeding sites, as part of ongoing surveillance after the rains. The report emphasizes rapid testing to differentiate dengue from other febrile illnesses and curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: 雨の後にデング熱が襲来！女性がデング熱陽性、保健チームが警戒
triage.triage_reason: モンスーン後の季節性デング熱の単発症例であり、通常の保健当局の対応（戸別訪問調査、幼虫駆除）の範囲内で、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はインド・パンジャブ州グルダースプルでの単発デング熱陽性例と、それに伴う地域保健当局の通常の媒介蚊対策・啓発活動を報じるもの。バングラデシュは発生地域に含まれるが記事本文では言及されておらず除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 新增兩宗基孔肯雅熱及一宗登革熱個案　全部均為外地傳入
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two new chikungunya fever cases and one dengue fever case, all imported.
article.articleSummary: From Oct 9 to Oct 15, 2026, Hong Kong’s Centre for Health Protection reported one imported dengue fever case, the patient having visited Cambodia during the incubation period. This year Hong Kong has 34 dengue cases, most imported. In the past week, two imported chikungunya fever cases were identified in two men; both had travel history to Mainland China during incubation. They were admitted to hospital in a mosquito-free environment for treatment; the 17-year-old has recovered and been discharged, while the 64-year-old remains in stable condition. The CHP will continue epidemiological investigations and has notified Mainland health authorities about the two cases. Hong Kong’s total chikungunya cases this year reach seven (six imported, one local). Original report published by RTHK.

triage.headline_ja: 新たにチクングニア熱2件・デング熱1件を確認、いずれも海外からの輸入症例
triage.triage_reason: 全て渡航関連の輸入症例であり、重症例や地域内流行の兆候はなく、通常の症例報告の範囲内と判断される。
triage.notes: 香港の症例はいずれも輸入例で、うち1名のデング熱感染地はカンボジア、チクングニア熱2名は中国本土への渡航歴あり。香港自体は対象国リストに含まれないため、中国本土のみverified_locationsに記載。カンボジアは渡航先として言及されているが発生地ではなく対象国にも含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: തുലാമഴ എത്തുന്നു; സംസ്ഥാനത്ത് പകർച്ചവ്യാധി ഭീഷണി, മുന്നറിയിപ്പുമായി ആരോഗ്യ വിദഗ്ധർ!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two monsoons are arriving; health experts warn of an epidemic threat in the state.
article.articleSummary: Kerala faces an epidemic threat as the northeast monsoon intensifies, with dengue fever and leptospirosis spreading and water-borne diseases rising amid intermittent rainfall. The health department urges intensified prevention under a year-long Aarogyabhheri protection program, directing local self-government bodies to strengthen implementation. Influenza cases are reported in Ernakulam district, and children in Kochi show rising Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease. Dr. Rajani Jos, Infectious Disease Prevention Cell Coordinator at Ernakulam Government Medical College Hospital, stresses that fever warrants prompt medical care and that early treatment is crucial for leptospirosis and dengue; self-treatment should be avoided. Dr. Satyajith Nayar, secretary of the Indian Academy of Pediatrics (Kochi), outlines risks and urges rapid professional care for suspected cases. Preventive measures include boiling drinking water, chlorinating wells, a weekly Dry Day, and intensified sanitation and vector-control sprays by local authorities.

triage.headline_ja: トゥラマザ（北東モンスーン）到来へ；州内で感染症脅威、保健専門家が警告！
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州でのデング熱・レプトスピラ症・インフルエンザ等の季節性感染症拡大に関する年次的な注意喚起記事であり、重篤性や異常性の明確な記述はないが、継続的な監視が望ましい。
triage.notes: モンスーン季節に伴う例年の感染症（デング熱、レプトスピラ症、インフルエンザ、手足口病）の増加に関する保健当局の注意喚起記事。異常事態ではなく、季節的・定例的な公衆衛生対応の一環とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: 新增兩宗基孔肯雅熱及一宗登革熱感染個案　均為外地傳入
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two new chikungunya fever cases and one dengue fever infection case, all imported.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-16, Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection reports one newly imported dengue fever case from Oct 9–15, with the patient having traveled to Cambodia during the incubation period. This year Hong Kong has recorded 34 dengue cases, most imported. In the past week, two imported chikungunya fever cases were identified in two men; both had traveled to Mainland China during incubation. They were admitted to hospital in a mosquito-free environment for treatment; the 17-year-old has recovered and been discharged, while the 64-year-old remains in stable condition. The Centre is continuing epidemiological investigations and has notified Mainland health authorities about the two chikungunya cases. This year Hong Kong has seven chikungunya diagnoses, including six imported and one locally acquired; all three current cases are imported.

triage.headline_ja: 基孔肯雅熱の新規輸入症例2件とデング熱輸入症例1件を確認（いずれも海外渡航歴あり）
triage.triage_reason: 香港における輸入症例（デング熱・チクングニア熱）の通常の疫学報告であり、重症度・異常性・国際的拡大リスクのいずれも低い。
triage.notes: チクングニア熱の2症例は中国本土滞在歴があり、中国本土での感染源の可能性が示唆されるが詳細不明。デング熱症例はカンボジア渡航歴があり、カンボジアは対象国リスト外のため除外。すべて輸入症例で地域内（香港）での流行拡大は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: DSÖ, Kenya'da ikinci Ebola vakasını doğruladı, hükümetin temaslı takibini tebrik etti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO confirms the second Ebola case in Kenya, congratulates the government on its contact tracing.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms a second Ebola case; the patient is a relative of the first case who died on 5 October. WHO confirmed the second case and commended Kenya’s government for listing and quarantining contacts to curb transmission, with WHO Kenya representative Neema Rusibamayila Kimambo stating ongoing support to outbreak control. The second case resulted from contact with the first; no details of imported/exported cases are reported. The Bundibugyo Ebola variant has no approved treatment or vaccine. Background context notes Ebola outbreaks in Africa since 1976, including Sudan and the DRC, and the 2014-2017 West Africa epidemic with about 30,000 infections and over 11,000 deaths. In Ituri province, eastern DRC, 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths were reported, with the outbreak declared on May 15.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ケニアで2例目のエボラ出血熱患者を確認、政府の接触者追跡を称賛
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の二次感染がケニアで確認され、背景としてDRCイトゥリ州で246例の疑い例・65名の死者を伴う進行中のアウトブレイクが報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの2例目のエボラ確認だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。背景情報として言及されたDRCイトゥリ州の進行中アウトブレイク（246疑い例、65死亡、5月15日宣言）は具体的かつ現在進行形のデータであるため、対象国DRCをverified_locationsに含めた。ケニアでの2次感染は、DRCからの越境拡大の可能性を示唆しており国際的拡大リスクを高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Người đàn ông 68 tuổi tử vong do bệnh tay chân miệng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 68-year-old man dies of hand, foot and mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: An Giang Province, Vietnam, reports a fatal hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) case: a 68-year-old man, resident of Rạch Giá Ward, diagnosed with HFMD type 4 and rapidly progressing to acute fulminant myocarditis; laboratory tests confirmed Enterovirus 71 (EV71). Local CDC data show HFMD hotspots: Chợ Mới 788 cases, Long Xuyên 613, Châu Phú 553, and Châu Thành 406, with overall 2026 numbers higher than the prior year. The year’s pattern features early-year surges, a dip, then a rise from week 8, peaking in week 23 with 224 cases; by late September, activity appears to be waning, yet total cases remain elevated versus 2025. Among 126 samples from cases grade 2b and above, 62 were EV71 (49%), 27 were other enteroviruses, and 37 were negative. Authorities stress strengthened surveillance, rapid outbreak investigations, and targeted measures in preschools, schools, nurseries, and child-care facilities, with cross-sector collaboration to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: 68歳男性、手足口病により死亡
triage.triage_reason: 通常は小児に多い手足口病（EV71型）により68歳男性が急性劇症型心筋炎で死亡した異例の事例であり、地域全体の症例数も前年より増加しているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 成人（68歳）のEV71型手足口病による死亡は非典型的であり、アンジャン省では複数地域（Chợ Mới、Long Xuyên、Châu Phú、Châu Thành）で症例が集積し、2026年の累計症例数が前年を上回っている点に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Priorité santé - Ebola en RDC : les femmes en première ligne
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health Priority - Ebola in the DRC: women on the front lines.
article.articleSummary: Women and girls in the Democratic Republic of the Congo are disproportionately exposed to Ebola during the ongoing 17th outbreak, because they perform caregiving and support roles within families and communities, accompany patients to hospital, oversee funeral rites, and serve as frontline health workers in isolated, under-resourced facilities. Infection during pregnancy poses additional risks for pregnant women. The program examines why women remain especially vulnerable and why targeted awareness matters, and it questions how women’s engagement in communities and the health sector shapes the Ebola response in DRC. This Kinshasa-based broadcast concludes a series of special Ebola programs focused on women on the front lines. Participants include Dr Marie-Roseline Belizaire (WHO emergencies), Pr Octavie Lunguya (INRB microbiology), and Pr Bruno Lapika Dimomfu (CERDAS, University of Kinshasa), with Paulina Zidi reporting.

triage.headline_ja: 健康優先 - DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱：最前線に立つ女性たち
triage.triage_reason: 進行中の第17次エボラ流行に関する解説・特集番組であり、新規の感染拡大や異常事態を報じるものではないが、継続中のアウトブレイクとして経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事はDRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行における女性の脆弱性・役割に焦点を当てた特集報道であり、新規発生や急変を報じるものではない。既存のエボラ流行として別途フルRRAが進行中である可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: กรมควบคุมโรค ห่วงไข้หวัดใหญ่แพร่เชื้อใน 'ศูนย์พักพิง' แนะวิธีป้องกัน-เลี่ยงใกล้ชิดผู้ป่วย
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Department of Disease Control Concerned About Influenza Transmission in Shelter Centers; Recommends Prevention Measures and Avoiding Close Contact with Patients.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 October 2026, Thailand’s Department of Disease Control warns that influenza is a respiratory infection that spreads person-to-person via droplets from coughing or sneezing and through contact with contaminated secretions, especially in crowded or poorly ventilated shelter centers. To curb transmission, authorities urge universal precautions: wear masks in common areas, wash hands with soap and water or use alcohol-based gel (notably before meals, after using the restroom, and after touching shared items), and avoid sharing cups, utensils, towels, or personal items. If ill, individuals should wear a mask, maintain distance from others, and notify shelter staff for assessment and care. Typical influenza symptoms include fever, cough, sore throat, runny nose, headache, body aches, and fatigue. High-risk groups are young children, the elderly, pregnant women, and those with underlying conditions. The campaign emphasizes the “Cover, Wash, Avoid, Stop” approach and provides the 1422 hotline for information.

triage.headline_ja: 疾病管理局、避難所での季節性インフルエンザ感染拡大を懸念、予防法を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザに関する一般的な予防啓発情報であり、異常な流行や重症化、国際的拡大のリスクを示す記述はない。
triage.notes: 避難所という閉鎖的環境でのインフルエンザ拡散防止の注意喚起であり、通常の季節性疾患対策の範囲内。具体的な患者数や重症例、異常な流行動態の報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: Zika Antibody Signals in Pregnant Thai Women Blur the Line Between Zika and
article.articleSummary: Bangkok, Thailand—199 pregnant women at Rajavithi Hospital were followed during 2021-2022. Using the DPP ZCD IgM/IgG rapid assay for Zika, dengue, and chikungunya, researchers observed Zika-reactive serologic responses at 15.4 per 100 person-years, yet all samples were RT-qPCR negative for Zika RNA. Zika IgM positivity at enrollment or seroconversion for Zika IgM/IgG was accompanied by neutralization against Zika and all four dengue serotypes, indicating broad flavivirus exposure rather than a definite Zika infection. Prior dengue infection was associated with higher odds of Zika-reactive serology (OR 3.53, P=0.046). The study concludes that in dengue-endemic settings, cross-reactivity and dengue-immune boosting can masquerade as Zika signals, complicating real-time diagnosis in pregnancy; molecular confirmation is required, but may be elusive when asymptomatic. These findings echo similar diagnostic challenges noted in Latin America.

triage.headline_ja: 妊娠中のタイ人女性におけるジカ抗体シグナルがジカとデングの境界を曖昧にする
triage.triage_reason: 2021-2022年の研究データに基づく血清学的診断課題に関する学術報告であり、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威や急性アウトブレイクを示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は過去（2021-2022年）のコホート研究結果に関する学術論文の紹介であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイクや新規の公衆衛生事象を報告するものではない。診断上の交差反応性に関する知見であり、トリアージ対象のシグナルイベントには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Khởi tố 2 người mua hơn 7 tạ thịt lợn nhiễm dịch về làm thịt sấy, lạp sườn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two people charged for buying more than 700 kg of diseased pork to make jerky and sausages.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever virus detected in 750 kg of pork purchased for drying into jerky and sausages in Vinh Hung commune, Phú Thọ Province, Vietnam. On 16 October 2026, Phú Thọ Police Investigation Agency charged Chu Văn Đoàn (43) and Bùi Thị Hiền (50) with violations of food safety regulations (Article 317) for processing meat from diseased animals. Earlier, on 28 July, authorities, prompted by a tip, inspected Đoàn’s meat business and found no valid food safety certification, missing product origin documents, and lack of proper labels. Laboratory tests confirmed ASF virus in the meat; a purported food additive powder contained colors not permitted. Seizures included 225 kg dried pork and 165 kg raw meat, plus other dried meats and sausages, with assets valued over 96.2 million VND. The case remains under investigation; authorities urge compliance with safety laws and avoidance of diseased, spoiled, or unclearly sourced meat.

triage.headline_ja: 病気の豚肉700kg以上を購入し干し肉・ソーセージを製造した2人を起訴
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（アフリカ豚熱）に関する食品安全法違反の摘発事例であり、ヒトの公衆衛生への直接的な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ASFは動物疾病でありヒトへの感染性はない。本件は食品安全・法執行の案件であり、疾病サーベイランスとしての公衆衛生シグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Khẩn trương khoanh vùng, khống chế bệnh não mô cầu tại TP Hồ Chí Minh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urgently contain and control meningococcal disease in Ho Chi Minh City.
article.articleSummary: Three confirmed cases of Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B meningococcal disease have been identified at Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School, Hiệp Phước, Ho Chi Minh City, with one death and two others currently treated. On 14 October, a student diagnosed with fulminant meningococcemia and septic shock died; another student at the same school was diagnosed with meningitis due to serogroup B. On 15 October, a third student, sharing a desk with the deceased, developed fever; 16 October PCR tests on blood and CSF confirmed serogroup B meningococcal infection; the patient is stable and in isolation. Health authorities (Ho Chi Minh City Department of Health, HCDC, and involved hospitals) have initiated rapid epidemiological investigation, contact tracing, and chemoprophylaxis for close contacts, with health monitoring and infection-control measures in place at the school. Class suspension is not routinely required; vaccination and prophylaxis decisions follow professional guidance, and parents are advised not to self-prescribe antibiotics.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市で髄膜炎菌感染症の封じ込めを急ぐ
triage.triage_reason: 学校内クラスターで死亡例を含む3例が確認されたが、保健当局が迅速に調査・接触者対応を実施しており、現時点で国際的拡大の兆候はないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 単一校内でのクラスター発生であり、地元保健当局が積極的に対応している。続報でクラスターの拡大有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : le virus fait 10 victimes parmi les élèves d'un établissement d'Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the virus kills 10 people among the students of a school in Ituri.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease continues to spread in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province, with at least 10 student deaths among 25 confirmed Ebola cases in several schools. Seven students are currently receiving treatment in regional Ebola centers. The fatalities occur more than a month after schools reopened for a new academic year. Yvon Muke, Ituri’s provincial education official, urged adherence to protective measures and health guidelines to curb transmission. The WHO Africa regional office reports the outbreak evolving geographically and in case/death counts. The outbreak has affected over 65 health zones across eight provinces: Haut-Uele, Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, South Ubangi, and North Ubangi.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で拡大：イトゥリ州の学校で生徒10人死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRC複数州・65以上の保健地域に拡大し、学校でのクラスター発生と死亡者増加が確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHOアフリカ地域事務局が地理的・症例数の拡大を報告しており、学校での集団感染が新たな懸念材料。8州・65以上の保健地域に拡大中であり、継続的な監視と国際支援が必要と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Vietnamese man in critical condition with malaria after returning from Congo
article.articleSummary: Plasmodium falciparum malaria in a 46-year-old Vietnamese man returning from nearly two years in the Democratic Republic of Congo leaves him in critical condition. He developed persistent jaundice, fatigue and loss of appetite, collapsed and required intubation. Tests confirmed P. falciparum, the deadliest malaria parasite common in Africa. History includes untreated hepatitis B and self-treatment with traditional herbal medicine before hospital admission. On admission he had multi-organ dysfunction: liver injury, kidney dysfunction and coagulation abnormalities. Initial suspicion of severe liver disease masked malaria; travel history and prior fevers guided testing. This case highlights imported malaria risk for travelers from endemic regions, with guidance to seek prompt medical care and report travel history; prevention includes mosquito avoidance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴから帰国したベトナム人男性、マラリアで重体
triage.triage_reason: 渡航関連の輸入マラリア単発症例であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な拡大リスクや異常性は認められず、社会的関心も限定的と判断される。
triage.notes: 単一の輸入症例報告であり、DRCやベトナムでの集団発生・流行を示す情報はない。個人の重症化事例としての報道。

article.articleHeadline: HCM City reports meningococcal disease cluster, one student dead
article.articleSummary: Three students at Hai Ba Trung Lower Secondary School in Hiep Phuoc commune, Ho Chi Minh City, have been diagnosed with group B meningococcal disease, with one fatality. The first case, reported October 14, died from fulminant meningococcal disease; two more cases were confirmed among the students. The Hospital for Tropical Diseases, along with Children's Hospital 1 and Nha Be General Hospital, are treating the cases. HCMC’s Centre for Disease Control (HCDC) and city health department have ordered contact tracing and preventive antibiotics for close contacts, and disinfected classrooms, toilets and shared areas. Contacts will be monitored for at least 10 days per MOH guidance. An urgent meeting with medical experts and the Department of Education was held to coordinate actions. HCDC is guiding the school and Hiep Phuoc Commune Health Station on hygiene and monitoring. Meningococcal disease is caused by Neisseria meningitidis and spreads via the respiratory tract.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市で髄膜炎菌感染症クラスターを報告、学生1人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 学校内で髄膜炎菌感染症のクラスターが発生し1名が死亡、保健当局が緊急会議と接触者管理を実施しており、重症度と社会的関心の両面で基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 現時点では学校内の局所的クラスターであり、当局により接触者追跡・予防投薬・消毒などの対応がとられている。国際的拡大の兆候はないが、続報でクラスターの拡大有無を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 本港錄得34宗登革熱個案 衞生署籲防蚊｜METROHK.com.hk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong records 34 dengue fever cases; Department of Health urges mosquito prevention.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong’s Centre for Health Protection reports 34 dengue fever cases in 2026 to date, with 32 imported and 2 locally transmitted; the latest imported case (Oct 9–15) had visited Cambodia. Two imported chikungunya cases were recorded, ages 17 and 64, both had visited Mainland China and were hospitalised in a mosquito-free environment; the 17-year-old has recovered and was discharged, the other remains stable. Past HK totals: 2023 had 59 dengue cases (all imported); 2024 had 161 (156 imported, 5 local). Globally, dengue incidence remains high: last year >5 million cases reported in over 90 countries/regions; Jan–Aug this year ~2.2 million. Nearby hotspots include Bangladesh, Cambodia, Sri Lanka, Vietnam (>100,000 each), Indonesia (>80,000), Malaysia (>70,000), and Singapore (>2,600); Guangdong Province, China, recorded 586 infections as of September. Prevention emphasizes DEET repellents (restricted concentrations for pregnant women and children), weekly vase-water changes, inner-wall cleaning, and keeping drains clear; call 1823 and consult CHP/FEHD pages for details.

triage.headline_ja: 本港で登革熱34件を記録、衛生署が防蚊を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 香港における輸入例中心の登革熱・チクングニア熱の定例サーベイランス報告であり、異常な増加や重症化、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は確認されない。
triage.notes: 記事は香港の定例サーベイランス報告が主題。地域の流行状況としてベトナム・インドネシア・中国広東省の具体的な症例数が言及されているため参考として含めたが、カンボジア・スリランカ・バングラデシュ・マレーシア・シンガポールは対象国リスト外のため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: 3 học sinh TPHCM mắc não mô cầu, 1 em tử vong trong ngày nhập viện
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three Ho Chi Minh City students contract meningococcal meningitis; one dies on the day of admission.
article.articleSummary: Three students from Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School in Hiệp Phước Commune, Ho Chi Minh City, have meningococcal meningitis due to Neisseria meningitidis group B. One child died on admission; two others are under treatment. On 14 October, a student born in 2014 presented with fulminant septicemia and multi-organ failure, laboratory-confirmed as group B. Another student from the same school was admitted with group B meningitis and is stable. On 15 October a third classmate developed fever; on 16 October PCR confirmed group B meningococcal infection, the patient stable and isolated. Health authorities launched an epidemiological investigation, identified close contacts, and provided antibiotic prophylaxis where indicated, with schools implementing preventive measures. Vaccination for group B exists but coverage varies; prophylaxis guidance is targeted rather than universal.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市の生徒3人が髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎に感染、1人は入院当日に死亡
triage.triage_reason: 同一校の生徒間で髄膜炎菌（B群）によるクラスターが発生し、1人が入院当日に死亡するなど重症例が確認されており、IHR基準2項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 同一中学校（Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School）内で3名の髄膜炎菌感染例（B群、劇症型敗血症含む）が短期間に発生し、保健当局が接触者調査・抗菌薬予防投与・学校での予防対策を実施中。今後の二次感染拡大の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 신정환, '뎅기열 사건' 병원 사진 비하인드 언급..."나 치료하던 인턴 지금 병원장" [RE:뷰]
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shin Jung-hwan, 'Dengue Fever Incident' behind-the-scenes mention of hospital photos... 'The intern I treated is now the hospital director' [RE:View]
article.articleSummary: Shin Jung-hwan revisits the 2010 dengue fever episode tied to his Philippines-based illegal gambling scandal. At the time, he claimed dengue fever prevented his return from the Philippines, and viral photos showed him on a hospital bed undergoing an electrocardiogram. In a recent YourHan/TV appearance, he recalled the moment and joked that the nurse and a young intern who cared for him later became a hospital director. He had previously admitted on another program that the dengue claim was a fabrication, saying a friend suggested the photo idea and that he apologized while dressed in the attire from that period. The controversy spurred a public backlash and a roughly 16-year hiatus, after which he launched a personal channel in April. The episode underscores how a dengue-related claim was used in a celebrity scandal and its lasting impact on the public image.

triage.headline_ja: シン・ジョンファン、『デング熱事件』の病院写真の裏話に言及...「当時治療してくれたインターンが今は病院長」[RE:ビュー]
triage.triage_reason: 2010年の芸能人スキャンダルに関する回顧的な芸能ニュースであり、実際の感染症発生事例ではないため公衆衛生上の懸念に該当しない。
triage.notes: デング熱への罹患自体が本人の告白により虚偽（捏造）であったとされており、現実の疾病発生事例ではない芸能ゴシップ記事。

article.articleHeadline: Kisah Epidemi Satu Abad yang Lalu: Ketika Disentri Melanda Desa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Story of a Century-Old Epidemic: When Dysentery Struck the Village.
article.articleSummary: Dysentery struck Cilimus, a village at the foot of Mount Ciremai in Kuningan, West Java, during the 1920s in the post–World War I era. In the Cirebon region, foreign ships docking at Cirebon harbour introduced the illness inland, enabling spread across Cilimus about 21 kilometers from the port. The outbreak caused at least one death per day in Cilimus and featured severe diarrhea with mucus and blood. Dysentery is transmitted fecal-oral, via contaminated food or water, caused by bacteria such as Shigella or parasites such as Entamoeba histolytica. The account draws on Peter Liang Tek Sun's autobiography, A Life Under Three Flags, documenting colonial-era public health challenges and imported infections that devastated a once-prosperous town in Priangan Timur.

triage.headline_ja: 一世紀前の疫病の物語：赤痢が村を襲った時
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は1920年代の歴史的な赤痢流行に関する回顧録であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生イベントではないため、トリアージ対象外。
triage.notes: 記事は1920年代の植民地時代の歴史的エピソードを扱ったコラムであり、現在の感染症発生事例ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Sau ăn tiết canh, nhiều người nguy kịch do nhiễm liên cầu lợn nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After eating raw pig-blood dish, many people are in critical condition due to severe Streptococcus suis infection.
article.articleSummary: Four culture-confirmed Streptococcus suis infections have been reported at Hanoi’s National Hospital of Tropical Diseases over the past two weeks, all linked to pigs or pig products. The most severe case involves a 53-year-old man from Hai Phong who developed septic shock, multi-organ failure, and disseminated intravascular coagulation after eating tiết canh (a raw pig blood dish). On admission he was unconscious with shock; labs showed marked inflammation, severe thrombocytopenia (platelets 29 x10^9/L), hypofibrinogenemia (<0.35 g/L), and hyperlactatemia (lactate 13 mmol/L). He required intubation, mechanical ventilation, vasopressors, broad-spectrum antibiotics, and continuous renal replacement therapy. Other patients presented with meningitis or septicemia, with some experiencing persistent headaches and hearing loss. Streptococcus suis is carried by pigs and can infect via contact with pig blood/secretions or by consuming undercooked pork. Prevention emphasizes avoiding tiết canh, cooking pork thoroughly, protective gear for handlers, wound care, and reporting exposure to clinicians.

triage.headline_ja: 生豚血の料理(ティエットカン)を食べた後、多くの人が重症の豚レンサ球菌感染症で危篤に
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・ハノイで豚レンサ球菌感染症（S. suis）による重症例が複数報告されているが、既知の食文化由来の散発例であり国際的拡大や渡航制限の懸念は低い。社会的関心度が不明なため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: S. suisはベトナムで毎年散発的に報告される既知の人獣共通感染症で、生豚血料理（ティエットカン）摂取が主要リスク因子。ヒト-ヒト感染は確認されておらず、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性は低いが、重症例（敗血症性ショック、DIC等）が集中して報告されている点は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC eleva a cerca de 9.300 los casos y 4.500 los muertos a causa del brote de ébola declarado hace cinco meses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC raises to nearly 9,300 the number of cases and 4,500 deaths due to the Ebola outbreak declared five months ago.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is the deadliest in the country’s history. By 16 Oct 2026, reported cases reach 9,277 with 4,478 deaths (65 new cases, 37 deaths in the last 24 hours). Case fatality rate stands at 48.3%; 2,486 recoveries and 924 patients in hospital or isolation; contact tracing covers 78% of contacts. Ituri province remains the epicenter, accounting for 73.4% of all cases, though 47.7% of the latest daily infections occur there; seven provinces (Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Bas-Uélé, Tshopo, Ubangi Sur) are affected across 65 of 167 health zones. No vaccine or approved treatment exists. The outbreak has prompted Kenya to report two cases; Uganda declared itself Ebola-free on 28 July after 2 deaths and 20 cases. WHO comparisons suggest it could surpass West Africa’s 2014–2016 epidemic (28,616 cases, 11,325 deaths).

triage.headline_ja: DRC、エボラ出血熱の症例数が約9,300人、死者数が4,500人に増加 ― 発生から5カ月
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.3%、死者4,478人、ケニアへの越境伝播が確認され、国家史上最悪の規模に拡大しており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確なためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: ケニアで2例確認、ウガンダは7月28日にエボラ終息を宣言済み。ワクチン・承認治療法が存在せず、西アフリカ2014-2016年流行を超える可能性がWHOにより指摘されている。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Mosqitter uses AI to turn mosquito traps into a disease surveillance network The Mainstream
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-16, dengue, a viral illness transmitted by mosquitoes, surged globally with WHO reporting cases rising from 6.5 million in 2023 to 14.6 million in 2024. Mosqitter, a Pennsylvania startup, is turning mosquito traps into a disease-surveillance network with AI-powered species identification. With over 5,000 devices on 5 continents, its Mosqitter Grand and Mini trace populations in public spaces and homes. The forthcoming Febris Monitoring System adds continuous monitoring and disease-risk assessment, but does not diagnose individual mosquitoes. Traps attract female Aedes mosquitoes using heat, scent, light, and CO2 in the Grand model. Its AI analyzes captured specimens, cross-checks results with external datasets, and outputs a confidence score, aided by weather, wind and humidity data to forecast population changes and potential health risks. Markets include Brazil, US, Greece, India, Ukraine, Nigeria; Heathrow and Gatwick are pilots under UK HSA. Revenue projections: 2026 >$1M; 2027 >$3.5M; round of $5M.

triage.headline_ja: MosqitterがAIを活用し蚊トラップを感染症サーベイランスネットワークに転換
triage.triage_reason: 特定の国・地域での具体的なデング熱アウトブレイクを報じるものではなく、蚊トラップ監視技術企業の製品紹介記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱監視技術（Mosqitter社の製品）に関する紹介であり、特定国での感染拡大を報じるものではない。ブラジル・インドは市場展開先として言及されているのみで、実際の感染イベントの発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: DRC: Ebola Response -- Haut-Uele Governor Closes Strategic PK51 Mining Site
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Haut-Uele Province, linked to Bundibugyo strain. On Sept 30, 2026, Governor Jean Bakomito Gambu ordered the immediate closure of the PK51 mining site and strict movement restrictions between PK51 and Sali Sali to curb transmission amid resistance from mining communities in Wamba and PK51. A crisis meeting with mining cooperatives, artisanal miners, WHO, UNICEF, and Africa CDC led to enhanced measures, including large-scale deployment of security forces (FARDC, PNC) to escort healthcare workers and ensure compliance. Mining operators are being held accountable for enforcing preventive practices, such as regular handwashing and immediate reporting of suspected cases. The article does not provide case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, or specific infection sources beyond the Bundibugyo-strain epidemic linked to mining communities, and there is no mention of imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ対応 ― オートウエレ州知事が戦略的なPK51鉱山サイトを閉鎖
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国オートウエレ州でブンディブギョ株によるエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクが継続中であり、鉱山コミュニティでの対策抵抗、WHO・UNICEF・Africa CDCを含む緊急対応が実施されていることから、重大性・異常性・国際的拡大リスクの複数基準に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事には症例数・死亡数・検査確定情報の記載なし。鉱山労働者の移動制限や治安部隊の展開など、感染拡大防止のための積極的対応が行われている段階。

article.articleHeadline: Ikan Favorit RI Mengandung 1.600 Parasit, Lakukan Ini Sebelum Makan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Indonesia's Favorite Fish Contains 1,600 Parasites, Do This Before Eating.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian researchers analyzed 53 Katsuwonus pelamis (skipjack tuna) caught in Brazilian waters and found parasites in 96% of specimens, totaling over 1,600 worms. Parasites belong to Trypanorhyncha and Anisakis; kidneys and heart were consistently parasite-free, while intestines showed the highest infection, followed by skeletal muscle and stomach. The study, published in Ocean and Coastal Research, emphasizes prompt removal of internal organs after capture to prevent larvae migrating into muscle. Most parasites are killed by cooking or canning, but live larvae can cause gastrointestinal symptoms if the fish is eaten raw or undercooked; canned tuna poses lower risk. The findings come from a small, single-period sample and cannot be extrapolated globally. Parasitic infections in seafood can affect product quality and consumer safety and may indicate healthy marine ecosystems.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアで人気の魚に1,600匹の寄生虫、食べる前にすべきこと
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル産カツオの寄生虫に関する研究報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態やヒト感染事例の報告ではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術研究（寄生虫の魚肉への分布に関する調査）の紹介であり、感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生イベントではない。対象国リストのBrazilは発生地域として付与されているが、感染症イベントではないためverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Khởi tố 2 đối tượng mua bán thịt lợn nhiễm dịch tả châu Phi làm thịt sấy, lạp sườn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two suspects charged with selling pork infected with African swine fever to make jerky and sausages.
article.articleSummary: Two suspects in Phú Thọ province, Vietnam, Chu Văn Đoàn (1983) and Bùi Thị Hiền (1976), were charged on 16 October 2026 with violating food safety regulations after buying pork showing signs of spoilage and infected with African swine fever (ASF) to make dried meat and sausages. The investigation began 28 July when police inspected Đoàn’s Dai Đồng household business in Vĩnh Hưng commune and found no valid food-safety certificate, self-declaration, or origin documents; many products lacked proper labeling. In July 2026, Đoàn bought about 750 kg of pork with discoloration and odor from Hiền to process into dried pork and sausages. Laboratory tests confirmed ASF virus in the raw meat, and a powder suspected as an additive contained unauthorized coloring. Authorities seized 225 kg of dried pork, 165 kg of raw meat, and other dried meats. The case is ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱感染豚肉を乾燥肉・ソーセージに加工して販売した2名を起訴
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（ASF）に関する食品安全違反の刑事事件であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生リスクや国際的拡大の懸念は認められないため見送りと判断する。
triage.notes: ASFは動物疾病でありヒト感染症ではない。本件は食品安全・刑事事件としての報道であり、感染症危機管理上のシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Rutshuru Fishing Activities Suspended in Vitshumbi and Nyakakoma Due to the Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Six laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases (Bundibugyo strain) were reported on October 2 in Kayna and Alimbongo health zones (Alimbongo: first four; Kayna: two after a prior recovered patient). On October 5, Rutshuru territory administrator Éphrem Kabasha, under AFC-M23, announced suspensions of fishing in Vitshumbi and Nyakakoma and bans on canoe traffic on Lake Edward, plus travel between Vitshumbi/Nyakakoma and Kiwanja, and on Nyakakoma-Ishasha, Kanyabayonga-Kiwanja, and Kanyabayonga-Kikuku roads, “until further notice.” All canoes must return to docking areas; fishing and boat traffic on Lake Edward are halted. Local residents fear livelihoods loss for fishers, transporters, merchants, and households dependent on cross-shore trade of fish and foodstuffs, amid prior disruptions with Lunyasenge and Musenda. The administrator did not specify whether these restrictions are tied to the Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行によりルツシュルのヴィツンビおよびニャカコマで漁業活動が停止
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州でエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）の検査確定症例が複数報告され、現地当局により移動制限・漁業停止などの対応が既に取られており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当するため。
triage.notes: 紛争地域（AFC-M23支配下）での発生であり、アクセス制限や治安問題が対応を複雑化させる可能性がある。ウガンダ・ルワンダは地理的に近接するが、記事内で発生国として言及されていないため対象国リストに含めず。オーストラリアはBluedotのジオコーディング誤りと判断し除外。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل ثاني إصابة مؤكدة بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records its second confirmed case of the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its second confirmed case of Ebola virus, with Nairobi saying there is no evidence of widespread community transmission. The patient was isolated and under medical follow-up before laboratory confirmation after presenting fever, fatigue, and joint pains. The second case is a close relative of last week’s first Ebola-related death in Kenya, a man who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and returned home. The ongoing outbreak remains centered in Ituri province, DRC, with cross-border spillover into neighboring countries, including Uganda and Kenya. Health authorities emphasize enhanced surveillance, contact tracing, and strict isolation to prevent further transmission while the Ituri outbreak continues to unfold.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラウイルスの2例目の感染確定例を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRC・イツリ州を中心としたエボラ流行がウガンダ・ケニアへ越境拡大しており、ケニアで死亡例に続き2例目の確定症例が報告された。国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の深刻性が認められるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はDRC（イツリ州）で継続中のエボラ流行とその越境拡大（ウガンダ・ケニア）。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、発生源国であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。渡航・貿易制限の有無は記事内で明示されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Quảng Ngãi: Thực phẩm vụ ngộ độc bánh mỳ dương tính với vi khuẩn Salmonella spp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Quang Ngai: Bread poisoning case tests positive for Salmonella spp.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella spp outbreak linked to bread products in Cam Thanh ward, Quảng Ngãi Province, Vietnam. On 16 Oct 2026, Viện Pasteur Nha Trang confirmed Salmonella spp positive (25g samples) in 13 items tested from ingredients and fillings used for bread, including pork sausage, shredded pork floss, sauces, chili sauce, butter, vegetables, and bread itself. Some samples also exceeded safety limits for Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus aureus. The investigation follows illness starting 9 Oct after consumption of bread purchased at the Ba Được sidewalk stall on Duy Tân Street; by 13 Oct, 167 people had been hospitalized. Authorities sealed the facility, suspended operations, and issued urgent directives; bakery Hồng Ngọc 12 was fined 90 million VND and will be shut for four months. Health officials advocate strict food-safety practices: cooking foods thoroughly, using clean water, avoiding cross-contamination, handwashing, and mandatory sampling and retention of food.

triage.headline_ja: クアンガイ省：パン食中毒事件の食品からサルモネラ菌陽性反応
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設が原因と特定された食品由来サルモネラ食中毒事例であり、当局により施設封鎖・営業停止等の対応が完了している。ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクはなく、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念は低い。
triage.notes: 原因食品（パン及び具材）からサルモネラ菌、大腸菌、黄色ブドウ球菌が検出され、販売施設は既に封鎖・罰金・営業停止処分済み。167人が入院したが地域限定の食中毒事例であり、感染症の国際的拡大リスクはない。

article.articleHeadline: TP.HCM ghi nhận chùm ca mắc não mô cầu, một trẻ tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City records a cluster of meningococcal disease cases, one child dies.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City records a cluster of meningococcal disease (Neisseria meningitidis) group B involving three students at a secondary school in Hiệp Phước commune; one 12-year-old, H.H.K., died on Oct 14. The other two patients are currently hospitalized with meningococcal meningitis at the Ho Chi Minh City Hospital for Tropical Diseases, in stable condition. Health authorities have initiated rapid epidemiological investigation, contact tracing, environmental cleaning, and ensured isolation and treatment. Close contacts were given antibiotic prophylaxis; classrooms and common areas were decontaminated; anyone with respiratory symptoms is monitored. On Oct 16, the Department of Health convened a crisis meeting with health experts and the Department of Education to reinforce early detection, prompt diagnosis, and management of suspected cases, especially those with epidemiological links. Parents are advised not to self-prescribe antibiotics; prophylaxis must be administered under medical guidance. Separately, Dak Lak province reported two meningococcal cases, including a 2-year-old fatality.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市で髄膜炎菌感染症のクラスターを確認、児童1人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 学校内での髄膜炎菌感染症クラスター発生と死亡例があり、保健当局が緊急会議を開くなど行政的関心も高いため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が妥当と判断。
triage.notes: ホーチミン市の学校内クラスター（3例、うち1名死亡）に加え、ダクラク省でも2例（うち2歳児1名死亡）報告されており、複数地域での発生が示唆される。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は現時点でなし。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en el Congo supera los 9 mil 300 casos y 4 mil 400 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo surpasses 9,300 cases and 4,400 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 9,277 cases and 4,478 deaths, per INSP. The tally rose by 65 cases and 37 deaths in the last 24 hours, with a global case-fatality rate of 48.3%. About 2,486 people have recovered; 924 remain hospitalized or in isolation. Bundibugyo ebolavirus is circulating, with no vaccine or approved treatment. Contact tracing stands at 78% and has declined recently, raising transmission concerns. Ituri remains the epicenter with 73.4% of total cases, though the latest day accounted for 47.7% of new infections. The outbreak has spread to Kivu Norte, Kivu Sur, Alto Uélé, Bajo Uélé, Tshopo and Ubangi Sur, affecting 65 of 167 health zones across seven provinces. Kenya reported two confirmed cases; Uganda declared Ebola-free on July 28 after 20 cases and two deaths. Projections suggest it could surpass the 2014–2016 West Africa outbreak (28,616 cases, 11,325 deaths) per WHO.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ、症例9,300件・死者4,400人を超える
triage.triage_reason: 致死率約48%、7州65保健地区に拡大し接触者追跡率低下による伝播リスク増大、近隣国ケニアへの越境感染も報告されており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダ・アンゴラは発生地域に含まれるが対象国リストに該当せず除外。ワクチン・承認治療法がなく、接触者追跡率低下が伝播拡大の懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RD Congo: l'épidémie s'étend à une huitième province, frontalière de la Centrafrique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: the outbreak has spread to an eighth province bordering the Central African Republic.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to Nord-Ubangi, an eighth province bordering the Central African Republic, with two cases confirmed by health officials and not yet officially announced. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant and has surpassed 9,000 cases with about 4,381 deaths, the DRC’s deadliest Ebola outbreak and the second-largest globally by case count. In Nord-Ubangi, suspected mining-zone deaths in Wapinda prompted laboratory testing in a provincial lab and Kinshasa. Ituri remains the epicenter, but cases have risen in North Kivu, and infections have been reported in South-Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele and South-Ubangi. Cross-border cases include Uganda (20 cases, 2 deaths) and Kenya (second case; a 39-year-old Kenyan living in DRC; first patient died Oct 5 in Nairobi). Ebola transmits via contact with bodily fluids; no vaccine or approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱: 流行が中央アフリカ共和国と国境を接する8番目の州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCのエボラ流行が8州目に拡大し、9000例超・死者4381人で同国史上最悪の流行となっており、ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境感染も発生していることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境感染が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。中央アフリカ共和国は国境を接するのみで感染報告はない。

article.articleHeadline: How prepared is Kenya for an Ebola outbreak?
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed Ebola cases and one death in Kenya, linked to the DRC outbreak that has surpassed 9,000 cases and 4,400 deaths. The first Kenyan patient died in Nairobi on Oct 5 after traveling from DRC to Uganda and then flying to Nairobi via Entebbe on Oct 3. A second relative, 39, contracted Ebola while under quarantine; symptoms appeared Oct 13. Contact tracing identified 128 contacts; 113 have been located and all but five—abroad in unspecified countries—are quarantined. Health authorities report no evidence of wider community transmission. Early symptoms include fever, fatigue, malaise, muscle pain, headache, sore throat; later vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, and kidney/liver infection. Laboratory tests confirm Ebola. WHO notes incubation of 2–21 days. Kenya has designated isolation centers, enhanced screening at airports/borders, mobile labs, and wings for screening. Critics warn of leadership gaps, limited isolation capacity, PPE shortages, and strains on health workers, questioning regional cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアはエボラ出血熱の発生にどの程度備えているか？
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9000例・4400人超の死者を出す大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、ケニアへの国際的な感染拡大（渡航関連の確定症例・死亡）が確認されているため、フルリスク評価が必要と判断する。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアの備え状況だが、感染源であるDRCの流行規模（9000例超、死者4400人超）が国際的拡大の根拠となっているためDRCを対象国として記録。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。渡航・貿易制限については明示的な禁止措置ではなく空港での検疫強化のため、Yes判定はやや保守的な評価である点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia : Kasenengwa Steps Up Malaria Fight
article.articleSummary: Malaria surge in Kasenengwa District, Eastern Province, Zambia, prompts intensified Indoor Residual Spraying after more than 22,000 malaria cases in the second quarter of 2026, a 277% increase from the first quarter. District Health Director Naphtaly Phiri said household spraying targets mosquitoes to reduce transmission. Community-Based Volunteers have been mobilized to sensitize residents and encourage participation. Headman Kanamanja's Induna, Kenneth Zulu, welcomed the initiative and urged community leaders to back the programme, noting that the Government has invested substantial resources to protect the population from malaria.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア：カセネングワ、マラリア対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: 特定地域でマラリア症例が前四半期比277%増と急増しているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低く、既に国内対応（室内残留噴霧）が進行中であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 死亡数・重症度の具体的データが不足。マラリアは媒介感染症であり国際的拡散リスクは通常低いが、感染者数の急増（277%）は地域の公衆衛生上の懸念として継続監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: गिरफ्तारी से बचने के लिए आरोपी ने पुलिसकर्मी के हाथ पर काटा, HIV संक्रमण की पुष्टि to evade arrest the accused bit the police officer on the hand hiv infection
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: To evade arrest, the accused bit the police officer on the hand; HIV infection confirmed.
article.articleSummary: In Chhatarpur’s Bakshawa area, a rape-accused fugitive bit a police constable on the hand to evade arrest. The assailant tried to flee as blood was seen, and was captured. A routine medical test after arrest confirmed the accused is HIV-positive. The injured constable was rushed to Sagar Medical College for initial treatment and later to Bundelkhand Medical College in Sagar for further care. SP Rajat Saklecha noted first aid was provided before hospital transport, and the blood test confirmed HIV infection in the suspect. The bite left deep marks on the constable’s hand, raising concerns about possible HIV transmission; doctors are treating the officer, and it remains unclear whether the constable has contracted HIV, with results awaited.

triage.headline_ja: 逮捕を逃れるため容疑者が警察官の手を噛む、HIV感染が確認される
triage.triage_reason: 単発の個別事件であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスク、社会的関心の高まりは認められない。
triage.notes: 個別の刑事事件に伴うHIV曝露事例であり、公衆衛生イベントとしての広がりはない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Spread Raises Fresh Urgency for Africa's Domestic Health Funding
article.articleSummary: Ebola persists in Africa, with active spread at the DRC's north Kivu epicentre and a recent Ebola death in Kenya, underscoring Africa’s urgent need for robust health emergency preparedness and sustained domestic funding. Kenya reported outbreak controls already in place, while DRC faced delayed life-saving supplies after USAID shutdown and MSF warning that the strain is spreading rapidly. UNECA notes Africa’s health-financing model remains fragile: external aid has fallen about 30%, and in 13 countries households fund more of health costs than governments; Abuja Declaration targets of 15% of national budgets for health remain unmet (often 2–12%). Calls for a fundamental reset in health financing stress the need for prepositioned stock, PPE distribution, and sustainable reform with budget lines, medium-term expenditure frameworks, and costed benefit packages. Officials warn that health is investment in people, productivity, and prosperity, not merely expenditure.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの拡大、アフリカの国内保健資金の緊急性を再認識させる
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブでのエボラ流行継続に加えケニアでの死亡例が報告され、MSFが急速な拡大を警告しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: ケニアでの死亡例が報告されているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。DRCでの流行継続とUSAID資金停止による供給遅延が深刻度を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Khởi tố 2 người mua, bán lợn bệnh về làm thịt sấy, lạp sườn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two people charged with buying and selling diseased pigs to make jerky and sausages.
article.articleSummary: Two people in Phú Thọ Province, Vietnam, Chu Văn Đoàn (43) and Bùi Thị Hiền (50) were charged on Oct 16, 2026, with food safety violations after purchasing about 750 kg of diseased pork from Hiền to process into dried pork and sausages. An inspection of Đoàn’s Vĩnh Hưng commune business found no food safety certification, missing product declarations and origin documents, and many items without labels. Laboratory tests on the July 2026 meat batch returned positive for African swine fever (ASF) virus. Investigators also found a powder suspected as a food additive containing prohibited colorants. Authorities seized 225 kg of dried pork and 165 kg of raw meat, along with other products, and continue the case. The police urged compliance with safety rules and avoidance of using diseased or spoiled meat. Separately, Lập Thạch police are pursuing a case of 15 dead pigs dumped by road.

triage.headline_ja: 病気の豚を購入・加工・販売した2人を起訴、乾燥肉やソーセージに加工
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱(ASF)感染豚肉の不正流通事件であり食品安全上の懸念はあるが、人への健康被害や大規模流行拡大の情報はなく、単発の犯罪摘発事例として様子見が妥当。
triage.notes: ASFは家畜疾病でありヒトへの感染性はない。本件は食品安全・流通規制違反の刑事事件が主題。別途15頭の豚の死骸遺棄事案も言及されているが詳細不明。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: School children among virus victims in Ituri province
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to hit Ituri Province in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, where authorities say at least 10 students have died amid an outbreak that has produced 25 confirmed cases among schoolchildren. The deaths come more than a month after schools reopened for the new school year; seven currently undergoing treatment. A provincial education official urged strict adherence to protective equipment use and health guidelines to curb transmission. The World Health Organization's Regional Office for Africa, in a situation report released Wednesday, said the outbreak in the Congo continues to evolve, expanding both geographically and numerically. The latest outbreak has affected more than 65 health zones across eight provinces, underscoring the ongoing spread as authorities monitor affected schools and communities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱:イトゥリ州の学童が犠牲者に含まれる
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で学童を含む死亡者を出しながら地理的・数的に拡大しており、WHOアフリカ地域事務局も継続的な拡大を報告しているためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: WHOアフリカ地域事務局の状況報告によれば、アウトブレイクは8州65以上の保健地区に拡大しており、致死性の高い疾患であることから継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: بعد أول وفاة.. كينيا تعلن ثاني إصابة مؤكدة بإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After the first death, Kenya announces the second confirmed Ebola case.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 October 2026, Kenya reports its second confirmed Ebola virus disease (EVD) case, with authorities noting no evidence of widespread community transmission. The patient was under lockdown/isolation and medical monitoring prior to confirmation, and was isolated after developing fever, fatigue, and joint pains; laboratory tests subsequently confirmed Ebola infection. Last week Kenya also reported its first Ebola-related death; the deceased was a man who resided in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and returned to Kenya, with the current second case being a close relative of the first. The outbreak remains active in the Ituri region of the DRC, with spillover reported in neighboring countries, including Uganda and Kenya. Kenyan health authorities emphasize containment measures and tracing to prevent wider spread.

triage.headline_ja: 最初の死亡例の後、ケニアが2例目のエボラ確定症例を発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱がDRCイトゥリ州から周辺国（ウガンダ、ケニア）へスピルオーバーしており、死亡例も発生していることからIHR基準を複数満たし、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの感染確認だが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。アウトブレイクの発生源であるDRC（イトゥリ州）のみを対象国として計上した。国境を越えた伝播事例であり、続報の確認とDRC国内の状況把握が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Mua thịt lợn nhiễm bệnh về chế biến lạp sườn, thịt sấy để bán ra thị trường
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Buying diseased pork to process into sausages and jerky for sale on the market.
article.articleSummary: In Phu Tho province, Vietnamese police charged two individuals on suspicion of violating food safety regulations after discovering a small business producing dried pork, jerky, and sausages without proper certificates, labeling, or origin documents. Investigations showed Chu Van Doan had purchased about 750 kg of pork with discoloration and a foul odor from Bui Thi Hien in July 2026 to process into cured meats. Laboratory testing of the meat returned positive for African swine fever virus, raising serious public-health concerns. A suspected additive powder found at the facility contained colorants not approved for food use. Authorities seized 225 kg of dried pork, 165 kg of raw meat, and various products, with assets valued at over 96.2 million dong. Doan and Hien face charges under Article 317 of the Penal Code for food-safety violations. Separately, four individuals were hospitalized with severe Streptococcus suis infections over two weeks in association with eating raw pig blood dishes or contact with diseased pigs, prompting urgent health warnings.

triage.headline_ja: 病気の豚肉を購入してソーセージや干し肉に加工し市場で販売
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム国内の食品安全犯罪事件が主題だが、Streptococcus suis感染による重症入院例が複数報告されており、公衆衛生上の懸念として継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事は主にASF感染豚肉を用いた食品安全違反事件を報じているが、別途Streptococcus suis感染による重症患者4名（生豚血料理摂取や病豚との接触が原因）が報告されており、公衆衛生上の注視が必要。ASF自体はヒトに感染しないため、人の健康への直接的影響はStreptococcus suisに限定される。

article.articleHeadline: Children at highest risk of death in DR Congo Ebola outbreak, says MSF
article.articleSummary: MSF warns that in the DR Congo Ebola outbreak driven by Bundibugyo virus, the youngest children are at the highest risk of death. In North Kivu, children account for about 24% of confirmed cases; specifically, 24% are under five, and infants under one year old make up 13%—versus 6% in Ituri. At the Ebola treatment centre in Butembo, from June to September 2026, 24 of 30 admitted children died, most under five. MSF says gaps in general health facilities—limited paediatric expertise, equipment, and infection prevention—hamper identification and safe management of suspected cases. Many paediatric admissions had prior illnesses in other facilities, with family members not infected, suggesting likely healthcare-associated transmission. MSF calls for stronger infection control, PPE, and training, plus child-focused dosing guidance and rapid inclusion of children in all Bundibugyo virus studies and vaccines.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行、子どもの死亡リスクが最も高いとMSFが警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョウイルス）のアウトブレイクが継続中で、重症度・死亡率が高く、医療関連感染の懸念もあることからIHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当し、フルRRAが必要と判断。
triage.notes: MSFが医療施設内感染（院内感染）の可能性を指摘しており、感染対策の不備が拡大リスクを高めている点に注意。ワクチン・治療薬の小児への適用についても課題が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện chùm ca bệnh não mô cầu tại TP Hồ Chí Minh, một học sinh tử vong​
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Detection of a cluster of meningococcal disease cases in Ho Chi Minh City; one student has died.
article.articleSummary: Three students from Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School, Hiệp Phước commune, Ho Chi Minh City, have meningococcal disease due to Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B. One pupil, H.H.K. (born 2014), developed fulminant meningococcemia with septic shock and multiorgan failure on Oct 14 and died. N.A.B.M. (born 2014) was diagnosed with meningitis due to serogroup B and hospitalized at the Tropical Diseases Hospital. N.T.H.Q. (born 2014), a classmate, developed fever on Oct 15; by Oct 16 PCR on cerebrospinal fluid and blood confirmed meningococcal group B meningitis; this patient is alert, vitals stable, and in isolation. Public health authorities launched rapid epidemiological investigation, contact tracing, and environmental cleaning; close contacts received antibiotic prophylaxis, and health surveillance is planned for at least 10 days. Ho Chi Minh City Department of Health and HCDC are coordinating with hospitals and the school and advising parents to monitor symptoms and avoid unverified information.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市で髄膜炎菌感染症のクラスターを検出、生徒1名が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 同一学校内で髄膜炎菌感染症（血清群B）のクラスターが発生し死亡例もあるが、現時点では学校内の限定的な集団発生であり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 同一学校の生徒3名に発生したクラスターで、保健当局が接触者調査・予防投薬・環境消毒等の対応を実施中。地域的拡大や国際的影響の兆候は現時点で報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: 3 học sinh TP HCM mắc não mô cầu, một em tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three students in Ho Chi Minh City contracted meningococcal meningitis; one died.
article.articleSummary: Three students from Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School in Hiệp Phước, Ho Chi Minh City, contracted meningococcal meningitis due to Neisseria meningitidis group B; one died. First case, a male born in 2014, began 14 Oct with fever, sore throat and headache, progressing to septic shock and multi-organ failure; lab confirmed group B. A second female student from the same school arrived at the Infectious Disease Hospital with similar symptoms and is now stable. On 15 Oct, a third female desk mate developed fever; blood and CSF PCR confirmed group B meningococcal disease, and she remains isolated and stable. Health authorities say closures are not mandatory; decisions depend on epidemiology and safety. Close contacts receive antibiotic prophylaxis; broad prophylaxis for all students is not advised. Vaccines for group B exist but have varying coverage; vaccination should follow age and medical guidance. Neisseria meningitidis spreads via respiratory droplets and can progress.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市の生徒3名が髄膜炎菌感染症に罹患、1名死亡
triage.triage_reason: 同一校の生徒3名が髄膜炎菌(グループB)感染症を発症し1名が死亡するクラスターであり、重症度・異常性ともに高いためフルリスク評価に進めるべきと判断。
triage.notes: Bluedotが付与した疾患名に『Classical Swine Fever』が含まれるが記事内容とは無関係（誤タグの可能性）。実際の事象は髄膜炎菌感染症（Neisseria meningitidis group B）による学校内クラスター。

article.articleHeadline: Elephant dies of anthrax near Coimbatore; carcass incinerated following strict safety protocols
article.articleSummary: An elephant died of anthrax in the Gopanari Reserve Forest, Periyanaickenpalayam range, Coimbatore district, Tamil Nadu. Forest patrol found the carcass around 4pm on Tuesday; initial assessments suggested anthrax. A blood smear collected on Wednesday by forest veterinarians was sent to the district animal husbandry department, which confirmed the infection. After lab confirmation, a 50-metre perimeter was established to keep scavengers away. Disposal followed MoEF and Tamil Nadu environment, climate change and forests department guidelines, and the carcass was incinerated at the site on Thursday. The incident demonstrates strict wildlife disease control, including rapid lab confirmation, site isolation, and safe disposal to prevent further transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コインバトール近郊で象が炭疽症で死亡、厳格な安全対策に基づき死体を焼却処分
triage.triage_reason: 単発の野生動物（象1頭）における炭疽感染事例であり、適切な処理・管理が行われたことが報告されているのみで、ヒトへの感染や公衆衛生上の懸念、社会的関心の高まりは確認できない。
triage.notes: 野生動物（象）単独例であり、ヒトへの感染や二次感染の報告なし。地域当局により適切に管理されている。

article.articleHeadline: 3 học sinh tại TPHCM nhiễm não mô cầu, một ca tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three students in Ho Chi Minh City infected with meningococcal disease, one fatality.
article.articleSummary: Three students in Ho Chi Minh City have been infected with meningococcal disease caused by Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B, including one fatality. On 14 October, the city’s Department of Health reported a fulminant meningococcemia with septic shock and multi-organ failure in a 12-year-old student, H.H.K., of Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School in Hiệp Phước commune, who died the same day. The same day, another student, M., was diagnosed with meningococcal meningitis (serogroup B) and is receiving care at the Hospital for Tropical Diseases, with health status currently monitored.
