By the morning of 15 October, Q., who sat at the same desk, developed fever; PCR testing of cerebrospinal fluid and blood confirmed meningococcal disease, serogroup B. The Department urged rapid epidemiological investigations, contact tracing, environmental management, and ensured admission and treatment across the Hospital for Tropical Diseases, Children’s Hospital 1, and Nhà Bè General Hospital.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市の生徒3人が髄膜炎菌感染症に感染、1人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 同一学校・同席の生徒間で髄膜炎菌感染症（血清群B）のクラスターが発生し、1名が死亡。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性がある集団感染でIHR基準2項目に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 同一学校・同じ机に座っていた生徒間での感染確認があり、濃厚接触によるヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が示唆される。保健当局は疫学調査・接触者追跡・環境管理を実施中。今後の感染拡大状況と当局の対応能力について続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: هل يتوسع إيبولا إقليميًا؟ كينيا تسجل إصابة جديدة مؤكدة بعد أول وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Will Ebola spread regionally? Kenya records a new confirmed case after the first death.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 October 2026, Kenya reports a second Ebola case and its first death linked to the outbreak in the country. The second case, a close contact of the first patient, developed fever, fatigue, and joint pains, and was laboratory-confirmed and isolated. The first case was a relative of the deceased who had arrived in Kenya from the Democratic Republic of Congo and was later found infected; authorities had announced the death last week. Public health teams are conducting contact tracing and intensifying surveillance as Ebola continues to spread in Ituri province, DR Congo, with cases linked to neighboring countries. Officials emphasize no evidence of widespread community transmission in Kenya at present, while boosting cross-border readiness to prevent regional spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラは地域的に拡大するのか？ケニアで最初の死亡後、新たな感染確定例を記録
triage.triage_reason: DRC（イツリ州）で継続中のエボラ出血熱がケニアに越境し死亡例・二次感染例が確認されたため、国際的拡大リスクが高くIHR基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの新規感染・死亡例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRC（イツリ州）のアウトブレイクを verified_locations に含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Chùm ca não mô cầu ở TP.HCM khiến 1 trẻ tử vong, ai cần uống thuốc dự phòng?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cluster of meningococcal meningitis cases in Ho Chi Minh City has left one child dead; who should take prophylactic antibiotics?
article.articleSummary: As of 16 October 2026, Ho Chi Minh City authorities report a cluster of meningococcal meningitis at Hai Ba Trung Secondary School in Hiep Phuoc commune, with three students infected and one fatality; two remain under treatment. Neisseria meningitidis can cause meningitis or septicemia and can progress rapidly, with case fatality typically 8-15%, rising to 40-50% in septic shock; 10-20% of survivors bear lifelong sequelae. Transmission is via respiratory droplets; incubation 3-4 days. The city’s Department of Health (HCDC) is tracing close contacts and will administer antibiotic prophylaxis where indicated, ideally within 24 hours of case confirmation. Prophylaxis is not for all students; eligibility depends on exposure type (household, classmates sharing items, caregivers, direct care). Parents should not self-medicate. Vaccination against meningococcal group B exists, but vaccines vary in coverage and must align with age and medical guidance.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市で髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎のクラスター発生、児童1人死亡—予防内服が必要なのは誰か?
triage.triage_reason: 学校での髄膜炎菌クラスターで死亡例が出ているが、現時点では3例に限定され当局が接触者追跡と予防投薬を実施中であり、広域拡大の情報はないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 学校内クラスター（3例、死亡1例）で、当局が接触者特定と予防内服を実施中。髄膜炎菌感染症は散発例として一定頻度で発生するため、更なる拡大の有無を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola en el Congo supera 9,300 casos y 4,400 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo surpasses 9,300 cases and 4,400 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surged to 9,277 confirmed cases and 4,478 fatalities, with 2,486 recoveries and 924 patients currently hospitalized or in isolation as of the latest INSP bulletin. Since mid-May 2026, this is the deadliest epidemic in the country’s history and could become the deadliest globally. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or approved treatment. Case fatality rate stands at 48.3%. Contact tracing coverage sits at 78% and is declining. Ituri province remains the epicenter, accounting for 73.4% of total cases; last day it contributed 47.7% of new infections. The outbreak has spread across seven provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, Tshopo, and Ubangi-Sud—across 65 of 167 health zones.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ、症例9,300件・死者4,400人を超える
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最悪規模のエボラ流行(致死率48.3%)が7州に拡大し、ワクチン・治療法未承認の未知株(Bundibugyo)で、IHR基準・WPRO基準いずれも複数該当するため。
triage.notes: ワクチン・承認治療法のないBundibugyo株による流行で、接触者追跡率が低下傾向(78%)にあり、国際的な支援ニーズが高いと考えられる。国境を越えた拡大の有無については記事に明記なし。

article.articleHeadline: CCMB scientists develop genetic toolkit to shine light on TB's inner workings
article.articleSummary: 40 new shuttle vectors with fluorescent markers were developed by CCMB scientists to study Mycobacterium tuberculosis biology. The toolkit, designed for mycobacteria, can switch genes on, track proteins inside cells, and probe how proteins interact. Fluorescent tags like GFP and mCherry let researchers visualize protein localization and movement during growth and division. The vectors were validated in Mycobacterium smegmatis, a non-pathogenic relative, where markers highlighted proteins involved in cell growth and division. The system supports multiplex studies, demonstrated by examining four regulatory TB proteins within a single cell to reveal coordination of cellular processes. A new purification method reduces background contamination and improves identification of physiological protein interactions. The toolkit can be expanded with additional genetic switches, tags, and regulatory elements. Published in Journal of Bacteriology on 2026-10-16.

triage.headline_ja: CCMBの科学者が結核菌の内部構造を解明する遺伝子ツールキットを開発
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核菌研究のための基礎科学ツール開発に関する学術的内容であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や感染拡大、異常事態とは無関係である。
triage.notes: 研究開発に関する学術記事であり、実際のアウトブレイクや症例報告ではないため、地理的発生地としてのトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : sensibilisation renforcée aux mesures barrières contre Ebola à Bengamisa - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: intensified awareness-raising on barrier measures against Ebola in Bengamisa - ACP
article.articleSummary: Intensive awareness-raising on barrier measures against Ebola was conducted in Bengamisa, Tshopo province, Democratic Republic of Congo, during a visit by the provincial governor. The event engaged scientific staff, students, and local residents from the Institut supérieur d'études agronomiques de Bengamisa in Kisangani, in the North-East DRC. The governor urged broad participation to enforce mandatory infection-control practices and a rapid response to curb Ebola transmission, emphasizing strict adherence to barrier measures, sanitary directives, and heightened community vigilance to limit the outbreak in the province. He reiterated provincial decrees banning the movement of corpses and large gatherings as precautionary steps to prevent Ebola spread. The activity highlights community-level prevention efforts to strengthen public health measures in higher education settings and neighboring communities amid the Ebola response in North-Eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州:ベンガミサでエボラ出血熱の感染防止策に関する啓発活動が強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国チョポ州で進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクへの対応として、州知事主導の感染防止策強化・遺体移動禁止令等が実施されており、IHR基準複数該当かつ社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラアウトブレイク対応における地域啓発活動を報じるもので、新規発生の詳細（症例数等）は不明。DRCは過去に繰り返しエボラ流行があり、国際的な支援体制（WHO等）が関与している可能性が高い。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Oxford-developed Ebola vaccine enters Phase I clinical trial in Uganda - The Oxford Student
article.articleSummary: Phase I trial of the ChAdOx1 BDBV vaccine against Bundibugyo virus disease (BVD), a form of Ebola, began 6 October 2026 in Masaka, Uganda. First participants received the chimpanzee adenovirus–vectored vaccine encoding Bundibugyo virus glycoprotein. The Uganda study, led by MRC/UVRI & LSHTM Uganda Research Unit with Oxford Vaccine Group and Pandemic Sciences Institute, will enroll 110 healthy adults in three arms: vaccine vs placebo; two-dose regimen six months apart; and prior Ebola-vaccine recipients given a single dose. Participants are followed for 12 months to monitor safety and immunogenicity. CEPI funds the program; Serum Institute of India manufactures and stockpiles about 620,000 doses, delivering 300 vials to the UK and around 3,000 investigational Uganda doses. Context: ongoing Bundibugyo virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo; Bundibugyo virus identified in western Uganda in 2007 with 149 suspected cases and 37 deaths; no licensed vaccine yet.

triage.headline_ja: オックスフォード大学開発のエボラワクチン、ウガンダで第I相臨床試験開始 - The Oxford Student
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はウガンダでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ型）ワクチン第I相治験開始であり新規アウトブレイクのシグナルではないが、文脈としてDRCでの進行中アウトブレイクに言及があるため継続注視が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事本文はワクチン臨床試験のニュースが主題。ウガンダ（対象国リスト外）での治験実施が中心だが、DRCでの進行中Bundibugyoウイルス（エボラ亜型）アウトブレイクが背景として言及されているため、DRCを発生国として記載。インドは製造拠点、英国は配送先であり発生国ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : les équipes de riposte Ebola dénoncent le contournement des contrôles sanitaires - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: Ebola response teams denounce the circumvention of health checks.
article.articleSummary: Ebola response teams in Tshopo Province, northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo, denounced circumvention of epidemiological surveillance at entry and control points, with overnight transport of corpses from Mambasa (Ituri) to Kisangani to be deposited in morgues. Dr Franck Mebwa, head of Ebola response operations with the provincial health division, said some families who lost relatives in Mambasa allegedly changed tactics to bypass entry restrictions for corpses at the Avakubi checkpoint in Bafwasende Territory. At PK 23 on RN4, refusals to comply with health measures—screening and handwashing—were recorded. By 12 October, 329 people refused temperature checks and handwashing (3.5%), across five entry points. These behaviors hinder surveillance and control efforts; community cooperation remains essential to strengthen epidemiological monitoring in Tshopo.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州：エボラ対応チームが保健検査の回避を非難
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は重篤かつ国際的関心の高い感染症であり、本記事はコンゴ民主共和国チョポ州・イトゥリ州での対応中に検疫回避行為（遺体の無断搬送、検温・手洗い拒否）が報告されており、感染拡大リスクを示す重要なシグナルである。
triage.notes: 現在進行中のエボラ対応における検疫回避（遺体搬送、検温・手洗い拒否329人/5拠点）が報告されており、サーベイランス体制の実効性低下と地域拡大リスクが懸念される。フルリスク評価が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Sumber Air yang Bikin 145 Warga Serpong Lagoon Muntaber Ternyata Ilegal, Diminta Disegel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The water source that caused gastroenteritis in 145 residents of Serpong Lagoon turned out to be illegal and was ordered sealed.
article.articleSummary: Gastroenteritis outbreaks in Serpong Lagoon, South Tangerang, Indonesia, affecting 145 residents who drank water from an unauthorized Water Treatment Plant that drew from an artificial lake. The source violated regulations that require wells or river water of adequate depth, and officials from Tangsel’s DPRD Commission I urged Satpol PP to seal the WTP in Keranggan, Setu. Alexander Prabu stated the WTP lacked permits and that the lake receives external runoff and waste, contributing to unsafe water. In the Rapat Dengar Pendapat, health (Dinas Kesehatan) and environmental (DLH) agencies were asked to supervise and recommend sealing, with provisional water supply coordinated by the relevant district facility and the WTP management to prevent a crisis. Operators must obtain full approvals for the raw water source; after improvements, if water is clear and free of E. coli, supply to residents can resume. Ongoing monitoring and strict supervision are emphasized.

triage.headline_ja: Serpong Lagoonの住民145人が胃腸炎になった水源は無許可だったことが判明、封鎖を要請
triage.triage_reason: 単一地域の無許可水処理施設による水質汚染が原因の局地的な胃腸炎（集団食中毒的事象）であり、既に当局が対応・封鎖要請済みで国際的拡大リスクや公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威は認められない。
triage.notes: 地元自治体（DPRD、Dinas Kesehatan、DLH）が既に対応しており、原因は無許可の水処理施設による汚染水。感染症の人−人感染や地域拡大の兆候はなく、局地的な公衆衛生問題として処理中。

article.articleHeadline: Meningitis in India: Closing the gap between first symptom and first dose
article.articleSummary: India faces meningitis with an estimated 60–80 cases per 100,000 annually and tens of thousands of deaths from bacterial, tuberculous, and viral causes, with children under five most vulnerable. Early symptoms—sudden high fever, severe headache, neck stiffness, vomiting, photophobia—plus altered sensorium require urgent care; in infants, irritability, poor feeding, high-pitched cry, lethargy, or a bulging fontanelle may predominate. A non-blanching purpuric rash signals possible meningococcal sepsis, but its absence does not exclude disease. Time is critical: suspected cases must be moved immediately to facilities with emergency, imaging, labs, and ICU; empirical antibiotics should not wait for confirmation, and blood cultures with cerebrospinal fluid sampling should be taken where safe. Hospitals need rapid lumbar puncture, neuroimaging, and clear escalation pathways; surveillance must improve. Hib and pneumococcal vaccines are in the Universal Immunisation Programme; meningococcal vaccine is not, but available through private clinics and travel services and is advised for at-risk groups and pilgrims. Survivors require audiology, rehab, and long-term follow-up.

triage.headline_ja: インドの髄膜炎：初発症状から初回投薬までのギャップを埋める
triage.triage_reason: 特定の新規アウトブレイクや異常増加を報告するものではなく、インドにおける髄膜炎の既知の疾病負荷・臨床対応・予防接種体制に関する啓発的な解説記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事は特定の発生事象ではなく、インドにおける髄膜炎（細菌性・結核性・ウイルス性）の年間推定罹患率や臨床管理指針、予防接種プログラムに関する一般的な医療啓発記事であり、対象国での具体的発生イベントとしての検証対象外と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Sau chùm ca não mô cầu, bác sĩ cảnh báo dấu hiệu dễ nhầm với cúm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: After a cluster of meningococcal meningitis cases, doctors warn that the symptoms can be easily mistaken for the flu.
article.articleSummary: In Ho Chi Minh City, a cluster of meningococcal meningitis cases has been reported, involving three students, including one death. Clinicians warn that Neisseria meningitidis infections can present as meningitis or septicemia and can progress rapidly, with some patients deteriorating to critical condition within hours. Early symptoms are non-specific, such as fever, headache, muscle pains, and nausea, easily mistaken for flu or common viral infections. Warning signs include cold extremities, severe headache, non-blanching purpura, neck stiffness, altered consciousness, seizures, and septic shock; in severe cases, death can occur within 24 hours from onset. The bacteria may reside in the nasopharynx of healthy carriers and spread via close contact with respiratory secretions. Prevention includes vaccination and hygiene: regular handwashing, not sharing utensils or items with saliva, covering the mouth when coughing or sneezing, and ensuring well-ventilated spaces. Seek healthcare promptly if symptoms appear.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎クラスター発生後、医師がインフルエンザと混同しやすい症状について警告
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市の学生間で髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎クラスター（3例、うち1名死亡）が発生し、急速に重症化する致死的疾患であるため、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響・異常性）を満たしフルリスク評価が必要と判断。
triage.notes: 死亡例を含むクラスター発生であり、学生間の濃厚接触による拡大リスクが懸念される。続報でのクラスター規模拡大や当局の対応状況の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Tiếp nhận nhiều ca nhiễm liên cầu lợn, có trường hợp suy đa tạng nguy kịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Admitting numerous cases of Streptococcus suis infection, with some cases of life-threatening multi-organ failure.
article.articleSummary: Four cases of Streptococcus suis infection were admitted to Hanoi’s National Hospital for Tropical Diseases over a two-week period, signaling risks from unsafe pork and pig contact. All patients had exposure to pigs or pig products; one 53-year-old man from Hai Phong who ate tiet canh developed septic shock, organ failure, and disseminated intravascular coagulation, requiring vasopressors, intubation, and continuous renal replacement therapy. Others presented with meningitis symptoms—fever, headache, delirium—and varied severity; some improved with antibiotics, though headaches and hearing loss persisted in some. Laboratory confirmation was by culture. Streptococcus suis infection can progress, especially with septicemia, causing organ hypoperfusion, kidney and liver injury, and coagulation disorders. Preventive messages urge: do not eat tiet canh or undercooked pork; farm workers should use PPE, cover wounds, avoid exposure to animal blood or secretions, and refrain from slaughtering sick pigs. Seek care for fever, headache, confusion, diarrhea, or rashes after exposure.

triage.headline_ja: レンサ球菌感染症の症例を多数受け入れ、多臓器不全で重篤な例も
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで豚レンサ球菌（Streptococcus suis）による重症例が報告されているが、豚の血液・肉を介した既知のリスクであり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大の兆候はないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 豚レンサ球菌感染症はベトナムで毎年一定数発生する既知の人獣共通感染症であり、生豚血（ティエットカン）摂取や豚との接触が主な感染経路。ヒト-ヒト感染は確認されておらず、国際的な公衆衛生リスクは低いと考えられる。保健当局による予防啓発が行われている点から、国内での管理は可能とみられる。

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện vi khuẩn Salmonella spp. trong mẫu thực phẩm vụ ngộ độc bánh mì
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Detection of Salmonella spp. in a food sample in a bread poisoning incident.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella spp. detected in multiple bread fillings tied to a mass food poisoning incident in Cam Thành Ward, Quảng Ngãi Province, Vietnam. On 16 October 2026, the Nha Trang Pasteur Institute reported positive Salmonella in samples from 13 items tested on 11 October by the Quảng Ngãi Provincial Center for Disease Control, including pork sausage (cha lua), shredded pork floss, sauce, chili sauce, butter, vegetables, and the bread roll (per 25 g). Some samples also exceeded safety standards for Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus aureus. The findings help identify the outbreak’s cause, which began after bread from a stall on Duy Tân Street was consumed; by 13 October, 167 people were hospitalized with abdominal pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and fever. Authorities sealed the facility, suspended operations, and traced food sources. Preventive measures emphasized include strict food safety, cooking thoroughly, clean water, separating raw/cooked foods, hand hygiene, and three-step food checks with sample retention.

triage.headline_ja: パン食中毒事件の食品検体からサルモネラ菌を検出
triage.triage_reason: 単一の食中毒事案（サルモネラ等汚染によるパン食中毒）であり、発生源施設は特定・封鎖済みで管理可能と見られるが、167名が入院するなど規模が大きいため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 食品由来の集団食中毒事案であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクは低い。当局が原因施設を特定・封鎖し対応中であり、管理可能性は高いと考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: Advogado denuncia suspeita de surto de tuberculose em presídio do Acre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lawyer reports suspected tuberculosis outbreak in Acre prison.
article.articleSummary: Suspected tuberculosis outbreak reported at the Rio Branco Penitentiary Complex in Acre state. The law firm Santiago & Maffini Advogados Associados told ContilNet that inmates in multiple areas have TB and expressed concern about exposure and adequacy of medical care. The firm says nearly six cases are known among its clients, with reports of additional infections among other detainees; no independent confirmation of a formal outbreak or exact case counts. TB is airborne, and the prison's ventilation and triage routines may influence transmission. Alleged cases were reported in Pavilion C (triage) and cells 18 and 19 in Pavilion A; newly admitted detainees reportedly stay 10–15 days in Pavilion C before moving. A suspected inmate death linked to TB has been mentioned but not independently confirmed. Semsa states they do not know of an outbreak and that TB care for detainees falls under Semsa and Sesacre; data should be requested from Semsa. ContilNet seeks official confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: 弁護士、アクレ州の刑務所で結核のアウトブレイクが疑われると通報
triage.triage_reason: 刑務所内での結核感染拡大が弁護士から報告されているが、保健当局（Semsa）はアウトブレイクを把握しておらず、公式な症例数や死亡例の確認も取れていないため、続報を待つ必要がある。
triage.notes: 刑務所内の結核集団感染が疑われているが、地元保健当局（Semsa）は正式な確認を行っておらず、症例数・死亡例の独立検証もされていない。換気不良や過密収容など流行しやすい環境要因はあるが、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い局地的事案。

article.articleHeadline: Syphilis Cases Plummet in Hangzhou District After Two-Decade Epidemic Peak
article.articleSummary: Syphilis incidence in Hangzhou’s Xihu District (China) declined from a 2005 baseline of 68.71 to a 2010 peak of 155.16 cases per 100,000, plunging to 13.17 per 100,000 by 2025. Four phases describe the trend: rapid growth 2005–2008 (annual percent change 25.23%); mild decline 2008–2019 (−5.00%/yr); accelerated decline 2019–2023 (−18.69%/yr); and a further reduction 2023–2025 (−39.01%/yr). The surge coincides with China’s resurgent syphilis epidemic and maturation of the national reporting system (China Information System for Disease Control and Prevention) mandating 24‑hour reporting, raising ascertainment of cases. Latent syphilis dominates across stages, suggesting screening intensity as a major driver. Declines in primary/secondary syphilis are more modest (−14.76% and −12.19%/yr), indicating fewer new infections. Congenital syphilis nearly disappeared, with no notified cases since 2017, aligning with prenatal screening and free treatment policies; WHO 2030 targets aim to reduce adult incidence and congenital syphilis.

triage.headline_ja: 杭州市の一地区で梅毒症例が20年ぶりの流行ピークを経て急減
triage.triage_reason: 梅毒罹患率は長期的に減少傾向にあり、公衆衛生上の急性リスクや異常事態を示す内容ではなく、歴史的トレンド分析の記事である。
triage.notes: 記事は杭州市西湖区における2005年から2025年までの梅毒罹患率の推移を分析した疫学研究報告であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生上の脅威を報じるものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Alerta no Amazonas: casos de sarampo quase dobram em uma semana e chegam a 17
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert in Amazonas: measles cases almost double in one week and reach 17.
article.articleSummary: Measles cases in Amazonas, Brazil surge to 17 confirmed as of Oct 15, 2026, escalating weekly from 10. Since Sept 1, 34 cases have been suspected, with 17 confirmed, 10 discarded, and 7 under investigation; no deaths reported. All cases are concentrated in the Alto Solimões region, near the tri-border area with Peru and Colombia, a nexus of cross-border movement. Among the 17 confirmed, 14 were unvaccinated and one did not report vaccination status. Health authorities emphasize vaccination as primary prevention. The measles triple viral vaccine (MMR) is provided free at Manaus and throughout 61 interior Amazonas municipalities via Basic Health Units; residents are urged to check vaccination records and update their doses to curb transmission. The report comes from Fundação de Vigilância em Saúde do Amazonas (FVS-RCP).

triage.headline_ja: アマゾナス州で警戒:はしか症例が1週間でほぼ倍増し17例に達する
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・アマゾナス州でのはしか症例が1週間で10例から17例へ急増し、未接種者が大半を占める上、ペルー・コロンビアとの三国国境地帯という越境移動の盛んな地域で発生しているため、国際的拡大リスクが懸念される。
triage.notes: ペルー・コロンビアは三国国境地帯として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。死亡者は報告されていないが、未接種者14/17という高い割合と症例の急増は今後の拡大リスクを示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Iron-Scavenging Machinery Reveals a Hidden Route to Tuberculosis Drug
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis remains a global threat, with 2023 reporting 8.2 million new cases and 1.25 million deaths; about 400,000 MDR/RR-TB cases worldwide, only 44% diagnosed and treated. Researchers from Huazhong Agricultural University, Wuhan University and Guangxi University, working with Mycobacterium bovis BCG, report that ACA (3-azidothiophene-2-carboxylic acid) kills M. tuberculosis by dual targeting CpsA1/CpsA2, but a regulatory pathway linked to the bacterium’s iron-scavenging system modulates ACA susceptibility. A resistant clone, BCG-R01, carried a cytosine insertion in acasR (BCG_0932/Rv0880), truncating AcasR and raising ACA MIC from 3 to 9 μg/mL. Deleting acasR increased MIC to 6 μg/mL; complementation brought it down to 2.5 μg/mL. Overproducing AcasR increased drug sensitivity. AcasR binds the fadD9 promoter at TAATATATTTACTTT, and fadD9 encodes fatty acid CoA ligase FadD9. Chromatin IP confirmed in vivo binding; fadD9 is the sole validated target. Reporter assays established the regulatory relationship; this pathway links ACA susceptibility to iron-scavenging metabolism with implications for resistance and drug development.

triage.headline_ja: 鉄スカベンジング機構が結核薬剤耐性への隠れたルートを明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核の基礎研究論文（薬剤耐性機構の分子生物学的解析）に関する報道であり、新規感染症イベント・アウトブレイク情報ではない。公衆衛生上の緊急な疾患発生・流行の報告ではなく、研究知見の紹介に過ぎない。
triage.notes: この記事は華中農業大学・武漢大学・広西大学の研究グループによる結核菌の薬剤耐性機構に関する基礎研究の報道である。新規の感染症イベント・疾患流行情報ではなく、既知の全球的課題（MDR-TB）に関する研究知見に過ぎない。シグナルトリアージの対象外の学術ニュースと判定される。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : MSF alerte sur l'abandon des déplacés face à la priorité accordée à Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: MSF warns of the abandonment of internally displaced people as Ebola takes priority - ACP.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo, has redirected humanitarian resources, risking neglect of the internally displaced population. As of 16 October 2026, Ituri hosts more than one million displaced amid armed violence in Djugu territory. The Ebola response, declared five months earlier, dominates funding and attention, leaving displaced people with insufficient support. MSF chief Pierre Boulet-Desbareau warns this focus creates a crisis within a crisis, requiring simultaneous emergency care for displaced communities and treatment of Ebola patients. MSF continues health interventions while addressing urgent needs of vulnerable populations, in a context of ongoing clashes and frequent displacements. Other humanitarian actors provide limited support to the displaced, with resources largely oriented toward Ebola. Calls persist for integrating the consequences of conflict and population movements into the broader response while maintaining medical services for Ebola-affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州:国境なき医師団、エボラ対応優先による国内避難民の見捨てられに警鐘 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRC・イトゥリ州でのエボラ流行は既に5ヶ月前から宣言されており新規発生ではないが、人道対応の歪みと継続的な感染リスクがあるため継続監視が妥当。記事の主眼は人道支援の課題でありエボラの新規感染状況の詳細は不明。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行そのものより、避難民支援の資源不足という人道危機の側面に焦点を当てている。エボラの症例数・死亡者数など疫学的詳細は記載なし。既存のアウトブレイクであり、新規性は低いが、継続的なモニタリングが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola dans la Tshopo : une mission gouvernementale pour sensibiliser les communautés de Basoko - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Tshopo: a government mission to raise awareness among Basoko communities - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 16 October 2026, a government mission in Basoko territory, Tshopo Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, was launched to raise awareness about Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) among local communities. Provincial Planning Minister and government spokesperson Claudine Atisandi Elondia stated that community sensitization is a priority to prevent Ebola spread and secure Basoko. The initiative aims to boost residents' vigilance through local information, involve citizens in prevention measures, and strengthen collaboration with local authorities and health services. Emphasis is placed on timely, accurate health messaging, reducing misinformation, and encouraging rapid consultation with health facilities if symptoms arise. The campaign reflects ongoing provincial efforts to reinforce the Ebola response and durably protect populations, underscoring collective responsibility in fighting Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: トショピ州のエボラ出血熱：バソコ地域社会への啓発を目的とした政府ミッション - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重篤・国際的懸念の高い疾患に関する公式対応（政府ミッション）がDRCで進行中であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事は既存のエボラ流行に対する啓発活動を報じており、具体的な症例数・死亡者数は記載されていない。感染拡大状況の続報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: FEHD releases second batch of gravidtrap indexes for Aedes albopictus in October (with photos)
article.articleSummary: On 16 October 2026, FEHD released the second batch of gravidtrap indexes and density indexes for Aedes albopictus in October, covering 29 survey areas in Hong Kong. Surveillance continues across 62 survey areas with a two-week cycle: traps are collected weekly, and glue boards are examined after the first week to compile the Gravidtrap Index and Density Index (First Phase); after the second week, data are checked again to inform Area Gravidtrap Index and Area Density Index, with results published on the department’s website. Measures include interdepartmental collaboration, targeted inspections, larviciding, fogging, and installation of mosquito trapping devices, alongside public education and a rapid alert system for subscribed estates. A Sha Tin District housing estate’s stagnant water prompted a statutory notice to clear water. Public guidance urges removing standing water, cleaning drains, covering containers, and weekly maintenance to reduce chikungunya fever and dengue transmission risk.

triage.headline_ja: 食物環境衛生署、10月のヒトスジシマカ（Aedes albopictus）に関する第2回グラビッドトラップ指数を発表（写真あり）
triage.triage_reason: これは香港の食物環境衛生署による定例の蚊媒介サーベイランス指数発表であり、デング熱・チクングニア熱の実際の症例発生や異常な流行を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は蚊の密度指数モニタリングという通常の公衆衛生業務の報告であり、実際の感染症患者発生データは含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : formation des volontaires de la Croix-Rouge aux enterrements dignes - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: Red Cross volunteers trained for dignified burials
article.articleSummary: Kisangani, Democratic Republic of the Congo, on 16 October 2026, reports the 17th Ebola Virus Disease outbreak across health zones Bafwasende, Kabondo, Makiso-Kisangani, and Mangobo in Tshopo. Red Cross volunteers were trained in dignified and safe burials (EDS) under the EPIC program for community epidemic preparedness and response. The 13-step EDS process requires an eight-person team, equipment assembly, family engagement, and mandatory use of personal protective equipment; mass graves are strictly prohibited, and burials cannot proceed without family consent while honoring ritual and sanitary steps. Dr. Guylain Mamona, urgent health assistant for the RDC Red Cross, emphasizes that EDS cuts transmission and protects families and responders. The Red Cross also conducts risk communication, community engagement, psychosocial support, and infection prevention and control as integral components of outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: キサンガニのエボラ:赤十字ボランティアが尊厳ある埋葬のための訓練を実施
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で進行中の第17次エボラ出血熱アウトブレイクに関する継続報道であり、複数の保健区域への拡大や人-人感染リスクが認められるためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事は第17次エボラアウトブレイクに対する赤十字の対応（尊厳ある埋葬訓練）に関する内容で、新規発生ではなく既存アウトブレイクの継続状況報告。複数健康区域（Bafwasende, Kabondo, Makiso-Kisangani, Mangobo）に拡大している点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Second Ebola Case Confirmed In Kenya
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed a second Bundibugyo-strain Ebola case, a 39-year-old man who is a relative of Kenya's first case, who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and died in Nairobi on October 5. The second patient developed symptoms on October 13 and tested positive, prompting WHO to expand contact tracing. More than 40 contacts — airline passengers and crew, airport cleaners, baggage handlers, immigration officials, health workers, and family — are in quarantine or self-quarantine; authorities are working to reach six passengers with foreign phone numbers. The first case arrived in Nairobi from Uganda on October 3 and died two days later. The outbreak in DR Congo persists in the east; Uganda had ruled out outbreaks by late August. Kenya had begun preparedness measures since May as the DRC outbreak continued, with ongoing regional vigilance.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで2例目のエボラ出血熱症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)がケニアへ国際的に拡大し、航空機乗客を含む40名以上の接触者が検疫対象となっており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本記事の主題はケニアでの輸入症例確認だが、感染源であるDRC東部での流行継続が明記されているためDRCを検証地域に含めた。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Alarm: Sterblichkeitsrate bei Kleinkindern hoch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert: high mortality rate among toddlers.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo shows disproportionately high mortality among toddlers. In Nord-Kivu and Ituri, Bundibugyo virus drives infections; nearly a quarter of confirmed cases in Nord-Kivu are children under five, with 13% being infants; in Ituri, 13% are under five and 6% are infants. Médecins Sans Frontières’ Epicentre reports severe pediatric burden, and at the MSF Ebola Treatment Center in Butembo, Nord-Kivu, the case fatality rate for children from June to September 2026 reached 80%, most patients younger than five. Rapid community spread and limited access to specialized care amplify deaths. Nosocomial transmission is evident, as many children had recent stays in other facilities before Ebola diagnosis. MSF urges national authorities, researchers, drug developers, and funders to prioritize children in all current and future Bundibugyo virus studies, including dosages and child-friendly formulations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報:幼児の死亡率が高い
triage.triage_reason: DRC北東部(北キブ・イツリ)でブンディブギョウイルスによるエボラ流行が継続中で、幼児の致死率が80%に達するなど深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、院内感染も確認されているため国際的拡大・対応リスクが高い。
triage.notes: MSFが各国当局・研究者・創薬企業・資金提供者に対し、小児を対象とした研究優先化を呼びかけている点が特記事項。院内感染の拡大が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Cà Mau: Bệnh dịch tả lợn châu Phi diễn biến phức tạp
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ca Mau Province: African swine fever is developing in a complex manner.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreaks in Ca Mau Province, Vietnam, have been ongoing since the start of 2026, with 19 outbreaks across 15 communes affecting 113 pig-keeping households. A total of 1,375 pigs have died or been culled, weighing more than 87,400 kg. Five outbreaks remain under 21-day surveillance in Tran Van Thoi, Vinh My, Da Bac, Khanh Binh, and Chau Thoi. Authorities mandate a coordinated response: mobilize local resources, activate village disease-control teams, and boost herd monitoring; implement the second vaccination campaign in 2026; clearly demarcate outbreak zones and perform complete culling of diseased and suspected animals, with reinforced public communication. In flood-prone areas, avoid burying carcasses; prefer incineration or thermal treatment with thorough disinfection. The Department of Livestock and Veterinary Services will supervise technical guidance, tighten movement controls of animals and products, monitor slaughterhouses and markets, and enforce biosecurity. Farmers are urged to report suspected cases and not dispose of carcasses improperly.

triage.headline_ja: カマウ省:アフリカ豚熱(ASF)の流行が複雑化
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病(ASF)であり人への直接感染リスクはないが、広範な発生規模と養豚業への経済的影響があり、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: ASFはヒトに感染しない動物疾病のため、公衆衛生上の直接リスクはないが、養豚産業・食料安全保障への影響の観点から経過観察とする。

article.articleHeadline: Sốc nhiễm khuẩn, suy đa tạng sau khi ăn tiết canh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Septic shock and multi-organ failure after eating pig's blood jelly
article.articleSummary: As of 16 October 2026, four Streptococcus suis infections have been admitted to the National Institute of Infectious and Tropical Diseases in Hanoi over the past two weeks, with one severely ill patient in Hai Phong linked to eating pig blood jelly (tiết canh). The 53-year-old Hai Phong man developed abdominal pain, diarrhea, and hypotension two days after ingestion, progressing to septic shock and multi-organ failure (acute kidney injury, liver injury, severe coagulopathy) requiring vasopressors, mechanical ventilation, antibiotics, and continuous renal replacement therapy before his family opted to discharge him home. Another case presented with meningitis symptoms—fever, severe headache, confusion, and hearing loss—suggesting potential long-term sequelae. All cases involve pigs or pig products (processing, slaughter, consumption of tiết canh or undercooked pork). Streptococcus suis can inhabit pigs without illness and transmits via contact with pig blood/secretions or wounds, underscoring rapid progression in septicemia and risk of necrosis or limb loss.

triage.headline_ja: 豚の血のゼリー(ティエットカン)を食べた後の敗血症性ショックと多臓器不全
triage.triage_reason: ハノイ近郊で豚レンサ球菌症(Streptococcus suis)の散発例が報告されているが、既知の人獣共通感染症で特定の食習慣（生の豚血ゼリー摂取）に関連した散発事例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大の兆候はない。重症例があるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: Streptococcus suis感染症はベトナムで毎年散発的に報告される既知の人獣共通感染症であり、豚の生血・生肉の摂取や処理作業に関連する。ヒト-ヒト感染は確認されておらず、アウトブレイクというより個別の重症例報告に近い。

article.articleHeadline: CEMAC : Beac-FMI-Motaze-Ebola-Nigeria - News du Cameroun
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: CEMAC: BEAC-IMF-Motaze-Ebola in Nigeria - Cameroon News
article.articleSummary: Nigerian exporters delegation to Cameroon (Oct 18–24, 2026) seeks private-sector partnerships in agriculture, manufacturing, and services; identify Cameroonian distributors; explore joint ventures in logistics and industry. Motaze attends IMF/World Bank Annual Meetings in Bangkok, seeking a new program after the 2021–2025 arrangement ended in July 2025. BEAC’s first international bond issue raised $222 million (about 130 billion FCFA) on Oct 13, 2026, maturing Oct 2029, with Africa Finance Corporation as anchor investor; aims to diversify funding and accelerate disbursements for regional integration, infrastructure, agriculture, and industry across six member states; Moody’s Ba3 rating with stable outlook. CEMAC six member states harmonized eight Ebola protocols to prevent, detect, and respond to Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo; the Oct 15, 2026 Brazzaville meeting focused on surveillance, contact tracing, border controls, and risk communication.

triage.headline_ja: CEMAC：BEAC・IMF・モタゼ財務相・ナイジェリアのエボラ－カメルーンニュース
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題はCEMAC諸国の経済・金融動向（IMF会合、BEAC債券発行）であり、エボラについてはDRCでの既存流行に対する加盟国間の対策協調会議への言及のみで、新規発生や具体的な症例・規模等の情報がないため。
triage.notes: 記事本文は実質経済ニュースであり、エボラは地域対策協調の文脈でのみ言及。タイ（バンコク）はIMF会合開催地であり、感染症発生地ではないため除外。ナイジェリアやカメルーン、コンゴ共和国も対象国リスト外または発生地としての記載なしのため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Respiratory cases rise
article.articleSummary: In Central Visayas, respiratory consultations at four DOH-7 hospitals rose 26.8% in Q3 2026 to 3,524 (July–Sept) from 2,778 in 2025, during ashfall from Mt. Kanlaon and transboundary haze from Indonesia, with Metro Cebu recording a very unhealthy AQI (172 on Oct 16). Health officials say the data do not prove pollution caused the rise, but poor air quality is a potential contributing factor warranting closer monitoring and considerations for shift to modular learning when AQI is unhealthy. Cebu South Medical Center in Talisay City showed the largest rise, 66.1% to 1,407, with pneumonia up to 427, tuberculosis to 327, and respiratory tract infections to 223. Vicente Sotto Memorial Medical Center rose 22.2% to 1,217; Gov. Celestino Gallares Memorial Medical Center in Tagbilaran City, Bohol, up 82.9% to 353; St. Anthony Mother and Child Hospital declined 26.3% to 547. Data may include repeat visits; link to pollution not confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: 呼吸器疾患の受診件数が増加
triage.triage_reason: セブ地域で呼吸器疾患（結核含む）の受診増加が報告されているが、噴火灰・越境ヘイズとの因果関係は未確認でありデータの不確実性が高いため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事は結核単独の流行ではなく、火山灰・越境ヘイズによる大気質悪化と呼吸器疾患（肺炎・結核・呼吸器感染症）受診増加との関連を調査中の内容。保健当局自身が因果関係を確認できていない旨を明言しており、感染症アウトブレイクというよりは環境要因による健康影響報告に近い。インドネシアはヘイズの発生源として言及されているのみで、感染症発生国ではないため対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Second Ebola Case Confirmed In Kenya
article.articleSummary: Second Bundibugyo strain Ebola case confirmed in Kenya: a 39-year-old man who is a relative of the first Kenyan case, which died in hospital on October 5. The second patient developed symptoms on October 13 and tested positive. The first patient, a local man who had lived in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, arrived in Nairobi via Uganda on October 3 and died two days later. WHO commended Kenyan authorities for listing and quarantining contacts; more than 40 people—airline passengers and crew, airport workers, baggage handlers, immigration officials, health personnel and family members—were identified, with most in quarantine and some low-risk contacts self-quarantining and monitored. Efforts continue to reach six passengers with foreign phone numbers. Preparedness steps were heightened after the DR Congo outbreak began in May; Uganda had faced the disease with outbreak officially ruled out in late August.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで2人目のエボラ出血熱症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: 致死性の高いエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）がケニアで2例目確認され、家族内感染および航空機乗客・乗員を含む多数の接触者調査が進行中であり、国際的拡大リスクが高いため。
triage.notes: 本記事の主題はケニアにおける2例目のエボラ出血熱症例であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれない。DRCは最初の患者の出身地として言及されているが、本記事における現在の主要発生地ではなく、5月から継続する既知の流行の背景情報として言及されているに過ぎないため、verified_locationsには含めなかった。

article.articleHeadline: Vírus do Nilo Ocidental bate recorde histórico na Europa; entenda a doença
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Nile virus sets a historic record in Europe; understand the disease.
article.articleSummary: West Nile virus reached historic levels in Europe in 2026. By early October, 1,855 human cases and 141 deaths were reported across 18 countries, led by Italy (748), Greece (445), and France (144), per EFSA and ECDC. Animal surveillance showed 511 equine and 595 avian outbreaks in 15 countries. Transmission is mainly via Culex mosquitoes; the virus cycles between birds and mosquitoes, with humans and horses rarely sustaining onward transmission. Rare non-vector routes include blood transfusion, organ transplant, and mother-to-child transmission. About 80% of infections are asymptomatic; when present, symptoms resemble a viral illness and typically appear 2–14 days after exposure. Neurological disease occurs in less than 1% (meningitis, encephalitis, or acute flaccid paralysis), with risk rising after age 70 and in those with chronic diseases. Diagnostics rely on serology and RT-PCR in early disease; no human vaccine exists; prevention centers on mosquito control and personal protection. Brazil reports first 2026 cases: two in São Paulo state and two in Santa Catarina.

triage.headline_ja: 西ナイルウイルス、欧州で過去最多を記録；同疾患を解説
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主眼は欧州における西ナイルウイルスの記録的流行であり、対象国であるブラジルについては本年の初症例（4例）が簡潔に言及されているのみで、重症度や拡大状況等の詳細情報が不足しているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事の中心は欧州（イタリア・ギリシャ・フランス等）の西ナイルウイルス流行だが、これら欧州諸国は対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ブラジルは2026年シーズン初の人症例（サンパウロ州2例、サンタカタリーナ州2例）が報告されたとの記載があり、対象国として含めた。蚊媒介性で人-人感染は稀。続報でブラジル国内の症例数・重症度の推移を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : 9 pays à Brazzaville pour le renforcement de la riposte sanitaire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: 9 countries travel to Brazzaville to bolster the public health response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) preparedness takes center stage as 119 participants from six CEMAC member states, plus the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Burundi and Sao Tome and Principe, gather in Brazzaville, Republic of the Congo, October 13–16, 2026. The regional workshop aims to validate harmonized protocols and operational directives for preparedness and rapid response to EVD and other epidemic-prone diseases in Central Africa. Key focus areas include surveillance and early detection, border health controls and cross-border cooperation, secure transport of biological samples, contact tracing, patient care, and infection prevention; risk communication, community engagement, and safe, dignified burials are also covered. The instruments are coordinated by DERDS of the CEMAC Commission, with technical support from OCEAC and HeSP-CEMAC. The goal is stronger national capacities, better interoperability of health systems, and a faster, coherent regional response to health threats, regardless of borders.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：公衆衛生対応強化のため9か国がブラザビルに集結
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は実際のエボラ発生事例ではなく、中央アフリカ地域における準備・対応強化のためのワークショップ開催を報じるものであり、疾病発生情報がないため見送りと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・ブルンジ・サントメプリンシペ・CEMAC加盟国によるエボラ対応能力強化のための地域ワークショップ（2026年10月13-16日、コンゴ共和国ブラザビル開催）についての内容であり、実際のエボラ発生事例の報告ではない。そのため対象国での発生確認はできず、verified_locationsは空配列とした。

article.articleHeadline: Afrique centrale : La CEMAC renforce la coordination régionale contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Central Africa: The CEMAC strengthens regional coordination against Ebola
article.articleSummary: Six member states of the Central African Economic and Monetary Community (CEMAC) harmonized their Ebola virus disease (EVD) prevention plans as a regional response to the threat from Ebola, active in the Democratic Republic of the Congo since May. The alignment was finalized at a Brazzaville meeting, with discussions concluding on October 15. No case counts or fatalities are provided in the article. The move reflects heightened regional concern over Ebola near shared borders and aims to synchronize national prevention strategies across the six Central African countries to prevent cross-border transmission. The initiative signals ongoing public health measures within the region in response to the DRC outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 中央アフリカ：CEMACがエボラ対策で地域協調を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5月から継続するエボラ流行に対し、周辺6か国が国境を越えた感染拡大を懸念し地域的な予防体制を統一する会議を開催しており、IHR基準の複数（重大性・異常性・国際拡大リスク）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はCEMAC（中部アフリカ経済通貨共同体）の地域協調策に関する内容で、実際の流行発生国はDRC。コンゴ共和国（Republic of the Congo）は会議開催地（ブラザビル）であり、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。具体的な症例数・死亡者数は記事中に記載なし。
