article.articleHeadline: 겨울철 가축전염병 예방...대형 산란계 농장·밀집단지 집중관리
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Winter livestock infectious disease prevention... intensive management of large-scale layer farms and densely populated farming complexes.
article.articleSummary: On Oct 1, Korea's Ministry of Agriculture, Food and Rural Affairs announced a Special Quarantine Period through February 28 to prevent Highly Pathogenic Avian Influenza (HPAI) and other livestock diseases, focusing on high-risk areas, large layer farms, and densely populated farming complexes ahead of winter migratory birds. Last winter saw 62 HPAI outbreaks, with 31 (50%) on layer-hen farms, prompting intensified preemptive management of large egg-laying operations. The ministry urged local governments and agencies to sustain a rigorous preventive system, including the new four-stage pre-registration of personnel and vehicles entering large layer farms. They called for strict basic biosecurity, wild bird surveillance, and disinfection of high-risk areas, plus rapid response for AI antigen detection or suspected cases. Foot-and-mouth disease was also discussed; vaccination coverage must be complete, and safeguards against SAT1 strains from China and Mongolia were urged. Minister Song Mi-ryeong urged all sectors to cooperate.

triage.headline_ja: 冬季家畜伝染病予防...大規模採卵鶏農場・密集団地の集中管理
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は韓国農林畜産食品部による季節的な家畜伝染病（HPAI・口蹄疫）予防対策の定例発表であり、新規の異常な発生事例の報告ではないため。
triage.notes: 記事は韓国政府による冬季特別検疫期間（10月1日〜2月28日）の予防策発表。中国・モンゴル由来のFMD SAT1株への警戒が言及されているが、実際の発生事例としての記述はなく、予防的注意喚起に留まる。対象国での実発生の確認情報はないため verified_locations は空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Congo, Ebola: la guerra invisibile
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo, Ebola: the invisible war
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo, as of October 11, 2026, involves 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths (crude case fatality ~48.3%). The outbreak spans 65 health zones across seven provinces, with Ituri at the center and increasing impact in North Kivu and Upper Uele. The epidemic’s geography is dynamic, with cross-border implications including an imported case in Kenya from Congo via Uganda, who died October 5. Insecurity and violence hinder surveillance, case finding, sample transport, isolation, safe burials, and vaccination efforts; by October 4, about 80% of contacts had been reached. There are no vaccines or approved treatments for Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease; early diagnosis and supportive care remain essential. The situation highlights the need for regional coordination, strengthened health systems, and sustained international cooperation rather than temporary facilities to prevent further transmission and protect communities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ出血熱：見えない戦争
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で9,066例・死亡4,381例（致死率約48%）の大規模エボラ（スーダン型/ブンディブギョ型）アウトブレイクが継続し、ケニアへの越境輸入例も発生しているため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは越境症例の経路として言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。治安悪化により監視・ワクチン接種等の対応が困難な状況が続いている点に注意。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : les pratiques funéraires traditionnelles et les retards de
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: traditional funeral practices and the delays in
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Nizi health zone, Djugu Territory, Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is impeded by traditional funeral practices and delayed medical care. A sociological study conducted in August with WHO support reports 458 deaths among 794 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases in the area. Direct contact with corpses during funerals heightens transmission risk, prompting recommendations to engage local chiefs to adapt rites temporarily during the epidemic rather than abandon tradition. Late diagnosis is common, as patients attribute early symptoms to malaria or poisoning, leading to self-medication or consulting traditional healers and delaying formal care. The study calls for strengthened near‑term community awareness and re-engagement of dignified, safe burial teams to interrupt transmission chains, emphasizing culturally appropriate risk communication and infection-control improvements during the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：伝統的な葬儀慣行と治療の遅れ
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイクにおいて、794例中458例の死亡という高致死率が報告されており、伝統的葬儀慣行やマラリアとの誤診による治療遅延が感染拡大を助長しているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: WHO支援による社会学的調査が実施されており、既に国際的な関与がある。致死率約57%と非常に高く、葬儀慣行・マラリアとの誤診による診断遅延が感染連鎖の主要因とされる。

article.articleHeadline: Liên cầu lợn có thể gây điếc, hoại tử chi và tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Streptococcus suis can cause deafness, limb necrosis, and death.
article.articleSummary: Streptococcus suis infections have been identified in four patients at the National Institute of Infectious and Tropical Diseases in Hanoi over roughly two weeks; one case from Haiphong required life-saving support for septic shock and multi-organ failure with mechanical ventilation and continuous renal replacement therapy after eating raw pork dish tiết canh. Other patients presented with meningitis symptoms—fever, severe headache, confusion—while some developed septicemia with shock, coagulopathy, and organ injury. Laboratory features included severe thrombocytopenia (platelets 29 G/L), hypofibrinogenemia (fibrinogen <0.35 g/L), and marked metabolic acidosis with lactate 13 mmol/L. Despite antibiotics, some survivors report lasting headaches and hearing loss. Clinicians emphasize rapid progression after bacteremia, and advise taking exposure history (consumption of raw/undercooked pork, contact with pig blood/secretions). Prevention: avoid tiết canh and undercooked pork; workers should use PPE; seek urgent care if symptoms develop.

triage.headline_ja: 豚レンサ球菌は難聴、四肢壊死、死亡を引き起こす可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで豚レンサ球菌感染症（既知の人獣共通感染症）による重症例が散発しているが、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクは低く、既知・周期的な事象であるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 豚レンサ球菌症（Streptococcus suis）はベトナムで生豚血（tiết canh）摂取に伴い毎年一定数報告される既知の食品媒介性人獣共通感染症。ヒト-ヒト感染は確認されておらず、国際的な公衆衛生リスクは低いが、重症化率・死亡率・後遺症（難聴等）のため国内での注意喚起が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Nature Conference India 2026 at MAHE Manipal puts infectious disease threats under the scientific spotlight
article.articleSummary: Second Nature Conference in India, Oct 14–16, 2026, at MAHE Manipal, Manipal, India, spotlighted infectious disease threats amid rising antimicrobial resistance and climate-change-driven disease patterns; the conference concluded Oct 16, 2026. Leading researchers and public health experts from India and worldwide gathered to address surveillance and forecasting, AMR, diagnostics, vaccine development, prevention, climate change, and pandemic preparedness, with a focus on strengthening India's health system. Keynotes highlighted post-COVID data-informed decision-making (Lauren Gardner, Johns Hopkins), TB diagnosis reform (Madhukar Pai, McGill), vaccine-preventable respiratory infections in children (Shabir A. Madhi, University of the Witwatersrand), and outbreak risk prediction (Marion Koopmans, Erasmus University Rotterdam). Discussions covered Klebsiella pneumoniae, TB regimens, HPV testing and vaccination, vaccines for emerging and endemic diseases, and long-acting preventive interventions, under a One Health lens linking climate, vector-borne risk, and antimicrobial resistance. The forum underscored cross-disciplinary collaboration among epidemiologists, microbiologists, clinicians, public health specialists, and environmental scientists.

triage.headline_ja: MAHEマニパルで開催された『ネイチャー・カンファレンス・インディア2026』、感染症の脅威に科学的焦点を当てる
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、学術会議の開催に関する記事であり、IHR基準・WPRO基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の感染症流行事例ではなく、感染症研究・公衆衛生に関する学術会議の報告であるため、トリアージ対象外と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Indore HIV Cases 2026: 357 Test Positive in Six Months, 6 Yet to Start Treatment
article.articleSummary: Indore’s HIV testing from April to September 2026 produced 357 positive results from 44,259 tests (about 0.81% positivity). Of those diagnosed, 351 were linked to antiretroviral therapy (ART), while six have not yet started treatment; all six are from MGM Medical College, which reported 215 positives from 1,152 tested (209 linked to ART, six not yet on treatment). Other facilities recorded positives including MY Hospital (10/8,813), PC Sethi Hospital (17/4,259), District Hospital (24/5,135), and Malaranj Polyclinic (22/3,503), along with Sri Aurobindo Hospital, Index Medical College, Civil Hospital in Mhow, and community health centers Betma, Sanwer and Manpur. The First-95 campaign screened 6,313 people. These figures stress the need for timely follow-up, counselling, and confidentiality to connect the remaining six to care, and to bolster testing and awareness efforts without stigma.

triage.headline_ja: インドール市のHIV感染状況2026年:6ヶ月間で357人が陽性、6人が未治療
triage.triage_reason: 通常のHIVサーベイランス報告であり、異常な増加や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はなく、国際的拡大リスクも認められない。
triage.notes: 地域の定期的なHIV検査・治療状況の報告記事であり、既存の対策枠組み内で管理可能。

article.articleHeadline: Khởi tố 2 đối tượng mua bán thịt lợn nhiễm dịch tả châu Phi làm thịt sấy, lạp sườn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two suspects indicted for selling pork infected with African swine fever to make dried meat and sausages.
article.articleSummary: Two individuals in Phú Thọ province, Vietnam—Chu Văn Đoàn (1983) and Bùi Thị Hiền (1976) of Vĩnh Hưng commune—were indicted on 16 October 2026 for violating food safety regulations after purchasing about 750 kg of pork from Hiền that showed discoloration and a foul odor to manufacture dried meat and sausages. Phú Thọ Police found the facility in Đại Đồng, Vĩnh Hưng, lacking required food safety certificates, product declarations, and origin documents, with many items unlabeled. Laboratory tests on the raw meat were positive for African swine fever virus. A powder suspected as an additive contained colorants not approved as permitted food additives. At inspection, authorities seized 225 kg of dried pork, 165 kg of raw meat, and various other dried products (buffalo, chicken) and sausages, along with related equipment. The case remains under ongoing investigation by Phú Thọ Police.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱感染豚肉を乾燥肉・ソーセージに加工して販売した2名を起訴
triage.triage_reason: 動物衛生・食品安全上の刑事事件であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大のリスクは認められない。ASFは家畜疾病でヒトには感染しない。
triage.notes: ASFはヒトに感染しない家畜疾病であり、本記事は食品安全法違反による刑事起訴事案。公衆衛生上の緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Ăn bánh mì Bà Được, 175 người ngộ độc: Chả, rau, nước sốt, tương ớt, bơ...đều dương tính với vi khuẩn Salmonella
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mrs. Được's banh mi: 175 people poisoned; pork loaf, vegetables, sauce, chili sauce, butter—all tested positive for Salmonella
article.articleSummary: Salmonella poisoning linked to Bánh mì Bà Được in Cam Thành Ward, Quảng Ngãi Province, sickened 175 people after eating the shop’s banh mi. Pasteur Institute Nha Trang reported 12 of 13 food samples collected on Oct 11 were positive for Salmonella spp., including vegetables, pork loaf, chà bông, sauce, chili sauce, bread, and butter; one of two pork sausage samples was positive, the other negative. Symptoms include severe abdominal pain, fever, diarrhea, and vomiting. In addition, other bacteria were detected: vegetables 380 E. coli units per gram; pork sausage 2,600 E. coli and 1,400 Staphylococcus aureus per gram; butter 18,000 E. coli per gram; Bacillus cereus generally under 10 per gram in most samples. The outbreak prompted a temporary halt to business and sealing of remaining foods; authorities cited lack of documentation for some ingredients and sanitation issues in the home processing area. No imported/exported cases reported. As of 16 Oct 2026.

triage.headline_ja: バーズオック氏のバインミー店、175人が食中毒:チャー、野菜、ソース、チリソース、バターすべてからサルモネラ菌が検出
triage.triage_reason: 単一の飲食店が原因の食中毒事件であり、原因食品の特定・営業停止・汚染食品の封鎖など既に対応が行われている。国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクはなく、IHR基準・社会的関心ともに低い。
triage.notes: 175人が発症し重症例（重度腹痛・発熱・下痢・嘔吐）が報告されているが、単一店舗由来の食品汚染事件であり、地元当局が原因究明・営業停止・衛生指導を実施済み。輸出入例の報告はなく、地域限定の公衆衛生事案と判断。

article.articleHeadline: TP.HCM: Một học sinh tử vong do mắc bệnh não mô cầu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City: A student dies after contracting meningococcal disease.
article.articleSummary: Three students at Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School in Hiệp Phước, Ho Chi Minh City, are affected by meningococcal disease due to Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B. One student died on Oct 16 after fulminant septic shock and multiorgan failure; another student at the same school was admitted with meningococcal meningitis on Oct 14; a third classmate developed fever on Oct 15 and was PCR-confirmed for serogroup B meningococcal infection on Oct 16. The patient with meningitis remains stable, is isolated, and receiving treatment. Ho Chi Minh City Department of Health, via HCDC and hospitals (Institute of Tropical Diseases, Children's Hospital 1, Nhà Bè Hospital), has launched epidemiological investigation, contact tracing, and antibiotic prophylaxis for close contacts, along with hygiene, ventilation, and environmental cleaning. No immediate school closure is mandated; decisions will depend on ongoing epidemiology. Authorities emphasize monitoring exposed students and ensuring rapid care for suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市:ある生徒が髄膜炎菌感染症で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 同一学校内で髄膜炎菌感染症（血清群B）のクラスターが発生し、死亡例を含む重症例が複数確認されたため、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性）を2つ満たす。
triage.notes: 同一学校（Hai Bà Trưng中学校）で3名の髄膜炎菌感染症患者が確認され、うち1名が劇症型敗血症性ショックで死亡。当局は疫学調査・接触者追跡・予防的抗菌薬投与を実施中。地域的クラスターであり、現時点で国際的拡大の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: Adagro confirma foco de raiva dos herbívoros em Caetés e orienta vacinação de animais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Adagro Confirms Rabies Outbreak in Herbivores in Caetés and Advises Vaccination of Animals.
article.articleSummary: Rabies outbreak confirmed in herbivores in Caetés, Pernambuco, Brazil, with a perifocal caution area of 12 km surrounding the focus, including Caetés, Capoeiras, and Jucati. Active surveillance runs October 13, 2026, to January 11, 2027. Vaccination is recommended for cattle, sheep, goats, horses and other herbivores aged three months or older, with a second dose after 30 days and annual boosters. Producers must keep vaccine invoices for verification by Adagro; field teams are monitoring the situation. Suspected cases must be reported to Adagro immediately; failure to report may incur sanctions and movement restrictions. Suspected signs include neurological or atypical behavior; transmission is primarily via hematophagous bat bites, with the virus in saliva entering through wounds. If an animal dies, do not open, bury or remove the carcass. Humans bitten or scratched should wash wounds and seek care promptly; rabies in humans is fatal.

triage.headline_ja: Adagro、カエテスにおける草食動物の狂犬病発生を確認し、動物へのワクチン接種を推奨
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル国内の家畜（草食動物）における狂犬病の局地的発生であり、人への感染事例は報告されていない。地域の防疫措置が取られており、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 動物（草食動物）における狂犬病の局地的発生で、地方当局（Adagro）が監視・ワクチン接種対応を実施中。人への感染報告はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Phú Thọ: Thu mua thịt heo nhiễm vi rút làm lạp sườn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Phú Thọ: Purchasing virus-infected pork to make pork ribs.
article.articleSummary: Phú Thọ Province, Vietnam, prosecuted two individuals for violations of food safety after purchasing pork contaminated with African swine fever virus (ASFV) to make dried meat and sausages. Chu Văn Đoàn (43), owner of a Vĩnh Hưng commune business, and Bùi Thị Hiền (50) were charged. In late July, police inspection found no food-safety certificate, no product-licensing records, and missing labels. Investigations showed Đoàn bought about 750 kg of discolored, foul-smelling pork from Hiền to process into dried pork and sausages. Lab tests on the raw meat were positive for ASFV; a suspected additive powder contained unapproved colorants. Authorities seized 225 kg of dried pork, 165 kg of raw pork, plus other dried meats and equipment, valued at over 96 million VND. Police urged consumers to verify origin and report violations to protect public health.

triage.headline_ja: フート省：ウイルス感染豚肉を買い取りソーセージを製造
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）に汚染された豚肉を加工・販売した食品安全違反の摘発事例であり、ASFはヒトに感染しないため公衆衛生上の深刻な影響はなく、新たな疫学的異常事象でもない。
triage.notes: ASF（アフリカ豚熱）は家畜（豚）の疾病でヒトには感染しない。本件は食品安全・違法食品製造に関する刑事摘発事例であり、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Tshopo : un malade d'Ebola en fuite décède et un autre activement recherché à Bafwasende - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tshopo: an Ebola patient on the run dies and another is actively sought in Bafwasende - ACP
article.articleSummary: Two confirmed Ebola virus disease cases on the run were reported in Bafwasende, 264 km east of Kisangani in Tshopo province, northeast Democratic Republic of Congo. One woman, transported by her husband on a motorcycle, died en route after leaving the General Reference Hospital to go to a prayer room; her body has been secured at the Health Zone Central Office awaiting a safe burial. The second case, a man, fled and his body has not yet been located. Police have been deployed to track him. Health and political authorities are urging communities not to move patients from medical facilities to non-medical settings like prayer rooms, and to alert response teams immediately to break transmission chains. As of 16 October 2026, two confirmed cases are circulating in Bafwasende; no further details on laboratory confirmation or exposure sources were provided.

triage.headline_ja: チョポ州：逃走中のエボラ患者が死亡、もう一人がバフワセンデで捜索中 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: 確定エボラ患者が医療施設から逃走し、感染伝播のリスクが地域社会に広がっている事例であり、DRCでのエボラ再燃という重大な公衆衛生上の懸念があるためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 確定症例が医療施設から逃走し、1名は死亡後も遺体回収・安全埋葬が未完了、もう1名は行方不明で警察が捜索中。コミュニティへの祈祷所等への移送中止呼びかけがあり、伝播連鎖遮断が急務。DRCは過去に複数回のエボラ流行歴があり、本件が既存のアウトブレイクの一部か新規発生かは記事から不明。

article.articleHeadline: São Bernardo reforça dose zero contra sarampo em 36 UBSs
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: São Bernardo strengthens zero-dose measles vaccination in 36 Basic Health Units.
article.articleSummary: Measles zero-dose vaccination expanded in São Bernardo, Brazil, with 36 Basic Health Units (UBS) offering a zero-dose of the measles vaccine for infants aged 6 months through 11 months and 29 days. The outreach takes place Saturday, October 17, from 8:00 to 17:00, as part of a special program aligned with the National Vaccination Calendar. The zero-dose is an additional dose of the trivalent measles-mumps-rubella (MMR) vaccine and does not replace the routine schedule at 12 and 15 months. The move follows measles cases confirmed in 2026 in São Bernardo — two cases in July with mild symptoms and recovery. In the state of São Paulo, 41 measles cases have been confirmed in 2026. Details on UBS locations and hours are on the city health portal. Vaccination remains the main prevention; healthcare workers should have two doses.

triage.headline_ja: サンベルナルド市、36カ所の基礎保健ユニットで麻疹ゼロ接種を強化
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・サンパウロ州で麻疹症例（州内41例、サンベルナルド2例）が確認されており予防接種強化の動きがあるが、重症例や急増の報告はなく情報が限定的。
triage.notes: 症例は軽症で推移しており、行政によるルーチンのワクチン接種強化策の一環。経過観察が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: vacinação contra a febre amarela em Minas Gerais - Jornal Panorama
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yellow fever vaccination in Minas Gerais - Panorama Journal
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever vaccination in Minas Gerais remains below Brazil’s 95% target. In 2025, vaccination coverage was 84.91%, rising to 87.50% in 2026 (SES-MG). No human yellow fever cases have been confirmed in the state to date; 69 suspected human cases and 632 epizooties (non-human primates) have been notified in 2026, with 33 primate infections confirmed for the yellow fever virus. Detection in non-human primates signals viral circulation and spillover risk to people. Transmission is via infected mosquitoes; there is no human-to-human transmission. The peak activity period is December–May. Minas Gerais is an Area with Vaccination Recommendation since 2008; vaccines are free through SUS and vacimóveis. Vaccination schedule targets: 9 months; 4 years; 5–59 years without vaccination or proof; 60+ evaluation. Travelers to areas with circulation should vaccinate at least 10 days before international travel. Immediate reporting of suspected human cases and investigation of ill/dead primates remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州における黄熱病ワクチン接種 - パノラマ紙
triage.triage_reason: ミナスジェライス州で非ヒト霊長類における黄熱ウイルス確認が継続し、ワクチン接種率が目標未達であるためスピルオーバーリスクは示唆されるが、確定ヒト症例は報告されておらず、国際的拡大や渡航制限等の懸念は認められない。
triage.notes: ミナスジェライス州は2008年から黄熱ワクチン接種推奨地域であり、年次のサーベイランス報告の一環。ヒト確定症例は0件だが、非ヒト霊長類での陽性確認（33件）があり、12月〜5月の活動期に向けた注意喚起記事。

article.articleHeadline: Xem nhanh 20h ngày 16.10: TP.HCM họp khẩn vì 3 học sinh mắc não mô cầu | Ấn định ngày xét xử đại gia Chu Thị Thành
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 8pm quick update for Oct 16: Ho Chi Minh City holds emergency meeting because three students contracted meningococcal meningitis | Trial date set for business magnate Chu Thi Thanh
article.articleSummary: Three 12-year-old students in Ho Chi Minh City’s Hiệp Phước, Nhà Bè District, were diagnosed with meningococcal meningitis (Neisseria meningitidis) group B, prompting an emergency city-wide health meeting on 16 October 2026. Student H.H.K. from Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School died on 14 October, while N.A.B.M., also 12, was admitted to Bệnh viện Bệnh nhiệt đới with meningitis caused by group B Neisseria. The third student, N.T.H.Q., began fever on 15 October and, by 16 October, had PCR-confirmed meningococcal meningitis group B in CSF and blood. Health authorities, including Ho Chi Minh City Center for Disease Control (HCDC), Bệnh viện Bệnh nhiệt đới, and Bệnh viện Nhi đồng 1, launched rapid epidemiological investigation, contact tracing, environmental disinfection of classrooms and shared spaces, and prophylactic antibiotics for close contacts. No imported/exported cases reported.

triage.headline_ja: 16日20時速報：ホーチミン市、3人の生徒が髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎に感染し緊急会議を開催｜大物実業家チュー・ティ・タインの裁判日程が決定
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市内の学校で髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎（B群）の患者が3名（うち1名死亡）発生し、市当局が緊急会議を開催するなど異常性と重篤性が認められるため、フルリスク評価に進めるべき。
triage.notes: 疾患名にClassical Swine Feverが付与されているが、記事内容は髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎（Neisseria meningitidis group B）のクラスター発生に関するものであり、豚コレラへの言及はないためBluedotのタグ付けが誤っている可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: El ébola amenaza a una octava provincia de RD Congo tras notificarse un caso sospechoso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola threatens an eighth province in DR Congo after a suspected case was reported.
article.articleSummary: Ebola threatens a ninth province in the Democratic Republic of Congo after a suspected case in Nord-Ubangi (northwest), near the Central African Republic border. A field test indicated positivity; samples were sent to the National Institute of Biomedical Research (INRB) in Kinshasa for confirmation, with results not yet available. Preventive measures and community awareness are being deployed, along with close contact tracing, in coordination among the INSP, local authorities, police and the army. Provinces with confirmed cases now include Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu, Haut-Uélé, Bas Uélé, Tshopo, and Sud-Ubangi (total 65 health zones). Since the 17th outbreak was declared on May 15, the epidemic has recorded 9,277 confirmed cases and 4,448 deaths (case fatality 48.3%), with 2,486 recoveries and 924 in hospital or isolation. The Bundibugyo strain has no specific treatment; two vaccines are in human trials. Uganda reported 20 cases (15 imported from DRC); additional cases were detected in Kenya (2), France (1) and the Netherlands (1).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国で疑い例報告後、エボラが8番目の州に拡大の恐れ
triage.triage_reason: DRCの大規模エボラ流行（確定9,277例、死亡4,448例、致死率48.3%）が新たな州に拡大しつつあり、ウガンダ・ケニア・フランス・オランダへの国際的波及も確認されているため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断。
triage.notes: ウガンダ、ケニア、フランス、オランダでの関連症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。CAR国境付近での疑い例であり、CAR自体も対象国外。

article.articleHeadline: В Кении выявили второй случай заражения вирусом Эбола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second case of Ebola virus infection detected in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 October 2026, the World Health Organization confirms a second Ebola virus infection in Kenya, with the first patient having died on 5 October. The second case is a relative with contact to the initial patient; Kenya's Ministry of Health confirmed the infection. WHO representative in Kenya, Nima Rusibamayila Kimambo, said the agency will continue supporting containment and urged full contact tracing and quarantine of those exposed. The Kenyan outbreak adds to the virus’s historic footprint: Ebola was first identified in 1976 near Nzara, Sudan and Yambuku, DRC. The West Africa epidemic of 2013–2017 (Guinea, Liberia, Sierra Leone) infected about 30,000 people with roughly 11,000 deaths. In May, Ituri province in eastern DRC declared another outbreak of the Bundibugyo variant, with 246 suspected cases and 65 deaths; for Bundibugyo, no proven treatment or vaccine exists.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラウイルス感染の2例目が確認される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重篤な感染症のヒト-ヒト感染例が新たに確認され、WHOが関与・支援しており、国際的拡大やコンテインメントの必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの2例目エボラ感染だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRC（イトゥリ州）での別のブンディブギョ株アウトブレイク（246疑い例、65死亡）が進行中の実際の事象として言及されているため、verified_locationsに含めた。スーダン・シエラレオネ・リベリア・ギニアは1976年および2013-2017年の歴史的言及のみであり、現行事象ではないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: TP Hồ Chí Minh ghi nhận hơn 40.000 ca tay chân miệng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City records over 40,000 cases of hand, foot, and mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City recorded 1,844 hand, foot, and mouth disease (HFMD) cases in week 41 (Oct 5–11, 2026), up 32.2% from the four-week average, bringing the year-to-date total to 40,446. The highest local counts include Con Dao (858), Bình Khánh (561), Hiệp Phước (518), and Tân Nhựt (491). HFMD is caused by enteroviruses, chiefly Enterovirus 71 and Coxsackieviruses, and mainly affects children under five, especially under three. Incubation is 3–6 days. Early symptoms: fever up to 39–40°C, sore throat, drooling, poor feeding; mouth ulcers (2–3 mm) and vesicular lesions (2–10 mm) on hands, feet, knees, buttocks, and around digits. EV71 can cause severe CNS complications such as encephalitis, meningitis, seizures, altered consciousness, respiratory or circulatory failure, and death. No specific antiviral; treatment is supportive. Prevention emphasizes hygiene; VNVC vaccination began Sept 25 across about 300 centers in 31 provinces, with over 100,000 children vaccinated in two weeks, aided by 3 billion VND.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市、手足口病の症例が4万例を超える
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで季節性かつ地方型の手足口病（EV71含む）の症例増加が報告されているが、既にワクチン接種キャンペーン等の国内対応が進行中であり、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はないため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 手足口病はベトナムで毎年流行する既知の季節性疾患であり、本記事は定期的なサーベイランス報告に近い。EV71による重症化（脳炎等）のリスクは一般論として言及されているが、今回の報告期間内での重症例・死亡例の具体的データはなく、国家主導のワクチン接種対応（VNVC）が既に進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Dùng thịt lợn nhiễm dịch tả châu Phi làm thịt sấy, lạp sườn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Using pork infected with African swine fever to make dried meat and sausages.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever virus detected in pig meat intended for dried meat and sausages in Phú Thọ, Vietnam. On 16 October 2026, Phú Thọ Police announced charges against Chu Văn Đoàn (1983) and Bùi Thị Hiền (1976) of Vĩnh Hưng commune for violating food safety regulations. Investigators found the processing site lacked required licenses, product declarations, and proper labeling. In July, Đoàn procured about 750 kg of pig meat showing discoloration and foul odor to produce dried meat and lạp sườn (sausages). Laboratory tests confirmed ASF virus in the raw meat; additional evidence included an additive powder with non-permitted colorants. At inspection, authorities seized 225 kg of dried meat, 165 kg of raw meat, and other dried products, with assets valued at over 96.2 million VND. The case remains under investigation; authorities urge strict adherence to safety rules and public vigilance on product origin and labeling.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱感染豚肉を使った乾燥肉・ソーセージの製造事件
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）はヒトに感染しない動物疾患であり、本記事は食品安全規則違反・犯罪事件に関する内容であって公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えないため。
triage.notes: ASFはヒトに感染しないため公衆衛生リスクは低い。本件は食品安全・動物衛生当局による犯罪捜査事案であり、EBSのヒト感染症シグナルとしての重要性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: കേരളത്തിൽ ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി വ്യാപനം മുൻകൂട്ടി അറിയാൻ ഐഎവിയുടെ നൂതന സംവിധാനം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: IAV's novel system to forecast the spread of dengue fever in Kerala.
article.articleSummary: Kerala's Dengue Early Warning System (DEWS), developed by the Institute of Advanced Virology in Thiruvananthapuram under Dr. Abhinand C.S., uses machine learning to forecast district-level dengue risk. It integrates state health surveillance with central meteorological data (rainfall, temperature, humidity) and weekly dengue case counts to classify districts into four risk levels: low, moderate, high, and very high. Trained on daily data from March 2020 to February 2026, the model leverages historical transmission patterns and climate trends to predict spread. While Aedes mosquito reproduction is climate-influenced, the system also weighs case-number trends to identify rising transmission phases early. Preliminary evaluation using March–July 2026 health data showed agreement with reported trends; further validation is ongoing. The goal is to guide vector control, public awareness, surveillance enhancements, and prioritized resource allocation in high-risk districts. Details at https://dews.iav.res.in.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州におけるデング熱流行予測のためのIAVの新システム
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱の早期警戒予測システム（研究開発）に関する内容であり、実際の異常な発生や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱予測システムの技術的紹介であり、具体的な発生状況や症例数の急増を報じるものではないため、対象国の発生地として計上しない。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола в ДРК распространилась на новую провинцию, граничащую с ЦАР
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC has spread to a new province bordering the Central African Republic.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 October 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has spread to a new province, North Ubangi, which borders the Central African Republic. North Ubangi is the eighth province affected. Two cases have been confirmed there, though officials have not yet publicly announced them. The epicenter remains Ituri, but case numbers are rising in North Kivu and have also been confirmed in South Kivu, Chopo, Upper Uele, Lower Uele, and South Ubangi. In Vipinda health zone, a mining area near the Lower Uele border, a series of suspicious deaths prompted sending samples to a provincial laboratory and to Kinshasa for analysis. The development signals expanding geographic reach and underscores the need for intensified surveillance and cross-border cooperation to contain transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ、中央アフリカ共和国と国境を接する新たな州に拡大
triage.triage_reason: エボラ流行が8番目の州に拡大し、国境地域での感染拡大や原因不明の死亡例も報告されており、公衆衛生上の深刻性と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国(CAR)との国境地域への拡大が報じられているが、CARは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC国内での8州への拡大が主題。

article.articleHeadline: Phát hiện vi khuẩn Salmonella spp. trong mẫu thực phẩm vụ ngộ độc bánh mì
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Detection of Salmonella spp. in a food sample from a bread-related food poisoning incident.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella spp. detected in a bread-related food poisoning outbreak in Quảng Ngãi Province, Vietnam. On Oct 16, Pasteur Nha Trang announced results from 13 samples tested on Oct 11 by Quảng Ngãi CDC, finding Salmonella positive (per 25g) in multiple bread fillings and even the loaf, including chả thịt heo (pork sausage), chà bông (shredded pork), sauce, ớt tương (chili sauce), bơ (butter), and vegetables; some samples also exceeded safety limits for E. coli and Staphylococcus aureus. This laboratory evidence underpins the investigation into the outbreak that began Oct 9 after people consumed bread at Bà Được stall on Duy Tân Street, Cam Thành ward. By Oct 13, about 167 people had been hospitalized. Authorities sealed the facility, suspended business, and traced food origins. The report highlights Salmonella transmission via contaminated ingredients and cross-contamination in street foods, urging strict food safety practices and routine testing with retained samples.

triage.headline_ja: パンによる食中毒事件の食品サンプルからサルモネラ菌を検出
triage.triage_reason: 単一の屋台パンに起因する食中毒事例で約167人が入院したが、施設は封鎖・対応済みであり国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低い。続報（原因究明や拡大有無）を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 食品（パン及び具材）の汚染による単発食中毒事例。施設は封鎖・営業停止済みで、地域CDCによる対応が進行中。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性は低く、感染源は特定の屋台に限定されている。

article.articleHeadline: TP Hồ Chí Minh: Phát hiện chùm ca não mô cầu trường học, một học sinh tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City: Detection of a cluster of meningococcal meningitis cases at a school, one student dies.
article.articleSummary: Three students at Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School in Hiệp Phước, Ho Chi Minh City, contracted meningococcal meningitis due to Neisseria meningitidis group B. One student died on 14 October; a second admitted the same day remains under treatment, and a third developed fever on 15 October with PCR-confirmed group B meningococcal infection by 16 October; this student is now stable and isolated. The Ho Chi Minh City Department of Health, in coordination with the Municipal CDC, hospitals, and the Education Department, launched rapid epidemiological investigation, contact tracing, chemoprophylaxis for close contacts, and school hygiene measures. Not all students require antibiotics; vaccination decisions depend on risk assessment and guidelines. Authorities stress that class closure is not routine and will adjust measures as the situation evolves. Ongoing monitoring and updates will be provided.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市：学校で髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の集団発生を検出、生徒1名死亡
triage.triage_reason: 学校における髄膜炎菌感染症のクラスター発生で死亡例を含み、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）に2つ該当するためフルリスク評価に進む。
triage.notes: 学校内での髄膜炎菌（グループB）感染クラスターで、1名死亡、2名が確認・治療中。保健当局が疫学調査・接触者追跡・予防投薬を実施中。国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクは現時点で低いが、学校という閉鎖的環境での二次感染拡大の可能性に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: TP Hồ Chí Minh phát hiện chùm ca bệnh não mô cầu trong trường học, một học sinh tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City detects a cluster of meningococcal disease cases in a school, one student dies.
article.articleSummary: Three students at Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School, Hiệp Phước commune, Ho Chi Minh City, are diagnosed with meningococcal disease caused by Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B; one student died and two are under treatment. The index case, born in 2014, developed fulminant meningococcemia with septic shock and multi-organ failure and died on 14 Oct. A second student was diagnosed with meningococcal meningitis (group B) on the same day and is receiving care. On 15 Oct, a third classmate developed fever; by 16 Oct PCR tests of blood and CSF confirmed meningococcal disease group B, and the patient is stable and isolated. Authorities launched epidemiologic investigation, contact tracing, and antibiotic prophylaxis for indicated close contacts, with health surveillance of students and staff. Not all students require prophylaxis; vaccination exists for MenB but decisions depend on age, health, and medical guidance. Follow official guidance; do not self-medicate.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市、学校で髄膜炎菌感染症のクラスターを検出、生徒1人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 学校内での髄膜炎菌感染症（血清群B）クラスター発生により生徒1人が死亡し重症例も発生しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 同一学校内で3例の髄膜炎菌感染症（血清群B）が確認され、うち1例が劇症型で死亡。濃厚接触者への抗菌薬予防投与と健康監視が実施されている。国内医療機関による対応が進行中で、現時点で外部支援の必要性は不明。

article.articleHeadline: Vụ ngộ độc bánh mì ở Quảng Ngãi, phát hiện Salmonella trong 12 mẫu thực phẩm
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bread poisoning incident in Quang Ngai, Salmonella detected in 12 food samples.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella contamination linked to a bread poisoning outbreak in Cam Thanh ward, Quảng Ngãi Province, Vietnam. On Oct 9, 2026, 135 people were hospitalized with abdominal cramps, diarrhea, vomiting, and fever after eating bread; cases later expanded across facilities in the province. As of Oct 16, 2026, Pasteur Institute Nha Trang, per Quảng Ngãi CDC’s testing (document 1984/IPN-ATTP), found Salmonella in 12 of 13 food samples, including vegetables, pork sausage, pork floss, sauces, chili sauce, bread, and butter. A sausage sample VSTP-NĐ-11A was Salmonella-negative but had Escherichia coli 2.6×10^3 CFU/g and Staphylococcus aureus 1.4×10^3 CFU/g; butter had E. coli 1.8×10^4 CFU/g. Both bread samples tested Salmonella-positive; other bacteria were below 10 CFU/g in those samples. Separately, An Giang Province reported a 68-year-old man died of hand, foot, and mouth disease, with year-to-date cases up 1.8-fold.

triage.headline_ja: クアンガイ省のパン食中毒事件、12検体からサルモネラ菌検出
triage.triage_reason: 単一地域での食品汚染による食中毒事件であり、原因（サルモネラ菌）も特定され当局が対応中。人-人感染の可能性はなく、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクも低い。
triage.notes: 135人が入院した食中毒事例だが、原因食品と病原体（サルモネラ菌）が特定され地元当局（CDC・パスツール研究所）が検査・対応済み。別件としてAn Giang省での手足口病死亡例が言及されているが、本記事の主題ではないため評価対象外とした。

article.articleHeadline: Vụ 175 người nhập viện sau ăn bánh mì: Chả, rau, bơ, nước sốt nhiễm Salmonella
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Case: 175 people hospitalized after eating banh mi: pork sausage, vegetables, butter, and sauce contaminated with Salmonella.
article.articleSummary: 175 people were hospitalized in Quảng Ngãi Province, Vietnam, after eating banh mi linked to Salmonella contamination. On 10 October diners at bakery BĐ on Duy Tân Street in Cam Thành Ward fell ill with abdominal pain, diarrhea, vomiting, and fever; by 15 October hospitalizations reached 175 across 9 healthcare facilities in the province. Laboratory testing of 13 related food samples found Salmonella in 12 samples—vegetables, pork sausage, pork floss, sauce, chili sauce, bread, and butter—with one pork sausage sample negative. Additional findings included Escherichia coli and Staphylococcus aureus in some samples; butter contained E. coli at 1.8 × 10^4 CFU/g. Salmonella causes enteric infection with GI symptoms. Pasteur Institute Nha Trang shared results with Quảng Ngãi CDC; the Ministry of Health’s Food Safety Department and provincial authorities ordered a rapid investigation, traceability of ingredients, seizure of remaining foods, and enforcement of regulations.

triage.headline_ja: 175人入院事件：バインミーに使用されたチャー（豚肉ソーセージ）、野菜、バター、ソースからサルモネラ菌検出
triage.triage_reason: ベトナム・クアンガイ省で発生した単一のサルモネラ食中毒事例。入院者数175人と規模は大きいが、原因食品が特定され当局が対応中であり、国際的拡大や渡航・貿易制限のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 食品媒介のサルモネラ食中毒であり、ヒト-ヒト感染の懸念はない。原因食品（野菜、豚肉ソーセージ、バター等）が特定され、保健当局による調査・トレーサビリティ対応が進行中。175人という規模は国内での関心事項だが、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威とは言えないためWATCHと判定。続報で死亡者の有無や感染拡大の推移を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Otters Face a Rising Tide of Parasites, Disease, and Human Pressure
article.articleSummary: Eight studies compiled in a Frontiers in Mammal Science editorial (30 June 2026) flag a global rise in parasites, infectious diseases, and human-driven threats to otters (Lutrinae). The works span North American river otters and American mink, giant otters (Pteronura brasiliensis) and neotropical otters (Lontra longicaudis), plus regional analyses in Chesapeake Bay and Canadian provinces British Columbia and Alberta, with Brazil as a focus. Zoonotic Alaria mustelae is documented for the first time in river otters, with larval-stage disease linked to clinical illness. Canine Distemper Virus and Toxoplasma gondii exposures occur among neotropical otters in a Brazilian conservation reserve, aided by domestic dog/cat spillover. Globally, parasites include digeneans, cestodes, nematodes, and apicomplexans; strongylid nematodes predominate in Chesapeake Bay scats. The reviews highlight uneven data, a need for regional context, and gaps in wildlife parasite reference sequences.

triage.headline_ja: カワウソ、寄生虫・病気・人間からの圧力の増大に直面
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物(カワウソ)の寄生虫・感染症に関する学術的レビュー記事であり、ヒトへの公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な流行は確認されない。
triage.notes: 主な対象は野生動物(カワウソ)における寄生虫・感染症の学術研究であり、ヒトの感染症危機ではない。ブラジルの保護区における事例が言及されているため対象国として記載したが、公衆衛生上の重大性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: 31 nouveaux cas d'Ebola signalés à Lubero
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 31 new Ebola cases reported in Lubero
article.articleSummary: 31 new Ebola cases were reported in Lubero territory, North Kivu Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, over more than a week ending Oct 15. Epidemiological data show that both confirmed cases and people infected are concentrated in seven health zones within Lubero. Alain Kiwewa, administrator of Lubero, noted a rise in confirmed cases in the area and urged residents to recognize the disease's reality. He called for vigilance and strict adherence to infection prevention measures to reduce transmission and protect families and communities. Health authorities are continuing community sensitization to strengthen prevention and curb the outbreak in the affected zones. No details on laboratory confirmation methods or exposure sources are provided; no mention of imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ルベロで31件の新規エボラ症例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の新規症例31件がコンゴ民主共和国で報告され、複数の保健区域に拡大しており、重篤性・異常性・ヒト-ヒト感染リスクの観点からフルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 7つの保健区域にまたがる症例の集中が報告されており、エボラという疾患の致死性・感染力の高さから継続的な監視とリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Plague case in Siberia: what we know and what we should know | In Focus Podcast
article.articleSummary: Death of Darya Shiplova, a lab worker at a Siberia plague research institute, is believed to be caused by pneumonic plague. Russia quarantined dozens of contacts but officials insist there is no epidemic risk; a WHO official urged more information. The In Focus episode surveys plague beyond recent headlines, asking what the disease is, how infectious it is, and why it has receded from public attention. It traces India's historical battles with plague in the 1890s and Surat in 1994 to frame transmission, treatment, and historical impact, then weighs the likelihood of another outbreak. The discussion, with host Zubeda Hamid and guest Rajib Dasgupta of Jawaharlal Nehru University, highlights how laboratory incidents influence public perception and what is known about infection sources and response.

triage.headline_ja: シベリアのペスト症例：何が分かっていて、何を知るべきか | In Focus ポッドキャスト
triage.triage_reason: 実際の発生国はロシア（シベリア）であり対象国リストに含まれない。インドへの言及は1890年代・1994年の歴史的事例の文脈のみで、現在インドで発生している事案ではないため対象外とする。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア（シベリア）の研究所関連の肺ペスト死亡事例を扱うポッドキャストで、インドは歴史的事例（1890年代・1994年スーラト）として比較的に言及されているのみ。現在インドで発生している事案ではないため、対象国としての該当なし。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため評価対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Africa: Ebola Spread Raises Fresh Urgency for Africa's Domestic Health Funding
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak intensifies in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s North Kivu, with rapid spread and concerns over limited resources and delayed cross-border support. A Ebola death in Kenya last week highlights Africa’s urgent need for robust health emergency preparedness and locally funded responses, as Kenya implemented outbreak controls while the DRC faced 10-day delays in receiving life-saving supplies from neighbors. Doctors Without Borders warnings describe the current strain spreading like a megafire amid under-funded health systems. UNECA reports external health assistance down ~30%, and Africa’s health-financing model remains structurally fragile, with households often paying more for health than governments. The Abuja Declaration target of allocating 15% of national budgets to health remains unmet (roughly 2–12% in many countries). Calls persist for a fundamental reset of health funding, treating health spending as investment, even amid debt-service pressures.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ:エボラ拡大がアフリカの国内保健資金調達に新たな緊急性を突きつける
triage.triage_reason: DRC北キブ州でエボラが急速拡大し、ケニアへの越境死亡例も確認されるなど国際的拡大がみられ、資源不足・支援遅延という公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念があるためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: ケニアでの死亡例が報告されているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外した。国境を越えた資源供給の遅延がDRCでの対応を困難にしている点が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: 俄罗斯疑似猴痘疫情 已有5人接受医学观察
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia's suspected monkeypox outbreak; five people under medical observation.
article.articleSummary: Monkeypox in Russia: as of Oct 15, Moscow region reports five people hospitalized for medical observation; epidemiological tracing and disinfection are underway, with no confirmed cases yet. Earlier this year, Domodedovo reported one confirmed case, later three; Saint Petersburg recorded two travelers from Thailand with infection. October cases suggest ongoing transmission. Monkeypox, identified in 1958 and first human case in 1970, is an Orthopoxvirus with lower virulence than smallpox, and a fatality around 0.1%. Smallpox vaccination provides about 85% cross-protection, but global eradication after 1980 led to waning immunity, leaving many under 40 unprotected. Since 2022, more than 100 countries have reported cases; China classified monkeypox as a Category B infectious disease in Sept 2023, with border and healthcare surveillance in place. Transmission is mainly via close contact with lesions or mucosal surfaces; incubation 5–21 days; most recover in 2–4 weeks, with higher risk for children, pregnant women, or immunocompromised. Moscow’s rapid testing aids quick detection; minimize close contact with suspected cases.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアで猴痘疑いの流行、5人が医学観察下に
triage.triage_reason: ロシア（モスクワ州・サンクトペテルブルク）でMpoxの疑い例・確定例が継続的に報告されており流行可能性があるが、対象国（タイ・中国）は本イベントの発生地ではなく、重症度や社会的関心度の情報も不足している。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシア（モスクワ州・ドモジェドヴォ・サンクトペテルブルク）での猴痘発生であり、対象国リストに含まれるタイ・中国は旅行歴や疾病分類制度の言及に過ぎず、発生国として確認できないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Sarampo avança no Amazonas e já atinge 17 pessoas; crianças são maioria - Amazonas | Portal do Holanda
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles spread in Amazonas and already affect 17 people; children are the majority - Amazonas | Portal do Holanda.
article.articleSummary: Measles outbreak in Amazonas, Brazil, with 17 laboratory-confirmed cases by Oct 14, up from 10, among 34 total notifications since Sep 1; 7 under investigation, 10 discarded; no deaths reported per Oct 15 bulletin by FVS-RCP. All confirmed infections are in Alto Solimões near the Brazil-Peru-Colombia border, with Tabatinga (9), Benjamin Constant (5), Atalaia do Norte (2), and São Paulo de Olivença (1) affected. Of patients, 14 are unvaccinated; vaccination status unknown for one; nine cases are children under five; four indigenous people are among the infected. Symptoms include fever, red rash, cough, coryza, and conjunctivitis. Prevention centers on vaccination; the MMR vaccine is provided free at Basic Health Units (UBSs). Authorities urge checking vaccination records, updating doses, and seeking care for suspected cases, noting recent travel or contact with people from areas with circulating virus.

triage.headline_ja: アマゾナス州で麻疹が拡大、すでに17人が感染；子どもが大多数を占める - アマゾナス | ポルタル・ド・オランダ
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル（排除認定済み）での麻疹再興がペルー・コロンビア国境地帯で確認され、未接種者・子ども・先住民に拡大しており、IHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク）を2つ満たすためフルRRAへ移行すべき。
triage.notes: ペルー・コロンビアも地理的に関連するが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。症例は国境地帯（Alto Solimões）に集中し、国境を越えた感染拡大の可能性に留意が必要。死亡例はないが未接種者が大半（14/17）であり、流行継続の可能性が高い。
