article.articleHeadline: В Уганде начались первые испытания вакцины против Эболы Бундибуджио
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Uganda, the first trials of a vaccine against Bundibugyo ebolavirus have begun.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 October 2026, Uganda’s southern city of Masaka hosts a first-in-human Phase I trial of an experimental vaccine against Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV). The ChAdOx1 BDBV vaccine, developed by the University of Oxford, aims to enroll about 110 volunteers who received the first dose on 6 October. The study, led by Eugene Ruzagira of the London School of Hygiene & Tropical Medicine, first evaluates safety before assessing immunogenicity, with participants monitored for a year. Uganda has received roughly 3,000 vaccine doses, while the Serum Institute of India has produced and reserved around 620,000 doses for potential future use. Parallel safety studies are underway in the United Kingdom. Bundibugyo ebolavirus was first identified in Uganda in 2007; unlike Ebola Zaire, no licensed vaccine exists for BDBV yet.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダでブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスに対するワクチンの初の臨床試験が開始
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はワクチン臨床試験の開始を報じるものであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの発生情報ではないため、シグナルとして取り上げる必要性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでのワクチン臨床試験開始の報告であり、実際の感染発生国ではない。対象国リストにウガンダは含まれず、インドはワクチン製造元（Serum Institute of India）として言及されているのみで、インド国内での感染発生ではないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: A One-Dollar Bedside Test Catches Deadly Superbugs in Rural Hospitals
article.articleSummary: Carbapenem-resistant Enterobacteriaceae (CRE) carriage detected at the bedside in a Vietnamese ICU (Viet Tiep Hospital) using pre-formulated chromogenic agar plates and a portable incubator, performed by nurses for under $1 per test. Involving 220 ICU patients, 26 were CRE carriers (11.8%), with the KESC group (Klebsiella, Enterobacter, Serratia, Citrobacter) accounting for 76.9% of positives. Bedside testing achieved 100% phenotypic concordance with the centralized reference laboratory, with all metrics—sensitivity, specificity, positive predictive value, and negative predictive value—at 100%. Inter-reader reliability was perfect (Cohen’s kappa 1.0), and environmental contamination was 0.0% (95% CI 0–4.1%). This decentralized, low-cost approach enables rapid detection of asymptomatic gastrointestinal carriage, potentially reducing undetected transmission and reliance on empiric broad-spectrum antibiotics in resource-limited hospital settings, addressing a key driver of CRE outbreaks in ICUs.

triage.headline_ja: 1ドルのベッドサイド検査が農村部の病院で致死的な薬剤耐性菌を検出
triage.triage_reason: 新規の検査手法に関する研究報告であり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: この記事はベトナムのICUにおけるCRE（カルバペネム耐性腸内細菌科細菌）保菌検出のための低コスト検査法の研究発表であり、疾患アウトブレイクの報告ではない。疾患名がCoccidioidomycosisとなっているがサマリー内容と一致せず、Bluedotのタグ付けが誤っている可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: പകർച്ചവ്യാധി ഭീതിയിൽ കേരളം; എലിപ്പനി മരണം 100 കടന്നു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kerala in fear of an infectious disease; smallpox death toll has crossed 100.
article.articleSummary: Kerala, India, as of 16 October 2026, reports a surge in infectious diseases, led by smallpox. Smallpox deaths have surpassed 100 this year, with 118 deaths and 2,308 lab-confirmed cases; one additional smallpox death occurred today. Dengue concerns include 99 suspected cases, with 40 patients under treatment. Influenza fatalities amount to 123, with 22 patients under care. Overall, fever-driven consultations reach 7,048, and total infectious-disease deaths this year stand at 478. Health officials attribute transmission to the monsoon season and ongoing exposure to stagnant, dirty water. Guidance urges patients not to self-medicate; upon symptoms, obtain doxycycline from government hospitals. Concurrently, emphasis is placed on sanitation and public participation in vector-control activities to curb spread of vector-borne diseases such as dengue.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州で感染症への不安高まる；エリ熱(レプトスピラ症)による死者100人超える
triage.triage_reason: レプトスピラ症・デング熱・インフルエンザを含む複合的な感染症流行によりケララ州で年間478人の死者が発生しており、政府の対応（病院での抗生剤提供、ベクター対策の呼びかけ）と地域住民の不安の高まりが確認されるため、フルRRAでの精査が望ましい。
triage.notes: 疾患名タグに'Smallpox'とあるが、原文マラヤーラム語の見出し『എലിപ്പനി（エリッパニ）』はレプトスピラ症（鼠咬熱/rat fever）を指しており、天然痘ではない。治療薬としてドキシサイクリンが挙げられている点からもレプトスピラ症であることが裏付けられる。これはBluedot APIの疾患タグ付けの誤りと考えられる。モンスーン期の季節性流行であり、例年繰り返される傾向があるため『異常・予想外』には該当しないと判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya on high alert as Ebola outbreak in DR Congo fuels border fears
article.articleSummary: Kenya is on high alert as Ebola linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo drives border fears. The Bundibugyo virus is involved; Congo reports 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths across seven provinces, with over 70% of new cases not identifying contacts. Kenya confirms a second case: a 39-year-old close relative of the first Kenyan patient, who had lived in Congo, tested positive after symptoms appeared in quarantine; the first patient, a 40-year-old Kenyan, fell ill in Congo, traveled via Uganda to Nairobi, and died on Oct. 5. Kenya identified about 128 contacts, with 108 in quarantine, and has tightened border and airport screening. Uganda had declared its outbreak over earlier; WHO opposed border closures to avoid diverting people to informal crossings. No vaccine or approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo virus.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、DRCでのエボラ流行を受け国境懸念から厳戒態勢
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ(ブンディブギョ型)流行(9,066症例・4,381死亡)が続き、ケニアへの越境感染が確認されヒト-ヒト感染・国際的拡大のリスクが高いため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当しフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのエボラ流行とそのケニアへの越境拡大。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCは流行の発生源として該当。

article.articleHeadline: Bánh mì khiến 175 người ở Quảng Ngãi ngộ độc nhiễm khuẩn Salmonella
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bread causes 175 people in Quang Ngai to be infected with Salmonella.
article.articleSummary: Salmonella outbreak linked to bread in Quảng Ngãi province led to 175 hospitalizations. On Oct 10, residents who bought bread at Bà Được bakery on Duy Tân Street in Cam Thành ward developed gastrointestinal symptoms; by Oct 15 hospitalizations reached 175. Pasteur Institute Nha Trang tested 13 samples, announcing on Oct 13 that 12 were Salmonella-positive (two vegetables, two pork sausages, two shredded pork, two sauces, two chili sauces, two bread samples, one butter); one pork sausage sample was negative. Escherichia coli appeared in three samples (butter, sausage, vegetables); Staphylococcus aureus in one sausage. Although Salmonella aligns with foodborne illness, results do not yet identify a direct source; epidemiological and clinical-biospecimen analyses are ongoing. Authorities ordered the bakery to suspend trading and seal remaining foods; several ingredients lacked origin documents, and home-processing hygiene was questioned. The Health Ministry and Food Safety Authority urged treatment, tracing, and enforcement if violations occur.

triage.headline_ja: クアンガイ省でパンによるサルモネラ食中毒、175人が感染
triage.triage_reason: 単一のパン屋を発端とする食中毒事例で、原因食品の特定と店舗閉鎖など地元当局による対応が既に進んでいるが、疫学調査が継続中であり情報が確定していないため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 単発の食品由来（パン屋）集団食中毒事例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染や国際的拡大のリスクは低い。原因食品の特定調査が継続中のため続報を確認する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: TP.HCM ghi nhận ba học sinh mắc não mô cầu, một ca tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City records three students infected with meningococcal meningitis, one death.
article.articleSummary: Ho Chi Minh City reports three students from Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School in Hiệp Phước diagnosed with meningococcal meningitis, group B, as of 16 October 2026. One student died; two others are stable on treatment. A fulminant meningococcemia case two days earlier, with septic shock and multi-organ failure, also tested positive for group B and died. A second student from the same school was admitted to the Infectious Diseases Hospital with meningococcal meningitis and remains stable. On 15 October, a classmate who sat with the deceased developed fever; 16 October PCR from blood and CSF confirmed group B meningococcal infection, with the patient stable and isolated. Health authorities conduct aggressive contact tracing, provide chemoprophylaxis to close contacts, and monitor exposed students; vaccination and school activity adjustments will be considered per epidemiological risk. Parents are advised to follow official guidance and avoid self-medication.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市で生徒3人が髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎に感染、1人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 同一学校内で髄膜炎菌(B群)による複数症例・死亡例が確認され、濃厚接触者への化学予防や接触者調査が進行中であり、公衆衛生対応の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 疾患名にClassical Swine Feverが含まれているが、記事内容は髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎の学校内クラスターに関するものであり、豚コレラとは無関係と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: DRC Ebola Deaths reach 4,400
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo strain) in the DRC persists, with deaths reaching about 4,400 as of 13 October 2026 (ECDC). The country reports 9,144 confirmed cases and 4,410 deaths (data up to 12 Oct); 899 patients are in isolation. On 12 Oct, 79 new confirmed cases (Ituri 40; North Kivu 27; Haut-Uele 8) and 11 new deaths were reported. Of those infected with Bundibugyo virus, 2,418 have recovered; 77.6% of identified contacts are under follow-up. Ituri bears the majority of deaths (3,177), North Kivu 1,102; 28 of 36 health zones have Ebola deaths, with provincial totals awaiting reconciliation with the national figure. Kenya reports its first case; movements traced from DRC through Uganda, which had earlier cases but no new since May. No approved vaccine for Bundibugyo yet; several candidates in development. The outbreak unfolds amid insecurity and regional rivalries complicating response.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ死者数、4,400人に達する
triage.triage_reason: DRCで大規模なエボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが継続し、死者4,400人・確定例9,144人に達しており、ケニアでの初症例やウガンダへの波及など国際的拡大が確認されているためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsには含めていない。治安悪化や地域間対立が対応を複雑化させている点も留意。

article.articleHeadline: Discussion on infectious diseases held at conference
article.articleSummary: Nature Conference on infectious diseases was held at Manipal Academy of Higher Education (MAHE) in Mangaluru, India, concluding a three-day conference titled Meeting the challenge of infectious diseases. Attendees from India and abroad discussed antimicrobial resistance, tuberculosis diagnosis, vaccine development, climate-linked diseases and pandemic preparedness, with emphasis on surveillance, diagnostics, prevention, vaccines and One Health. Keynote speakers included Lauren Gardner (Johns Hopkins University) on data in public health decisions after COVID-19; Madhukar Pai (McGill) on transforming tuberculosis diagnosis; Shabir A Madhi (University of the Witwatersrand) on preventing vaccine-preventable respiratory infections among children; and Marion Koopmans (Erasmus University Rotterdam) on outbreak risk prediction for pandemics. Sessions covered new treatments for drug-resistant infections like Klebsiella pneumoniae, new TB regimens, HPV testing and vaccination, vaccines for emerging and endemic infections and long-acting preventive interventions. Climate change linked to vector-borne disease risk and malnutrition; One Health emphasized; MAHE highlighted collaboration.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症に関する会議が開催される
triage.triage_reason: 特定の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、学術会議の開催報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性は認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症に関する学術会議の内容紹介であり、具体的な発生事例の報告ではないため、トリアージ対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : décentralisation des soins pour réduire les retards de prise en charge (MSF) - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: decentralization of care to reduce delays in treatment (MSF) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola treatment strategy in Ituri, Northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, shifts toward decentralization to cut delays in treatment for suspected cases. MSF states that the Ebola Treatment Center (ETC) should move toward patients rather than wait for them to reach centers, as delays have persisted despite strengthening care capacity. Access remains challenging in Mambasa due to insecurity and in Damas where rapid-response teams face difficult transport, limiting disruption of the virus transmission chain. New cases continue to appear with high mortality in affected communities. To address this, MSF will mobilize resources to bring care closer to populations, adapting to local geographic and security realities, and continuing community outreach in collaboration with representatives and civil society. MSF emphasizes supporting, not substituting, communities, which are key to ending the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州でのエボラ出血熱:治療の遅延を減らすためのケアの分散化（MSF）- ACP
triage.triage_reason: DRCイトゥリ州で進行中のエボラアウトブレイクにおいて新規症例と高い致死率が継続しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にCosta Rica（San José, Damas）が含まれるが、記事サマリーはDRCイトゥリ州（Mambasa, Damas地区）のエボラアウトブレイクのみを主題としており、Costa Ricaは対象国でないため除外。既知の進行中アウトブレイクだが、治療遅延とアクセス困難により新規感染が続いている点が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Com nova confirmação, BH tem 11 casos de raiva em morcegos neste ano
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: With a new confirmation, Belo Horizonte has 11 cases of rabies in bats this year.
article.articleSummary: Rabies confirmed in Belo Horizonte, Minas Gerais, with 11 bat cases reported in 2026. A bat found in the Venda Nova region on October 8 tested positive; laboratory confirmation was issued on October 14, with updates on October 15. All 11 cases this year are bats, spread across six regional areas: Barreiro (3), Leste (3), Norte (2), Centro-Sul (1), Pampulha (1), and Venda Nova (1). Rabies is an acute, fatal viral disease affecting the central nervous system, transmitted to humans mainly through saliva, typically by bites, scratches, or licking. Incubation varies; initial symptoms include malaise, anorexia, nausea, numbness, and later hydrophobia, hypersalivation, tremors, seizures, coma, and death. Public health actions include vaccinating dogs and cats within 300 meters of the site and providing local guidance. The last non-bat rabies case in Belo Horizonte was in 2022 (21 bats, 1 cat).

triage.headline_ja: 新たな確認により、ベロオリゾンテで今年のコウモリ狂犬病症例は11件に
triage.triage_reason: コウモリにおける狂犬病の通常の発生報告であり、ヒト感染例はなく、公衆衛生当局による通常の予防対応（ワクチン接種等）が取られている。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations は空配列。動物（コウモリ）間での狂犬病発生であり、ヒト感染例の報告はない。地域の公衆衛生当局が通常の対応（周辺地域の犬猫へのワクチン接種）を実施済み。

article.articleHeadline: TP.HCM ghi nhận 3 học sinh mắc não mô cầu nhóm B, một em tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City reports 3 students infected with meningococcal disease serogroup B, one dies.
article.articleSummary: Three students at Hai Ba Trung Secondary School, Hiệp Phước, Ho Chi Minh City, have Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B meningococcal disease; one died. The first case, a student born in 2014, developed meningococcemia with septic shock and multiorgan failure and died the same day (14 Oct). A second student from the same school was admitted to the Tropical Diseases Hospital with meningococcal meningitis B and is stable. The third student, who sat near the deceased, developed fever on 15 Oct and tested positive by PCR on 16 Oct in blood and CSF for serogroup B meningococcal infection; is alert and isolated. Health authorities including the HCMC Department of Health and HCDC are conducting epidemiological investigation, contact tracing, and offering chemoprophylaxis to close contacts. Emphasis on hygiene, ventilation, and health monitoring; prophylaxis not for all students. Parents should monitor symptoms and seek care if suspicious; class or school closure not mandatory.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市で学生3人が髄膜炎菌感染症B群に感染、1人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 同一学校内で髄膜炎菌感染症（血清群B）のクラスターが発生し、死亡例を含む重症例が複数確認されており、公衆衛生上の懸念と社会的関心が認められる。
triage.notes: 同一学校内での集団発生であり、保健当局が疫学調査・接触者追跡・化学予防を実施中。現時点で学校閉鎖は義務付けられておらず、感染拡大は限定的とみられるが、死亡例を含むため続報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Thành phố Hồ Chí Minh khẩn trương kiểm soát chùm ca bệnh não mô cầu tại xã Hiệp Phước
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City urgently contains a cluster of meningococcal disease cases in Hiệp Phước commune.
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal disease, Neisseria meningitidis serogroup B, is clustering in Hiệp Phước commune, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, centered on Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School. By 16 Oct 2026, three students are confirmed with MenB infections; one death occurred on 14 Oct after septic shock, and another student from the same school is hospitalized with meningitis; a third classmate tested positive by blood and CSF tests and remains stable and isolated. Local health authorities—the Hiệp Phước Commune Health Station and Ho Chi Minh City CDC—are conducting epidemiologic investigations, contact tracing, and providing antibiotic prophylaxis to close contacts; fever screening of all students and health education for teachers and parents are in progress. Guidance emphasizes that common respiratory symptoms do not diagnose meningococcal disease; vaccination exists but coverage varies; prophylaxis is not universally indicated. School suspension is not routine and depends on epidemiology. Officials will monitor and adjust control measures as needed.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市、ヒエップフォック地区での髄膜炎菌感染症クラスターを緊急に抑制
triage.triage_reason: 学校を中心とした髄膜炎菌感染症クラスターで1名死亡、2名入院というIHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）に2つ該当するため、フルリスク評価への移行が妥当。
triage.notes: 単一校（Hai Bà Trưng中学校）を中心とした髄膜炎菌B群によるクラスターで、死亡1例を含む3例確定。地元保健当局（CDC等）が接触者追跡・予防投薬・発熱スクリーニングを実施中。国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候は現時点でなし。

article.articleHeadline: Sequencing Read Counts Could Flag the Most Infectious Tuberculosis Patients
article.articleSummary: Pulmonary tuberculosis remains persistent; this retrospective study from The Affiliated Changsha Central Hospital of the University of South China, China, examined whether the count of Mycobacterium tuberculosis reads generated by targeted next-generation sequencing (tNGS) reflects bacteriological-positive status and thus patient infectiousness. Among 482 suspected TB cases admitted Jan 2023–May 2025, 369 met eligibility for analysis. Higher MTB read counts correlated with inflammatory and bacterial burden markers, including elevated C-reactive protein, low BMI, weight loss, and positive acid-fast bacilli (AFB) smear and rapid culture. Multivariate analysis showed MTB read counts independently predicted bacteriological-positive status. ROC AUC 0.825; optimal cutoff 10.163 reads with 68.2% sensitivity and 85.7% specificity. Agreement with AFB smear/rapid culture was moderate (kappa 0.559). tNGS reads outperformed immunological tests. Potential utility for infection control: rapid, quantitative signal of infectiousness to guide isolation and tracing; retrospective, single-center limitations noted.

triage.headline_ja: シーケンシングリード数で最も感染力の強い結核患者を特定できる可能性
triage.triage_reason: これは結核の診断技術（tNGS）に関する後ろ向き研究論文であり、公衆衛生上の緊急事態や異常なアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 単一施設での後ろ向き研究による診断手法の有効性評価であり、アウトブレイクや新規感染症事例の報告ではないため対象国の実発生イベントには該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Governo Ronaldo prepara implantação do método Wolbachia para reforçar combate à dengue, Zika e chikungunya em Feira de Santana
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ronaldo's government prepares the implementation of the Wolbachia method to bolster the fight against dengue, Zika, and chikungunya in Feira de Santana.
article.articleSummary: Feira de Santana, Bahia, Brazil is preparing to deploy Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti to combat dengue, Zika, and chikungunya. A 15 October 2026 videoconference training for 20 endemic-control agents outlined the technology, preparatory steps, and planned population surveys in areas slated for release. The initiative aims to complement existing vector-control measures (monitoring and eliminating standing water) rather than replace them. In Bahia, Wolbachia has already been implemented in Camaçari and Vitória. The program involves releasing Wolbachia-carrying mosquitoes to establish the bacterium in local populations, reducing viral transmission. The approach is led in Brazil by Fiocruz, in partnership with the Ministry of Health. Details on release timing, mosquito quantities, and affected neighborhoods were not specified, and community engagement is ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: ロナウド市政、フェイラ・デ・サンタナでデング熱・ジカ熱・チクングニア熱対策強化のためウォルバキア法の導入を準備
triage.triage_reason: 既存の媒介蚊対策を補完する予防的な公衆衛生プログラムの導入準備に関する記事であり、新規の異常な流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 記事はウォルバキア法によるベクター対策プログラムの準備段階を報じるものであり、感染拡大や症例急増等の具体的な疫学的異常を示す情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Buntut Kasus Muntaber Warga, Pemkot Tangsel Desak Perombakan Total WTP Serpong Lagoon
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Residents' Gastroenteritis Case Triggers South Tangerang City Government to Push for a Total Overhaul of the Serpong Lagoon Water Treatment Plant.
article.articleSummary: As of Oct 16, 2026, hundreds of residents in Perumahan Serpong Lagoon, Keranggan, Setu, South Tangerang City, Indonesia are affected by gastroenteritis (muntaber) linked to Escherichia coli contamination of the local water supply. Health authorities conducted epidemiological investigation and tested three water samples; laboratory results show elevated E. coli levels: 14 in the Water Treatment Plant reservoir, 660 in households using filtered water, and 956 in unfiltered systems. In response, the South Tangerang City Government ordered the Water Treatment Plant to halt operations, provide safe alternative water, and undertake a total overhaul of the treatment and distribution system, including disinfection and chlorine optimization, plus pipe-network checks. The Dinas Lingkungan Hidup and Dinas Kesehatan will monitor the quality of the replacement water to ensure safety, signaling a long-term fix rather than a partial remedy.

triage.headline_ja: 住民の胃腸炎(ムンタバー)事件を受け、南タンゲラン市政府がスルポンラグーン浄水場の全面改修を要求
triage.triage_reason: 地域の上水道汚染による集団胃腸炎で、住民・行政双方の関心が高く、曝露の継続性や拡大しやすさといったWPRO基準に該当するため。
triage.notes: 地元自治体が既に浄水場の操業停止と改修を指示しており、国際的な拡大や渡航制限のリスクは低いが、住民への継続的曝露と地域内感染拡大の可能性から経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Two more contract renal infections after C-section at Kota govt hospital
article.articleSummary: Two more post‑C‑section renal infections reported in Kota, India, at NMCH. Reshma (40) and Anita (30), residents of Kota district, developed kidney-related complications within hours after Cesarean deliveries in NMCH's gynaecology dept. Reshma's fourth C-section; Anita's second. Reshma transferred to a private hospital ICU; Anita to NMCH super-specialty block ICU. Anita is stable with healthy urine flow as of 10 am Oct 16, 2026; other recent patients remain stable. May 2026 outbreak at NMCH saw 12 women with acute kidney infection after C-section; 5 died, 7 recovered. Investigations launched, but final diagnostic reports remained elusive after five months, fueling negligence concerns. Families allege operational deficiencies, including delays obtaining single-donor platelets (redirected to JK Lone Hospital); calls for rigorous clinical audits and immediate publication of the pending investigation report.

triage.headline_ja: コタ市立病院で帝王切開後の腎感染症がさらに2例確認
triage.triage_reason: 2026年5月に12例・死亡5例を出した帝王切開後腎感染クラスターが未解決のまま継続し、新たに2例が発生。原因病原体不明で院内感染管理の欠陥が疑われ、IHR基準（重大な公衆衛生影響・異常性）を2つ満たすためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 原因病原体・感染経路（医療資材汚染、院内感染管理不備等）が特定されておらず、5ヶ月経過しても最終調査報告書が未公表。院内感染クラスターであり地域/国際的拡大の証拠はないが、反復発生と高い死亡率から継続監視とRRAでの原因究明が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Delhi govt to use 85 Truenat platforms for hepatitis B, C testing
article.articleSummary: Delhi plans to deploy 85 Truenat molecular diagnostic machines under the National Tuberculosis Elimination Programme to boost hepatitis B and C testing, with 2,500 testing chips allocated for each infection in 2026-27. Truenat platforms are portable PCR-based devices that detect infections by identifying genetic material. Initially, one Truenat platform per district will be earmarked for viral load testing among HBV/HCV-positive patients, pending concurrence from the State Programme Officer of NTEP. Viral load assays quantify circulating virus to monitor infection. Chips will be procured centrally by the Centre to enhance access and coordination between national health programmes. The plan includes operating machines beyond normal hours and holidays, with technicians trained and incentivised. A broader screening push also contemplates portable X-ray facilities, with a focus on women, especially pregnant women, for early identification of conditions needing further investigation. District-level rollout awaits concurrence and operational planning.

triage.headline_ja: デリー政府、B型・C型肝炎検査に85台のTruenatプラットフォームを活用へ
triage.triage_reason: これは既存の検査体制強化に関する行政施策の発表であり、異常な感染拡大やアウトブレイクを示す情報ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の慢性感染症（HBV/HCV）および結核プログラムにおける診断機器の導入計画に関するもので、新規アウトブレイクや異常事態の報告ではないため、対象国リストへの計上は見送った。

article.articleHeadline: Dia D de Multivacinação em Campina Grande foca na prevenção de sarampo e meningites
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Multivaccination Day in Campina Grande Focuses on the Prevention of Measles and Meningitis
article.articleSummary: On Saturday, October 17, 2026, Campina Grande, Brazil, will host the Day D Multivaccination focused on measles and meningitis prevention, aiming to raise vaccination coverage and update vaccination records per the Ministry of Health guidelines for all age groups. Immunization coordinator Samira Luna noted the campaign will operate with special hours at strategic sites to ease access. Basic Health Units (UBSs) and polyclinics will be open 8:00–12:00; the Integration Terminal 8:00–17:00; Parque da Criança 8:00–16:00; and Casa da Vacina 8:00–20:00. The initiative reinforces that vaccines are safe and lifesaving and urges families to protect loved ones by getting vaccinated across Campina Grande.

triage.headline_ja: カンピーナ・グランジでの予防接種強化デー、麻疹と髄膜炎予防に焦点
triage.triage_reason: 実際の麻疹アウトブレイクの報告ではなく、予防接種キャンペーンの案内記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 記事は麻疹の実際の発生事例ではなく、ワクチン接種キャンペーンの告知であるため、疾病発生シグナルとは見なさない。

article.articleHeadline: Doc Talk | 12% Of India's Cancer Cases Linked To Infections: HPV, Hepatitis B And More
article.articleSummary: India bears about 190,000 cancer cases attributable to infections, roughly 12% of the national total, per The Lancet Oncology analysis Global burden of cancer attributable to infections: a worldwide incidence analysis. Infections classified as IARC Group 1 carcinogens—five key agents drive most infection-attributable cancers: Helicobacter pylori, human papillomavirus (HPV), hepatitis B virus (HBV), Epstein-Barr virus (EBV), and hepatitis C virus (HCV). Globally, estimated infection-attributable cancers in 2024 include H. pylori ~760,000; HPV ~750,000; HBV ~360,000; EBV ~260,000; HCV ~160,000. In India, HPV accounts for the largest share of infection-attributable cancers, followed by H. pylori, EBV, HBV and HCV. Prevention examples include HPV vaccination and cervical screening; HBV vaccination; HCV testing with antiviral treatment (no vaccine exists); and H. pylori testing/treatment. Emphasizes population-level prevention, testing, and access to care, noting infections are one contributor, not the sole cause of cancer.

triage.headline_ja: 医師が語る｜インドのがん症例の12%は感染症に関連：HPV、B型肝炎など
triage.triage_reason: 慢性感染症とがんの関連性に関する疫学的・統計的分析記事であり、急性の公衆衛生上の緊急事態や新規アウトブレイクではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はLancet Oncology誌の分析に基づく、既知の慢性感染症（HPV、HBV、HCV等）とがんの関連性に関する一般的な健康啓発記事であり、新規または急性の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。EBSシグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Le Kenya renforce les contrôles aux frontières après un deuxième cas d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya strengthens border controls after a second Ebola case.
article.articleSummary: Kenya tightens border controls after a second Ebola case linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak; Busia residents face temperature checks and hand hygiene measures amid border vigilance with Uganda. The second case is a 39-year-old man, a close relative of the first patient, who tested positive while in quarantine. The initial patient, a 40-year-old Kenyan resident in DRC, had traveled via Uganda to Nairobi and died on October 5. About 128 contacts have been identified, with 108 in quarantine; no community transmission detected to date. In the DRC, the outbreak has 4,381 deaths from 9,066 confirmed cases across seven provinces, worsened by conflict, population movements, and contact-tracing challenges. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which no vaccine or approved treatment exists; the WHO cautions against border closures that could drive informal travel.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ出血熱の2例目確認後に国境管理を強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行（9,066症例、4,381死亡）が国境を越えケニアへ拡大しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへ進むべき事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主たる舞台はケニア（国境対策）だが、発生源・主要流行地はDRCであり対象国リストに該当するためDRCのみverified_locationsに含めた。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Cúm A gia tăng ở trẻ: Không chủ quan với những dấu hiệu cảnh báo biến chứng nặng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Influenza A on the rise in children: Do not ignore the warning signs of serious complications.
article.articleSummary: Influenza A is rising among children in Hanoi. As of 16 October 2026, Hanoi CDC reports an average of 200–300 influenza cases requiring treatment, many children. Seasonal transition and crowded schools drive transmission; children under 5, especially under 2 with underlying conditions, are at higher risk of severe disease. Complications include pneumonia, bacterial superinfection, respiratory failure, otitis media, dehydration; in rare cases myocarditis or neurologic injury. Typical symptoms are fever, cough, sore throat, fatigue, and myalgia, though presentations may be non-specific (irritability, poor feeding, vomiting, diarrhea). Warning signs needing urgent care: fast breathing, chest indrawing, cyanosis, lethargy, seizures, dehydration, poor intake. Rapid home tests can be falsely negative; diagnosis relies on clinical assessment. Other febrile illnesses (dengue, hand-foot-and-mouth, RSV) can mimic influenza. Prevention emphasizes annual vaccination from 6 months, hygiene, and avoiding transmission; vaccine effectiveness can reach about 90% in optimal conditions per Long Châu vaccination system; real-world protection varies.

triage.headline_ja: 子どものA型インフルエンザが増加：重症合併症の警告サインを軽視しないで
triage.triage_reason: 季節性インフルエンザの流行についての一般的な啓発記事であり、異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められず、通常の季節性疾患情報の範囲内である。
triage.notes: ハノイにおける季節性インフルエンザAの増加と小児の重症化リスクに関する一般的な医療啓発記事。流行の異常な拡大や国際的な懸念は記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: 6,6 milliarder til ebola-håndtering er ikke gjort rede for i Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 6.6 billion for Ebola response has not been accounted for in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Around 6.6 billion for Ebola response has not been accounted for in Congo, aid groups say. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, at least 9,144 people have been infected in the ongoing outbreak, with 4,410 deaths, per a WHO status update on October 13. Donors have contributed about $962 million to organizations handling Ebola response, not to the government authorities, Africa CDC Secretary-General Jean Kaseya says. Among recipients, only about one-third report on funds received and usage; one group reported receiving $228 million and spending $127 million, leaving roughly $101 million unaccounted. Distrust toward health workers and authorities complicates the response, with past outbreaks fueling suspicions of corruption. Health Minister Samuel-Roger Kamba calls for transparency on fund sources, allocation targets, and achievement; those not complying could be barred from Congo operations and blacklisted continent-wide.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ対応費66億（クローネ）の使途が説明されていない
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,144人感染・4,410人死亡という大規模なエボラ流行が継続中であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と資金管理・信頼の問題が国際的関心を集めているため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: 記事は資金の不透明性に焦点を当てているが、背景として大規模かつ継続中のエボラ流行（9,144例・4,410死亡）が存在するため、公衆衛生リスクとしての重大性が高い。国際的拡大リスクや渡航制限の有無については本文に明記がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: 北, 니파 입국 제한 풀고 에볼라 빗장...오락가락 방역 매뉴얼 - 정치 | 기사 - 더팩트
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Korea lifts Nipah virus entry restrictions and Ebola lockdowns... inconsistent disease-control guidelines
article.articleSummary: North Korea has lifted entry restrictions on travelers from Nipah virus–affected regions, including India and Bangladesh, reversing earlier 2026 measures that imposed quarantines—up to 30 days—for entrants from India. Nipah virus, a zoonotic disease with no vaccine or specific treatment, transmits from infected animals or contaminated food and can spread between people; WHO cites a case fatality rate of 40–70%. India and Bangladesh have reported Nipah cases since January 2026. Meanwhile, Pyongyang is reportedly restricting Western and Chinese attendees at a forthcoming trade fair, citing Ebola risk. Korea designated Nipah virus as a Class 1 legally notifiable disease in September last year. Analysts note broader gaps in North Korea’s public health infrastructure, including border-control procedures and disease-management manuals.

triage.headline_ja: 北朝鮮、ニパウイルス感染地域からの入国制限を解除しエボラには警戒…一貫性を欠く防疫マニュアル
triage.triage_reason: インドで継続中のニパウイルス流行（致死率40-70%）を背景に北朝鮮が検疫措置を変更しており、重症度・流行しやすさの基準に該当し、政治的関心も高いためフルRRAでの確認が望ましい。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は北朝鮮の検疫政策の一貫性欠如であり、インドおよびバングラデシュでのニパウイルス流行自体の具体的な症例数・死亡数は記載なし。バングラデシュは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。北朝鮮・韓国も対象国リスト外。

article.articleHeadline: Weekly Rounds: Ebola Screening Gaps, Dengue in Florida, and Why Shared Equipment Still Matters | Infection Control Today
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its first imported Bundibugyo virus disease case: a 40-year-old man traveling through the DRC, Uganda, and Kenya tested positive on October 5 and died that night; fever screening at airports proved limited, with 28 contacts (mostly healthcare workers) and 23 airline passengers plus four crew traced. Florida’s dengue outbreak reaches 296 locally acquired cases across eight counties, including 259 in Hillsborough; an 80-year-old Tampa woman died; 273 serotyped cases are DENV-2. No dengue vaccine is available in the US; about 1 in 20 symptomatic patients develop severe disease, and treatment should not wait for test results; avoid aspirin/NSAIDs. Shared equipment and missed surfaces elevate antimicrobial resistance risk: 65% of long-term care resident rooms harbor at least one MDR organism, 90% of 10 hospitals have at least one dispenser delivering low concentrations, and only 16% of mobile equipment is cleaned between patients; mantra: "You use it, you clean it."

triage.headline_ja: 週刊ラウンドアップ：エボラのスクリーニングの隙間、フロリダのデング熱、そして共有医療機器の重要性
triage.triage_reason: DRC・ウガンダ・ケニアを横断した渡航者がブンディブジョウイルス病で死亡し、ケニアで初の輸入症例として確認された。接触者・航空機乗客の追跡が行われており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻性からIHR基準を複数満たすためPICKUPと判断。
triage.notes: 記事は週刊ラウンドアップ形式で、エボラ関連（ブンディブジョウイルス病）、フロリダのデング熱、医療機器の抗菌薬耐性リスクの3トピックを扱う。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ（患者はDRC・ウガンダ・ケニアを経由、ケニアで検査陽性・死亡）。フロリダ（米国）は対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Опять оспа обезьян? Мужчины не то, чтобы сильно предрасположены, но в зоне риска их больше
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Monkeypox again? Men aren't exactly more predisposed, but there are more of them in the risk group.
article.articleSummary: Five people in Moscow Region were hospitalized as a precaution after potential contact with a monkeypox patient; their condition is stable and no clinical symptoms are observed, with tests ongoing. Monkeypox (MPXV) is a viral zoonosis related to smallpox; Central and West Africa are current epicenters. The illness causes lymphadenopathy, rash, chills and fever, generally milder than smallpox. Russia has previously reported cases dating back to 2022, including a February 2022 case at Domodedovo Hospital and later infections in Saint Petersburg linked to travel from Portugal and Europe, as well as two Saint Petersburg cases in 2024 linked to Hong Kong travel and two more in Moscow. Globally, public health emergencies fluctuated: active 2022–2023, re-declared in 2024, canceled in 2025; by 2026 outbreaks are local and controlled. Transmission is not highly contagious; close contact (often sexual) increases risk. Airport screening is impractical; diagnosis requires blood tests rather than airborne detection.

triage.headline_ja: またサル痘？男性がより罹りやすいわけではないが、リスク群には男性が多い
triage.triage_reason: モスクワ州での予防的入院事例であり、症状なし・安定した状態で、重篤性や国際的拡大の兆候がない。対象国（中国等）は渡航歴としてのみ言及され、現在の発生地域ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はロシア（モスクワ州・サンクトペテルブルク）における既存のMpox監視状況の概説記事であり、対象国（中国など）は過去の渡航歴としてのみ言及されている。現時点で対象国における新規発生は確認されない。

article.articleHeadline: Why Some Older Adults Say Yes to Tuberculosis Prevention While Others Walk
article.articleSummary: Eastern China’s Huzhou and Zhejiang CDCs conducted a cross-sectional study of 620 adults aged 60+ with latent TB infection (LTBI) to assess uptake of tuberculosis preventive treatment (TPT). Of these, 430 (69.35%) accepted TPT; 354 male; 192 over 70; most selected short-course chemoprophylaxis (three months rifapentine plus isoniazid). Mycobacterium vaccae immunotherapy was offered as an alternative for those unsuitable or reluctant to chemotherapy. Two recruitment channels were used: community health examinations and screening of close contacts of active TB cases. About 30% of eligible individuals did not initiate treatment. Multivariate analysis identified three independent factors: households with three or fewer persons were associated with an 88% higher odds of acceptance (adjusted OR 1.88, 95% CI 1.15–3.07); annual household income ≤ 150,000 CNY linked to a 124% higher odds. A third factor was reported but not detailed in the excerpt. Implications point to feasible prevention uptake but room for improvement.

triage.headline_ja: 高齢者の結核予防治療、受け入れる人と拒む人の違いとは
triage.triage_reason: 学術的な横断研究であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常性、拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 研究報告であり、特定の地域での感染拡大やアウトブレイクを示すものではないため対象国としては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO scales up Ebola readiness in 22 countries across three continents
article.articleSummary: As of 16 October 2026, WHO is scaling up Ebola readiness across 22 Eastern Mediterranean countries, with Djibouti, Somalia and Sudan as priority areas amid conflict and displacement. Deadly Bundibugyo virus outbreaks have occurred in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, and Kenya confirmed a case linked to the DRC. No Ebola cases have yet been detected in the region, but conflict and overstretched health systems threaten preparedness. From July to September, WHO missions to Djibouti, Somalia and Sudan assessed readiness, identifying gaps in surveillance, laboratory capacity, infection prevention and case management. WHO is providing training, supplies and simulation exercises, plus regional readiness checklists, contingency plans and technical guidance, and strengthening coordination with Africa and the Eastern Mediterranean. Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus described the region as "the epicentre of global humanitarian need," underscoring the urgency of readiness.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、3大陸22カ国でエボラ対策準備を強化
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでブンディブギョウイルス（エボラ属）による死亡例が発生し、ケニアでもDRC関連症例が確認されるなど、既に国境を越えた拡大が見られるため、IHR基準・WPRO基準の複数に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC・ウガンダでのブンディブギョウイルス（エボラ属）アウトブレイクとそれに伴うWHOによる近隣22カ国（主にジブチ・ソマリア・スーダン等、東地中海地域）への準備強化。対象国リストのうちDRCのみが実際の発生国として該当し、ウガンダ・ケニア・ソマリア・スーダン・ジブチは対象国リストに含まれないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Ituri : 11 guérisons et 29 décès liés à Ebola à Mambasa | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | Ituri: 11 recoveries and 29 Ebola-related deaths in Mambasa | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: Ituri's Mambasa health zone reports an Ebola virus disease outbreak with 43 cases recorded, 11 recovered, 29 deaths, and 3 patients still hospitalized as of 14 October 2026. Local health authorities disclosed the figures during an epidemiological briefing led by Yunga Abedi, chief medical officer of the Mambasa health zone. Thishimbi Maxime, deputy administrator of Mambasa Territory, commended health teams and partners for their response and urged the population to follow preventive measures, including regular handwashing, and to seek prompt care at a health facility if symptoms arise. The update highlights the current totals and the need for continued vigilance and adherence to hygiene to reduce mortality.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州:マンバサでエボラ関連の回復11人、死亡29人
triage.triage_reason: 致死率の高いエボラ出血熱のアウトブレイクがDRCイトゥリ州で継続しており、43症例中29人死亡と重症度・国際拡大リスクが高いためフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: 致死率が約67%（29/43）と非常に高く、現地当局・パートナーによる対応が継続中。国際的な注視と支援が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: 12 food samples from Vietnam banh mi shop linked to 175 food poisoning cases positive for Salmonella
article.articleSummary: Salmonella spp was detected in 12 of 13 samples from Ba Duoc banh mi shop in Cam Thanh, Quang Ngai Province, Vietnam, per tests by the Nha Trang Pasteur Institute. Salmonella appeared in vegetables, pork rolls, pork floss, sauce, chili paste, bread and mayo; one pork roll sample was negative, another positive. The samples carried E. coli; a pork roll sample contained Staphylococcus aureus. As of Oct 16, 175 people had suspected poisoning after eating Ba Duoc banh mi at Duy Tan Street; onset began Oct 10, with hospitalizations rising to 13, 55, 105, 135 and 167 by Oct 13. Symptoms include abdominal pain, diarrhea, fever, nausea and vomiting. Authorities suspended the shop, sealed remaining food, and inspected the prep area; the owner could not provide origin documents, and hygiene issues were noted at the home. Ba Duoc has operated in Quang Ngai for over 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: ベトナムのバインミー店の食品サンプル12件からサルモネラ菌検出、食中毒175例と関連
triage.triage_reason: 単一店舗由来の食中毒事例であり、当局により営業停止・調査済みで、国際的拡大リスクや継続的曝露のリスクは低いと判断される。
triage.notes: 単一の飲食店が原因の食中毒事例で、サルモネラ菌・大腸菌・黄色ブドウ球菌が検出された。店舗は営業停止済み、当局が調査中。死亡例の報告はなく、地域限定的な事案。

article.articleHeadline: Russia plague: China increases surveillance at border after unexplained laboratory death
article.articleSummary: Plague-related caution at China-Russia border after unexplained death of a laboratory worker at Irkutsk Antiplague Research Institute in Siberia and the Far East on 2 October. Chinese CDC at Manzhouli, a major land port, conducted a risk assessment and ordered stronger disease surveillance, urging closer coordination with customs and border authorities to monitor for imported infections. The move follows the worker's death and ongoing investigation into the cause of a fatal pneumonia; Russian health authorities report no evidence of plague or other high-threat pathogens so far, despite exhaustive contact tracing and testing. The incident has prompted heightened border screening and cross-border information sharing, though authorities have not confirmed an infectious agent linking the death to a plague outbreak. Surveillance remains precautionary while investigations continue.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト関連事案：研究所内での原因不明死亡を受け、中国が国境監視を強化
triage.triage_reason: ロシアの抗ペスト研究所職員の原因不明死亡という異常事象を受け、中国が国境監視を強化しており、国際的な注目（BMJ掲載）と当局の関心が高いため、フルリスク評価で事実関係を確認する必要がある。
triage.notes: 事案の発生地はロシア（イルクーツク）であり対象国リストに含まれない。中国（Manzhouli）は国境監視を強化しているのみで、感染症の実際の発生は確認されておらず、ロシア当局もペストや高危険度病原体の証拠はないとしている。続報でペストとの関連性や中国国内への波及が確認された場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Global Arbovirus Models Miss Africa, Creating a Critical Surveillance Blind
article.articleSummary: West Nile and Usutu arboviruses are spreading in Europe, prompting surveillance, diagnostics, and modeling. A Frontiers in Tropical Diseases perspective argues global arbovirus dynamics are biased by underrepresentation of Africa, which hosts high mosquito diversity and dense human-vector contact yet remains under-surveilled. Data are concentrated in Thailand, Brazil, Singapore, North America, and Europe; Africa's surveillance is fragmented and often outbreak-triggered rather than longitudinal. This data gap skews models that rely on environmental correlates, potentially underestimating transmission pathways and the scale of arbovirus circulation in Africa. Apparent European emergence may reflect enhanced detection rather than real ecological change. Transmission networks across continents involve migratory birds and human mobility, but lack of African data hampers quantification. Moreover, Anopheles mosquitoes—well-studied due to malaria—are rarely included in arbovirus surveillance or models, despite ecological overlap.

triage.headline_ja: 世界的なアルボウイルスモデルがアフリカを見落とし、重大なサーベイランスの死角を生んでいる
triage.triage_reason: 特定の国・地域での具体的な感染症発生報告ではなく、アルボウイルスのサーベイランス体制・モデリングの偏りに関する学術的論考記事であるため、シグナルとしての該当性は低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は特定の国での感染症アウトブレイク事例ではなく、アルボウイルス（ウエストナイル熱・ウスツウイルス等）のグローバルなサーベイランス・モデリングにおけるアフリカのデータ不足を指摘する学術的視点記事。タイ・ブラジル・シンガポール等はデータが集中している地域として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地としての記述ではないため、いずれもverified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Map Overlays Reveal Which Philippine Villages Face a Double Threat of
article.articleSummary: COVID-19 counts in Lemery, Batangas, Philippines, are combined with ten natural-hazard maps to produce a barangay-level priority ranking for disaster preparedness. The study uses sieve mapping in QGIS, converting diverse severity scales into a common ordinal score and applying area-sensitive weighting so each hazard category contributes proportionally to a barangay’s exposed area. COVID-19 counts are scaled to the highest barangay and given 50% weight, while the natural-hazard domain also weighs 50% (ground shaking 10%, storm surge 10%, flood 10%, earthquake-induced landslide 5%, rain-induced landslide 5%, and 2% for tsunami, liquefaction, base surge, fissure, volcanic tsunami). The top composite barangays were District IV, Wawa Ibaba, Palanas, Mataas Na Bayan, and Sambal Ilaya; Bukal with 125 cases ranked 10th after hazard integration. This ranking guides planning rather than implying infection probability, focusing on area exposure across the Taal volcanic region.

triage.headline_ja: 地図重ね合わせ分析により、フィリピンの村々が直面するCOVID-19と自然災害の二重リスクが明らかに
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19感染数は防災計画立案のための学術的な複合リスクマッピング研究に利用されているのみで、新規の公衆衛生上の脅威やアウトブレイクを報告するものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はCOVID-19の症例数データを自然災害リスクマップと統合した学術研究の紹介であり、感染症アウトブレイクの発生や拡大を報告するものではないため、対象国verified_locationsには含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Computational Hunt Yields Two New Anti-Tuberculosis Drug Leads Targeting
article.articleSummary: TB remains a major killer, with about 1.25 million deaths annually, driven by multidrug- and extensively drug-resistant Mycobacterium tuberculosis. Indian researchers report two new computational drug leads, compounds D and I, that target the bacterial DNA gyrase B (GyrB) ATPase domain, a critical, non-redundant enzyme in M. tuberculosis and absent in humans, reducing off-target risk. This contrasts with GyrA-targeting fluoroquinolones facing rising resistance. The team from Banaras Hindu University, North Eastern Hill University and Jawaharlal Nehru University built an integrated pipeline: pharmacophore-based screening of ~1 million compounds from PubChem, ZINC, ChEMBL, and MolPort; filtering via Lipinski rules, docking, ADMET/toxicity, 100-ns MD, and DFT; narrowing ~30,000 hits to 21 to 10 unique molecules, with D and I as strongest leads. In docking against M. tuberculosis GyrB, A, D, I scored -10.07, -10.22, -10.16 kcal/mol; against M. smegmatis GyrB, scores ranged -10.34 to -12.18; novobiocin scored -9.65 (TB) and -3.36 (smegmatis).

triage.headline_ja: 計算科学的探索により、細菌DNA複製装置を標的とする2つの新規抗結核薬候補が発見される
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核治療薬候補の計算科学的研究に関する基礎研究報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急イベントや流行状況の報告ではないため、トリアージ対象のシグナルに該当しない。
triage.notes: 研究は結核の疫学的発生ではなく、新薬リード化合物の計算科学的同定に関するものであり、特定の国での感染拡大や公衆衛生イベントを報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Keňa potvrdila třetí případ nákazy ebolou
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya confirmed its third case of Ebola infection.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-16, Kenya confirmed its third Ebola infection case, per the Kenyan Ministry of Health. The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 9,066 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,381 deaths, according to the Congolese Institute of Public Health. The current outbreak, by scope and fatalities, exceeds the 2018–2020 epidemic. These figures are drawn from Kenyan press and Congolese health authorities (Kenyans.co.ke, NTV) cited in the report. The article does not provide symptom details, transmission sources, or information on imported/exported cases. The situation remains an ongoing Ebola outbreak in the region, with authorities continuing surveillance and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱の第3例目を確認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で過去最大規模（9,066例・4,381死亡）のエボラ流行が継続し、既に国境を越えてケニアへ感染が拡大していることが確認されており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし国際的拡大の事実として記述には考慮済み。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya confirms third Ebola case, a close relative of other two cases
article.articleSummary: Kenya has confirmed its third Ebola case, a 65-year-old woman in Nairobi who has been in quarantine since Oct 6. After developing fever, sore throat and malaise, she tested positive and is receiving supportive care, improving her recovery chances. The three Kenyan cases are linked to the Congo Ebola epidemic, the second-largest on record with more than 9,000 cases and over 4,000 deaths. The first case was a Kenyan man who had been ill in Congo, traveled via Uganda to Nairobi on Oct 3, and died Oct 5. The third case is a close relative of the first two cases, illustrating transmission linked to the Congo outbreak. All cases are under medical care and isolation, with Congo as the outbreak source.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで3例目のエボラ感染確認、他2症例の近親者
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ由来のエボラ流行がケニアへ越境し、家族内感染（ヒト-ヒト感染）が確認されたため、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻性が高く、フルリスク評価が必要と判断される。
triage.notes: 主題はケニアでの輸入・二次感染例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるコンゴのアウトブレイク（9,000例以上、死者4,000人超）が記事内で明確に言及されているためDRCを含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Penuh Penyesalan! Penjual Es Buah Tak Kuasa Tahan Tangis, Minta Maaf 219 Orang Keracunan Dagangannya - TribunWow.com
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Full of remorse! Fruit-ice seller cannot hold back tears, apologizes to 219 people poisoned by his fruit-ice business.
article.articleSummary: On 16 October 2026, in Kajoran District, Magelang Regency, Central Java, Indonesia, 219 people reported symptoms after consuming fruit ice from a stall. Some 300 portions were ordered from Sidowangi village for events, with symptom onset about 8–10 hours after ingestion. The cause of the suspected food poisoning remains unknown; authorities have collected vomit and fruit-ice samples and sent them to Balai Laboratorium Kesehatan dan Kalibrasi Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta for laboratory testing. Magelang Health Office, alongside police, is interviewing witnesses including the stall owner; investigators have not yet determined criminal liability. The vendor publicly apologized in a viral video, expressing remorse and stating no intent to harm."

triage.headline_ja: 後悔の念でいっぱい！フルーツアイス売りが涙をこらえきれず、自身の商品で219人が食中毒になったことを謝罪
triage.triage_reason: 食中毒の疑いで219人に症状が発生しているが、感染症（ヒト-ヒト感染）ではなく食品由来の化学的・微生物的中毒の可能性が高く、原因究明中のため続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事例は集団食中毒（食品由来疾患）であり、感染症の国際的拡大リスクは低い。原因物質（化学物質か病原体か）は検査待ちのため不明。ビデオがバイラル化し地元での関心は高いが、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念には該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya confirms third Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Kenya has confirmed its third Ebola case, caused by Bundibugyo virus disease, in a 65-year-old woman who was a primary contact of the earlier infections. She had been in quarantine since October 6, developed fever, sore throat and malaise, prompting isolation and laboratory confirmation. The first Ebola patient in Kenya was a Kenyan national who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo for seven years; ill for about a month, he sought care at several hospitals, then traveled by road to Kampala, Uganda. From Entebbe Airport he boarded Jambojet flight 8523 to Nairobi, where Port Health Services cleared him on arrival; he died three days later. The second case was linked to the first. Airline officials are coordinating with health authorities to support the response; contact tracing, monitoring and enhanced surveillance at airports and land borders are ongoing. Supportive care remains central; early detection and isolation help limit transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで3例目のエボラ感染確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブジョウイルス病）がケニアで3例確認され、うち1名死亡、国境を越えた感染経路（DRC→ウガンダ→ケニア）が判明しており、IHR基準の複数項目に該当する深刻な公衆衛生事案である。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのエボラ感染拡大であり、対象国リストにケニアは含まれていない。DRCは最初の患者の居住歴として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地ではないため verified_locations から除外した。国際的な人の移動（航空機搭乗、陸路国境越え）を伴う感染連鎖があり、空港・国境での監視強化が報告されている点が特に懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Health ministry confirms third Ebola case in Kenya
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms a third Ebola case (Bundibugyo virus disease). A 65-year-old woman, a close relative and primary contact of the first two patients, tested positive and is in Infectious Disease Unit after quarantine since Oct 6. Lab confirmation was achieved at the National Virology Reference Laboratory and KEMRI. The second patient remains stable on supportive care. Of 130 identified contacts, 127 (97.7%) are in quarantine; three remain under monitoring. No evidence of community transmission; public risk is low, though additional cases may surface among quarantined contacts before monitoring ends. Surveillance is strengthened with PPE, IPC supplies, and screening gear distributed to 28 high-risk counties and points of entry. Travellers from 10 high-risk countries face enhanced airport screening and must present a digital surveillance form with a QR code. Ebola symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle/joint pain, vomiting, diarrhea, and unexplained bleeding; transmission is by direct contact with blood or body fluids.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省、ケニアで3例目のエボラ感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: エボラ（ブンディブギョウイルス病）の新規感染例確認であり、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）に該当するためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 発生地域データにはケニアとインド（Uttar Pradesh/Kemrī）が含まれるが、記事内容から実際の発生国はケニアであり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空とした。『Kemrī』はKEMRI（ケニア医学研究所）の誤分類と推測される。

article.articleHeadline: Un paciente de 26 años muere por rabia tras recibir un diagnóstico erróneo de lesión medular
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A 26-year-old patient dies from rabies after receiving a misdiagnosis of spinal cord injury.
article.articleSummary: Rabies in a 26-year-old previously healthy man at West China Hospital of Sichuan University, Sichuan, China, caused death from respiratory failure after a misdiagnosis of traumatic spinal cord injury. He had 10 days of progressive lower-limb paralysis after a fall and was treated for spinal trauma without spinal MRI. Reassessment uncovered a fox bite four months earlier and no post-exposure rabies prophylaxis. On arrival at a second hospital, he showed complete leg paralysis, sensory impairment, urinary and fecal dysfunction, cranial nerve signs, autonomic instability, and a hydrophobia-like sensation when swallowing water. Rabies can present as furious or paralytic; the latter often mimics Guillain‑Barré syndrome or acute spinal injury. The Frontiers in Medicine report emphasizes prompt evaluation of animal bites and post-exposure prophylaxis; once symptoms appear, rabies is nearly always fatal. China’s human rabies cases rose 36.9% in 2024 to 167.

triage.headline_ja: 26歳の患者、脊髄損傷の誤診を受けた後に狂犬病で死亡
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の医学的教訓的報告であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威や緊急性を示すものではない。狂犬病は既知の風土病でありヒト-ヒト感染もしない。
triage.notes: 単一症例報告（誤診による狂犬病死亡例）であり、中国における2024年の人獣共通感染症統計（前年比36.9%増、167例）への言及はあるが、本記事自体は症例報告・医学教育的内容が主眼。

article.articleHeadline: Potvrđen treći slučaj ebole u Keniji
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Third Ebola case confirmed in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: Third Ebola case confirmed in Kenya by the Kenyan Ministry of Health. A 65-year-old woman, a close relative of the first two patients, has been in quarantine since October 6. She developed fever, sore throat and generalized weakness; laboratory-confirmed Ebola infection. She is isolated and receiving supportive therapy, with early treatment improving recovery chances. Kenyan cases are linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak, which has over 9,000 cases and more than 4,000 deaths, the world’s second-largest. The first Kenyan case was confirmed last week: a Kenyan who fell ill in Congo about a month prior, traveled by road to Uganda, then arrived in Nairobi by plane on October 3 and died on October 5. Authorities are tracing contacts and monitoring for potential additional imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで3例目のエボラ感染確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当し、コンゴ民主共和国由来のエボラ流行がケニアへ越境拡大していることが確認されたためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの感染確認だが、ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。DRCは流行の発生源として具体的な症例数・死亡者数（9,000例超・4,000人超死亡）が言及されており、対象国として含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Κένυα: Επιβεβαιώθηκε τρίτο κρούσμα Έμπολα, γυναίκα 65 ετών
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya: Third Ebola case confirmed, a 65-year-old woman.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms a third Ebola case within days, a 65-year-old woman who is a relative of the two previous cases and has been in quarantine since Oct 6. After developing fever, sore throat, and weakness, she was isolated and samples tested positive for Ebola, enabling timely treatment. All Kenyan cases are linked to the outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, which has recorded more than 9,000 cases and over 4,000 deaths in recent months. The first Kenyan case involved a man who fell ill in DRC, traveled to Uganda, then Nairobi on Oct 3; a relative moved him to hospital the next day, and he died on Oct 5. Health authorities are conducting contact tracing and reinforcing infection control as cases connect to travel from DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア：エボラ第3症例を確認、65歳女性
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,000例超・死亡4,000人超の大規模エボラ流行が継続しており、ウガンダ経由でケニアへ国際的に拡大（3例確認）している。IHR基準を複数満たし、渡航制限や国際支援の必要性も高い重大事案。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入エボラ症例（対象国リスト外）だが、感染源であるDRCの大規模流行（9,000例超、死亡4,000人超）が継続中であり、対象国DRCを発生地域として記載。ウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू के खिलाफ AIIMS का बड़ा शोध, इलाज को लेकर जगी नई उम्मीद; दवा बनाने का खुला रास्ता
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AIIMS' major study against dengue; new hope for treatment; a clear path to drug development.
article.articleSummary: AIIMS, New Delhi, India reports a potential dengue drug-development pathway. As of 14 October 2026, researchers led by Dr. Bhupendra Verma in AIIMS’s Biotechnology Department found that cellular small particles, specifically tRNA-derived fragments (tRFs) produced during dengue infection, can either promote or restrain viral replication. In vitro experiments blocking certain tRFs reduced dengue growth, and the study identified a cellular signaling pathway that modulates replication, offering new drug targets. Currently, no dengue-specific drug is widely approved; treatment remains supportive. The work, begun in 2023 and extending to 2026, was published in NAR Molecular Medicine. Key contributors include Diksha Madhri and Riya Rai, with Ariba Aziz, Preeti Sokhal, and Sushant Fadnis also involved. Human efficacy and safety studies and clinical trials will be required before any drug reaches patients.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱に対するAIIMSの大規模研究、治療への新たな希望；新薬開発への道が開かれる
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱治療薬開発に関する基礎研究の報告であり、感染拡大や公衆衛生上の異常事態を示すものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の発生報告ではなく、AIIMSによる創薬基礎研究（tRNA断片に関する研究）に関するもの。実際の感染拡大事例ではないためverified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Vaccination underway as anthrax kills wild elephant near Coimbatore
article.articleSummary: Wild elephant mortality due to anthrax reported near Coimbatore. A female wild elephant was found dead in Gopanari reserve forest within the Periyanaickenpalayam forest range on October 13; blood smear examination confirmed anthrax. The carcass was burnt per Animal Husbandry Department instructions. In response, the Forest and Animal Husbandry Departments have intensified surveillance in the Periyanaickenpalayam range and surrounding areas. Vaccination of livestock—cattle, goats and sheep—has begun in tribal settlements and villages bordering forests to curb spread. Frontline forest staff have been instructed to report any suspicious animal deaths promptly. Villagers living near forest peripheries have been alerted to notify authorities about suspicious domestic animal deaths. The measures aim to prevent further spread of anthrax in the area.

triage.headline_ja: 炭疽により野生ゾウが死亡、コインバトール近郊でワクチン接種進行中
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物（象）の炭疽死亡例であり、家畜へのワクチン接種等の対応が取られているが、ヒトへの感染や重症例の報告はなく、現時点では限定的な動物衛生事案として経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 動物（野生象・家畜）における炭疽発生事例。ヒト症例の報告は記事中に見られないが、人獣共通感染症であり、周辺住民への警戒・家畜ワクチン接種が行われている点から継続的な情報収集が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola ta fantsama zuwa iyakar Congo da jamhuriyyar Afrika ta tsakiya
article.articleSummary: Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, has breached into northern Ubangi Province in the Democratic Republic of Congo, near the Central African Republic border, as of Oct 16, 2026, marking it as the 8th Ebola-affected province in DRC. Two people are reported to be carrying the virus, though Congolese authorities have not yet confirmed these cases. The outbreak, which began in mid-May, has now afflicted more than 9,000 people with over 4,000 deaths in DRC. Ituri remains the main hub, with rising infections in North Kivu, South Kivu, Tshopo, Haut-Uele, Bas-Uele, and southern Ubangi. In Ubangi’s north, a health source cites multiple Ebola-related deaths near Wapinda close to Bas-Uele, with samples sent to Kinshasa for testing. The outbreak has already crossed into Uganda from Congo; WHO declared Uganda’s outbreak over in August, and Kenya has reported its first Ebola death, raising fears of further cross-border spread into Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴとアフリカ中央共和国の国境地帯に拡大
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9000人超の感染・4000人超の死亡という大規模流行が継続し、新たな州（北ウバンギ）への拡大、ウガンダ・ケニアへの越境拡大も確認されているためIHR基準・WPRO基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 中央アフリカ共和国、ウガンダ、ケニアへの越境拡大が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。DRC国内の大規模流行（8州目への拡大、9000人超感染・4000人超死亡）が主題。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se proširila na još jednu državu, potvrđena tri nova slučaja
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola has spread to another country; three new cases confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Ebola has spread to Kenya, with three confirmed cases in a close relative of the first two infections. The latest patient is a 65-year-old woman quarantined since October 6; after fever, sore throat and malaise, she tested positive and is receiving supportive therapy, with early diagnosis cited as improving recovery chances. Kenyan cases are linked to the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the second-largest outbreak on record, which has more than 9,000 cases and over 4,000 deaths. The first Kenyan case was a man sickened in Congo about a month earlier, who traveled by road to Uganda and then by plane to Nairobi on October 3, dying October 5 after hospital admission. article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records a second Ebola case in a relative of the first victim, and the outbreak widens in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola cases have been recorded in Kenya as the outbreak widens in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Kenya’s Ministry of Health confirmed a second infection, a 39-year-old man who is a relative of the first patient; both cases were detected in quarantine with no evidence of widespread transmission in Kenya. The first patient, infected in the DRC about a month earlier, traveled via Uganda to Nairobi, was hospitalized and died on October 5. Authorities are tracing 113 of 128 direct contacts. The outbreak is due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus; no vaccines or licensed treatments exist for it. Ervebo (for Zaire ebolavirus) has not proven protection against Bundibugyo. article.articleSummary: Carlos Alberto de Nóbrega, 90, is hospitalized at Hospital Sírio-Libanês in São Paulo to investigate a possible Coxsackie virus infection. His wife, Renata de Nóbrega, a physician, prompted tests after months of fatigue and malaise, with both spouses showing indications of Coxsackie infection. Renata’s acute-phase blood tests were positive; Carlos Alberto awaits confirmation of serologies and results from imaging and cardiology assessments. He is under care of cardiologist Roberto Kalil and infectious-disease expert David Uip; no discharge date has been announced. Coxsackie, an enterovirus, can be transmitted via respiratory secretions, contaminated surfaces, or the fecal–oral route. In adults it can cause fever, muscle pains, malaise, and fatigue, with possible complications such as myocarditis or pericarditis. Renata stressed monitoring persistent symptoms and seeking medical care to raise awareness rather than to alarm.

article.articleSummary: Yellow fever vaccination campaign underway in Ghana's Upper West Region targets about 244,869 people in Wa West, Sissala East and Sissala West districts to contain an outbreak and protect communities. The five-day campaign began on Wednesday and is expected to end on Sunday, October 18, 2026. Eligible residents aged between nine months and 60 years are invited. article.articleHeadline: Malaria Parasite Protein Caught Hitching a Ride Into the Nucleus
article.articleSummary: 16 Oct 2026 — Central University of South Bihar researchers report the first direct biochemical evidence that Plasmodium falciparum SRP14 binds to importin α, the parasite’s classical nuclear import receptor. In a reductionist assay, SRP14 and importin α were produced in E. coli; importin α was GST-tagged and immobilized on resin, and SRP14 binding was concentration-dependent and saturable, proving a direct SRP–importin α interaction. This elevates SRP14 to a bona fide importin α cargo candidate, implying the classical import pathway delivers SRP components to the nucleolus for SRP assembly in the parasite. The finding builds on prior work showing ivermectin and importin α inhibitors disrupt SRP trafficking and kill parasites, consistent with SRP-dependent export/membrane protein remodeling of host red blood cells. The work highlights nucleocytoplasmic transport as a potential vulnerability in malaria.

article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surpassed 9,200 cumulative cases and 4,441 deaths (case fatality 48.2%) as of May 13, with about 2,000 new cases in the past month. The outbreak, declared May 15, is spreading across up to eight provinces; North Ubangi has reported two new infections, indicating broader transmission if confirmed. Kenya reports a third EVD case: a 65-year-old woman with fever and sore throat, isolated since the 6th, lab-confirmed after returning from the DRC earlier this month; she follows the first Kenyan case who died on May 5 and the second case. Funding transparency issues hinder the response: Africa CDC says over $700 million of aid to response partners lacks verifiable spend records; about $960.2 million was paid directly to NGOs/IGOs, not via the DRC government. Only 30% of implementing agencies disclosed finances; of those, roughly $220 million was reported, with $120 million spent and $100 million remaining; authorities will reconcile and may take regulatory action against noncompliant groups.
