article.articleSummary: WHO scales up Ebola readiness in 22 countries across Africa, Asia and Europe, with intensified support to Djibouti, Somalia and Sudan as priority amid conflict-driven displacement and overstretched health systems. Kenya reports a second positive case of Bundibugyo Ebola virus linked to the DRC; Uganda and the DRC have faced prior outbreaks. No Ebola cases have been reported in the Eastern Mediterranean region yet, but ongoing crises heighten preparedness needs. Meanwhile, cholera in the Democratic Republic of Congo has produced more than 125,000 suspected cases and 3,644 suspected deaths between January 2025 and September 2026. From July to September, WHO missions to Djibouti, Somalia and Sudan assessed readiness and gaps in surveillance, labs, infection prevention and control, case management and emergency coordination, providing training, supplies and guidance. The agency emphasizes regional readiness tools amid humanitarian needs affecting over 117 million people in Occupied Palestinian Territory, Sudan, Syria, Yemen and beyond.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、3大陸22カ国でエボラ出血熱への備えを強化
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるコレラの大規模流行（疑い症例12万件超、死亡3,644人）とエボラ出血熱の国境を越えた拡大（ケニアでの陽性確認）が報告されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はWHOによる22カ国でのエボラ準備態勢強化、ケニアでのBundibugyoエボラウイルス陽性例、及びDRCでのコレラ大規模流行（2025年1月～2026年9月で疑い症例125,000件以上、死亡3,644人）を主な内容とする。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ケニア、ウガンダ、ソマリア、スーダン、ジブチ、シリア、イエメン、パレスチナは対象国リスト外のためverified_locationsから除外。

article.articleHeadline: Plant Fungus Gloniopsis leucaenae Infects Human Hand in First Reported Case
article.articleSummary: Gloniopsis leucaenae, a mold previously documented on Thai plant material, caused a localized subcutaneous infection on the dorsal hand of a 68-year-old Florida landscaper—a first human case. The patient, with Crohn's disease treated on vedolizumab, had no international travel. Trauma-associated inoculation introduced the pigmented fungus, forming a subcutaneous phaeohyphomycosis. Initial excision removed the lesion without antifungal therapy; a second lesion appeared at the same site and was excised; histology showed fungal hyphae, but culture and broad tests were negative. Broad-range PCR finally identified Gloniopsis leucaenae. Empiric itraconazole was started to cover pigmented molds. This contrasts with a prior report of a disseminated Gloniopsis infection in an immunocompromised host, suggesting species- and host-dependent disease spectra. The case underscores global trade and climate change as possible routes for a plant-associated fungus to reach North America, and highlights diagnostic challenges of rare fungal infections, such as reliance on molecular methods for confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: 植物真菌Gloniopsis leucaenaeがヒトの手に感染、初の報告例
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の稀な真菌感染で、患者はフロリダ在住・海外渡航歴なし、ヒト-ヒト感染性もなく公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 発生地域にThailandが含まれているが、これは当該真菌が過去にタイの植物material上で確認されていたという背景情報であり、本症例はフロリダ（米国）で発生・海外渡航歴なしのため対象国には該当しない。米国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列。

article.articleHeadline: Le Kenya annonce un troisième cas d'Ebola sur son sol
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya Announces a Third Case of Ebola on Its Soil
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms a third Ebola case on its soil: a 65-year-old woman in quarantine since Oct 6 after fever, sore throat and malaise, who is a relative of the first patient who came from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The second case, also a relative of the first, was in quarantine when testing positive. The initial case and first death were announced Oct 6: a Kenyan resident who fell ill in the DRC, crossed into Uganda by road, and flew from Kampala to Nairobi on Oct 3; he died in Nairobi, marking Kenya’s first Ebola infection and death. Kenya has traced 130 contacts of the first case; 127 (97.7%) are in quarantine, above the 85% global threshold to break transmission. The DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak has surpassed 9,000 cases and 4,381 deaths; Uganda reported 20 cases and two deaths, but the WHO ended that outbreak in August. Ebola transmits via bodily fluids; no vaccine or approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo strain.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、国内で3例目のエボラ感染例を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の第17次エボラ流行がウガンダを経由してケニアに越境し、国境を越えた人-人感染と死亡例が確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する重大な国際的拡大事例。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでのエボラ感染確認だが、ケニア・ウガンダは評価対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であり現在進行中の大規模流行地であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載。DRCの流行は9,000例超・4,381人死亡と既に甚大な規模であり、越境感染により国際的関心が急速に高まっている。

article.articleHeadline: Трети случай на ебола в Кения
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Third case of Ebola in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 October 2026, Kenya has confirmed its third Ebola case, a 65-year-old woman quarantined on 6 October after developing fever, sore throat and malaise. She tested positive for Ebola and is receiving supportive care. The Kenyan cases are linked to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, described by Reuters as the second-largest ever, with more than 9,000 cases and about 4,000 deaths. The first Kenyan case was reported last week: a man who had been ill in DRC about a month before traveling by land to Uganda, then arriving by plane in Nairobi on 3 October; he died on 5 October. The developments illustrate transmission linked to the DRC outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで3例目のエボラ出血熱症例
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（9000例超、死亡約4000人）に関連し、国境を越えてウガンダ経由でケニアへ感染が拡大しており、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入エボラ症例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRCでの大規模アウトブレイクが記事の中心的要素であるためDRCのみ列挙。ウガンダも経由国として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: Ba học sinh mắc bệnh não mô cầu, một em tử vong: TP.HCM họp khẩn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Three students contract meningococcal disease, one dies: Ho Chi Minh City holds emergency meeting.
article.articleSummary: Three students in Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, have contracted meningococcal disease due to Neisseria meningitidis group B. The fatal case is 12-year-old H.H.K., who died on 14 October after fulminant meningococcemia. A classmate, N.A.B.M., was diagnosed with meningococcal meningitis (group B). By 15 October, a third student, N.T.H.Q., seated at the same desk as K., developed illness and tested PCR-positive for group B meningococcus in CSF and blood. The two surviving patients, M. and Q., remain isolated in stable condition at Ho Chi Minh City Hospital for Tropical Diseases. In response, the City Department of Health convened an emergency meeting with the HCDC and the Department of Education, launching epidemiological investigations, class-wide cleaning and disinfection, and antibiotic prophylaxis for close contacts. Health authorities continue daily surveillance and advise calm, with no additional suspected cases among contacts identified as of 16 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 生徒3人が髄膜炎菌性疾患に感染、1人死亡：ホーチミン市が緊急会議を開催
triage.triage_reason: 学校内で髄膜炎菌感染症のクラスター（3名感染、1名死亡）が発生し、市当局が緊急対応を行っており、IHR基準に2つ該当するためフルリスク評価が妥当。
triage.notes: 同じ教室・隣席の生徒間でクラスターが発生しており、濃厚接触者への抗菌薬予防投与と疫学調査が実施されている。現時点で追加の疑い例は確認されていないが、学校内での感染拡大リスクに注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: TP.HCM khẩn trương triển khai các biện pháp kiểm soát chùm ca bệnh não mô cầu tại xã Hiệp Phước
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ho Chi Minh City urgently rolls out measures to control a cluster of meningococcal disease cases in Hiệp Phước Commune.
article.articleSummary: Three meningococcal disease cases (Neisseria meningitidis, group B) linked to Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School in Hiệp Phước Commune, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam. On 14 Oct 2026, a student born in 2014 died from fulminant meningococcemia with septic shock; a second student was hospitalized with meningitis and is currently stable; on 16 Oct, a third pupil from the same class presented with fever and PCR-confirmed meningococcal disease. Health authorities immediately deployed epidemiologic investigations, contact tracing, and antibiotic prophylaxis for close contacts as indicated, with continued health surveillance and infection control measures at the school. Not all students require prophylaxis; antibiotic use is targeted. Meningococcal group B vaccine exists, but protection varies by vaccine type and age. The Department of Health and HCDC emphasize early detection, case management, hygiene, ventilation, and potential school adjustments based on ongoing risk assessments, urging calm and adherence to official guidance.

triage.headline_ja: ホーチミン市、ヒエップフォック社での髄膜炎菌感染症クラスターの制御措置を緊急展開
triage.triage_reason: 学校を中心とした髄膜炎菌感染症クラスターで死亡例が発生しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性）を2つ満たすためフルリスク評価に進むべき。
triage.notes: 単一校内での家族的・同級生間クラスターで、1名死亡・2名確認例。国際的拡大の証拠はなく現時点では国内対応中だが、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクのある髄膜炎菌感染症であり続報の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Jurunas terá ação de vacinação contra raiva, após caso confirmado em morcego
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jurunas will have a rabies vaccination campaign after a confirmed case in a bat.
article.articleSummary: Rabies vaccination campaign planned for Jurunas, Belém, Brazil, after a bat tested positive for rabies. The vaccination action is set for Saturday, Oct 17, starting at 8:00, at two sites: ESF Portal da Amazônia (Family Health Strategy) and Jurunas Health Post. The campaign follows confirmation of rabies in a bat found on Rua dos Tamoios near Avenida Bernardo Sayão; the specimen was collected by the Zoonoses Surveillance Unit on Sept 25 and lab-confirmed in early October. Public health authorities are intensifying surveillance, including nocturnal controlled bat capture at strategic Belém sites to detect circulation. Captured bats are sent for laboratory analysis to map virus circulation. Guidance for residents includes avoiding contact with bats, reporting sightings to zoonoses, and seeking medical care if exposure occurs, with vaccination and rabies immunoglobulin as indicated.

triage.headline_ja: ジュルナス地区でコウモリの狂犬病感染確認後、ワクチン接種キャンペーンを実施
triage.triage_reason: 単発のコウモリの狂犬病陽性事例に対する予防的ワクチン接種キャンペーンであり、ヒト感染例の報告はなく、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 地域の動物衛生当局が標準的な監視・予防対応（ワクチン接種、コウモリ捕獲調査）を実施している事例。ヒトへの感染報告はなく、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内。

article.articleHeadline: WHO supports Kenya's Ebola response as third case is found early in quarantine
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola in Kenya: By 16 October 2026, Kenya has confirmed three cases and one death. The first case, a Kenyan man who had travelled home from the Democratic Republic of the Congo, died on 5 October—the first Ebola case recorded in Kenya. About 130 contacts were identified; by 16 October, 127 were in 21-day quarantine with daily temperature and symptom checks. The second and third cases, a 39-year-old man and a 65-year-old woman who are close family members of the index patient, were already in quarantine when they fell ill and are linked to the imported case. No evidence of community transmission. Both patients receive supportive care; the second is stable. Transmission is via direct contact with infected blood or body fluids; no licensed vaccine currently, trials in DRC. WHO supports Kenya's MOH, providing coordination, lab testing, IPC, and US$70,000 in supplies; Kenya remains open to travel and trade.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがケニアのエボラ対応を支援、検疫中に第3例を早期発見
triage.triage_reason: ケニア初のエボラ症例発生で死亡例を伴い、IHR基準の複数該当（深刻性・異常性）とWHOの直接支援が確認されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 指標症例はDRCからの帰国者であり、DRCでの流行状況（ワクチン治験実施中）との関連が示唆されるが、DRC国内での新規症例発生は記事中で明示されていない。主たる発生国はケニアだが対象国リストに含まれないため、関連国としてDRCのみ記載。コミュニティ内伝播は現時点で確認されていない点は留意。

article.articleHeadline: Стравична зараза однела преко 4.000 живота! Епидемија еболе шири се и ван граница Конга! Болест стигла у Кенију: За само недељу дана потврђен и трећи случај
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Terrifying outbreak has claimed over 4,000 lives! The Ebola epidemic is spreading beyond the borders of Congo! The disease has reached Kenya: In just a week, a third case has been confirmed.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 October 2026, Kenya has confirmed its third Ebola case, a 65-year-old woman in isolation since Oct 6 after developing fever, sore throat and malaise; she tested positive and is receiving supportive care. The Kenyan cases are linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak that has surpassed 9,000 infections and 4,000 deaths, one of the largest on record. The first Kenyan case emerged last week; a man ill in Congo about a month earlier traveled to Uganda and then Nairobi, dying on Oct 5. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugy o ebolavirus; there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments for Bundibugyo. The Ervebo vaccine, licensed for other Ebola strains and used by frontline workers in Congo, has unknown effectiveness against Bundibugyo. The ECDC says Europe’s importation risk remains very low, while UN agencies note the outbreak remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with response hampered by remote areas.

triage.headline_ja: 恐ろしい感染症が4,000人以上の命を奪った！エボラ流行がコンゴ国境を越えて拡大！病気がケニアに到達：わずか1週間で3例目が確認される
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行が9,000人以上の感染・4,000人以上の死亡に達し、既に国境を越えてケニアに拡大（3例確認）、PHEIC相当とされており、IHR基準の複数に該当する重大事案。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダへの拡大が報告されているが、両国は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。震源地であるDRCのみを計上。Bundibugyo株に対する承認済みワクチン・治療薬が存在しない点も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya confirms third Ebola case, a relative of the first patient who died
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms a third Ebola case: a 65-year-old woman who is a relative of the 40-year-old man who died after arriving from Congo. She tested positive while in quarantine after identification as a known contact; the second patient, a 39-year-old man from the same family, remains in stable condition. No evidence of community transmission; all cases are linked to the first patient. The index case had lived in Congo and traveled through three Ebola-affected provinces; Congo's outbreak has caused at least 4,000 deaths since May. Three contacts linked to Kenya's first case are still yet to be traced, with tracing efforts hampered by cross-border movement with Uganda and Congo. Kenya has intensified border screening, including a designated Nairobi airport gate for flights from 10 at-risk countries and enhanced Busia border checks with handwashing and temperature screening. MSF emphasizes early reporting of exposures.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、3例目のエボラ感染を確認 ― 死亡した最初の患者の親族
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続くエボラ流行（死者4,000人以上）がケニアへ越境し、関連者間で感染が広がっている。国際的拡大・渡航制限対応・接触者追跡の遅れがあり、IHR基準を複数満たすためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの感染確認だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であり継続的流行地であるDRCのみを対象国として記載。接触者3名が未追跡で、ウガンダ・コンゴとの越境移動が追跡を阻害している点に注意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Lutte contre le paludisme : Le ministère de la Santé suit la campagne de CPS+ à Laye
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tackling malaria: The Ministry of Health monitors the CPS+ campaign in Laye.
article.articleSummary: Seasonal Malaria Chemoprevention (CPS+) in Burkina Faso enters its fourth and final phase (P4), with a Ministry of Health delegation led by Secretary-General Dr Joël Arthur Kiendrébéogo visiting Laye in the Boussé health district on Oct 16, 2026. The campaign targets about 5.5 million children nationwide: 3–59 months, and, in the Nazinon region, 5–9 years, combining chemoprevention with malnutrition screening, larval habitat destruction, and immediate care for febrile children. In Laye's CSPS, malaria incidence has fallen compared with last year. By Oct 15, frontline teams report 28.80% first-dose coverage, reflecting strong community engagement. Kiendrébéogo personally administered a treatment dose to a child, signaling political commitment and optimism that the final phase will meet its objectives.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア対策:保健省がレイでのCPS+キャンペーンを視察
triage.triage_reason: ブルキナファソにおける季節性マラリア化学予防(CPS+)キャンペーンの定例的な実施報告であり、異常事態や公衆衛生上の深刻な影響は認められない。対象国（ガーナ等）はこの記事の主題ではない。
triage.notes: 記事はブルキナファソ（対象国リスト外）での既存の予防キャンペーンに関する内容。発生地域にGhana、Franceが含まれるが記事主題とは無関係。マラリア発生数はむしろ前年比で減少傾向と報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Carlos Alberto de Nóbrega é internado após meses de fadiga para investigar infecção viral
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Carlos Alberto de Nóbrega is hospitalized after months of fatigue to investigate a viral infection.
article.articleSummary: 90-year-old Brazilian television host Carlos Alberto de Nóbrega is hospitalized at Hospital Sírio-Libanês in São Paulo to investigate a possible Coxsackie virus infection. He has endured months of fatigue, malaise, and general indisposition, with imaging, cardiology evaluations, and serologies pending. Renata Nóbrega, his wife and physician, reported suggestive infection in both spouses. The couple is being monitored by a cardiologist and an infectious disease specialist. Coxsackie, an enterovirus, can cause malaise, myalgias, fever, and fatigue, and clinicians stress careful follow-up for potential complications. The report highlights that persistent symptoms warrant medical attention, while a definitive diagnosis remains unconfirmed. No broader outbreak or additional cases are mentioned; the focus is on this individual’s diagnostic workup and care in São Paulo.

triage.headline_ja: カルロス・アルベルト・デ・ノブレガ氏、数か月に及ぶ倦怠感の原因となるウイルス感染を調査するため入院
triage.triage_reason: 著名人個人の症例報告であり、公衆衛生上の広がりやアウトブレイクを示す情報はない。社会的関心は芸能人個人に関するものでIHR・WPRO基準には該当しない。
triage.notes: 著名人の個人的な健康問題に関する記事であり、集団感染やアウトブレイクの兆候はない。対象国リストに該当する公衆衛生イベントではないためverified_locationsは空とする。

article.articleHeadline: Кения потвърди трети случай на ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya confirmed a third case of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Kenya has confirmed a third Ebola case, a 65-year-old woman who is a close relative of the two previously diagnosed patients. She was quarantined on 6 October after developing high fever, sore throat and malaise, and her test for Ebola virus was positive. The patient is in an early stage and receiving supportive care. Kenyan cases are linked to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, described by Reuters as the second-largest globally, with more than 9,000 infections and about 4,000 deaths. The first Kenyan case was reported last week: a man who had been ill in Congo for about a month, traveled overland to Uganda, and arrived in Nairobi by plane on 3 October; a relative then took him to hospital. He died two days later.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラの第3例目を確認
triage.triage_reason: ケニアでDRC由来のエボラ国際伝播例が3例確認され、死亡例も発生しており、IHR基準の複数該当とWPRO基準の該当、社会的関心の高さからフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: ケニアおよびウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。元の流行地であるDRCのみを対象国として記載。国境を越えた人の移動によるエボラ感染拡大事例であり、DRCの大規模流行（9000人超感染、4000人死亡）との関連が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Keňa potvrdila tretí prípad eboly. Nakazená je príbuzná dvoch predchádzajúcich pacientov
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya has confirmed a third case of Ebola. The infected person is a female relative of two previous patients.
article.articleSummary: Kenya has confirmed a third case of Ebola, involving a 65-year-old woman who is a close relative of two earlier patients and has been in quarantine since October 6. Once she developed fever, sore throat, and malaise, she was isolated and tested; laboratory confirmation followed. She is receiving supportive care, which the health ministry says improves her chances of recovery. Kenya’s cases are linked to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the second-largest on record with more than 9,000 cases and over 4,000 deaths. The first Kenyan case appeared last week: a Kenyan citizen who had become ill in Congo about a month earlier, traveled to Uganda, arrived in Nairobi on October 3, and died on October 5. Ebola is highly contagious, with mortality up to 90% for the current variant. The disease was first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱の第3例を確認。感染者は過去2人の患者の親族の女性
triage.triage_reason: DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行（9000例超、死者4000人超）がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境し、二次感染（親族間）も発生しており、国際的拡大と公衆衛生上の深刻な影響が認められるためフルRRAへ進めるべき。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入・二次感染事例だが、ケニアおよびウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。流行の発生源であるDRCのみをverified_locationsに記載した。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : les communautés appelées à prendre les commandes de la riposte (Chef de mission MSF)​ - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Communities urged to take the lead in the response (MSF mission chief) - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, North-East Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), centered in Bunia. MSF mission chief Pierre Boulet-Desbareau emphasizes that local communities must lead the response to overcome mistrust and strengthen health interventions. MSF prioritizes supporting community representatives and civil society groups to occupy a central role, aiming to reduce hostility toward health teams and violence against responders. To build trust, MSF will demystify the disease by inviting community leaders to Ebola treatment centers and to meet recovered patients. Active community participation is seen as a key lever to improve acceptance of interventions and interrupt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ流行：コミュニティが対応の主導権を握るよう呼びかけ（MSFミッション責任者）
triage.triage_reason: DRC・イトゥリ州でのエボラ出血熱の流行が継続中であり、コミュニティの不信や暴力リスクが示唆されている。エボラは重篤性・異常性・国際拡大リスクが高い疾患であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準に複数該当するためフルRRAへ進めるべき。

article.articleHeadline: Contaminated Seawater Drives Resistant Bacteria Through the Oyster Supply
article.articleSummary: Brazil’s Florianópolis coastal waters harbor antimicrobial-resistant bacteria along the oyster supply chain. In a study of 167 resistant Enterobacterales isolates, Escherichia coli and Klebsiella pneumoniae predominated, signaling fecal contamination. Whole genome sequencing revealed identical sequence types and resistance profiles in water, farmed oysters, and commercially sold products, implying the water source seeded the supply. Key resistance determinants included extended-spectrum beta-lactamase genes and resistances to quinolones, aminoglycosides, tetracyclines, sulfonamides, and trimethoprim, often on broad-host-range plasmids facilitating horizontal transfer. The findings highlight a regulatory gap: major shellfish programs in the United States, European Union, China, Australia, and Brazil rely on E. coli or fecal coliform counts, not resistance surveillance; oysters sold raw may carry WHO critical-priority pathogens. Interventions targeting farm-water quality could reduce downstream risks as of 16 October 2026.

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू में प्लेटलेट्स कम होने के अलावा क्या दिमाग भी होता है प्रभावित, जानें क्या कहते
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In dengue, besides the drop in platelets, is the brain affected as well? Find out what they say.
article.articleSummary: Dengue can affect the brain and nervous system in severe cases, beyond the typical symptoms of fever, body pains, and low platelets. PSRI Hospital's senior consultant Dr. Neetu Jain explains that some dengue patients experience confusion, excessive sleepiness, agitation, fainting, seizures, or altered mental status. Not every dengue patient develops neurological symptoms, and a drop in platelets alone is not a definitive measure of severity. Potential causes include direct brain invasion by the dengue virus, systemic changes during severe infection, liver dysfunction, hypoglycemia, and electrolyte imbalances such as low sodium; in critical cases, reduced cerebral blood flow may contribute. Regular monitoring is essential: doctors assess consciousness, blood pressure, blood sugar, platelets, and other tests to guide treatment. Early recognition and appropriate care can lower the risk of serious complications.

article.articleHeadline: Vaccine target of 100 days isn't fast enough, says CEPI chair -- while expert warns of failure to provide basic care in DRC Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) is highlighted as of 2026-10-16. At the World Health Summit in Berlin, Congolese Ebola co-discoverer Jean-Jacques Muyembe Tamfum warned that despite advances in vaccines, persistent weaknesses in outbreak preparedness hinder responses, contributing to infections and deaths among health workers in the DRC outbreak. His remarks align with ongoing discussions about a 100-day vaccine development target, with the CEPI chair stating that speed alone is insufficient without strengthening basic infection-control tools and care. The excerpt does not provide specific case or death counts. Emphasis remains on bolstering basic tools and frontline protection to improve outbreak response, alongside continued vaccine development efforts.

article.articleHeadline: Carlos Alberto de Nóbrega é internado para investigar vírus Coxsackie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Carlos Alberto de Nóbrega is hospitalized to investigate a Coxsackievirus infection.
article.articleSummary: Carlos Alberto de Nóbrega, a 90-year-old presenter, is hospitalized at Hospital Sírio-Libanês in São Paulo to investigate a possible Coxsackievirus infection. His wife, Renata de Nóbrega, a physician, is also under investigation, with laboratory tests showing indicators of Coxsackie infection in both spouses. Coxsackie is an enterovirus transmitted through respiratory secretions, contaminated feces, or contaminated surfaces. While typically mild in children, it can affect adults and cause fever, muscle pains, and malaise. The medical team’s primary concern is potential cardiac complications, especially myocarditis, which can lead to dangerous arrhythmias. Carlos Alberto remains under infectious-disease and cardiology care, awaiting imaging results and detailed cardiac evaluations before discharge. The couple’s case serves as a reminder to seek medical care for persistent fatigue that deviates from usual patterns.

article.articleHeadline: Εξαπλώνεται ταχύτατα ο Έμπολα: Τρίτο κρούσμα στην Κένυα - Πάνω από 4.000 οι νεκροί
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads rapidly: Third case in Kenya - Over 4,000 dead.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its third confirmed Ebola case on 16 October 2026, linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak, with over 9,000 infections and more than 4,000 deaths in Congo in recent months. A 65-year-old woman, a relative of the two earlier Kenyan patients, has been in quarantine since 6 October after fever, sore throat and malaise; laboratory tests confirmed Ebola infection. Early diagnosis allowed treatment, with higher chances of full recovery. The first Kenyan case involved a man who contracted Ebola in Congo about a month earlier, then travelled by road to Uganda and by air to Nairobi on 3 October; he died on 5 October. No other imported/exported cases are detailed.

article.articleHeadline: Cinco meses del brote de ébola en Congo: 9.300 casos y 4.500 muertos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Five months into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 9,300 cases and 4,500 deaths
article.articleSummary: By Oct 16, 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, caused by Bundibugyo strain (no vaccine or approved treatment), has reached about 9,300 cases and 4,500 deaths, potentially the deadliest on record worldwide. The National Institute of Public Health reports 9,277 cases and 4,478 deaths, including 65 new cases and 37 deaths in the last 24 hours, with a case fatality rate of 48.3%. Two thousand four hundred eighty-six have recovered; 924 remain hospitalized or in isolation; contact tracing stands at 78% but has declined. Ituri remains the epicenter with 73.4% of cases, though 47.7% of last-day infections occurred there. Kenya confirms a third imported Ebola case in a 65-year-old woman who presented fever, sore throat and malaise; she has been quarantined since Oct 6 and tested positive. Uganda reported Ebola-free status on July 28 after 2 deaths and 20 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行から5カ月：9,300症例、4,500人死亡
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.3%、9,300症例・4,500死亡という過去最悪規模の流行で、ケニアへの輸入症例も確認されており国際的拡大リスクが高いため、フルリスク評価に進むべきシグナルと判断する。
triage.notes: ケニアおよびウガンダは記事中で言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。承認済みワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株による流行で、史上最悪規模の可能性があり、接触者追跡率の低下も懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Kenijoje užregistruotas trečiasis Ebolos viruso infekcijos atvejis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The third case of Ebola virus infection registered in Kenya.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 October 2026, Kenya reports its third Ebola virus infection, a 65-year-old woman who is a close relative of the first two Kenyan cases. She developed fever, sore throat and malaise, was quarantined on 6 October, and laboratory-confirmed Ebola infection. The first case was a 40-year-old Kenyan businessman who contracted the virus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and died in Nairobi on 5 October after traveling from Kampala by air on 3 October. The second case, a 39-year-old male relative of the first patient, was identified in quarantine and was asymptomatic as of 6 October. Kenya has identified 127 of 130 contacts and is isolating the remaining three. The Bundibugyo strain has caused an outbreak in the DRC since May, with about 9,066 infections and 4,381 deaths; there is no vaccine or specific treatment. Uganda reports 20 cases linked to the DRC with two deaths; Uganda announced in August that Ebola was not spreading.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Kisangani : l'ONG Forum Sida intensifie la sensibilisation dans les écoles - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Kisangani: NGO Forum Sida intensifies awareness-raising in schools - ACP
article.articleSummary: In Kisangani, Democratic Republic of Congo, Ebola awareness is being intensified in schools as NGO Forum Sida conducts outreach in Makiso and the Makiso-Kisangani health zone. As of 16 October 2026, two weeks into the campaign launched to inform students about prevention measures, transmission modes, and hygiene practices. Despite limited resources, Forum Sida field teams explain risks to youths and reinforce good practices. The effort follows an appeal by Provincial Health Minister Dr Simon Bokongo for broad participation to curb the outbreak. During the second week, visits included Monaka School in the Makiso commune, the second private school visited in the Makiso-Kisangani health zone. At each session, the NGO hands over sets of hand sanitizers and an educational image box to school authorities to sustain prevention messages at morning gatherings. The initiative emphasizes school-based community mobilization.

article.articleHeadline: Quatro bairros de Limeira terão mutirão da dengue neste sábado | Rápido no Ar
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Four Limeira neighborhoods will host a dengue control campaign this Saturday | Rápido no Ar
article.articleSummary: Limeira, São Paulo, Brazil, will host a dengue-control campaign on Saturday, 17 October 2026, from 7:30 to 12:00, in Parque Residencial Belinha Ometto, Geada, Jardim Residencial Águas da Serra, and Jardim Residencial Village. The city hall aims to identify and eliminate breeding sites of Aedes aegypti, the dengue vector. About 90 uniformed agents with identification badges will participate. The campaign underscores resident cooperation to prevent dengue by removing containers that can collect water and by keeping yards and outdoor areas free of potential mosquito habitats. By targeting source reduction and public participation, the effort seeks to reduce local transmission risk in Limeira and protect affected neighborhoods.

article.articleHeadline: ​Ebola à Beni : des enseignants s'engagent à faire respecter les mesures barrières - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: teachers commit to enforcing barrier measures - ACP
article.articleSummary: Five months after Ebola's resurgence in North Kivu's Beni, Democratic Republic of the Congo, teachers pledged to enforce barrier measures in schools during a guided visit to the Ebola Treatment Center (ETC). The effort, led by CREC (Risk Communication and Community Engagement) with support from International Medical Corps, emphasized handwashing as the first barrier, directing symptomatic children to care and informing parents for follow-up. It aims to counter rumors about Ebola treatments and patient feeding in ETCs. A teacher noted that timely presentation to ETCs improves survival and urged the community to view ETCs as places of care and recovery, while spreading reliable information. Multiple actors intensified outreach to sustain community engagement and combat the outbreak.

article.articleHeadline: Beni : suspension du concours interscolaire "Tous pour la paix" à cause d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: Suspension of the inter-school contest "All for Peace" due to Ebola - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola persists in Beni, North Kivu, in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, prompting the suspension of the fifth edition of the inter-school contest “All for Peace” for the 2026-2027 academic year. The CJPC notes the decision aims to protect students, teachers, partners, and the community as the Ebola outbreak continues to spread in the East with ongoing fatalities. The suspension is presented as a precaution, not a abandonment of objectives, and authorities hope to resume once health conditions allow. The organization emphasizes that health remains the priority and urges adherence to health authorities’ guidance, avoidance of risky behaviors, and dissemination of reliable prevention information. Partners, school authorities, teachers, and students are thanked for their support, with a pledge to renew activities when conditions permit, reaffirming that peace is built through protection of life.

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : lancement à Beni de la vaccination contre Ebola avec le vaccin Ervebo - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Ebola vaccination launch in Beni with the Ervebo vaccine - ACP.
article.articleSummary: On 16 October 2026, in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, a vaccination campaign against Ebola Virus Disease using the Ervebo vaccine was launched for frontline workers. The rollout, supervised by the national outbreak coordinator, prioritizes health care providers, surveillance and case management teams, personnel involved in dignified and safe burials, laboratory experts, and those handling body transport. The launch frames vaccination as a complement to established pillars: epidemiological surveillance, early case detection, patient care, infection prevention and control, and community engagement. The coordinator emphasized vaccination is voluntary, starting with frontline staff, and stressed sustained efforts to curb the outbreak. Partnerships acknowledged include WHO, Africa CDC, UNICEF, and the World Food Programme for ongoing support. The aim is to reinforce response efforts and end Ebola as quickly as possible.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州:ベニでエルベボワクチンを用いたエボラワクチン接種が開始—ACP
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国北キブ州でエボラ出血熱の最前線対応者向けワクチン接種が開始されたことは、現在進行中の深刻なエボラアウトブレイクを示しており、WHO・Africa CDC等国際機関の関与も確認されるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は新規症例報告ではなく既存アウトブレイクへのワクチン接種キャンペーン開始の報告だが、エボラという疾患特性上、継続的なアウトブレイク対応として重要度は高い。WHO、Africa CDC、UNICEF、WFPとの連携が言及されており、国際的な支援体制が既に動いていることが示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Carlos Alberto de Nóbrega é internado para investigar possível infecção viral
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Carlos Alberto de Nóbrega is hospitalized to investigate a possible viral infection.
article.articleSummary: Carlos Alberto de Nóbrega, a 90-year-old Brazilian presenter, is hospitalized at Hospital Sírio-Libanês in São Paulo to investigate a possible Coxsackie virus infection. Medical supervision includes cardiology and infectious-disease specialists. The admission follows months of fatigue, malaise, and tiredness; initial assessments blamed aging and comorbidities, but his wife Renata de Nóbrega, a physician, ordered further testing. Laboratory results showed signs of Coxsackie infection in both Carlos Alberto and Renata, though a definitive diagnosis remains unconfirmed. He awaits imaging studies, cardiology evaluations, and the completion of serologies to confirm infection status and potential complications. Coxsackie viruses, part of the enterovirus family, can cause varied manifestations depending on the type and host health; confirmation depends on clinical history and laboratory tests. Ongoing investigations continue with no confirmed infection announced.

article.articleHeadline: डेंगू के मरीजों के लिए अस्पताल में 15 बेड आरक्षित, चार का इलाज
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fifteen beds reserved in the hospital for dengue patients, four are under treatment.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 October 2026, Raja Pratap Bahadur Hospital in Prayagraj, Uttar Pradesh, has reserved a 15-bed ward for dengue, with four patients currently under treatment; malaria care is ongoing, and the facility reports adequate medicines and platelet supplies, with malaria tests kits available. In Pratapgarh district, January–September 2026, malaria and dengue testing identified 67 infections. Malaria: 197,400 tests conducted, 25 positives. Dengue: 5,300 ELISA tests conducted, 42 positives, and all dengue patients have recovered. Officials emphasize early fever testing and timely treatment. The hospital notes sufficient injectable and oral anti-malarial medicines and platelet supplies. Preventive guidance includes eliminating standing water around homes, cleaning containers and flower pots, wearing long-sleeved clothing, and using mosquito nets to reduce transmission.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱患者のため病院に15床を確保、4人が治療中
triage.triage_reason: インド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州における季節性のデング熱・マラリア発生の日常的な医療対応報告であり、感染者数も限定的で医療体制も整っているため、異常性・深刻性は認められない。
triage.notes: デング患者は全員回復しており、医薬品・血小板の供給も十分と報告されている。マラリア陽性率も低く（197,400件中25件陽性）、通常の季節的な感染症対応として扱われる。

article.articleHeadline: Uganda: Ssenyonyi Seeks Answers Over Travel Restrictions On Ugandans After Ebola Outbreak
article.articleSummary: Uganda's opposition leader Ssenyonyi seeks answers over travel restrictions on Ugandans after Ebola outbreak. As of 16 Oct 2026, Uganda was declared Ebola-free, with the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak recording 20 confirmed cases and two deaths; WHO declared the outbreak over on Aug 27 after 42 consecutive days with no new confirmed cases. Despite this, travel bans persist in several countries, prompting calls for explanations and lifting steps. The government cites ongoing transmission in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and cross-border movements, noting porous borders contribute to risk. The DRC outbreak continues, with more than 9,000 confirmed cases reported by Oct 13; Kenya has reported imported cases linked to the outbreak. WHO advises against travel or trade restrictions on Uganda and DRC, warning of disruption without clear public-health benefit. Uganda plans a health conference in Munyonyo to review response; government is engaging foreign authorities to reconsider restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ:エボラ出血熱流行後のウガンダ人への渡航制限についてセニョニ氏が説明を要求
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ出血熱の流行が継続し9,000例超の確定例が報告されており、ケニアへの越境感染例も確認されている。IHR基準に複数該当し、渡航制限を巡る国際的対立も生じているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダの渡航制限問題だがウガンダ・ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCでの継続中の大規模エボラ流行（9,000例超）が本イベントの中心的リスク要因であり対象国に該当するため記載。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia confirma un tercer caso de ébola en su territorio pero...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya confirms a third Ebola case in its territory but...
article.articleSummary: As of 16 October 2026, Kenya confirms a third Ebola case of Bundibugyo strain: a 65-year-old woman who is a close family contact of the first two confirmed cases, currently in quarantine and isolated after fever, sore throat, and malaise. She has been in quarantine since 6 October 2026 and is receiving care at the Infectious Diseases Unit. Officials say the risk of community transmission remains low, with no evidence of spread beyond contacts. Of 130 identified contacts, 127 (97.7%) have been located and placed in quarantine, exceeding the 85% global threshold to interrupt transmission. Kenya has now reported three cases and one death from Bundibugyo Ebola. The outbreak in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo has caused more than 4,500 deaths and 9,300 cases. Ongoing surveillance and containment measures are in place.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで3例目のエボラ感染確認、ただし地域内感染は否定
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,300例超・死者4,500人超の大規模エボラ流行が継続中であり、隣国ケニアへの越境伝播（3例目の確認）が発生しているため、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の直接の主題はケニアでの新規症例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、感染源であるDRCの大規模流行（9,300例、死者4,500人超）が実質的な背景情報として詳述されており、対象国であるため含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Llega el ébola a Kenia: ¿cómo se prepara para controlarlo?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Arrives in Kenya: How Is Kenya Preparing to Control It?
article.articleSummary: Two Ebola cases with one related death have been confirmed in Kenya, linked to the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) outbreak, which has reported over 9,000 cases and 4,400 deaths. The first patient died October 5 in Nairobi after traveling by road from the DRC to Uganda, then flying to Kenya on October 3. A 39-year-old relative in quarantine developed symptoms on October 13; both cases are related and there is no evidence of transmission in their surroundings. Contact tracing identified 128 contacts; 113 have been located and are in quarantine, with five abroad or unknown. Kenya has tightened airport and border controls, deployed mobile laboratories, and designated isolation centers; flights from several African countries are directed to screening zones. Critics argue preparedness gaps, including border controls, rural isolation capacity, and public education. WHO notes Ebola symptoms can appear 2–21 days after infection; early symptoms include fever and fatigue, later vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain; confirmation requires laboratory testing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱がケニアに到達：ケニアはどのように制御体制を整えているか？
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）で9,000人超の感染・4,400人超の死亡が報告されている大規模エボラ流行がケニアへ越境し、死亡例を含む確定例と128人の接触者追跡が発生しており、国際的拡大・渡航制限対応が既に生じているためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な新規イベントはケニア（対象国リスト外）での輸入例確認だが、感染源であるDRCの大規模継続流行（9,000例超、4,400人死亡）が直接言及されているためDRCを含めた。ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola.- Kenia confirma un tercer caso de ébola en su territorio pero...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola - Kenya confirms a third Ebola case within its territory but...
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms a third Ebola case of the Bundibugyo strain, a 65-year-old woman who is a close family contact of the first two cases; as of Oct 16, 2026, all three are in quarantine with no evidence of community transmission. She developed fever, sore throat and malaise and has been moved to the Unit of Infectious Diseases for supportive care. The authorities say the risk of community spread remains low; 130 contacts have been identified, 127 located and in quarantine (97.7%), exceeding the 85% global threshold to interrupt transmission. Overall, Kenyan health authorities have confirmed three cases and one death linked to the outbreak affecting neighboring Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), which has reported more than 4,500 deaths and 9,300 cases.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱 - ケニアが国内で3例目の感染を確認するも、地域感染は否定
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,300症例・4,500人超の死亡者を出しているエボラ流行がケニアに越境し、3例目の感染者が確認されたため、国際的拡大とIHR基準の複数該当がありフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていないが、エボラ流行の起点であるDRCの被害規模（9,300症例、4,500人超の死亡）が記事の主要な背景情報として重要。

article.articleHeadline: ஆந்த்ராக்ஸ் நோய் தாக்கி பெண் யானை உயிரிழப்பு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anthrax kills a female elephant.
article.articleSummary: Anthrax confirmed as the cause of death of a female elephant in the Gobanari Protected Forest area of Periyanaickenpalayam, Coimbatore district. Wildlife staff on patrol found the carcass on Oct 13 in the evening; nighttime conditions delayed immediate response. On Oct 14, veterinarians in protective gear collected a blood sample for laboratory testing. Laboratory confirmation established anthrax infection. Following central and Tamil Nadu forest department guidelines, the elephant's body was cremated under an assistant forest guard's supervision on Thursday, with precautions to keep other wildlife and scavengers away. The report notes one elephant death due to anthrax in this incident; no other cases are described, but authorities are continuing surveillance and preventive measures in the region.

triage.headline_ja: 炭疽病によりメス象が死亡
triage.triage_reason: 野生動物（象）の単発炭疽死亡事例であり、ヒトへの感染拡大や公衆衛生への直接的影響は確認されていないが、炭疽は人獣共通感染症であるため今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本事例は野生の象1頭の炭疽死亡であり、人への感染や感染拡大は報告されていない。森林当局による予防的措置と監視が継続されている段階。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل ثالث إصابة بإيبولا والمصابة كانت في الحجر الصحي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records its third Ebola case, and the patient was in quarantine.
article.articleSummary: Kenya records its third Ebola case, a 65-year-old woman in quarantine since Oct 6; upon developing fever, sore throat and malaise she was isolated, samples taken, and diagnosed early, with care underway. The Kenyan cases are linked to the Congo outbreak, which has reported over 9,000 infections and more than 4,000 deaths. The first Kenyan case involved a man ill in Congo for about a month, who traveled by land to Uganda and by air to Nairobi, Kenya, on Oct 3, dying in hospital on Oct 5. The second case remains stable, with no evidence of community transmission. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids of living or dead patients and can cause fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding. The Congo outbreak began mid-May and involves the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no vaccines or approved treatments.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで3例目のエボラ感染例を記録、患者は検疫中だった
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当し、コンゴ(DRC)で続く大規模アウトブレイク（9000人超感染、4000人超死亡）が隣国へ越境拡大している重大事例であるためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はコンゴ(DRC)で5月中旬から続くBundibugyo株によるエボラ流行で、ワクチンや承認された治療法がない。ケニア・ウガンダは越境症例の発生国だが対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya confirms third Ebola case, a relative of the first patient who died
article.articleSummary: Kenya’s health ministry confirms a third Ebola case in quarantine: a 65-year-old woman, a relative of the 40-year-old man who died on Oct 5 after arriving from Congo. The third patient developed symptoms during quarantine (since Oct 6) and has been moved to the Infectious Disease Unit. A second patient, a 39-year-old man from the same family, remains in stable condition. Officials say there is no evidence of community transmission; all cases are linked to the first patient and quarantined. Congo’s ongoing outbreak has caused at least 4,000 deaths since May. Three contacts linked to Kenya’s first case remain untraced; tracing faces challenges in Uganda and Congo. Kenya has intensified border screening, with a Nairobi airport gate for flights from 10 countries, and Busia border checks. MSF urges disclosure of exposures and travel history to improve survival.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、3例目のエボラ感染を確認 ― 死亡した最初の患者の親族
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続いているエボラ流行（5月以降4000人以上死亡）から国境を越えてケニアへの感染拡大が確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際的拡大・渡航制限）に該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの感染確認だが、ケニアおよびウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは流行源として明示的に言及され、進行中の大規模アウトブレイク（4000人以上死亡）であるためverified_locationsに含めた。接触者の追跡はウガンダ・コンゴで難航しており、地域的拡大リスクが継続している点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Viral Video: Digital Creator Explains Report Of 215 HIV-Positive Cases At Indore College! (WATCH)
article.articleSummary: Claim that 215 people tested HIV-positive at a college in Indore, Madhya Pradesh circulated online, triggering concern and debate. A digital creator explained the viral report, providing interpretation of the figures and cautions against drawing conclusions about infection sources or circumstances. As of 16 Oct 2026, there are no verified medical statements or official confirmation of an outbreak or cluster at the college. The episode highlights the need for verified information, responsible reporting, and heightened HIV awareness to prevent stigma. Experts emphasize the value of regular screening and early diagnosis for accessing treatment and care, while acknowledging that online claims must be evaluated against official health communications. The discussion underscores how misreported health data can mislead the public and prompt unnecessary alarm.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス動画：デジタルクリエイターがインドールの大学でHIV陽性215件という報告を解説（視聴）
triage.triage_reason: 公式な医療確認がなく、未検証のバイラル動画に関する内容であり、実際のアウトブレイクやクラスターの証拠がないため見送りと判断。
triage.notes: 記事自体が、未検証のオンライン上の主張（バイラル動画）について誤情報の拡散防止と責任ある報道の重要性を説く内容であり、公式な感染確認は存在しない。実際の疾病発生イベントではないため対象国の検証も該当なしとした。

article.articleHeadline: Кения потвърди трети случай на ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya confirmed a third case of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirmed a third Ebola case, a 65-year-old woman quarantined on 6 October after developing fever, sore throat, and malaise; she tested positive and is receiving supportive care. The cases in Kenya are linked to the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, which has reported more than 9,000 cases and about 4,000 deaths, making it one of the largest outbreaks on record. The first Kenyan case emerged last week: a man who fell ill in the DRC about a month earlier and then traveled by land to Uganda before arriving in Nairobi by plane on 3 October; he died on 5 October. The current third case is a close relative of the initial patients. The DRC outbreak remains the primary driver of cross-border transmission, prompting quarantine and clinical monitoring in Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアがエボラの第3症例を確認
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国発の大規模エボラ流行（9000例以上、死者約4000人）が国境を越えてケニアに波及しており、国際的拡大リスクが高く、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの輸入症例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。発生源であり主要な感染拡大ドライバーとされるコンゴ民主共和国（対象国）を verified_locations に含めた。ウガンダも経由地として言及されているが対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تعلن عن ثالث إصابة بالإيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya announces its third Ebola case.
article.articleSummary: Kenya has confirmed its third Ebola case, with a positive test in a patient who was in quarantine and known to be a contact of the first case who died after arriving from Congo. The third case is a woman related to the man who died of Ebola on October 5. She has been in isolation since October 6 after developing symptoms, and was later moved to the infectious diseases isolation ward. The second patient, a man from the same family, remains in stable condition. Health authorities say there is no evidence of community transmission, and all cases are linked to the first patient, who triggered the cluster while in quarantine. Congo is contending the deadliest outbreak since May, with at least 4,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、3例目のエボラ感染を発表
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続く大規模エボラ流行（死者4000人以上）が国境を越えてケニアに波及し、ヒト-ヒト感染が確認されたため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの二次感染3例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、感染源であるDRCは現在進行中の大規模流行（死者4000人以上）の当事国として対象国リストに含め検証対象とした。

article.articleHeadline: Plague fears in Russia put troupe's Bhopal Ramleela performance on hold
article.articleSummary: On 2026-10-16, reports of a pneumonic plague outbreak in Russia prompted health concerns that kept a Russian artistes troupe from joining the International Ramleela festival in Bhopal. The performers were to perform at Ravindra Bhavan but could not secure travel clearance amid the outbreak; the Indian Council for Cultural Relations had not formally confirmed their arrival, so the festival will proceed without them. Culture director N P Namdeo stated the event would continue with other performances. The situation adds a public health dimension to the festival, with no laboratory-confirmed details, case counts, or infection source provided in the report. No mention of exported/imported cases is included.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアでのペスト懸念により、劇団のボパールでのラームリーラー公演が保留に
triage.triage_reason: ロシアでの肺ペスト発生情報は未確認で症例数や検査確認の詳細がなく、対象国（インド）では疾病発生ではなく渡航制限の間接的影響のみが報じられているため、続報を注視する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はロシアでの肺ペスト発生疑惑によりロシア人劇団のインド渡航が妨げられたことであり、インド国内での疾病発生は報告されていない。ロシアは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Malária: Anvisa autoriza teste em humanos de vacina 100% brasileira - Diário de Notícias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria: Anvisa authorizes human testing of a 100% Brazilian vaccine - Diário de Notícias.
article.articleSummary: Anvisa authorized the first human testing of Vivaxin, the world's first vaccine against malaria caused by Plasmodium vivax, and the first 100% Brazilian vaccine for this parasite. The immunogen is developed by Centro de Tecnologia de Vacinas (CTVacinas) at the Federal University of Minas Gerais (UFMG). The Health Ministry notes R$12 million has been allocated to support Phase I-III clinical trials. Phase I will evaluate safety, local and systemic reactions, and the vaccine's ability to elicit an immune response in 48 malaria-naive adults aged 18-59, with 360 days of follow-up. Currently recommended malaria vaccines target Plasmodium falciparum, which predominates in Africa; vivax malaria predominates in the Americas and Asia. Vivaxin testing in Brazil marks a milestone toward addressing vivax malaria where it is most prevalent.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア：アンビザが100%ブラジル製ワクチンのヒト試験を承認 - Diário de Notícias
triage.triage_reason: マラリアワクチンの臨床試験承認に関する研究開発ニュースであり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリアワクチン（Vivaxin）の臨床試験承認に関する科学・医療ニュースであり、感染症の発生・流行事例ではないためシグナルとして扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Carbapenem-Resistant Salmonella ST34 Carrying blaNDM-5 Isolated From Rectal
article.articleSummary: SYA001, a multidrug-resistant monophasic Salmonella enterica serovar Typhimurium 1,4,[5],12:i:- ST34 carrying blaNDM-5, was isolated from a rectal cancer patient in Sanya, Hainan, China. The patient was immunocompromised with an underlying malignant tumor. Complete genome sequencing (5,223,782 bp; GC 51.86%; 4,923 CDS, 76 tRNAs, 3 rRNA operons) confirmed ST34 (ANI to LT2 99.85%), with 1,275 SNPs and 654 unique gene clusters enriched for resistance genes, prophages, and plasmid elements. The strain is resistant to seven antibiotic classes, including imipenem, meropenem, and ertapenem (MICs 16, 16, 8 μg/mL), while remaining susceptible to aztreonam, amikacin, tigecycline, and colistin, with intermediate levofloxacin/ciprofloxacin. Resistance determinants include blaNDM-5, blaOXA-10, qnrS1, tet(A), sul2/sul3, AAC(6')-Iaa, AAC(3')-IVa, and EF-Tu/UhpT mutations. Four plasmid replicons were identified: IncHI2, IncHI2A, IncQ1, and p0111.

triage.headline_ja: 海南省の直腸がん患者からblaNDM-5を保有するカルバペネム耐性サルモネラST34が分離
triage.triage_reason: 単一患者からの多剤耐性サルモネラ分離という学術的・実験室的報告であり、アウトブレイクや二次感染の証拠はないが、新規の耐性遺伝子(blaNDM-5)保有株として今後の拡大可能性を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本報告は単一症例(免疫不全の直腸がん患者)からのゲノム解析研究であり、アウトブレイクの報告ではない。薬剤耐性サーベイランスの観点から継続的な情報収集が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: Νικοτίνη στην εγκυμοσύνη: Σοβαρότερες πνευμονικές βλάβες σε λοιμώξεις δείχνει νέα έρευνα
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Nicotine during pregnancy: New research shows more severe pulmonary damage in infections.
article.articleSummary: New laboratory study from UC Santa Cruz, published in Stem Cell Reports, shows perinatal nicotine exposure in mice leads to long-term impairment of the hematopoietic system and immune defense. Exposed offspring developed reduced hematopoietic stem cell reservoirs and gene-expression alterations that persisted into adulthood even after brief postnatal nicotine exposure. Although circulating immune cells appeared normal generally, the lungs showed a clear macrophage deficit. When these mice later encountered influenza A virus infection, their immune response became exaggerated, with massive pulmonary cellular infiltration, extensive lung injury, and significant weight loss. The study notes that these findings in animals cannot be directly extrapolated to humans, but raise concerns about nicotine exposure during pregnancy and infancy from all sources, including e-cigarettes and nicotine replacement therapies. The research underscores potential long-term hematopoietic and pulmonary risks.

triage.headline_ja: 妊娠中のニコチン摂取:新たな研究で感染症時のより重篤な肺損傷が示される
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はマウスを用いた基礎研究であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクの発生を報告するものではないため、公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はUC Santa Cruzによるマウス実験の研究発表であり、特定の国・地域での感染症アウトブレイクを報じるものではない。発生地域にPhilippinesが付与されているが、記事内容とは無関係（Bluedotの誤判定と思われる）。

article.articleHeadline: Third Ebola Case Confirmed in Kenya - Reports
article.articleSummary: Third Ebola case confirmed in Kenya, the Kenyan Star reports citing the health ministry. A 65-year-old woman has been in quarantine since October 6. This marks the third confirmed Ebola case in Kenya in the current outbreak. Earlier this month, a Kenyan citizen who arrived from the Democratic Republic of the Congo tested positive for Ebola and died on October 5. The new case suggests ongoing transmission linked to cross-border movement from the DRC. Kenyan authorities are tracing contacts and enforcing isolation. The report underscores continued importation risk and potential local spread in Kenya as of October 16, 2026, following the DRC-origin case.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで3例目のエボラ感染確認－報道
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ感染がケニアで3例目確認され、越境伝播・死亡例を伴う継続的なアウトブレイクを示しており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性、異常性、国際的拡大）に該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの感染確認だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRCでの進行中アウトブレイクが示唆されるためDRCのみverified_locationsに含めた。渡航制限や国際支援の必要性については記事に明記がなく不明。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya reports third Ebola case, a close relative of first two patients
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its third Ebola infection, a 65-year-old woman closely related to the first two cases linked to Congo's Bundibugyo outbreak. She had been in quarantine since Oct 6; upon developing fever, sore throat and malaise she was isolated and tested, diagnosed early and receiving supportive care. The Congo outbreak has produced more than 9,000 cases and over 4,000 deaths; it is led by the Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved vaccines or treatments exist. Kenya's first case involved a man who became ill in Congo, traveled via Uganda to Nairobi (Oct 3) and died Oct 5; the second patient remains stable. Authorities say there is no evidence of wider community spread. Screening lapses concerns persist after the first patient crossed borders; contact tracing covers 127 of 130 contacts, with three remaining.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで第3例目のエボラ感染確認、最初の2例の近親者
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で9000例超・4000人超の死者を出すエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）アウトブレイクが、国境を越えてケニアに拡大し複数の二次感染が発生しており、国際的拡大・公衆衛生上の重大性が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の主眼はケニアでの症例報告だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、感染源であるDRCのブンディブギョ株アウトブレイクは9000例超・4000人超の死者を伴う大規模な進行中の事象として具体的に記述されているためverified_locationsに含めた。ワクチン・治療薬が未承認である点も重大性を高める要因。

article.articleHeadline: Cutar Ebola ta kama mutum na uku a kasar Kenya bayan kashe biyu
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where May 2026 marked the 17th outbreak in the country’s history, with more than 15,000 deaths recorded over 50 years. Kenya reports a third Ebola case: a 65-year-old woman, sister to the two earlier Kenyan cases, isolated since October 6 after fever, sore throat and fatigue. A week earlier, a second Kenyan case was reported; both are siblings of the first Kenyan patient who had previously lived in the DRC before returning to Kenya; lab investigations confirmed the infection for the initial case, which later died. In Congo, 2026 has seen 9,066 cases and 4,381 deaths. The Kenyan cluster is linked to the Congo outbreak, illustrating cross-border transmission from the May 2026 wave.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱の第3例確認、2人死亡後
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続く大規模エボラ流行（2026年だけで9,066症例・4,381死亡）が国境を越えてケニアに伝播し、家族クラスターで3例目（うち1例死亡）が確認されており、IHR基準の複数（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当する。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし記事の主題はDRC由来のエボラ流行とその国際的拡大（ケニアへの越境伝播）であり、DRCでの大規模流行継続がPICKUP判定の根拠となる。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya confirms third Ebola case as health officials race to contain outbreak
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms third Ebola case, as outbreak across East Africa expands. The Health Ministry reports a 65-year-old woman, a close relative of the first two Kenyan cases, confirmed after showing symptoms while in quarantine since October 6. The initial case, a 40-year-old businessman who travelled from the Democratic Republic of Congo, died on October 5, triggering Kenya's first outbreak. A second case, another relative, was later confirmed. Contact tracing has identified 130 contacts, of which 127 have been traced and quarantined; three remain to be located. Public risk considered low with no evidence of community transmission. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the Bundibugyo strain has infected more than 9,000 people and caused over 4,300 deaths, and currently lacks a specific vaccine or treatment. The Kenya event represents an imported Ebola situation linked to ongoing DRC outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで3例目のエボラ感染確認、保健当局がアウトブレイク封じ込めを急ぐ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち3項目（深刻性・異常性・国際拡大）に該当し、DRC由来のエボラがケニアへ越境拡大している重大イベントであるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニアおよびモザンビークは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。感染源・主要アウトブレイクはDRC（Bundibugyo株、9,000人超感染・4,300人超死亡）であり、ケニアは輸入症例による二次的拡大事例。

article.articleHeadline: Épidémie d'Ebola en RDC : Le bilan franchit le cap des 4.300 morts , H24info
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC: Death toll surpasses 4,300, H24info.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 4,381 deaths among 9,066 confirmed cases (case fatality rate 48.3%). The Ituri province in the northeast remains the epicenter, accounting for 73.8% of total cases and 63.6% of new infections; 65 of 167 health zones across seven provinces are affected (38.9%). The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which no licensed vaccine or treatment exists. First doses of Ervebo, effective against the Zaïre strain, have been administered in recent weeks to frontline volunteers as part of a clinical trial. WHO reports a vaccine trial should launch in the DRC before month’s end. Declared mid-May in Ituri, this is the largest and deadliest Ebola outbreak in the DRC and the second globally after 2014–2016 West Africa; the 2018–2020 outbreak caused about 2,300 deaths from ~3,500 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱流行:死者数が4,300人を超える、H24info
triage.triage_reason: 致死率48.3%の大規模エボラ流行がDRCで拡大中であり、複数州にまたがる感染とワクチン未承認状況から公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: 発生地域にAngolaが含まれるが、記事サマリーでは言及がなく主題はDRCのみのため除外。本流行は史上最大規模のDRC国内エボラ流行であり、WHO主導のワクチン治験が開始予定。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya records third Ebola case, linked to first patient who died
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its third Bundibugyo virus disease case, a 65-year-old Nairobi woman who is a primary contact and relative of the first two cases; she has been in quarantine since October 6, developed fever, sore throat and malaise, tested positive, and is receiving supportive care with improving prospects. Kenyan authorities say there is no community transmission and the overall public risk remains low. The Kenyan cases are linked to the DRC Ebola outbreak, which has recorded more than 9,000 cases and over 4,300 deaths since May. The first Kenyan patient—a man who became ill in the DRC, traveled to Nairobi, and died October 5—triggered the investigation. Of 130 contacts, 127 are under quarantine. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine, though early-stage vaccines are under testing. Africa CDC notes funding transparency concerns, while in DRC, two new North Ubangi cases mark spread to an eighth province, pending official confirmation.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最初の患者から感染した3例目のエボラ症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続くエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)流行が8州目に拡大し9000例超・死者4300人超に達しており、ケニアへの越境伝播も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの越境感染例だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは流行の発生源であり8州目への拡大が言及されているため対象国として含めた。Africa CDCの資金透明性懸念も国際支援必要性を示唆する。

article.articleHeadline: Le Kenya confirme un troisième cas d'Ebola sur son territoire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya confirms a third Ebola case on its territory.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms a third Ebola virus disease (EVD) case as of 16 October 2026. The patient, a 65-year-old woman related to first two infections, was quarantined on 6 October after confirmation of initial case. After fever, she was isolated, tested positive, and is receiving treatment; authorities say early screening improves recovery and limits transmission. The first case was a Kenyan resident in the DRC who died 5 October in Nairobi after illness began there, with transit through Kampala, Uganda, before flying to Nairobi on 3 October. A second case, another family member, was confirmed while the first patient was in quarantine. Of 130 contacts, 127 (97.7%) were traced and quarantined; three remain to be located. No community transmission; risk remains low. DRC outbreak since May: 4,381 deaths, 9,066 cases; Uganda reported 20 infections and two deaths; WHO declared Ebola-free in August. Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or approved treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、国内で3例目のエボラ感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRCで続く大規模エボラ流行（死亡4,381人）がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境伝播し、国際的拡大とIHR基準の複数該当が確認されるため、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCは本流行の発生源として記事内で具体的な死亡・症例数が言及されており、主題の一部として含めた。国境を越えた感染拡大（DRC→ウガンダ→ケニア）が既に発生しており、国際的な注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: From AI X-Rays to Ultra-Short Drug Regimens: 2025's Tuberculosis
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis remains a leading killer, with global incidence falling about 1.5–2% annually and still short of WHO End TB 2030 targets. A Frontiers in TB narrative synthesis of 2025 notes rapid progress in diagnostics, therapeutics, vaccines, and care, yet health-system gaps constrain impact. In diagnostics, AI-assisted chest radiography improved sensitivity and reader consistency in high-volume screening across India and Southeast Asia, with pooled sensitivity often above 85%. Nigeria demonstrated cost-effective use of ultraportable X-ray with AI interpretation. Tongue-swab PCR (SMART4TB) in Philippines, South Africa, Nigeria, and Zambia yielded specificity 99.6% and sensitivity 66% versus culture, best used within diagnostic algorithms. Stool-based GeneXpert Ultra testing matured, showing robust performance despite stool variability and improved pediatric confirmation. WHO guidance urged concurrent multi-specimen testing in children, including stool, respiratory samples, and urine LAM for HIV-positive children. Therapeutics moved to shorter regimens: a four-month all-oral rifapentine–moxifloxacin–isoniazid–pyrazinamide regimen was noninferior to six months (Study 31).

triage.headline_ja: AIを用いたX線診断から超短期治療レジメンまで：2025年の結核分野の進展
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は結核の診断・治療技術に関する2025年の研究動向レビューであり、急性の公衆衛生上のイベントや異常な発生を報告するものではないため、トリアージ対象のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事は結核の診断・治療に関する科学的レビュー論文の紹介であり、特定の突発的な感染症イベントではない。南アフリカ・ナイジェリアも言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

locations.name: Union Territory of Andaman and Nicobar Islands

article.articleHeadline: Outbreak of African Swine Fever among pigs at Sri Vijaya Puram and at Arong, Car Nicobar -- declaration of epicentres under the Prevention and Control of Infectious and Contagious Diseases in Animals Act, 2009.
article.articleSummary: African Swine Fever (ASF) has been declared the epicentre in Sri Vijaya Puram, South Andaman, and Arong, Car Nicobar, following laboratory test results. ASF is a highly contagious viral disease of pigs with high mortality; it does not infect humans and poses no direct human health risk; there is no vaccine or specific treatment. To prevent spread, transportation of pigs, pork and pork products—including frozen items—across the Andaman and Nicobar Islands is restricted until further orders. Infected-zone restrictions require culling and disposal of pigs within a 1 km radius; no movement of live pigs, pig feed, pork or related products out of epicentres; no pig markets or gatherings. Sick or suspected pigs must be reported to the Senior Veterinary Officer. Disposal of carcasses and frozen meat will be by deep burial under veterinary supervision; common community burial pits may be used. Compensation is verified by a designated team under Ministry guidelines; the order remains in force until withdrawn or area is declared free.

triage.headline_ja: シュリー・ヴィジャヤ・プーラムおよびアロング（カー・ニコバル）における豚のアフリカ豚熱発生 -- 伝染病予防法に基づく発生中心地の宣言
triage.triage_reason: 動物のみに感染するアフリカ豚熱であり、人への健康リスクはないため公衆衛生上のシグナルには該当しない。
triage.notes: ASFは豚のみに感染し人獣共通感染症ではないため、公衆衛生イベントとしての対象国指定はなし。地域の家畜衛生当局の対応事案。

article.articleHeadline: African Swine Fever: Advisory for Pig Farmers & General Public
article.articleSummary: African Swine Fever (ASF) has been confirmed by ICAR-NIHSAD, Bhopal, in pig samples from Sri Vijaya Puram and Car Nicobar, with the lab report dated 16 October 2026. ASF is a highly contagious viral disease of domestic pigs and wild boars, causing very high mortality and major economic losses; it does not infect humans but can spread mechanically via people, vehicles, equipment, clothing and contaminated pork products. Key symptoms include sudden deaths, high fever, loss of appetite, weakness, reddish-purple skin discolouration, vomiting, diarrhoea and abortions. Farmers should report suspected cases to the Senior Veterinary Officer, segregate animals, restrict movement and trade, maintain biosecurity, avoid unsafe feeding and follow official control measures. Public should avoid transporting live pigs or pork products, discard waste away from pigs, and not handle carcasses; report unusual deaths. If directed, culling and safe disposal follow official instructions, with compensation per 2020 government notification. No curative treatment or approved vaccine exists; control relies on surveillance and coordinated actions to eradicate on the islands.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ豚熱：養豚業者および一般市民への注意喚起
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱はヒトに感染しないため公衆衛生への直接的な深刻性は低いが、新たな地域（アンダマン諸島）での確認、移動・取引制限の勧告など経済・流通面での影響が見られるため、今後の拡大状況を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 本疾患はヒトに感染しない動物疾病であり、公衆衛生リスクは限定的。主に養豚業への経済的影響と地域拡大（アンダマン・ニコバル諸島）の観点から継続監視が望ましい。

article.articleHeadline: African Swine Fever Confirmed in Pigs in Some parts of Sri Vijaya Puram and at Arong, Car Nicobar
article.articleSummary: African Swine Fever (ASF) confirmed in pigs in Sri Vijaya Puram and Arong, Car Nicobar, Nicobar District, Andaman & Nicobar Islands, on Oct 16, 2026. Confirmation based on lab results from ICAR-NIHSAD, Bhopal. ASF is a highly contagious viral disease of pigs with no human infection, no vaccine, and no specific treatment; it can cause high pig mortality and economic loss. To prevent spread, the Andaman & Nicobar Administration has imposed a total movement ban on pigs, pork and pork products (including frozen items) across the Islands, prohibiting transport by sea, road, or air. Sick or suspected pigs must be isolated; carcasses must be disposed of by deep burial under local supervision, not in water bodies. Culling/disposal and admissible compensation will follow government protocols after verification. Pig owners are urged to confine stocks and report suspected cases; the disease does not pose a human health risk.

triage.headline_ja: インド・アンダマン諸島スリ・ヴィジャヤ・プラムおよびカー・ニコバルのアロンで豚のアフリカ豚熱（ASF）感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱は豚のみに感染するウイルス性疾患で人への感染リスクはなく、現地当局により移動禁止等の防疫措置が既に講じられているため、公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威には該当しない。
triage.notes: 本疾患はヒトに感染しない動物疾病であり、CEPRのEBS対象となる公衆衛生危機には該当しない。地方行政が移動禁止・隔離・埋却等の標準プロトコルで対応中。

article.articleHeadline: Creche de Porangaba deve retomar aulas após 40 casos de mão-pé-boca | TVS+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Porangaba Daycare Must Resume Classes After 40 Cases of Hand, Foot and Mouth Disease | TVS+.
article.articleSummary: Porangaba, São Paulo, Brazil – 40 confirmed Hand, Foot, and Mouth Disease (HFMD) cases reported at the Municipal Daycare João Guilherme Soares Bertin, leading to a two-day shutdown on October 15–16. With 195 enrolled children, classes are planned to resume on Monday, October 19, after guidance from Epidemiological Surveillance and Sanitary Surveillance and reinforced cleaning and hygiene measures. The municipality had initially reported 30 cases; the tally rose to 40. HFMD is a contagious viral infection mainly affecting children under five, spreading via respiratory secretions, feces, and contaminated objects; infected individuals may shed the virus in feces for weeks after recovery. Symptoms include fever, lesions on hands, feet, buttocks, and mouth ulcers, which can cause pain and swallowing difficulties. Preventive steps emphasize frequent handwashing, surface cleaning, avoiding sharing items, and seeking medical advice if symptoms appear to ensure a safe return to school.

triage.headline_ja: ポランガーバの保育園、手足口病40例確認後に授業再開へ
triage.triage_reason: 単一施設での手足口病集団発生で、小児の罹患数が増加しているものの重症例や死亡の報告はなく、国際的拡大の懸念も低いが、今後の推移を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 単一保育施設内での局所的な手足口病（EV71含むエンテロウイルス感染症）の集団発生。地域保健当局が対応しており、国レベルでの深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威とは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Governo de Goiás intensifica combate ao Aedes aegypti e convoca população a eliminar criadouros
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Goiás State Government steps up the fight against Aedes aegypti and calls on the population to eliminate breeding sites.
article.articleSummary: Goiás State, Brazil, intensifies actions against Aedes aegypti to curb dengue, chikungunya, and zika. Dengue has 108,673 confirmed cases, up 17% from the same period last year; chikungunya 11,311 confirmed, up 343%. Measures focus on home-source elimination of breeding sites and expanded vector surveillance. Ovitrap monitoring covers 104 municipalities with 5,736 traps installed. Larvicide dissemination stations (EDL) total 3,278 in 2026, with Caldas Novas receiving 2,000 units and Inhumas, Goianira, Senador Canedo, Trindade also equipped. Training for vector-control teams reached 592 participants from 161 municipalities (86% of target). Equipment includes 20 Ultra-Low-Volume fumacê devices, 372 manual and 709 motorized backpack sprayers; maintenance of nebulizers and sprayers; supplies: 2,800 Fludora sachets, 8,400 BTI units, 14,900 L Cielo. Wolbachia releases expanding: Valparaíso and Luziânia first; Anápolis began Oct 5; Aparecida de Goiânia and Trindade preparing. Dengue vaccination (Qdenga) for ages 10–14; 402,915 doses, 54.84% first-dose coverage; 39.91% of youths need second dose.

triage.headline_ja: ゴイアス州政府、ネッタイシマカ対策を強化し住民に発生源除去を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱・チクングニア熱の症例数が前年比で大幅増加（チクングニア+343%）しているが、ブラジルでは風土病的に流行しており、本記事は定例的な媒介昆虫対策の広報であり国際的拡大や渡航制限等の懸念は確認できない。
triage.notes: ブラジル・ゴイアス州での定例的な蚊媒介性感染症対策（デング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱）に関する政府広報記事。症例数増加はあるが風土病的状況であり、国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia meldet dritten bestätigten Fall von Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya reports third confirmed case of Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Kenya's Ministry of Health confirms the third Ebola case in the country, a 65-year-old relative of the first patient who had contracted Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and traveled to Kenya. The patient has been in quarantine since October 6, when Kenya reported its first Ebola case and first death; symptoms include fever, sore throat, and malaise. The second Kenyan case was also a relative of the initial patient and is in quarantine. The initial patient died in a Nairobi hospital; he had become ill in the DRC about a month earlier, crossed into Uganda by land, and flew from Kampala to Nairobi on October 3. Kenya has traced 130 contacts, with 127 under quarantine. In the DRC, Ebola cases exceed 9,000; this outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant, for which there is no licensed vaccine or established treatment; several therapies are in trials.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアで3例目のエボラ確定症例を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のエボラ（ブンディブギョ株）がウガンダ経由でケニアに越境伝播し、死亡例・二次感染例も確認されており、IHR基準に複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にケニア・ウガンダが含まれるが、対象国リストに該当しないため除外。DRCでの流行（9000例超、ブンディブギョ株、ワクチン未承認）が本イベントの発生源として対象国に該当するため記載。

article.articleHeadline: Schistosomiasis Disease Symptoms and Treatment
article.articleSummary: Schistosomiasis, also called bilharziasis, is caused by six blood flukes that require freshwater snails and human hosts for their life cycle. It is prevalent in tropical regions with poor sanitation in South America, Africa, Asia, and the Caribbean; Corsica's 2013 outbreak highlights regional risk. Transmission occurs when larvae in water penetrate the skin during swimming or bathing, after which eggs lodge in organs. The six species include S. mansoni (most common; liver damage; Africa, South America; over 80 million infected), S. haematobium (bladder and urinary tract; Africa), S. japonicum (liver/intestines; China, Philippines), S. intercalatum (Gabon, DRC, Cameroon), S. guineensis (West/Central Africa), and S. mekongi (Mekong, Cambodia/Laos). Acute Katayama syndrome may appear weeks after exposure (rash, fever, cough, itch). Chronic disease causes abdominal pain, hepatomegaly, blood in urine or stool, and urinary/genital complications, potentially lasting years. Early treatment is essential; abroad exposure means non-endemic in US.

triage.headline_ja: 住血吸虫症の症状と治療について
triage.triage_reason: 一般的な疾患解説記事であり、特定の新規アウトブレイクや急性の公衆衛生事象を報じるものではない。
