article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확진 9천명 넘어...지원금 9천억원 행방 '깜깜'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceed 9,000; whereabouts of 900 billion won in aid funds remain unknown.
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to surge in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 9,212 confirmed cases and 4,441 deaths (case fatality 48.2%) as of Oct 13 since the May outbreak declaration. Donor funding totaling about $962 million has been earmarked for the response through international agencies and NGOs, but only 30% of reporting bodies contributed financial data, disclosing roughly $220 million. About $700 million (roughly 934 billion won) remains unaccounted, though Africa CDC Director Jean Kaseya said it is too early to accuse embezzlement and a full reconciliation of funds, expenditures, and balances will be pursued. Suspected Ebola cases have emerged in North Ubangi Province. Kenya has confirmed its third Ebola case, a relative of the first Kenyan patient who died, infected after traveling to DRC and identified during contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴのエボラ確診者数が9,000人を突破…9,000億ウォンの支援金の行方は「不明」
triage.triage_reason: DRCでのエボラ流行が9,000例超・致死率48%と深刻化し、ケニアへの国際的拡大（3例目確認）も発生しているため、IHR基準を複数満たしフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ケニアでの感染拡大が報告されているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsから除外。資金管理の不透明さ（約7億ドルの行方不明）も国際的関心事項として特記される。

article.articleHeadline: Amritsar: Fogging stepped up; watch out for symptoms: Health officials - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Dengue in Amritsar, Punjab, India is the focus of intensified fogging under the Punjab Government’s 'Har Shukarwar, Dengu Te war' campaign in government schools and other hotspots. District epidemiologist Dr. Harjot Kaur, speaking at Government Senior Secondary School, Gawal Mandi, said stagnant water creates ideal Aedes aegypti breeding grounds and urged residents to inspect homes every Friday to prevent water accumulation in air coolers, refrigerator trays, flowerpots, tanks, rooftops and other containers. Residents should wear full-sleeved clothing and use mosquito repellents to reduce bites; fogging aims to curb transmission. Amardeep Singh, District Mass Education and Information Officer, described dengue as a viral disease transmitted by Aedes aegypti. Symptoms include high fever, headache, muscle and joint pain, pain behind the eyes, vomiting, and potentially bleeding from the nose, mouth or gums. Central message: preventing breeding is the most effective control strategy and requires public cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: アムリトサル：燻煙対策を強化、症状に注意を呼びかけ：保健当局
triage.triage_reason: インドのパンジャブ州で毎年発生する季節性デング熱に対する定例の公衆衛生啓発・防除活動の記事であり、異常性や深刻な公衆衛生インパクトを示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 毎年恒例の季節性デング熱対策キャンペーンに関する記事で、症例数や死亡者数などの具体的な規模を示す情報はない。地方自治体による通常の予防活動であり、異常な拡大や深刻な影響を示唆する記述はない。

article.articleHeadline: Carlos Alberto de Nóbrega é internado para investigar possível infecção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Carlos Alberto de Nóbrega is hospitalized to investigate a possible infection.
article.articleSummary: Carlos Alberto de Nóbrega, a 90-year-old Brazilian television host, is hospitalized at Hospital Sírio-Libanês in São Paulo to investigate a possible Coxsackie virus infection. Reported as of 16 October 2026, his condition prompted testing after months of fatigue and malaise, initially attributed to age. He is under cardiology and infectious disease care, awaiting imaging, cardiac evaluations, and serological tests. Laboratory work and tests for several viral agents showed results suggestive of Coxsackie infection. Coxsackie is an enterovirus transmitted via respiratory secretions, contaminated surfaces, and the fecal-oral route, and can affect adults. Symptoms span fever, malaise, and muscle aches, with potential complications including myocarditis and pericarditis. Diagnosis and assessment of complications depend on ongoing testing and clinical follow-up. The update underscores the importance of investigating persistent symptoms rather than attributing them to aging. Keywords: Coxsackie, myocarditis, pericarditis, São Paulo, hospitalization.

article.articleHeadline: Prefeitura de Mogi das Cruzes alerta sobre risco de raiva transmitida por morcegos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mogi das Cruzes City Hall warns about the risk of rabies transmitted by bats.
article.articleSummary: Rabies risk from bats in Mogi das Cruzes, Brazil, highlighted by the City Hall. Rabies is a fatal infectious disease affecting mammals, including humans. In Brazil, from 2016 to 2026, 37 human rabies cases were recorded, all from sylvatic virus variants; 22 involved bats. Prevention centers on avoiding direct contact with bats, especially if found on the ground, indoors, or behaving abnormally. People should keep distance and contact the Center for Zoonosis Control (CCZ) at (11) 4798-7456 or via WhatsApp at (11) 99897-9307 for guidance; do not touch or handle bats. Domestic animals should be vaccinated; vaccination is offered free year-round by CCZ at Rua Julio Mobaid, s/nº, Vila São Francisco, Mon-Fri (excluding holidays) 8:00–11:30 and 13:00–16:30. First dog/cat vaccine at 3 months, boosters every 12 months. If exposed, wash wounds and seek health care.

article.articleHeadline: Anchor Worm Parasite Thrives in Warm Waters of Philippine Lake, Study Finds
article.articleSummary: Anchor worm Lernaea cf. cyprinacea infects Naujan white goby in Naujan Lake, Philippines. Adult females anchor into host tissue, with fins (dorsal/pectoral) as primary attachment sites; gill and opercular attachments rise during the wet season. The parasite’s life cycle includes free-living nauplius and copepodid stages; infection is strongly temperature-dependent. In Naujan Lake, prevalence peaks in May–June with warm temperatures and declines Oct–Feb, but infections persist year-round in tropical lakes, implying non-stop biosecurity needs for aquaculture. Larger fish carry heavier parasite burdens due to greater surface area, longer exposure, and maturation-related changes; broodstock programs selecting large fish pose higher introduction risk into hatcheries. Management suggests collecting fish smaller than 10 cm during cooler months to exploit lower transmission. Epidemiological metrics used include prevalence, mean intensity, mean abundance, and mean crowding to describe aggregation and inform targeted removal of heavily infected hosts.

article.articleHeadline: Kenya records third Ebola case, linked to first patient who died - British Caribbean News
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its third Bundibugyo virus disease case, a strain of Ebola linked to the DRC outbreak, ten days after reporting its first case in Nairobi. The latest confirmed case is a 65-year-old woman, a primary contact and close relative of the first two cases, in quarantine since Oct 6. After fever, sore throat and malaise, she tested positive and is in isolation receiving supportive care. Kenya’s outbreak is tied to the DRC epidemic, the second-largest on record with more than 9,000 cases and over 4,300 deaths since May. The first Kenyan case involved a man who was ill in the DRC, traveled to Nairobi via Uganda on Oct 3, and died Oct 5. Authorities say no community spread and low risk; 127 of 130 contacts have been traced. Bundibugyo has no licensed vaccine; vaccines are in early testing. In the DRC, two new cases were reported in North Ubangi, the eighth province affected, not yet officially announced.

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تسجل ثالث إصابة بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya records its third Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Kenya reported its third Ebola case on October 16, 2026: a 65-year-old woman with close links to the initial patients. She had been in quarantine since October 6, exhibited fever, sore throat, and malaise, and was isolated and tested, with a diagnosis confirmed in an early stage. She is currently receiving medical care. The Kenyan cases are linked to an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, which has recorded more than 9,000 infections and over 4,000 deaths to date. Ebola spreads through direct contact with body fluids of infected people, whether living or deceased, and can cause fever, vomiting, and diarrhea; severe cases may involve internal and external bleeding. The Congo outbreak, declared mid-May, is driven by the rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there are no approved vaccines or treatments at present.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : au Kenya, un troisième cas détecté en quarantaine
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: In Kenya, a third case detected in quarantine.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a third Ebola case, raising total infections to three with one death, tied to the first patient who died October 5 after traveling from the Democratic Republic of Congo. A second case—the 39-year-old man and a 65-year-old woman, relatives of the first patient—was confirmed on October 14. The new patient was already in quarantine when symptoms appeared; by October 16, 127 of 130 identified contacts were quarantined and monitored daily for 21 days. Early detection and isolation limit community transmission. The patients receive supportive care in dedicated units; the second patient is stable. No licensed vaccine nor specific treatment exists for the Bundibugyo Ebola strain; trials are underway in the DRC. About 5,000 Kenyan health workers have been trained; WHO provided equipment and roughly $70,000 in materials. Kenya remains open; no border closures are advised, with contact tracing and quarantine central to containment.

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Kenya records third case, continues contact tracing
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms a third Ebola case after a 65-year-old woman tested positive in quarantine; she is a close relative of Kenya's first patient, a 40-year-old man who died on Oct 5 after arriving from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). The second patient, a 39-year-old man from the same family, remains stable. All three cases are linked to the initial patient with no evidence of community transmission; 128 contacts have been identified, 113 located, 15 outstanding, and three contacts of the initial patient remain unaccounted for per AP. The initial case traveled from DRC via Uganda to Nairobi. The DRC Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak has recorded 7,890 confirmed cases and 3,799 deaths as of Sept 23, with Bundibugyo as a distinct Ebola strain lacking a specific approved vaccine or treatment. Nigeria is bolstering preparedness for possible importation of the virus.

article.articleHeadline: La gestion des épidémies d'Ebola par l'engagement communautaire analysée dans une thèse​ - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Management of Ebola Epidemics Through Community Engagement Analyzed in a Thesis - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease management is analyzed in a doctoral thesis presented in Kinshasa on 16 October 2026 by Dr Dieudonné Mwamba Kazadi, director-general of the Institut National de Santé Publique (INSP). Defended at the University of Montreal, Canada, the work titled ‘Improving the management of Ebola epidemics through community engagement and consideration of psychological distress within a One Health approach in the Democratic Republic of Congo’ emphasizes community involvement and mental health as core to outbreak response within a human–animal–environment health framework. The jury awarded an excellence distinction, underscoring the critical role of local communities and psychological support in crisis management. The study signals strengthened research and epidemic response capacity in the DRC, with implications for One Health–based strategies against Ebola.

article.articleHeadline: Zambia players to miss several NWSL games due to Ebola travel restrictions
article.articleSummary: Zambia internationals Barbra Banda (Orlando Pride), Racheal Kundananji (Chicago Stars), and Prisca Chilufya (Angel City FC) will miss several weeks of NWSL games after the Oct. 8 match in Uganda due to a 21-day U.S. entry ban tied to the Ebola outbreak. The CDC restricts entry for foreign nationals who have been in Uganda in the prior 21 days; re-entry windows could extend to about Oct. 30, with the regular season ending Nov. 1. The NWSL says players are in excellent health as clubs coordinate with U.S. immigration. CDC rules also affect travel from DR Congo; Ivory Coast played DR Congo this month, and Rosemonde Kouassi of Washington Spirit joined Ivory Coast for the second leg, then returned to Washington. Banda is the league’s second-leading scorer with 17 goals; Chilufya has 5 goals and 1 assist in 24 games; Kundananji recently moved from Bay FC to Chicago Stars.

article.articleHeadline: Gabi Dallacostah é internada na UTI após infecção durante tratamento
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gabi Dallacostah is admitted to the ICU after contracting an infection during treatment.
article.articleSummary: 32-year-old Brazilian actress Gabi Dallacostah was admitted to the ICU in Brazil after developing a bloodstream infection during chemotherapy for breast cancer. The ICU transfer was described as preventive and necessary following the infection identified during treatment. A public update via her press team noted intensive monitoring in the ICU and asked for positive support from fans and the media during recovery. Dallacostah disclosed the breast cancer diagnosis in June, initiating aggressive chemotherapy regimens described as 'red and white' chemotherapy. In Brazilian television, she has appeared in TV Globo productions such as Verdades Secretas 2 and the telenovela Fuzuê, and participated in season 3 of the reality show Túnel do Amor. The article does not report any deaths and emphasizes ongoing care and privacy during recuperation.

article.articleHeadline: Kenya records two linked Ebola cases, no evidence of community spread
article.articleSummary: Two linked Bundibugyo Ebola infections were confirmed in Kenya, including one death, with no evidence of wider community transmission as of 16 October 2026. The first case was a Kenyan man who had lived in the Democratic Republic of Congo and entered Nairobi via Uganda on 3 October; he tested positive and died on 5 October. A second case, confirmed on 14 October, involved a 39-year-old close family member identified as a contact, placed in quarantine, and who developed fever, fatigue and joint pain before testing positive. Health officials say the infections are linked, with secondary transmission confined to monitored contacts. Kenya has 334 suspected Ebola cases and 128 contacts for the first patient (108 in quarantine, 15 untraced, five abroad). The Public Health Act enables screening and isolation; the WHO notes a single case can trigger an outbreak, but 42 days without new cases can end it.

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Records Third Ebola Case Linked to First Patient Who Died
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a third Bundibugyo Ebola case linked to the first two infections. A 65-year-old woman, a primary contact and close relative, developed fever, sore throat and malaise; she was isolated on October 6 and tested positive for Ebola. She is in quarantine receiving supportive care; 127 of 130 contacts have been traced and quarantined, with no signs of community transmission and the risk to the Kenyan public deemed low. The initial case involved a man who fell ill in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, traveled through Uganda, and flew to Nairobi before dying on October 5. Kenya’s cases are tied to the Congo outbreak, the second-largest on record with more than 9,000 cases and over 4,300 deaths since May. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine; new cases have emerged in North Ubangi province, DRC. Funding transparency concerns persist regarding Ebola response funds.

article.articleHeadline: Hepatitis B and C in Hainan: reported incidence trends diverge from
article.articleSummary: Hainan, China’s tropical island province and major international tourist destination, shows divergent hepatitis B (HBV) and hepatitis C (HCV) incidence trends from national estimates during 2005–2020. HBV incidence fell 2005–2008 (-9.1%/yr), rose 2008–2018 (+10.5%/yr), and then declined non-significantly to 2020, yielding an overall AAPC of +3.37%. HCV incidence rose 2005–2015 (+32.1%/yr) and declined 2015–2020 (-10.9%/yr), with an overall AAPC of +14.54%. National Global Burden of Disease estimates for China show HBV at -0.54% and HCV at -1.52% over longer periods. The analysis uses 192 monthly observations (Jan 2005–Dec 2020), incidence per 100,000 permanent residents, and contextual tourism/population data, finding no meaningful seasonality for either virus. Authors caution that provincial trends reflect historical reporting patterns rather than progress toward WHO elimination goals, noting that improved screening and treatment may influence trends while undiagnosed infections remain a barrier.

article.articleHeadline: El ébola amenaza con extenderse a una octava provincia en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola threatens to spread to an eighth province in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola threatens to spread to an eighth province in the Democratic Republic of the Congo after a suspected case in Nord-Ubangi, a border region with the Central African Republic. A field rapid test was positive, but samples were sent to the National Institute of Biomedical Research (INRB) in Kinshasa for formal confirmation, which remains pending. Despite the lack of official confirmation, response teams have activated preventive protocols focusing on contact tracing and case finding, with ongoing coordination among local leaders, police and the army to raise awareness. If Nord-Ubangi is added, eight provinces would be affected; seven provinces and 65 health zones have reported confirmed cases since this nineteenth outbreak was declared last May. The outbreak is the second deadliest globally, with over 9,200 infections and more than 4,400 deaths (approx. 48% fatality). The Bundibugyo Ebola strain has no specific treatment; two vaccines are in human trials, with distribution possibly months away. Cross-border spillovers include Uganda; imported cases in Kenya, France and the Netherlands.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、コンゴ民主共和国で8番目の州への拡大の恐れ
triage.triage_reason: 進行中の大規模エボラアウトブレイク（第19次、致死率約48%）が新たな州（北ウバンギ）へ拡大の疑いがあり、既に複数国への越境感染も確認されているため、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当する。
triage.notes: 既にケニア・フランス・オランダ・ウガンダへの越境・輸入症例が報告されているが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めていない。北ウバンギ州の症例は迅速検査陽性のみでINRBによる確定診断は未了。

article.articleHeadline: Autoridades de Kenia aseguran que el riesgo de ébola sigue siendo bajo tras detectar un tercer caso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Authorities in Kenya say that the risk of Ebola remains low after detecting a third case.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms a third Ebola case: a 65-year-old woman, a primary contact and close relative of the first imported case from the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). She developed fever, sore throat and malaise after quarantine began October 6 and tested positive, now in the Infectious Diseases Unit receiving supportive care. The second case is a family member; the index patient, a 40-year-old man who resided in the DRC, traveled to Kenya via Kampala (Uganda) and Nairobi, landing October 3 and dying October 5. Of 130 identified contacts, 127 (97.7%) have been traced and quarantined; three remain under follow-up. No evidence of community transmission; public risk remains low. Kenya has distributed PPE, infection prevention/control supplies, and public health screening equipment to 28 high-risk counties and entry points. Since May 15, 685,027 tests have been conducted.

triage.notes: 確認されている症例自体はケニアで発生しているが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。指標症例がDRC在住者でありウガンダ経由で輸入された経緯から、感染源国としてDRCのみを含めた。ケニア・ウガンダでの発生は対象国外のため評価対象から除外している点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Quênia confirma segundo caso de Ébola, mas afasta risco de transmissão comunitária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya confirms second case of Ebola, but rules out risk of community transmission.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms a second Ebola infection, with no evidence of community transmission. The patient is a 39-year-old man, a direct relative of the first Kenyan case, who was in quarantine and monitored when testing positive. Kenya has traced 113 of 128 close contacts. Last week Kenya reported its first Ebola death; the victim contracted the disease in the Democratic Republic of Congo, traveled by land to Kampala, Uganda, and flew to Nairobi on October 3, dying October 5. The outbreak epicenter remains Ituri Province, DR Congo, with thousands of cases and hundreds in isolation. The current surge is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which there are no approved vaccines or proven therapies. Ervebo (Zaire strain) is used for frontline staff, but cross-protection is unproven. The EU's ECDC considers importation to Europe extremely low, though sporadic introductions cannot be ruled out.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアでエボラ出血熱の2例目感染を確認、ただし地域感染のリスクは否定
triage.triage_reason: DRC（イツリ州）を震源とするエボラ（スーダン/ブンディブギョ株）流行が既に国境を越えてケニアへ拡大し死亡例も発生しており、IHR基準複数該当かつ国際的な懸念が高いため。
triage.notes: ケニア・ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。震源地であるDRCのみを計上した。ワクチン・治療法未承認のブンディブギョ株による流行拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: 七旬婦染類鼻疽病逝 與其他個案無關連 - 20261017
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Elderly woman in her seventies dies of melioidosis; not linked to other cases - 20261017.
article.articleSummary: An elderly woman in her seventies died of melioidosis in Hong Kong; she developed fever and cough earlier in the month, progressing to dyspnea before death during hospitalization. The Centre for Health Protection is investigating the infection source; initial epidemiology suggests a sporadic, unlinked case with no evidence of transmission to or from previously confirmed cases. Melioidosis is not typically transmitted person-to-person or animal-to-human, but the bacterium can persist in the local environment. Authorities urge high-risk groups—diabetics, the elderly, and immunocompromised individuals—to seek prompt medical evaluation for diagnosis and treatment, and to maintain personal and environmental hygiene to prevent infection. After typhoons or heavy rain, avoid soil or muddy water to reduce exposure. Hong Kong remains endemic for melioidosis; as of Oct 15, 2026, 9 cases have been recorded this year, with 21 cases in 2025.

triage.headline_ja: 七旬婦人、類鼻疽病で死亡 他の症例との関連なし - 20261017
triage.triage_reason: 香港では類鼻疽（メリオイドーシス）は既知の風土病であり、本件は孤発例で他症例との関連もない。人-人感染もなく、公衆衛生上の新たな脅威とはみなされない。
triage.notes: 香港は類鼻疽の風土病地域であり、2026年は10月15日時点で9例、2025年は21例が報告されている。本件は孤発例であり、既存の監視・対応体制内で管理可能と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: كينيا تعلن تسجيل ثالث إصابة بفيروس "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya reports its third Ebola virus infection.
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports its third Ebola virus disease (EVD) infection, a 65-year-old woman who had close contact with two earlier cases linked to the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) outbreak. She was under quarantine since Oct 6; once she developed fever, sore throat, and malaise, she was isolated and samples were taken, with laboratory confirmation obtained early. The Kenyan cases are connected to the DRC Ebola transmission, where the first Kenyan case involved a man who had lived in the DRC before returning home. Kenya announced a second infection last week, and authorities emphasize there is no evidence of widespread transmission and that early detection reduces onward spread. As of Oct 16, 2026, three Ebola infections have been recorded in Kenya, with ongoing monitoring and containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、3例目のエボラウイルス感染を報告
triage.triage_reason: DRCで発生中のエボラアウトブレイクに起因し、ケニアへの越境伝播（3例目確認）が報告されており、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生上の深刻性からフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 本事例はケニアでの3例目のエボラ感染だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。感染源であるDRCのアウトブレイクが主題として明確に言及されているためDRCのみを verified_locations に計上。国境を越えた感染拡大が確認されており、WHO及び近隣国との連携した対応状況の続報を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Zastrašujuće vesti iz Afrike: Ebola ne prestaje da se širi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alarming news from Africa: Ebola continues to spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to spread in Africa. A 65-year-old Kenyan woman in quarantine since 6 October has tested positive for Ebola, presenting with fever, sore throat, and malaise and is receiving supportive therapy after early diagnosis. Kenya’s cases are linked to the Congo outbreak, the world’s second-largest, with over 9,000 cases and more than 4,000 deaths. The first Kenyan case was recorded last week: a man ill in Congo who traveled by land to Uganda and arrived in Nairobi on 3 October, dying on 5 October. The European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control warns the outbreak remains a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, with response hindered in remote areas. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no licensed vaccines or specific treatments exist. The Ervebo vaccine is used for frontline workers against other strains, but its protection against Bundibugyo is unknown. EU importation risk remains very low.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカから衝撃のニュース：エボラの拡大が止まらない
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ由来のエボラ(ブンディブギョ株)がウガンダ経由でケニアへ越境拡大し、死亡例・新規感染確認を含む国際的拡大が確認されているため、IHR基準複数該当でフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ケニアおよびウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし感染源であるDRCは対象国に該当するため記載。ワクチン・治療薬が未確立のブンディブギョ株であり、PHEICとして既に国際的懸念が表明されている点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: Quais os riscos de consumir alimentos que tiveram contato com rato?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: What are the risks of consuming foods that have come into contact with a rat?
article.articleSummary: In Porto Alegre, southern Brazil, a dead rat was found inside a cake at a bakery on Wednesday, Oct 14, triggering inspections of two establishments in Zona Sul and the city center, and the 41-year-old owner was arrested on suspicion of a crime against consumer relations. Infectious-disease expert Danise Senna Oliveira notes rodents can carry pathogens such as Salmonella, but consumption of a possibly contaminated food does not always cause illness; outcomes depend on storage, pathogens, and host immunity. Contamination can occur via rodent urine or feces or kitchen utensils and may be invisible to the eye. Symptoms may include nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, and abdominal pain, warranting medical care if they appear. Leptospirosis and hantavirus are discussed but are not primarily transmitted by ingestion; urban rats are less associated with these pathogens. The owner says the rat was not placed intentionally; the working hypothesis is the rodent fell into the cake mold inside the oven during preparation.

triage.headline_ja: ネズミに接触した食品を摂取するリスクとは?
triage.triage_reason: 単一のパン屋での食品汚染事例であり、感染症のアウトブレイクではなく一般的な衛生啓発記事のため、公衆衛生上の脅威や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 記事は単一のパン屋でのネズミ混入事件に関する衛生啓発・一般的なQ&A記事であり、実際の感染症患者の発生は報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak update through October 14
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak update through Oct 14, 2026: 65 new confirmed cases across Ituri (31), North Kivu (28), Haut-Uélé (5), Tshopo (1); 15 deaths in Ebola Treatment Centers (ETCs) (Ituri 6, North Kivu 6, Tshopo 2, Haut-Uélé 1) bringing period deaths to 37. 38 recoveries (Ituri 18, North Kivu 15, Haut-Uélé 5) after negative twice. Cumulative totals: 9,277 confirmed cases and 4,478 deaths (case fatality rate 48.3%). Ituri remains epicenter with 73.4% of cumulative cases and 47.7% of last 24-hour new cases. By date, 65 of 167 health zones (38.9%) across seven provinces affected since start. The 2026 Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in DRC is the 17th recorded Ebola outbreak there and the largest and deadliest to date, caused by Bundibugyo virus (BDBV); no licensed vaccine or specific treatment; ongoing challenges include insecurity, mobility, surveillance and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行状況アップデート(10月14日時点)
triage.triage_reason: DRCで過去最大規模・最悪のエボラ流行が継続中であり、累計9,277症例・致死率48.3%と深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大や渡航制限のリスクも否定できないためフルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: 2026年ブンディブジョ型エボラ(BDBV)流行はDRC史上最大・最悪規模で、167保健区のうち65区（38.9%）、7州に拡大。ワクチン・特効治療なし、治安・住民協力の課題あり。継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ludhiana sees over 80 malaria cases, Health Dept steps up surveillance - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Ludhiana district has reported over 80 malaria cases so far in 2026. Health Department conducted extensive anti-malaria surveillance and larvae-checking drive across Ludhiana on Friday, visiting residential areas as well as government and private offices to identify and eliminate potential mosquito breeding sites. Residents were sensitised on maintaining a clean and dry environment. Civil Surgeon Ramandeep Kaur stressed sustained surveillance and collective responsibility, urging all residents and office administrations to inspect premises and remove stagnant water, as even small amounts can become breeding grounds for malaria mosquitoes. The Dry Day practice is urged every Friday, focusing on checking water-holding objects such as coolers, water tanks, flowerpots, tyres, containers, and other potential sources. Eliminating breeding sites at the source remains a key measure to prevent malaria transmission.

triage.headline_ja: ルディアナでマラリア症例80件超、保健局がサーベイランス強化 - The Tribune
triage.triage_reason: 地域流行性感染症の季節的な発生であり、通常の公衆衛生対応（サーベイランス強化・ボウフラ駆除）が実施されている。異常性や国際的拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: マラリアはインドの一部地域で地方流行性の疾患であり、本記事は通年の予防的サーベイランス活動を報じるもの。症例数の急増や重症例、死亡例の報告はなく、通常の公衆衛生対応の範囲内と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Over $700m In Ebola Funds Unaccounted For In DRC - Africa CDC
article.articleSummary: Donor funds for Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) are largely unaccounted for, Africa CDC said in a communiqué on Oct 15, 2026. International donors disbursed about $962 million directly to international organizations and NGOs, with none paid to the Congolese government. Only about 30% of implementing organizations attended a meeting to provide financial information; those present reported receiving approximately $22, of which $120 million had been spent and $100 million remained available for response activities. The unaccounted total exceeds $700 million in information available to Congolese authorities, described as a major transparency and reporting failure. Africa CDC will work with the government to reconcile funding, identify amounts received per organization, document expenditures, and determine financed activities. It warned of administrative or regulatory measures against non-compliant groups and potential sharing of names with authorities in other African countries. No evidence of theft or embezzlement was given.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対策資金、7億ドル以上の使途不明 - アフリカCDC
triage.triage_reason: 記事はエボラ対応資金の会計・透明性に関する報道であり、新規症例数や流行状況など疫学的な変化を示す情報が含まれていないため、IHR・WPROいずれの基準にも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はエボラ対応資金の使途不明・透明性問題に関する報道であり、疾病自体の発生状況（症例数、重症度、拡大リスク等）についての情報は含まれていない。資金管理の問題は対応能力（manageability）への懸念として扱ったが、実際の流行状況を評価する材料はないためWATCHではなくDISMISSとした。

article.articleHeadline: Por la visita del Papa, la OPS alerta por el sarampión en Sudamérica: advierte un riesgo "muy alto" de propagación
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Because of the Pope's visit, PAHO issues a measles alert in South America: it warns of a 'very high' risk of spread.
article.articleSummary: PAHO issues a measles alert for South America ahead of the Pope’s visit, highlighting a resurgence amid mass religious gatherings and increased mobility. From Jan 4 to Oct 3, 2026, the Americas reported 55,792 confirmed measles cases and 77 deaths across 17 countries and territories, a 4.8-fold rise from the same period in 2025. About 99.5% of cases are concentrated in Guatemala, Mexico, the United States, Peru, and Canada; two 2025 outbreaks that evolved to community transmission originated in large religious gatherings. Argentina reports one case, with additional cases in Belice, Bolivia, Bonaire, Brazil, Chile, Colombia, Costa Rica, El Salvador, Honduras, Panama, and Uruguay. Health risk is high; regional spread risk is very high, with highly probable occurrence and major consequences due to insufficient prevention and control. Vaccination gaps persist: 2025 regional coverage was 88% for the first dose and 85% for the second, leaving ~1.6 million children unvaccinated. Emphasis on two-dose MMR and active traveler surveillance with 21-day monitoring for fever and rash.

triage.headline_ja: 教皇訪問を機にPAHOが南米ではしかについて警告：拡大リスクは「非常に高い」と警鐘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準のうち深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な増加、国際的拡大リスクの3つが該当し、PAHOが地域規模で警告を発していることから社会的・行政的関心も高いと判断される。
triage.notes: 記事は南米全域（主にグアテマラ、メキシコ、米国、ペルー、カナダに99.5%集中）の麻疹流行に関するPAHO警告が主題。対象国リストの中ではブラジルのみ追加症例国として明示的に言及されている。その他の対象国（フィリピン、タイ、ガーナ、DRC、インドネシア、中国、ミャンマー、ベトナム、インド、ザンビア）への言及はない。

article.articleHeadline: J&K reviews TB elimination programme, focuses on high-risk areas
article.articleSummary: Jammu and Kashmir reviews TB Mukt Bharat Abhiyan under NTEP; meeting chaired by Sumeet Kumar Jarangal (DPIIT) and Prabhari Officer for J&K. The session in Srinagar was attended by NHM J&K Mission Director, health directors, STOs, CMOs, DTOs, and NHM staff. Focus on expanding screening at the grassroots, strengthening diagnostic networks, and patient tracking via the Ni-kshay portal. Measures include stronger field-level operations, differentiated TB care, and improved access to nutritional support to reduce TB illness and deaths. Emphasis on stronger coordination between the J&K administration and MoH&FW to identify and address implementation gaps; intensified screening in high-risk villages; population mapping; X-ray coverage in high-risk areas; better use of diagnostic facilities; and timely disbursement of Ni-kshay Poshan Yojana nutrition via direct benefit transfer. Ni-kshay Mitras and MY Bharat volunteers participation noted. District teams urged to close gaps and accelerate progress toward national TB elimination targets.

triage.headline_ja: ジャンム・カシミール州、結核撲滅プログラムを見直し、高リスク地域に重点を置く
triage.triage_reason: 通常の行政レビュー会議に関する記事であり、新規の異常事態や公衆衛生上の緊急性を示す情報はない。
triage.notes: 国家結核撲滅プログラム(NTEP)の定例的な行政レビュー会議の報告記事であり、新規感染拡大や異常事態を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Brucelose: Prefeitura reforça a saúde do rebanho bovino com vacinação nas comunidades indígenas | Roraima em Foco
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Brucellosis: Municipality strengthens the health of the cattle herd through vaccination in indigenous communities | Roraima in Focus
article.articleSummary: Brucellosis vaccination campaign in Boa Vista, Roraima, Brazil, targets calves in 17 indigenous communities. Bezerras (heifers) aged 3–8 months receive a mandatory single-dose vaccine, administered only by veterinarians or trained technicians. Municipal teams visit communities twice yearly (April and October), vaccinating roughly 250 animals per cycle; the Vanda Elias farm vaccinated 12 animals during this period. The initiative aims to maintain herd health and reduce public-health risks, while lowering operational costs by deploying qualified staff to remote areas. Two years ago, MAPA recognized Roraima as foot-and-mouth disease-free without vaccination; maintaining sanitary measures, including brucellosis vaccination, supports preserving that status. This approach prioritizes indigenous community health and supports Roraima's public-health and agricultural objectives.

triage.headline_ja: ブルセラ症：市役所が先住民族コミュニティでの予防接種で牛群の健康を強化｜Roraima em Foco
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・ロライマ州における日常的な家畜ワクチン接種事業の報告であり、ヒトの感染事例や異常な流行は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 通常の予防的家畜ワクチン接種プログラムに関する記事であり、疾病の発生や流行を報告するものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Otters Face a Hidden Parasite Burden, and Most Species Have Never Been
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-10-16, a Frontiers in Mammal Science systematic review finds otters harbor a hidden parasite burden. Across ten otter species, researchers catalogued 146 parasite genera (164 species) from five phyla. Eurasian otter Lutra lutra dominates literature (89 papers; 184 parasite species), followed by sea otter Enhydra lutris (79; 41) and North American river otter Lontra canadensis (47; 66); three species—smooth-coated Lutrogale perspicillata, hairy-nosed Lutra sumatrana, Congo clawless Aonyx congicus—have no published parasite data, and Lontra annectens has none. Protozoa include Toxoplasma gondii (in five otter species); prevalences: sea otters 12.6%, Eurasian otters 14.3%, North American river otters 29.2%, southern river otters 76.9% (small sample). Sarcocystis neurona 18.5% in sea otters; Neospora caninum 19.4%; co-infections 5.1%. Acanthocephalan Corynosoma enhydri reaches 84.4% in sea otters. Warmer temperatures link higher biliary trematode prevalence (Pseudamphistomum truncatum, Metorchis albidus) in Eurasian otters. The review screened 4,515 sources and 240 full papers.

triage.headline_ja: カワウソは隠れた寄生虫負担に直面しており、ほとんどの種は調査されたことがない
triage.triage_reason: 動物（カワウソ）における寄生虫の学術的系統レビューであり、ヒトの公衆衛生リスクや特定地域での発生事例を示すものではないため。
triage.notes: 本記事は学術誌Frontiers in Mammal Scienceに掲載されたカワウソの寄生虫に関する系統的レビューであり、特定の国・地域での発生事象ではない。発生地域にタイ（バンコク）やDRCが付与されているが、記事内容はこれら特定国での発生を示すものではなく、世界的な種の分布研究である。

article.articleHeadline: WHO urges vigilance in Kenya after second Ebola case
article.articleSummary: Kenya reports a second Ebola case; a 39-year-old man who is a close relative of the first case has been quarantined. WHO warns Kenya to maintain vigilance, with contact tracing extending to air and ground contacts and ongoing screening at points of entry; there are no travel restrictions or border closures advised, as there is no confirmed community transmission. The case comes amid an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) declared in May, with more than 4,000 deaths reported there. WHO Representative Neema Rusibamayila Kimambo commended rapid listing and quarantine of contacts and stressed that case management and infection prevention and control (IPC) in quarantine centres are critical. WHO has donated about $70,000 in IPC and laboratory supplies since the first case. Authorities urge prompt care for the sick and adherence to IPC measures to contain spread.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、ケニアで2例目のエボラ症例確認後に警戒を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで5月に宣言され4,000人超の死者を出しているエボラアウトブレイクに関連し、ケニアで2例目の症例が確認され、WHOが接触者追跡や入国時スクリーニングを強化していることから、国際的拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの2例目のエボラ症例確認だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ただし記事はDRCで進行中のアウトブレイク（5月宣言、4,000人超死亡）を直接の背景・発生源として詳述しており、DRCを発生国として含めた。ケニアでの人-人感染（近親者間）が疑われ、コミュニティ内伝播の有無が今後の重要な注視点。

article.articleHeadline: Anvisa autoriza nova fase de estudos da vacina contra malária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Anvisa authorizes a new phase of malaria vaccine trials.
article.articleSummary: Anvisa has authorized a new phase of malaria vaccine trials in Brazil. The vaccine, developed in Minas Gerais in collaboration with researchers from São Paulo, has moved to the next stage of clinical testing following regulatory clearance. The approval signals progress in the Brazilian effort to develop a malaria vaccine and could broaden future prevention options against the disease. The project underscores ongoing partnerships between institutions in Minas Gerais and São Paulo and reflects the country’s continued investment in locally produced solutions to malaria. Specific details on the trial phase, participant numbers, timelines, or interim results were not disclosed in the report. The article by Léo Apolinário and Daniel Camargo.

triage.headline_ja: Anvisa、マラリアワクチンの新たな治験段階を承認
triage.triage_reason: マラリアワクチンの治験承認に関する科学・規制ニュースであり、アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す内容ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はマラリア感染拡大や発生に関する報告ではなく、ワクチン開発の進捗に関する内容のためトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Carlos Alberto de Nóbrega é internado para investigar suspeita de infecção viral
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Carlos Alberto de Nóbrega is hospitalized to investigate suspected viral infection.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 October 2026, 90-year-old Brazilian TV host Carlos Alberto de Nóbrega was hospitalized at Hospital Sírio-Libanês in São Paulo to investigate a possible viral infection. His wife Renata de Nóbrega stated he is under observation and undergoing tests, with care from cardiologist Roberto Kalil and infectologist David Uip. The report notes a suspected Coxsackievirus infection, which can cause mild flu-like symptoms but may lead to more serious illnesses. He had been previously hospitalized in March for a mild pneumonia; the current admission is described as further diagnostic work. The hospitalization follows an intense filming period for a 90th-birthday special produced by SBT. No laboratory-confirmed diagnosis or infection source is reported, and there are no details about imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: カルロス・アルベルト・デ・ノーブレガ氏、ウイルス感染疑いで入院し検査へ
triage.triage_reason: 著名人個人の健康状態に関する報道であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生や拡大リスクを示す情報がないため。
triage.notes: 90歳の著名人1名の個別症例報道であり、インフルエンザや感染症のアウトブレイクを示すものではない。原因病原体もCoxsackievirus疑いで未確定。公衆衛生イベントとしての該当性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Living Near a Dumpsite Raises Malaria Risk in Ghana's Urbanising
article.articleSummary: In Ghana's Bono Region, six communities within Dormaa Central Municipality—Dormaa, Ahantrease, Kokorasua, ABB, Kofi Asua and Maasu—were studied using household surveys, malaria incidence records and GIS. The spatial analysis found malaria risk generally declines with increasing distance from open dumpsites, with a consistent inverse association between dumpsite proximity and malaria occurrence. Malaria case patterns varied by community: significant clustering in Dormaa and Ahantrease, dispersed patterns in Kokorasua, and near-random in Kofi Asua. Across all sites, children under ten showed the highest prevalence and pregnant women were often more affected. The suggested mechanism: unmanaged waste creates peridomestic larval habitats and shelters mosquitoes, extending transmission seasons in dense urban areas. The study, published in SN Social Sciences, highlights how unserviced waste fuels urban malaria in an expanding Ghana.

triage.headline_ja: ゴミ捨て場の近くに住むことがガーナの都市化が進む地域でマラリアリスクを高める
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は学術研究（既存のマラリア流行地域における環境要因の関連分析）であり、新規の異常なアウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事はガーナ・ボノ地域の既存マラリア流行に関する学術研究報告であり、新規アウトブレイクの報告ではない。地理情報にイタリア・サルデーニャ州が含まれているが、記事内容とは無関係（データ誤付与）。

article.articleHeadline: டெங்கு காய்ச்சலுக்கு பெண் உயிரிழப்பு
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death of a woman due to dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Chennai reports a dengue-related death, the first publicly acknowledged in the city after authorities had said there were no dengue deaths. Abinaya, 28, wife of Sadheeshkumar, resident of Kalimani Street, Karthikeyan Nagar, Maduravoyal in the Valasaravakkam zone, developed fever on Oct 8; dengue was confirmed on Oct 9. She was admitted to a Purasaivakkam hospital, received a blood transfusion, but platelets fell to 6,500 and she died on Oct 14, with her husband attributing the death to dengue. The Residents Welfare Association of Maduravoyal alleges inadequate dengue-control measures and a lack of medical camps. Health officials say a 14-member team carried out vector-control actions, including fogging, after the case was identified, and medical camps are planned.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱で女性が死亡
triage.triage_reason: チェンナイで単発のデング熱死亡例が報告されたが、大規模発生や国際的拡大の兆候はなく、既存のベクター対策対応がなされているため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 単一の死亡例であり、デング熱はインドで季節性に発生する既知の風土病。住民団体から対策不足の指摘があり地元での関心は見られるが、国際的な公衆衛生上のリスクや渡航・貿易制限の兆候は認められない。続報（死亡者数の増加や地域拡大）があればPICKUPへの引き上げを検討。

article.articleHeadline: WHO nâng mức độ sẵn sàng ứng phó dịch Ebola tại 22 quốc gia trên ba châu lục
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO Raises Ebola Outbreak Preparedness in 22 Countries Across Three Continents
article.articleSummary: WHO is strengthening Ebola preparedness across 22 countries and territories in the East Med region, with Djibouti, Somalia, and Sudan prioritized, amid conflict, displacement, and fragile health systems. Ebola outbreaks caused by the Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda have prompted intensified support; Kenya reports its first imported Ebola case linked to the DRC cluster. Although East Med has not yet recorded Ebola, ongoing hostilities and mass displacement impede surveillance, testing, and infection control. WHO Director-General Tedros Ghebreyesus called the region a humanitarian center of need. The World Bank on Oct 14 pledged $93 million for Ebola response in Africa: $80 million for DRC to boost surveillance, diagnostics, treatment, and infection prevention; $13 million for 11 countries to strengthen emergency readiness. In DRC, 9,066 confirmed cases and 4,381 deaths since May 2026 across seven provinces, notably Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、3大陸22か国でエボラ出血熱への対応準備レベルを引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: DRCで9,066例確定・4,381人死亡という大規模流行が進行中で、ウガンダでの発生やケニアへの輸入例も確認されており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・ウガンダ・ケニア・東地中海地域（ジブチ、ソマリア、スーダン等）に言及しているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。ウガンダ・ケニアでの発生は確認されているが対象国リスト外のため除外。世界銀行がDRC向けに8000万ドルの支援を表明するなど国際的関心・支援ニーズが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Mato Grosso do Sul registra aumento de casos graves de SRAG por metapneumovírus, aponta Fiocruz
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Mato Grosso do Sul records an increase in severe acute respiratory syndrome cases due to metapneumovirus, Fiocruz says.
article.articleSummary: Health authorities in Mato Grosso do Sul, Brazil, report an uptick in Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SRAG) attributed to human metapneumovirus, per Fiocruz InfoGripe. MS is among six Centro-Sul states at alert/risk/high-risk for SRAG, with no long-term growth trend over the past six weeks. The Week Epidemiological 40 report (4–10 Oct 2026) shows MS’s SRAG rise alongside Sao Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Espírito Santo and Paraná; in the Northeast, increases were seen in Alagoas, Bahia, Pernambuco and Sergipe. Nationally, only Sergipe shows an alert with a long-term growth trend. The surge is concentrated in children under two and linked to metapneumovirus. Vaccination guidance emphasizes keeping COVID-19 vaccines up to date for priority groups and vaccinating pregnant women against RSV. In 2026, Brazil recorded 163,241 SRAG cases, with 87,618 lab-confirmed for some respiratory virus (53.7%). Data may change as new results are added.

triage.headline_ja: マットグロッソ・ド・スル州、メタニューモウイルスによる重症急性呼吸器症候群(SRAG)症例の増加を記録、フィオクルスが指摘
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル複数州でヒトメタニューモウイルスによるSRAG症例増加が報告されているが、長期的な増加傾向はなく、既知の季節性呼吸器ウイルスによる通常の流行パターンの範囲内と考えられるため、経過観察とする。
triage.notes: Fiocruz InfoGripeによる定期サーベイランス報告。既知の病原体（hMPV、RSV、COVID-19）による季節性呼吸器疾患の増加であり、新興感染症のシグナルではない。2歳未満の小児に集中している点は注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Từ vụ 3 học sinh mắc não mô cầu nguy hiểm: Bác sĩ cảnh báo khẩn
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Following the case of three students contracting dangerous meningococcal meningitis: doctors issue an urgent warning.
article.articleSummary: Three students at Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School in Hiệp Phước commune, Ho Chi Minh City, have contracted meningococcal disease caused by Neisseria meningitidis group B; one died and two remain under treatment. Health authorities are tracing close contacts and implementing preventive measures to curb transmission. Meningococcal disease can present as meningitis or septicemia, with rapid progression and mortality. Most affected are children under 5 and youths 15–24; risk rises for unvaccinated, immunocompromised, smokers, and those in crowded settings. Transmission occurs via respiratory droplets and close contact. Incubation averages 3–4 days; early symptoms mimic flu but can deteriorate quickly. Case fatality ranges 8–15%, up to 40–50% in fulminant septicemia; survivors may have long-term sequelae such as deafness, vision loss, cognitive impairment, or limb necrosis. Close contacts should receive antimicrobial prophylaxis within 24 hours, along with vaccination and preventive measures. Seek care promptly for fever, severe headache, neck stiffness, or rash.

triage.headline_ja: 3名の学生が危険な髄膜炎菌性髄膜炎に感染した事件を受けて：医師が緊急警告
triage.triage_reason: 単一校内での髄膜炎菌感染クラスター（3名、うち1名死亡）で重症度は高いが、現時点で地域的拡大や国際的懸念は確認されず、続報を注視する段階。
triage.notes: 単一の中学校内でのクラスター事例であり、保健当局が接触者追跡・予防措置を実施中。髄膜炎菌性疾患は致死率が高く重症例を含むため医療的関心は高いが、現時点で学校外への拡大や国際的影響を示す情報はない。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola llega a Kenia; los tres casos confirmados se mantienen en cuarentena
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak reaches Kenya; the three confirmed cases remain in quarantine.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms a third Ebola case (Bundibugyo strain) in Nairobi, with all three cases in the same family under quarantine and no evidence of community transmission. The 65-year-old woman, a close contact of the first two cases, developed fever, sore throat, and malaise; she has been in quarantine since 6 October 2026, with samples taken for laboratory confirmation and transfer to the Infectious Diseases Unit for supportive care. Health authorities say the risk of community spread remains low. Of 130 identified contacts, 127 (97.7%) have been located and quarantined, exceeding the 85% global threshold to interrupt transmission. Kenya records one death and three Ebola infections linked to the outbreak circulating in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo, which has more than 4,500 deaths and 9,300 cases. As of 16 October 2026.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がケニアに到達、確認された3症例は検疫隔離中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準に複数該当（重篤な影響、異常性、国際的拡大）し、DRCの大規模流行（9300症例・4500死亡）からケニアへの越境伝播が確認されており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニアでの3症例確認だが、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。一方、感染源であるDRCでの大規模エボラ流行（9300症例・4500死亡）は対象国に該当し、実際の発生国として記載されているため含めた。ケニアでの越境事例は国際的拡大リスクの重要な証拠となる。

article.articleHeadline: Kenia confirma su tercer caso de ébola tras dar positivo una familiar del primer contagiado
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kenya confirms its third Ebola case after a relative of the first patient tested positive.
article.articleSummary: Kenya confirms its third Ebola case: a 65-year-old woman in quarantine as a direct contact of the index patient from the Democratic Republic of the Congo. She has been transferred to a specialized care unit; authorities report low population risk with no evidence of community transmission. After the first case's death, 130 contacts have been identified, with 97.7% in quarantine, surpassing the global target to interrupt transmission. Containment measures include distribution of personal protective equipment and outbreak control supplies across 28 high-risk counties and entry points. Since May, more than 685,000 people have been tested. The third case represents ongoing transmission linked to the DRC index case within Kenya.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、最初の感染者の親族が陽性となり3人目のエボラ感染例を確認
triage.triage_reason: DRC由来のエボラ指標症例からケニア国内で家族内二次感染（3例目）が発生しており、国境を越えた伝播が現実化しているためIHR基準を複数満たす。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はケニア国内での家族内二次感染（3例目）であり、ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations は空配列とした。DRCは指標症例の出身国として言及されているのみで、DRC国内での新規発生が記事の主題ではないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Memory T Cell Metabolism May Decide Who Keeps Tuberculosis at Bay
article.articleSummary: Memory T cell metabolism may determine who maintains control of latent TB. In remote latent Mycobacterium tuberculosis infection, four memory CD4+ T cell subsets circulating in blood—T-SCM, T-CM, T-TM, and T-EM—exhibit distinct metabolic programs. Donors from Brazil and North America were stimulated with Mtb antigens ESAT-6 and CFP-10; RNA-seq (~50 million reads per sample) identified >4,000 differentially expressed genes, revealing a differentiation gradient: T-SCM/T-CM show elevated mitochondrial activity and oxidative metabolism, with fatty acid oxidation and a citric acid diversion via the carnitine shuttle, supporting self-renewal; T-TM/T-EM exhibit glycolysis and pentose phosphate pathway activity. Met-Flow validated these shifts, with CPT1A high in T-SCM early, followed by G6PD and GLUT1, while T-TM/T-EM rapidly upregulate glycolytic enzymes. Functionally, T-TM/T-EM produce more IFN-γ; T-SCM/T-CM have higher IL-17. An antimycobacterial assay used Mtb Erdman-infected macrophages co-cultured with each subset to monitor bacterial burden over days 1, 3, and 5.

triage.headline_ja: メモリーT細胞の代謝が結核の制御を左右する可能性
triage.triage_reason: 基礎研究に関する記事であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や異常な感染拡大等の事象を示すものではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は免疫学的基礎研究（T細胞代謝と結核制御の関係）であり、実際の疾病発生イベントではない。ブラジル・北米のドナー検体を用いた研究で、特定地域での流行や公衆衛生上の懸念を示すものではない。

article.articleHeadline: Chikungunya em Feira de Santana: Casos confirmados passam de mil e SMS reforça capacitação de profissionais
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chikungunya in Feira de Santana: Confirmed cases exceed 1,000 and SMS reinforces professionals' training.
article.articleSummary: Feira de Santana reports 1,765 chikungunya notifications with 1,027 confirmed cases from January–September 2026, up from 29 notifications and 18 confirmations in the same period of 2025. The Municipal Health Secretariat has intensified training for public and private health teams to improve diagnosis, notification, and management of suspected chikungunya and other arboviruses, with an October 15, 2026 session targeting primary care and higher-level services. Priority neighborhoods are Queimadinha, Tomba, Mochila and Cidade Nova. RT-PCR is advised from days 1–5 after symptom onset; after day 6, serology may be used. Specimens are collected at Emergency Care Units (UPAs), the Specialized Health Care Center (CSE) in Ponto Central, and municipal polyclinics, then sent to the Central Public Health Laboratory (LACEN) for processing. Common symptoms include severe joint pain in the hands, wrists, ankles, and shoulders, plus fever, headache, myalgias, nausea, and rash. Surveillance and Aedes aegypti–vector control remain essential.

triage.headline_ja: フェイラ・デ・サンタナのチクングニア熱：確定症例が1,000人を超え、市保健局が専門家研修を強化
triage.triage_reason: 特定市内でチクングニア熱の症例が前年比で大幅増加しているが、国際的拡大や渡航制限の兆候はなく、情報は自治体レベルの局所的な内容に限られるため経過観察とする。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・バイーア州フェイラ・デ・サンタナ市における2026年1〜9月の症例急増（前年同期比約57倍）と市保健局の対応（研修強化、診断・報告体制整備）を報じている。死亡例や重症例の具体的数値、国際的拡大の情報はなく、局所的な公衆衛生対応の範囲にとどまる。

article.articleHeadline: Подозрение на оспу обезьян в двух регионах России: госпитализированы 10 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected monkeypox in two regions of Russia: 10 people hospitalized.
article.articleSummary: On 17 October 2026, Russia reports suspected monkeypox across two regions. Ten people hospitalized: five in Saint Petersburg and Leningrad Region under medical observation, and five in Moscow Region who were prophylactically hospitalized after contact with a person presumed infected; no symptoms among the Moscow contacts and their condition is satisfactory. Epidemiological investigation is identifying contacts, with disinfection orders issued and a full suite of anti-epidemic measures in place. Diagnostics rely on Rospotrebnadzor-registered test systems to rapidly detect monkeypox; laboratory confirmation is pending as the investigation continues. The situation is described as under control. The report also notes earlier precautions in Bali for international travelers to prevent monkeypox spread.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア2地域でサル痘疑い：10人が入院
triage.triage_reason: サンクトペテルブルクとモスクワ州でサル痘疑い例が報告され入院措置が取られているが、検査室での確定診断は未了であり、対象国（ロシア）はリスト外のため直接的な優先度は低いが、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性と疫学調査継続中のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域はロシア（サンクトペテルブルク、モスクワ州）であり、対象国リストに含まれないためverified_locationsは空。インドネシア（バリ）は渡航者への予防措置として言及されているのみで、実際の発生地域ではないため除外。検査確定前の疑い例であり続報を要する。

article.articleHeadline: 俄鼠疫疑云未解 中国多地疫情传闻引发关注
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Unresolved questions about Russia's plague; rumors of outbreaks across multiple parts of China have drawn attention.
article.articleSummary: Unconfirmed reports tie pneumonic plague to Russia's Irkutsk, where 28-year-old Darya Shipilova died Oct 2 of unclear severe pneumonia; this sparked speculation of a pneumonic plague outbreak and lab exposure. The WHO requested more information on Oct 7. In China, authorities in Qinghai, Inner Mongolia, Hunan, and Guangdong issued plague prevention tips amid the rumors; social media claimed pneumonic plague deaths in Shanghai and Chongqing among people who had arrived from Russia. In Sichuan's Chengdu, a fever patient who reportedly returned from Russia died; local disease control center says investigations are confidential and no plague cases have been confirmed; internet posts about nationwide cases remain unverified. In Ningxia, a villager reported suspected hemorrhagic fever (Hantavirus) cases, treated in Xi'an, but confirmation is lacking. Cross-border trade with Russia continues; Mongolia has stepped up border surveillance; the U.S. embassy warned about plague in Russia; experts warn opaque information may fuel panic.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト疑惑が未解決、中国各地で疫病の噂が注目を集める
triage.triage_reason: ロシア・中国にまたがる肺ペスト疑い事例が複数報告され、WHOが情報要請を行うなど国際的関心が高まっており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルRRAへの移行が妥当。
triage.notes: ロシア（イルクーツク州）での死亡例やモンゴルの国境監視強化が報じられているが、ロシア・モンゴルは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。中国国内（青海、内モンゴル、湖南、広東、四川、寧夏等）での疑い症例・予防措置が中心であり、いずれも未確認情報である点に留意が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 俄鼠疫疑雲未解 中國多地疫情傳聞引發關注
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The mystery surrounding the Russian plague remains unsolved; rumors of outbreaks in many parts of China have drawn attention.
article.articleSummary: Pneumonic plague rumors surged after a 28-year-old female lab worker at Russia's Irkutsk Anti-Plague Research Institute died Oct 2 from an undetermined severe pneumonia, fueling fears of pneumonic plague and possible lab exposure. WHO requested more details on Oct 7. Mongolia reported border screening; China’s Qinghai, Inner Mongolia, Hunan, and Guangdong issued plague-prevention notices. Social media claimed pneumonic plague deaths in Shanghai and Chongqing linked to Russia, but Sichuan authorities say there is no confirmed outbreak and only fever-trace inquiries are ongoing; Shuangliu District CDC notes such cases would be confidential. A Sichuan resident recalls a Russia-returned man who died; police warnings were reportedly issued. Ningxia villagers report suspected hemorrhagic fever (hantavirus) treated in Xi’an; diagnosis unconfirmed. China–Russia trade continues; US embassy warns travelers; analysts caution that opaque information fuels panic.

triage.headline_ja: ロシアのペスト疑惑が未解決のまま、中国各地での疫病流行の噂が注目を集める
triage.triage_reason: ロシアでの原因不明肺炎死亡とペスト流行の噂を発端に、中国複数省での予防通知やWHOの照会、米大使館の渡航注意喚起など国際的・社会的関心が急速に高まっているが、公式には未確認の情報が多く検証が必要。
triage.notes: ロシア（イルクーツク）での検査技師死亡とペスト疑惑が発端だが、ロシアは対象国リスト外のため除外。中国各省（青海、内モンゴル、湖南、広東、上海、重慶、四川、寧夏）では予防通知や噂が広がっているが、四川当局は確認された流行を否定しており、情報は未確認・流動的。続報の検証が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia players to miss multiple NWSL games due to CDC's Ebola travel restrictions
article.articleSummary: Ebola travel restrictions imposed by the CDC on foreign nationals who recently visited parts of Eastern Africa—specifically Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo—could sideline three Zambia internationals for weeks as they re-enter the United States after CAF Olympics qualifiers in Uganda. The Copper Queens played Oct 8 in Uganda and returned to Zambia by Oct 10; re-entry could trigger a 21-day quarantine, delaying their NWSL duties until around Oct 30, with the regular season ending Nov 1. The NWSL said it is coordinating with clubs and U.S. immigration; players are in good health. The affected players include Barbra Banda (Orlando Pride), Racheal Kundananji (Chicago Stars), and Prisca Chilufya (Angel City FC); Chilufya was listed excused in Friday's report. Banda scored twice as Zambia advanced 5-3 on aggregate. Separately, Ivory Coast forward Rosemonde Kouassi (Washington Spirit) did not travel to DR Congo first leg to avoid quarantine.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア代表選手、CDCのエボラ渡航制限によりNWSL複数試合を欠場へ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（DRC含む東アフリカ地域）に対するCDCの渡航制限が国際的なスポーツ活動に実際の影響を及ぼしており、IHR基準（深刻性・国際拡大・渡航制限）に複数該当するため。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行そのものではなく、DRC・ウガンダでの既知のエボラアウトブレイクに起因するCDC渡航制限がザンビア代表サッカー選手の米国再入国・NWSL出場に与える影響を扱った二次的報道。ザンビア自体での感染発生は言及されておらず、ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia women's national team players to miss NWSL games while undergoing Ebola travel restriction protocols - AOL
article.articleSummary: Three Zambian women's national team forwards—Barbra Banda (Orlando Pride), Prisca Chilufya (Angel City FC), and Racheal Kundananji (Chicago Stars)—will miss multiple NWSL games while adhering to U.S. CDC Ebola travel-restriction protocols for travelers from East Africa. After CAF Olympic qualification matches against Uganda (Oct 8 in Uganda) and in Zambia (Oct 13), Copper Queens must observe a 21-day waiting period before returning to the U.S., per CDC guidelines for non-U.S. citizens from Uganda, the Democratic Republic of Congo, and South Sudan. The 21-day window likely expires toward the end of October, potentially costing them at least two NWSL games, possibly all three matches on Nov 1 (Decision Day). Banda ranks second in the league with 17 goals this season, while Chilufya remains in playoff contention with Angel City; Kundananji’s Chicago Stars sit last. NWSL is coordinating with clubs and U.S. immigration for safe return; players are reported in excellent health.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア女子代表選手、米CDCのエボラ渡航規制手続きのためNWSLの試合を欠場へ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はザンビア女子代表選手が渡航規制により試合を欠場するというスポーツ関連ニュースであり、公衆衛生上の新たな感染拡大や深刻な影響を報じるものではない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダ等での既存エボラ流行に伴う米国CDCの渡航規制により、ザンビア代表選手の試合参加が影響を受けるというスポーツニュース。ザンビア国内でのエボラ発生を示す記述はなく、DRCも規制対象国として名前が挙がるのみで発生の詳細記述はないため、verified_locationsは空とした。

article.articleHeadline: Sông Đăk Bla chảy ngược: Làng cổ Kon K'Tu và ký ức đại dịch
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Đắk Bla River Flows Upstream: The Ancient Village of Kon K'Tu and the Memory of the Pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Ancient Ba Na village Kon K'Tu sits along the Đăk Bla River in Đăk Rơ Wa commune (Quảng Ngãi), near Kon Tum. Today it has about 150 households and roughly 700 residents, but a century-old smallpox outbreak decimated the community, sending many families to abandon their homes and leaving only a few families behind at one point; the village name is said to mean ‘abandoned village.’ The outbreak’s exact date is uncertain; a 19th-century smallpox account by missionary priest Pierre Dourisboure (Dân Làng Hồ, 1929) describes a Kon Tum outbreak that began with a Vietnamese parishioner and lasted about two years, affecting priests and locals, though it cannot be definitively linked to Kon K'Tu. Kon K'Tu later rebounded, once attracting foreign visitors for Ba Na culture, with homestays and crafts, yet the pandemic memory remains embedded in local storytelling and place names.

triage.headline_ja: ダクブラ川は逆流する：コントゥ村の古い集落と大流行の記憶
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は19世紀〜100年前の歴史的な天然痘流行に関する文化・歴史的読み物であり、現在進行中の公衆衛生事象ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は歴史的・文化的な回顧記事であり、現在のアウトブレイクではないため対象国の現行感染症イベントとしては扱わない。

article.articleHeadline: Genomic Copy Number Shifts Revealed in Plasmodium vivax Isolates From
article.articleSummary: Genome-wide CNV analysis of Plasmodium vivax from Northwestern India reveals CNVs linked to severe disease and drug resistance. In Bikaner, three cerebral malaria and three uncomplicated P. vivax isolates were analyzed using a custom 2×400K tiling array, confirming pure P. vivax infections. CNVs span all 14 chromosomes, affecting 2,138 genes, with sizes from ~100 bp to ~1.43 Mb; the largest CNV (~1.45 Mb) on chromosome 12 covers 316 genes. Large amplified blocks also occur on chromosomes 14 and 10. Notably, amplifications occur in three ABC transporter–family genes PVX_097025, PVX_080100, PVX_118100, and pvmdr1, consistent with mefloquine/artesunate resistance signals; chloroquine resistance markers show chr12 amplification and chr1 deletion. Surface antigens show extensive CNVs: all 24 tryptophan-rich antigens (TRAgs) amplified, PVX_088850 linked to PvMSP7; 23 serine-repeat antigens on chromosome 4, with 19 deletions. These patterns suggest genome-wide diversification impacting virulence and drug tolerance, within an endemic Indian setting.

triage.headline_ja: 重症マラリア症例由来の三日熱マラリア原虫分離株におけるゲノムコピー数変動が明らかに
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は研究室レベルのゲノム解析報告であり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や新規アウトブレイクを示すものではないため、トリアージ基準に該当しない。

article.articleHeadline: Health authorities launch improved vaccination program in Beni amid Congo Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: On Oct 16, 2026, health care and other front-line workers in Beni, Democratic Republic of Congo, received the Ervebo Ebola vaccine, as authorities launch an improved vaccination program amid an ongoing Congo Ebola outbreak. Ervebo has proved effective in previous outbreaks caused by the Zaire strain of Ebola. As of Oct 14, 2026, the Health Ministry reported 9,066 confirmed Ebola cases and 4,381 deaths nationwide. The vaccination effort in Beni underscores intensified public health measures in the affected region as authorities continue to confront the outbreak. These figures are the latest government tally cited in the report.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行の中、ベニで改良型ワクチン接種プログラムを保健当局が開始
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国で9,066人の確定症例と4,381人の死亡という深刻な規模のエボラ流行が継続しており、IHR基準・WPRO基準ともに複数該当するためフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: 致死率は約48%と高く、ワクチン接種拡大は流行制御のための対応策と考えられる。続報での感染拡大状況・国際的対応の推移を要確認。

article.articleHeadline: Não mô cầu khởi phát giống cúm, có thể tử vong trong 24 giờ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Meningococcal disease with flu-like onset can be fatal within 24 hours.
article.articleSummary: Meningococcal disease (Neisseria meningitidis) can start with flu-like symptoms but rapidly progress to septicemia and meningitis, potentially fatal within 24 hours in fulminant cases. In Ho Chi Minh City, three students from Hai Bà Trưng Secondary School in Hiệp Phước Commune were diagnosed with serogroup B meningococcal disease; one 12-year-old boy died, while the other two girls are hospitalized and stable at Bệnh viện Bệnh Nhiệt đới. Doctor Đinh Văn Thới notes that the bacterium colonizes 10–20% of people, mainly adolescents and young adults, and can escalate quickly from nonspecific fever to critical illness. Incubation averages 3–4 days (range 1–10). Globally, WHO reports about 1.2 million cases and 150,000 deaths annually; serogroups A, B, C, W, Y, and X drive invasive disease. In Vietnam since 2026, cases have appeared in Hanoi, Ha Tinh, Lao Cai, Lam Dong, Phú Quốc; A, B, C, W, Y circulate, with B/C/W notably reported recently. Transmission is via close respiratory contact; vaccination options include groups B, B+C, or A/C/W/Y (ACWY), with varying protection; ACWY provides about 85–100% protection under 55 and 77.4–91.7% for 56+ depending on serogroup. Vaccination is advised based on age and risk.

triage.headline_ja: 髄膜炎菌感染症はインフルエンザのような症状で発症し、24時間以内に死亡することもある
triage.triage_reason: ホーチミン市の学校で髄膜炎菌感染症のクラスター（1名死亡）が発生し、ベトナム国内複数省（ハノイ、ハティン、ラオカイ、ラムドン、フーコック）でも血清群B/C/W等の症例が報告されており、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性と重症度の高さからWPRO基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: 学校クラスターでの死亡例に加え、2026年以降ベトナム各地（ハノイ、ハティン、ラオカイ、ラムドン、フーコック）で複数血清群（A,B,C,W,Y）の症例報告があり、地理的広がりと感染しやすさの観点から注視が必要。国際的拡大や渡航制限の情報はなし。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia players to miss multiple NWSL games due to CDC's Ebola travel restrictions
article.articleSummary: East Africa Ebola outbreak (Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo) prompts CDC 21‑day U.S. re-entry restrictions for travelers from affected areas. Three Zambia women’s internationals in the NWSL—Barbra Banda (Orlando Pride), Racheal Kundananji (Chicago Stars), Prisca Chilufya (Angel City FC)—are expected to miss several weeks after taking part in Uganda on Oct 8 for CAF Olympics qualifiers; Chilufya was listed as excused in Friday’s report. The Copper Queens advanced 5‑3 on aggregate, with Banda scoring twice in the return leg. The NWSL is coordinating with clubs and U.S. immigration, and all players are in excellent health. Without a government exemption, the 21‑day restriction could lift around Oct 30, depending on when the team left Uganda, with the regular season ending Nov 1. This situation reflects ongoing travel constraints linked to East African Ebola activity.

triage.headline_ja: CDCのエボラ渡航制限により、ザンビア代表選手が複数のNWSL試合を欠場へ
triage.triage_reason: 東アフリカ（ウガンダ・DRC）でのエボラ発生に伴い米国CDCが21日間の渡航後再入国制限を既に発動しており、IHR基準（深刻性・異常性・国際的影響・渡航制限）に複数該当するため。

article.articleHeadline: Sandwich ELISA Offers Rapid Antigen Test for Feline Coronavirus Detection
article.articleSummary: Fujian, China, researchers developed and validated a double-antibody sandwich ELISA (DAS-ELISA) that detects the feline coronavirus (FCoV) spike protein directly in feline fecal samples and ascitic fluid, providing a low-cost, high-throughput alternative to RT-qPCR. Using a rabbit polyclonal capture antibody and a mouse monoclonal detection antibody against a truncated Type I FCoV spike protein (FCoV-SP), the assay achieved clinical sensitivity of 81.3% and specificity of 80.0% compared with RT-qPCR benchmarks. FCoV is a non-segmented positive-sense RNA virus of ~29 kb, with two pathogenic forms: feline enteric coronavirus (FECV), which is highly contagious and usually mild, and feline infectious peritonitis virus (FIPV), arising from mutations in FECV that disseminate systemically and cause fatal feline infectious peritonitis. The spike protein, comprising S1 and S2 domains, dictates antigenicity and host entry, and Serotype I is most prevalent worldwide. RT-qPCR remains the reference but has limitations in variant detection and lab requirements.

article.articleHeadline: WHO nâng mức độ sẵn sàng ứng phó dịch bệnh Ebola tại 22 quốc gia trên ba châu lục
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO raises readiness level to respond to Ebola virus disease in 22 countries across three continents.
article.articleSummary: WHO raises readiness to respond to Ebola virus disease across 22 countries in the East Med region, spanning three continents, with Djibouti, Somalia, and Sudan prioritized for urgent support. Although the region has yet to report an Ebola case, Bundibugyo lineage outbreaks have caused fatalities in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with one imported case confirmed in Kenya linked to the DRC outbreak. Ongoing conflict, displacement, and strained health systems threaten early detection and cross-border containment. WHO Director-General Tedros described the area as a humanitarian crisis hotspot. More than 117 million people in the occupied Palestinian territories, Sudan, Syria, Yemen rely on international aid. Between July and September, WHO sent expert teams to Djibouti, Somalia, and Sudan to assess readiness, identify surveillance and lab gaps, and bolster infection prevention, case management, and emergency coordination.

triage.headline_ja: WHOが3大陸22カ国でエボラウイルス病への対応準備レベルを引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: DRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ（ブンディブギョ系統）死亡例とケニアへの越境感染例が確認され、WHOが東地中海地域22カ国で対応準備を強化していることから、国際的拡大リスクと深刻な公衆衛生影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRC・ウガンダでのエボラ(ブンディブギョ系統)流行とケニアへの越境感染例、及びWHOによる東地中海地域22カ国への対応強化。対象国リストのうち実際の発生国はDRCのみ。スーダン、シリア、イエメン、ジブチ、ソマリア、ケニア、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Gut Bacterium E. coli Emerges as a Central Suspect in IgA Nephropathy
article.articleSummary: IgA nephropathy (IgAN), the globe’s most common primary glomerular disease, shows striking geographic variation with Japan: ~39–45 per million; France: ~25–31; China comprising ~30–40% of primary glomerular diseases in biopsies. A Microbial Biotechnology review ties gut E. coli enrichment to IgAN, suggesting active involvement in aberrant mucosal immunity and Gd-IgA1 production rather than a passive marker. Metagenomics of 40 patients/20 controls identified E. coli as the characteristic species (14.01% vs 5.54% relative abundance; P significant), with enrichment correlating with serum creatinine, proteinuria, and Oxford histology severity, and absent in membranous nephropathy. Potential strain- and mechanism-based drivers include Type 1 fimbriae (FimH) adhesion, type III secretion (EspF/EspG) compromising barrier function, and LPS/flagellin triggering TLR4/5, promoting BAFF/APRIL-driven IgA responses and Cosmc downregulation, fostering Gd-IgA1-containing immune complexes that deposit in mesangial tissue. Enrichment detectable at diagnosis; association, not proven causation, remains. Published 2026-10-17.

triage.headline_ja: 腸内細菌E. coliがIgA腎症の主要容疑者として浮上
triage.triage_reason: 感染症アウトブレイクではなく、IgA腎症の病因に関する基礎研究レビューであり、公衆衛生上の緊急性や感染拡大リスクは認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症のアウトブレイクではなく、腸内細菌叢と自己免疫性腎疾患（IgA腎症）の関連を扱う基礎医学研究。発生地域として挙げられた日本・フランス・中国は疾患の地理的有病率データの引用であり、感染イベントの発生国ではない。
